- 来源：`06_M1_基础框架任务拆解.md` 第 3.1 / 4.5 / 5.4 节 T28，依赖 T05

### 任务、流程与验证

这一步只做服务端 SQLite 建库和 schema 迁移。正式类型放在 `Server/CloudIsle.Server/Data/SqliteStore.cs`，命名空间 `CloudIsle.Server.Data`。沿用工程里已有的 `Microsoft.Data.Sqlite` 8.0.11，不升级包，不引用 Unity。`PlayerDb` 保持不动，不覆盖、不删除现有 PoC 库文件。

`Initialize` 接收数据库路径，先创建缺失的父目录，再打开连接。迁移连接启用外键，并把日志模式设为 WAL；忙等待只作用于这次连接。本项不保留长连接，也不实现 `ExecuteAsync`。T29 的工作队列在自己的连接上重新设置外键和忙等待。

当前 schema 版本是 1。版本记在 `schema_meta`：单行，主键固定为 1，`version` 为整数。没有版本记录时按版本 0 升级。升级包在一个事务里执行，全部成功后才把版本写成 1。失败则回滚，不留下成功版本，也不留下半套新表。库上的版本高于 1 时直接拒绝，不降级、不改原库。

版本 1 建立三张业务表，不插入账号或玩家：

| 表 | 约束 |
|---|---|
| `account` | `id` 整数主键；`username` 非空且数据库级唯一；`pwd_hash`、`salt` 非空；`created_at` 为整数毫秒。用户名按 SQLite 默认二进制比较，本项不做大小写折叠 |
| `player` | `id` 整数主键；`account_id` 非空、唯一，并引用 `account(id)`；其余列为 `nickname`、`level`、`exp`、`gold`、`gem`、`ticket`、`shard`、`bag_slots`、`guide_step`、`last_daily_reset`。列默认值取 03：等级 1、金币 200、钻石 300、抽卡券 5、背包 60 格，经验和碎片、引导步骤、每日重置为 0。初始化不插入玩家行 |
| `auth_token` | `token_hash` 主键；`player_id` 非空并引用 `player(id)`；`expires_at_ms` 非空；`revoked` 非空。只保存摘要列，不设计令牌原文 |

背包、地块等其余集合本项不建表。注册写入、密码派生、缓存和落库分别留在后续任务。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Globalization;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Data;

/// <summary>
/// 打开指定的 SQLite 库并迁移到当前 schema。业务 SQL 经唯一队列连接同步执行。
/// </summary>
public sealed class SqliteStore : IDisposable
{
    public const int CurrentVersion = 1;

    readonly object _gate = new();
    string? _databasePath;
    BlockingCollection<IWork>? _queue;
    Thread? _worker;
    bool _disposed;

    /// <summary>创建缺失的父目录，并把库迁移到当前版本。高于当前版本时拒绝且不改库。</summary>
    /// <param name="databasePath">数据库文件路径。空白时抛出异常。</param>
    public void Initialize(string databasePath)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(databasePath))
            throw new ArgumentException("数据库路径为空", nameof(databasePath));

        string fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(databasePath);
        string? directory = Path.GetDirectoryName(fullPath);
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory))
            Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);

        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(SqliteStore));
            if (_worker != null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("队列连接已打开，拒绝再次初始化");

            using var connection = new SqliteConnection(ConnectionString(fullPath));
            connection.Open();
            using (var pragma = connection.CreateCommand())
            {
                pragma.CommandText = "PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;";
                pragma.ExecuteNonQuery();
            }

            int version = ReadVersion(connection);
            if (version > CurrentVersion)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "数据库 schema 版本 {0} 高于当前版本 {1}，拒绝降级", version, CurrentVersion));

            if (version < CurrentVersion)
                MigrateToCurrent(connection);

            using var wal = connection.CreateCommand();
            wal.CommandText = "PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;";
            wal.ExecuteNonQuery();
            _databasePath = fullPath;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>把同步操作排进唯一的数据库连接。Task 只表示等待排队结果。</summary>
    /// <param name="operation">在队列线程上执行的同步操作。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">入队前取消则不执行。</param>
    public Task<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(Func<SqliteConnection, T> operation, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (operation == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(operation));

        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(SqliteStore));
            if (_databasePath == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("数据库尚未初始化");

            EnsureWorker();
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                return Task.FromCanceled<T>(ct);

            var item = new WorkItem<T>(operation, ct);
            _queue!.Add(item);
            return item.Task;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>拒绝新的入队，取消尚未开始的操作，并在当前操作结束后关闭连接。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        Thread? worker;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                return;
            Volatile.Write(ref _disposed, true);
            _queue?.CompleteAdding();
            worker = _worker;
        }

        if (worker != null && worker != Thread.CurrentThread)
            worker.Join();
    }

    /// <summary>第一次执行时启动唯一的队列线程。</summary>
    void EnsureWorker()
    {
        if (_worker != null)
            return;

        _queue = new BlockingCollection<IWork>(new ConcurrentQueue<IWork>());
        _worker = new Thread(Loop)
        {
            IsBackground = true,
            Name = "SqliteStore"
        };
        _worker.Start();
    }

    /// <summary>按入队顺序执行操作。失败后重新打开连接，再继续下一项。</summary>
    void Loop()
    {
        SqliteConnection? connection = null;
        try
        {
            connection = OpenConnection();
            foreach (IWork item in _queue!.GetConsumingEnumerable())
            {
                if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) || item.Cancellation.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    item.Cancel();
                    continue;
                }

                try
                {
                    if (connection == null)
                        connection = OpenConnection();
                    item.Run(connection);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    item.Fail(ex);
                    connection = Reopen(connection);
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            connection?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>关掉失败操作留下的连接，并打开一条新连接。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">失败时正在使用的连接，可以为空。</param>
    SqliteConnection? Reopen(SqliteConnection? connection)
    {
        connection?.Dispose();
        try
        {
            return OpenConnection();
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>打开队列使用的连接，并设置外键、忙等待和 WAL。</summary>
    SqliteConnection OpenConnection()
    {
        var connection = new SqliteConnection(ConnectionString(_databasePath!));
        connection.Open();
        using var pragma = connection.CreateCommand();
        pragma.CommandText = "PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000; PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;";
        pragma.ExecuteNonQuery();
        return connection;
    }

    /// <summary>生成不进入连接池的连接串。</summary>
    /// <param name="fullPath">数据库文件的绝对路径。</param>
    static string ConnectionString(string fullPath)
    {
        var builder = new SqliteConnectionStringBuilder
        {
            DataSource = fullPath,
            Mode = SqliteOpenMode.ReadWriteCreate,
            Pooling = false
        };
        return builder.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>读取 schema_meta。没有记录时返回 0。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">已经打开的连接。</param>
    static int ReadVersion(SqliteConnection connection)
    {
        using var exists = connection.CreateCommand();
        exists.CommandText = "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_meta' LIMIT 1;";
        if (exists.ExecuteScalar() is null)
            return 0;

        using var read = connection.CreateCommand();
        read.CommandText = "SELECT version FROM schema_meta WHERE id = 1;";
        object? value = read.ExecuteScalar();
        if (value is null || value is DBNull)
            return 0;
        return Convert.ToInt32(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    /// <summary>在一个事务里把库迁到版本 1。失败则回滚。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">已经打开的连接。</param>
    static void MigrateToCurrent(SqliteConnection connection)
    {
        using var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();
        Execute(connection, transaction, """
            CREATE TABLE account (
              id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
              username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
              pwd_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
              salt TEXT NOT NULL,
              created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
            );
            """);
        Execute(connection, transaction, """
            CREATE TABLE player (
              id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
              account_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES account(id),
              nickname TEXT NOT NULL,
              level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
              exp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
              gold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 200,
              gem INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 300,
              ticket INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
              shard INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
              bag_slots INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60,
              guide_step INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
              last_daily_reset INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
            );
            """);
        Execute(connection, transaction, """
            CREATE TABLE auth_token (
              token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
              player_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES player(id),
              expires_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
              revoked INTEGER NOT NULL
            );
            """);

        if (!TableExists(connection, transaction, "schema_meta"))
        {
            Execute(connection, transaction, """
                CREATE TABLE schema_meta (
                  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
                  version INTEGER NOT NULL
                );
                """);
            Execute(connection, transaction, "INSERT INTO schema_meta (id, version) VALUES (1, 1);");
        }
        else
        {
            using var update = connection.CreateCommand();
            update.Transaction = transaction;
            update.CommandText = "UPDATE schema_meta SET version = 1 WHERE id = 1;";
            if (update.ExecuteNonQuery() != 1)
                throw new InvalidDataException("schema_meta 缺少当前版本行，拒绝写成成功版本");
        }

        transaction.Commit();
    }

    /// <summary>在当前事务里判断表是否已经存在。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">已经打开的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="transaction">当前迁移事务。</param>
    /// <param name="name">表名。</param>
    static bool TableExists(SqliteConnection connection, SqliteTransaction transaction, string name)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.Transaction = transaction;
        command.CommandText = "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = $name LIMIT 1;";
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$name", name);
        return command.ExecuteScalar() is not null;
    }

    /// <summary>在当前事务里执行一条语句。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">已经打开的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="transaction">当前迁移事务。</param>
    /// <param name="sql">要执行的 SQL。</param>
    static void Execute(SqliteConnection connection, SqliteTransaction transaction, string sql)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.Transaction = transaction;
        command.CommandText = sql;
        command.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }

    interface IWork
    {
        /// <summary>入队时带上的取消令牌。</summary>
        CancellationToken Cancellation { get; }

        /// <summary>在队列线程上执行。</summary>
        /// <param name="connection">队列当前持有的连接。</param>
        void Run(SqliteConnection connection);

        /// <summary>这项操作不执行，等待任务以取消结束。</summary>
        void Cancel();

        /// <summary>把异常交给等待任务。</summary>
        /// <param name="exception">操作失败时的异常。</param>
        void Fail(Exception exception);
    }

    sealed class WorkItem<T> : IWork
    {
        readonly Func<SqliteConnection, T> _operation;
        readonly TaskCompletionSource<T> _completion = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        /// <summary>记下一次排队的同步操作。</summary>
        /// <param name="operation">在队列线程上执行的操作。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellation">入队时带上的取消令牌。</param>
        public WorkItem(Func<SqliteConnection, T> operation, CancellationToken cancellation)
        {
            _operation = operation;
            Cancellation = cancellation;
        }

        public CancellationToken Cancellation { get; }

        public Task<T> Task => _completion.Task;

        /// <summary>执行操作，并用返回值完成等待任务。</summary>
        /// <param name="connection">队列当前持有的唯一连接。</param>
        public void Run(SqliteConnection connection)
        {
            _completion.TrySetResult(_operation(connection));
        }

        /// <summary>这项操作不执行，等待任务以取消结束。</summary>
        public void Cancel() => _completion.TrySetCanceled();

        /// <summary>把操作抛出的异常交给等待任务。</summary>
        /// <param name="exception">操作或重新打开连接时的异常。</param>
        public void Fail(Exception exception) => _completion.TrySetException(exception);
    }
}
```

## T29：实现 SqliteStore.ExecuteAsync 数据库队列

- 来源：`06_M1_基础框架任务拆解.md` 第 4.5 / 5.4 节 T29，依赖 T28
- 需求：R-S02
- 依据：第 4.5 节 `Task<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(Func<SqliteConnection,T> operation, CancellationToken ct)`；同节说明队列内同步执行 SQL，Task 只表示等待排队结果
- 通过条件：并发提交无共享连接竞争；异常交付给调用方且队列继续
- 日期：2026-10-19

### 任务、流程与验证

这一步只给已经完成初始化的 `SqliteStore` 加上一条数据库工作队列。正式类型仍是 `Server/CloudIsle.Server/Data/SqliteStore.cs`。不改 schema，不实现玩家队列、缓存、密码和注册。

`Initialize` 继续只做建库和迁移，用完即关闭自己的短连接。尚未调用 `ExecuteAsync` 时，重复 `Initialize` 保持 T28 的行为。队列连接打开之后再调用 `Initialize` 直接拒绝，避免迁移连接和队列连接同时写库。

`ExecuteAsync` 在 `Initialize` 之前调用则失败。第一次调用时打开唯一一条长期连接，并在这条连接上重新设置外键、忙等待和 WAL。调用方把同步操作放进队列后等待 `Task`；操作在队列线程上执行，不使用 SQLite 的异步命令。同一时刻只有一个操作持有这条连接，后提交的操作按入队顺序等待。

操作抛出的异常只结束这一次 `Task`，队列不停止。队列随后关闭并重新打开同一路径的连接，清掉失败操作留下的未提交事务，再执行下一项。入队前取消令牌已经取消的操作不执行，对应 `Task` 以取消结束。已经开始的同步操作不中途打断。`Dispose` 拒绝新的入队，尚未开始的操作以取消结束，当前操作结束后关闭连接，便于测试删除临时库。

```csharp
Task<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(Func<Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.SqliteConnection, T> operation, CancellationToken ct)
```

#### 脚本：SqliteStore.ExecuteAsync 与队列

```csharp
    /// <summary>把同步操作排进唯一的数据库连接。Task 只表示等待排队结果。</summary>
    /// <param name="operation">在队列线程上执行的同步操作。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">入队前取消则不执行。</param>
    public Task<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(Func<SqliteConnection, T> operation, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (operation == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(operation));

        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(SqliteStore));
            if (_databasePath == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("数据库尚未初始化");

            EnsureWorker();
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                return Task.FromCanceled<T>(ct);

            var item = new WorkItem<T>(operation, ct);
            _queue!.Add(item);
            return item.Task;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>拒绝新的入队，取消尚未开始的操作，并在当前操作结束后关闭连接。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        Thread? worker;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                return;
            Volatile.Write(ref _disposed, true);
            _queue?.CompleteAdding();
            worker = _worker;
        }

        if (worker != null && worker != Thread.CurrentThread)
            worker.Join();
    }

    /// <summary>第一次执行时启动唯一的队列线程。</summary>
    void EnsureWorker()
    {
        if (_worker != null)
            return;

        _queue = new BlockingCollection<IWork>(new ConcurrentQueue<IWork>());
        _worker = new Thread(Loop)
        {
            IsBackground = true,
            Name = "SqliteStore"
        };
        _worker.Start();
    }

    /// <summary>按入队顺序执行操作。失败后重新打开连接，再继续下一项。</summary>
    void Loop()
    {
        SqliteConnection? connection = null;
        try
        {
            connection = OpenConnection();
            foreach (IWork item in _queue!.GetConsumingEnumerable())
            {
                if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) || item.Cancellation.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    item.Cancel();
                    continue;
                }

                try
                {
                    if (connection == null)
                        connection = OpenConnection();
                    item.Run(connection);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    item.Fail(ex);
                    connection = Reopen(connection);
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            connection?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>关掉失败操作留下的连接，并打开一条新连接。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">失败时正在使用的连接，可以为空。</param>
    SqliteConnection? Reopen(SqliteConnection? connection)
    {
        connection?.Dispose();
        try
        {
            return OpenConnection();
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }
```

### 问题经过

1. 时机：队列实现写入后直接跑测。原因：这一步没有新的编译错误。`Initialize` 仍在队列启动前关闭自己的短连接，`ExecuteAsync` 才打开长期连接。结果：过滤 `FullyQualifiedName~SqliteStore` 一次通过，总数 12，失败 0。其中队列 6 项，T28 回归 6 项。


### T29 协调复核补充：首次连接失败后的恢复

- [x] 复核场景：Initialize 成功后，数据库路径变成不可打开的目录，随后首次调用 ExecuteAsync。
- 问题：Loop 原先在逐项异常处理之外首次调用 OpenConnection，SQLite 打开失败会成为后台线程未处理异常，调用方也不能可靠收到失败。
- 原因：首次打开与后续重开走了不同的异常路径；OpenConnection 在打开/PRAGMA 失败时也未释放创建的连接。
- 修复：删除 foreach 之前的首次 OpenConnection，所有打开动作统一在逐项 try/catch 内执行；OpenConnection 失败时 Dispose 并重新抛出。异常由 item.Fail 交给调用方，下一项可以重试连接。
- 新增用例：InitialConnectionFailure_IsDeliveredAndQueueRecovers。使用隔离临时目录，初始化后把库移到同目录备份，在原路径创建空目录；等待 SqliteException；只删除该测试创建的空目录并恢复库，验证下一次查询成功。

```csharp
    /// <summary>按入队顺序执行操作。失败后重新打开连接，再继续下一项。</summary>
    void Loop()
    {
        SqliteConnection? connection = null;
        try
        {
            foreach (IWork item in _queue!.GetConsumingEnumerable())
            {
                if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) || item.Cancellation.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    item.Cancel();
                    continue;
                }

                try
                {
                    if (connection == null)
                        connection = OpenConnection();
                    item.Run(connection);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    item.Fail(ex);
                    connection = Reopen(connection);
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            connection?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>关掉失败操作留下的连接，并打开一条新连接。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">失败时正在使用的连接，可以为空。</param>
    SqliteConnection? Reopen(SqliteConnection? connection)
    {
        connection?.Dispose();
        try
        {
            return OpenConnection();
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>打开队列使用的连接，并设置外键、忙等待和 WAL。</summary>
    SqliteConnection OpenConnection()
    {
        var connection = new SqliteConnection(ConnectionString(_databasePath!));
        try
        {
            connection.Open();
            using var pragma = connection.CreateCommand();
            pragma.CommandText = "PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000; PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;";
            pragma.ExecuteNonQuery();
            return connection;
        }
        catch
        {
            connection.Dispose();
            throw;
        }
    }


```


## T30：实现 PlayerQueue.EnqueueAsync

- 来源：`06_M1_基础框架任务拆解.md` 第 4.5 / 5.4 节 T30，依赖 T05
- 需求：R-S02
- 依据：第 4.5 节 `Task EnqueueAsync(long playerId, Func<CancellationToken,Task> action, CancellationToken ct)`
- 通过条件：同玩家动作完成顺序等于入队顺序；抛异常后下一项仍执行
- 日期：2026-10-19

### 任务、流程与验证

这一步只做玩家动作队列。正式类型是 `Server/CloudIsle.Server/Players/PlayerQueue.cs`，命名空间 `CloudIsle.Server.Players`。不实现 PlayerStore、PlayerCache、存档或账号业务，也不改 SqliteStore。

`EnqueueAsync` 按 `playerId` 把动作放进该玩家自己的队列。同一玩家严格按成功入队的顺序执行：上一个动作返回的 Task 完整结束后，才取出下一项。不同玩家各有一个执行器，可以同时停在各自的动作里。动作抛出的异常只写到这次调用返回的 Task 上，执行器继续下一项。

每个玩家有一个可配置的正数上限，默认 `PlayerQueue.DefaultCapacity` 为 32。这个上限统计的是已经接单、尚未结束的动作，包含正在执行的那一项，不只是还排在后面的项。构造时传入 0 或负数会抛出 `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`。已经达到上限时，`EnqueueAsync` 同步抛出 `InvalidOperationException`，不保存、也不调用这次动作；前面的动作结束后，空位可以再次入队。

取消分成三种。入队前令牌已经取消：直接返回已取消任务，不建队列、不调用动作。已经排上但还没开始：轮到它时发现已取消，不调用动作，对应任务以取消结束，再推进下一项。已经开始：把取消传给动作，执行器必须等待该动作的 Task 真正返回后才开始同玩家的下一项，不能只结束等待就把串行放掉。

空队列的移除和新的入队使用同一把锁。执行器只有在锁内确认队列已空时才清除“已有执行器”标记；若字典里仍是这一条队列，才把玩家删掉。因此同一次清空不会留下两个执行器，空闲玩家也不会一直留在字典里。`Dispose` 把队列标成关闭后立刻返回：尚未开始的动作改为取消且不调用委托，正在执行的动作继续等到它自己结束，关闭过程不等待它。关闭之后以及与关闭并发的新入队，要么在进入队列前得到 `ObjectDisposedException`，要么是关闭前已经接单、随后被取消；这两种都结束，不把调用方挂住。

```csharp
Task EnqueueAsync(long playerId, Func<CancellationToken, Task> action, CancellationToken ct)
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Players;

/// <summary>
/// 按玩家串行执行异步动作。同一玩家严格按入队顺序执行；不同玩家各有执行器，可以并发。
/// 空闲玩家会从字典移除，避免一直留下历史玩家对象。
/// 不包含玩家存档、缓存或业务状态。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PlayerQueue : IDisposable
{
    /// <summary>未另行指定时，每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限。此上限包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
    public const int DefaultCapacity = 32;

    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, Lane> _lanes = new();
    bool _disposed;

    /// <summary>使用默认上限创建队列。</summary>
    public PlayerQueue()
        : this(DefaultCapacity)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>创建队列。</summary>
    /// <param name="capacity">每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限，必须是正数。包含正在执行的一项；达到上限时新的入队被拒绝。</param>
    public PlayerQueue(int capacity)
    {
        if (capacity <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(capacity), "每名玩家的队列上限必须是正数");
        Capacity = capacity;
    }

    /// <summary>每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限，包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
    public int Capacity { get; }

    /// <summary>当前仍占着执行器的玩家数量。空闲玩家会被移除，供测试观察回收。</summary>
    internal int ActiveLaneCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _lanes.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>等待指定玩家的当前执行器退出。玩家已经不在字典中时立即完成。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要观察的玩家。</param>
    internal Task WaitForIdleAsync(long playerId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (!_lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out Lane? lane))
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            return lane.Idle.Task;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>把动作排到指定玩家的队尾。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家键。同一键共享一个执行器，不同键可以同时执行。</param>
    /// <param name="action">到达队首且尚未取消时才调用。参数是该次动作的取消标记；返回的 Task 结束前不会开始同玩家的下一项。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">调用方取消标记。入队前已取消则不入队；排到队首时已取消则不调用动作；执行中取消只通知动作，仍要等它返回。</param>
    /// <returns>该次动作的完成任务。动作异常或取消只体现在这个任务上。</returns>
    public Task EnqueueAsync(long playerId, Func<CancellationToken, Task> action, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (action == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(action));

        Lane lane;
        bool startExecutor;
        Task queued;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(PlayerQueue));
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                return Task.FromCanceled(ct);

            if (!_lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out lane!))
            {
                lane = new Lane();
                _lanes.Add(playerId, lane);
            }

            if (lane.Accepted >= Capacity)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"玩家 {playerId} 的队列已满，上限为 {Capacity}，该上限包含正在执行的一项");
            }

            var item = new WorkItem(action, ct);
            lane.Waiting.Enqueue(item);
            lane.Accepted++;
            startExecutor = !lane.ExecutorRunning;
            if (startExecutor)
            {
                lane.ExecutorRunning = true;
                if (lane.Idle.Task.IsCompleted)
                    lane.Idle = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            }

            queued = item.Completion.Task;
        }

        // 锁外启动。锁内已经把 ExecutorRunning 设为真，后到的入队不会再创建执行器。
        if (startExecutor)
            Schedule(playerId, lane);
        return queued;
    }

    /// <summary>拒绝新的入队，取消尚未开始的动作，并立刻返回。正在执行的动作继续被等待，直到它自己结束。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        List<WorkItem> dropped = new();
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                return;
            _disposed = true;
            foreach (Lane lane in _lanes.Values)
            {
                lane.Current?.Linked.Cancel();
                dropped.AddRange(lane.DrainWaiting());
            }
        }

        CompleteDropped(dropped);
    }

    /// <summary>在锁外启动唯一执行器，并观察它的任务，避免未观察异常。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">这个执行器负责的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="lane">锁内刚刚登记的那一条队列。</param>
    void Schedule(long playerId, Lane lane)
    {
        Task worker = RunLaneAsync(playerId, lane);
        _ = ObserveAsync(worker);
    }

    /// <summary>吞掉执行器循环自身的异常。动作异常已经写到对应调用者的任务上。</summary>
    /// <param name="worker">执行器任务。</param>
    static async Task ObserveAsync(Task worker)
    {
        try
        {
            await worker.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // 循环内部负责把动作异常交给对应任务。这里只避免后台任务无人观察。
        }
    }

    /// <summary>按入队顺序执行这一名玩家的动作。队列排空时在同一把锁里摘掉执行器并移除玩家。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家键。</param>
    /// <param name="lane">只由这个执行器推进的队列。</param>
    async Task RunLaneAsync(long playerId, Lane lane)
    {
        while (true)
        {
            WorkItem? item;
            List<WorkItem> dropped;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_disposed || lane.Waiting.Count == 0)
                {
                    dropped = lane.DrainWaiting();
                    lane.Current = null;
                    lane.ExecutorRunning = false;
                    if (lane.Waiting.Count == 0
                        && lane.Accepted == 0
                        && _lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out Lane? mapped)
                        && ReferenceEquals(mapped, lane))
                    {
                        _lanes.Remove(playerId);
                    }

                    lane.Idle.TrySetResult();
                    item = null;
                }
                else
                {
                    item = lane.Waiting.Dequeue();
                    lane.Current = item;
                    dropped = new List<WorkItem>();
                }
            }

            CompleteDropped(dropped);
            if (item == null)
                return;

            await ExecuteAsync(lane, item).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>执行一项，或在它已经取消时跳过。无论成功、失败还是取消，都要等本次 Task 结束后才返回。</summary>
    /// <param name="lane">该项所属的玩家队列，用于清除“正在执行”标记。</param>
    /// <param name="item">已经从等待队列取出的动作。</param>
    async Task ExecuteAsync(Lane lane, WorkItem item)
    {
        Exception? error = null;
        bool canceled = false;
        try
        {
            if (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                canceled = true;
            }
            else
            {
                try
                {
                    Task? work = item.Action(item.Token);
                    if (work == null)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家队列动作返回了空 Task");
                    await work.ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    canceled = true;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    error = ex;
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(lane.Current, item))
                    lane.Current = null;
                lane.Accepted--;
            }
        }

        CancellationToken token = item.Token;
        if (canceled)
            item.Completion.TrySetCanceled(token);
        else if (error != null)
            item.Completion.TrySetException(error);
        else
            item.Completion.TrySetResult();
        item.Linked.Dispose();
    }

    /// <summary>把尚未开始的动作完成成取消，不调用其委托。</summary>
    /// <param name="dropped">从等待队列取出的动作。</param>
    static void CompleteDropped(List<WorkItem> dropped)
    {
        foreach (WorkItem item in dropped)
        {
            if (!item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                try
                {
                    item.Linked.Cancel();
                }
                catch (ObjectDisposedException)
                {
                    // 取消标记已经释放时，下面仍尝试结束调用者的任务。
                }
            }

            if (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
                item.Completion.TrySetCanceled(item.Token);
            else
                item.Completion.TrySetCanceled();
            try
            {
                item.Linked.Dispose();
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
                // 重复释放可以忽略。
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一名玩家的等待队列和唯一执行器标记。</summary>
    sealed class Lane
    {
        /// <summary>尚未开始的动作，顺序与成功入队的顺序一致。</summary>
        public Queue<WorkItem> Waiting { get; } = new();

        /// <summary>已接单且尚未结束的数量，包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
        public int Accepted;

        /// <summary>为真时已经有一个执行器会把本队列排空，新的入队不能再启动执行器。</summary>
        public bool ExecutorRunning;

        /// <summary>已经取出、正在等待其 Task 的动作。没有正在执行的动作时为空。</summary>
        public WorkItem? Current;

        /// <summary>执行器退出时完成。续体异步执行，避免在锁内重入。再次启动执行器时若已完成则换新。</summary>
        public TaskCompletionSource Idle = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        /// <summary>取出全部尚未开始的动作，并按取出数量减少已接单计数。</summary>
        public List<WorkItem> DrainWaiting()
        {
            var dropped = new List<WorkItem>(Waiting.Count);
            while (Waiting.Count > 0)
            {
                dropped.Add(Waiting.Dequeue());
                Accepted--;
            }

            return dropped;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一次入队。完成任务只代表这一次动作，不代表整条玩家队列。</summary>
    sealed class WorkItem
    {
        /// <summary>创建一次入队。</summary>
        /// <param name="action">队首才会调用的动作。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">调用方取消标记，与内部标记连接。</param>
        public WorkItem(Func<CancellationToken, Task> action, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            Action = action;
            Linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
            Completion = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        }

        /// <summary>业务动作。</summary>
        public Func<CancellationToken, Task> Action { get; }

        /// <summary>调用方取消或队列关闭时会取消的标记源。</summary>
        public CancellationTokenSource Linked { get; }

        /// <summary>传给动作的取消标记。</summary>
        public CancellationToken Token => Linked.Token;

        /// <summary>交还给 EnqueueAsync 调用者的完成源。</summary>
        public TaskCompletionSource Completion { get; }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>PlayerQueue 的顺序、并发、取消、容量、回收和关闭。</summary>
public sealed class PlayerQueueTests
{
    static TaskCompletionSource NewSignal() =>
        new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

    /// <summary>同一玩家三次入队的完成顺序与入队顺序一致。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task SamePlayer_CompletesInEnqueueOrder()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(8);
        var release = NewSignal();
        var order = new List<int>();

        Task first = queue.EnqueueAsync(1, async _ =>
        {
            await release.Task;
            order.Add(1);
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        Task second = queue.EnqueueAsync(1, _ =>
        {
            order.Add(2);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        Task third = queue.EnqueueAsync(1, _ =>
        {
            order.Add(3);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        release.TrySetResult();
        await Task.WhenAll(first, second, third).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(order, Is.EqualTo(new[] { 1, 2, 3 }));
    }

    /// <summary>两名玩家同时停在动作内部，说明不同玩家没有共用一把串行锁。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task DifferentPlayers_RunConcurrently()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(4);
        var release = NewSignal();
        var bothInside = NewSignal();
        int inside = 0;

        Task Enter(long playerId) => queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, async _ =>
        {
            if (Interlocked.Increment(ref inside) == 2)
                bothInside.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        Task first = Enter(10);
        Task second = Enter(11);
        await bothInside.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(inside, Is.EqualTo(2));
        release.TrySetResult();
        await Task.WhenAll(first, second).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
    }

    /// <summary>前一个动作的异常只出现在它自己的任务上，同玩家下一项仍会执行。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Exception_IsDeliveredAndNextRuns()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(4);
        var started = NewSignal();
        var release = NewSignal();
        bool nextRan = false;

        Task gate = queue.EnqueueAsync(5, async _ =>
        {
            started.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        Task failed = queue.EnqueueAsync(5, _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("boom"), CancellationToken.None);
        Task next = queue.EnqueueAsync(5, _ =>
        {
            nextRan = true;
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        release.TrySetResult();
        InvalidOperationException error = Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
            await failed.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
        await next.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await gate.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(error.Message, Is.EqualTo("boom"));
        Assert.That(nextRan, Is.True);
    }

    /// <summary>入队前或排队期间取消时，动作委托不会运行，后面的动作仍会运行。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task CancelWhileQueued_DoesNotRunAction()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(4);
        var started = NewSignal();
        var release = NewSignal();
        int sideEffects = 0;

        using var alreadyCanceled = new CancellationTokenSource();
        alreadyCanceled.Cancel();
        Task beforeQueue = queue.EnqueueAsync(6, _ =>
        {
            Interlocked.Increment(ref sideEffects);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, alreadyCanceled.Token);

        Task first = queue.EnqueueAsync(6, async _ =>
        {
            started.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        using var queuedCancel = new CancellationTokenSource();
        Task queued = queue.EnqueueAsync(6, _ =>
        {
            Interlocked.Increment(ref sideEffects);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, queuedCancel.Token);
        queuedCancel.Cancel();

        bool laterRan = false;
        Task later = queue.EnqueueAsync(6, _ =>
        {
            laterRan = true;
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        release.TrySetResult();
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () => await beforeQueue.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () => await queued.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
        await first.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await later.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(sideEffects, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(laterRan, Is.True);
    }

    /// <summary>执行中的协作取消不会在动作返回前启动同玩家的下一项。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task CancelWhileRunning_WaitsForActionBeforeNext()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(4);
        using var runningCancel = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var started = NewSignal();
        var sawCancel = NewSignal();
        var finish = NewSignal();
        var secondStarted = NewSignal();
        int busy = 0;
        int overlap = 0;

        Task running = queue.EnqueueAsync(7, async ct =>
        {
            if (Interlocked.Increment(ref busy) != 1)
                Interlocked.Increment(ref overlap);
            started.TrySetResult();
            using (ct.Register(() => sawCancel.TrySetResult()))
                await sawCancel.Task;
            await finish.Task;
            Interlocked.Decrement(ref busy);
        }, runningCancel.Token);

        await started.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Task second = queue.EnqueueAsync(7, _ =>
        {
            if (Interlocked.Increment(ref busy) != 1)
                Interlocked.Increment(ref overlap);
            secondStarted.TrySetResult();
            Interlocked.Decrement(ref busy);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        runningCancel.Cancel();
        await sawCancel.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(secondStarted.Task.IsCompleted, Is.False);
        Assert.That(running.IsCompleted, Is.False);

        finish.TrySetResult();
        await running.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await second.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(secondStarted.Task.IsCompleted, Is.True);
        Assert.That(overlap, Is.Zero);
    }

    /// <summary>上限包含正在执行的一项。满时同步拒绝且不调用动作；腾出位置后可以再入队。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Capacity_IncludesRunningItem_RejectsThenRecovers()
    {
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new PlayerQueue(0));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new PlayerQueue(-1));

        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(2);
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => queue.EnqueueAsync(8, null!, CancellationToken.None));

        var firstStarted = NewSignal();
        var releaseFirst = NewSignal();
        var secondStarted = NewSignal();
        var releaseSecond = NewSignal();
        int rejectedCalls = 0;

        Task first = queue.EnqueueAsync(8, async _ =>
        {
            firstStarted.TrySetResult();
            await releaseFirst.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await firstStarted.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        Task second = queue.EnqueueAsync(8, async _ =>
        {
            secondStarted.TrySetResult();
            await releaseSecond.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        InvalidOperationException full = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            queue.EnqueueAsync(8, _ =>
            {
                Interlocked.Increment(ref rejectedCalls);
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }, CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.That(full.Message, Does.Contain("包含正在执行"));
        Assert.That(rejectedCalls, Is.Zero);

        releaseFirst.TrySetResult();
        await secondStarted.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Task recovered = queue.EnqueueAsync(8, _ => Task.CompletedTask, CancellationToken.None);
        releaseSecond.TrySetResult();
        await Task.WhenAll(first, second, recovered).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
    }

    /// <summary>玩家队列清空并移除后，再次并发入队仍然只有一个执行器。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ReclaimedLane_AcceptsConcurrentEnqueueWithoutOverlap()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(32);
        const long playerId = 4;
        int overlap = 0;

        for (int round = 0; round < 25; round++)
        {
            await queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, _ => Task.CompletedTask, CancellationToken.None).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            await queue.WaitForIdleAsync(playerId).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            Assert.That(queue.ActiveLaneCount, Is.Zero);

            int busy = 0;
            var burst = new Task[8];
            for (int i = 0; i < burst.Length; i++)
            {
                burst[i] = Task.Run(() => queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, async _ =>
                {
                    if (Interlocked.Increment(ref busy) != 1)
                        Interlocked.Increment(ref overlap);
                    await Task.Yield();
                    Interlocked.Decrement(ref busy);
                }, CancellationToken.None));
            }

            await Task.WhenAll(burst).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            await queue.WaitForIdleAsync(playerId).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            Assert.That(queue.ActiveLaneCount, Is.Zero);
        }

        Assert.That(overlap, Is.Zero);
    }

    /// <summary>关闭后排队任务结束为取消，并发入队不会挂起，关闭之后的新入队被拒绝。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Dispose_CancelsQueuedWorkAndRejectsConcurrentEnqueue()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(8);
        var started = NewSignal();
        var release = NewSignal();
        int queuedSideEffects = 0;
        int concurrentSideEffects = 0;

        Task running = queue.EnqueueAsync(3, async _ =>
        {
            started.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        var pending = new Task[4];
        for (int i = 0; i < pending.Length; i++)
        {
            pending[i] = queue.EnqueueAsync(3, _ =>
            {
                Interlocked.Increment(ref queuedSideEffects);
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }, CancellationToken.None);
        }

        var go = NewSignal();
        var workers = new Task<string>[24];
        for (int i = 0; i < workers.Length; i++)
        {
            workers[i] = Task.Run(async () =>
            {
                await go.Task;
                try
                {
                    await queue.EnqueueAsync(9, _ =>
                    {
                        Interlocked.Increment(ref concurrentSideEffects);
                        return Task.CompletedTask;
                    }, CancellationToken.None);
                    return "ok";
                }
                catch (ObjectDisposedException)
                {
                    return "disposed";
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                {
                    return "canceled";
                }
            });
        }

        go.TrySetResult();
        queue.Dispose();
        string[] outcomes = await Task.WhenAll(workers).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        foreach (Task pendingTask in pending)
            Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () => await pendingTask.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));

        Assert.That(queuedSideEffects, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(running.IsCompleted, Is.False);
        foreach (string outcome in outcomes)
            Assert.That(outcome, Is.EqualTo("ok").Or.EqualTo("disposed").Or.EqualTo("canceled"));
        Assert.That(concurrentSideEffects, Is.EqualTo(outcomes.Count(static value => value == "ok")));
        Assert.Throws<ObjectDisposedException>(() => queue.EnqueueAsync(9, _ => Task.CompletedTask, CancellationToken.None));

        release.TrySetResult();
        await running.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
    }
}
```

### 问题经过

1. 时机：T30 章节和源码写入后执行上述 `dotnet test`。原因：编译通过，8 项玩家队列断言和 13 项 SQLite 回归都成功。结果：总计 21，失败 0，退出码 0。没有失败需要修复。

### T30 协调复核：关闭回调与同步提交

- [x] 问题场景一：正在执行的动作在取消令牌上注册了会抛异常的回调，随后 Dispose。
  - 原因：原实现持有全局锁调用 Cancel；Cancel 会同步执行外部回调，异常可能中断剩余玩家及排队任务的清理。
  - 修复：锁内只快照正在执行和等待中的项，锁外取消；单项取消回调抛出 AggregateException 不阻止其余清理；动作已结束产生的 ObjectDisposedException 也单独处理。
- [x] 问题场景二：动作在第一个 await 前有同步阻塞代码，调用 EnqueueAsync 无法及时返回。
  - 原因：原 Schedule 直接调用异步方法，同步前缀仍在提交线程执行。
  - 修复：通过 Task.Run 启动已登记的唯一玩家执行器；同玩家串行标记仍由全局锁保护。

复验命令（--no-restore 使用已恢复依赖；--filter 限定玩家队列与SQLite；--results-directory 指定证据目录；两个 --logger 分别保存机器结果及详细控制台）：

```powershell
dotnet test Server/CloudIsle.Tests/CloudIsle.Tests.csproj --no-restore --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~PlayerQueue|FullyQualifiedName~SqliteStore' --results-directory Docs/Acceptance/M1/20261019-T30 --logger 'trx;LogFileName=T30-review.trx' --logger 'console;verbosity=normal'
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Players;

/// <summary>
/// 按玩家串行执行异步动作。同一玩家严格按入队顺序执行；不同玩家各有执行器，可以并发。
/// 空闲玩家会从字典移除，避免一直留下历史玩家对象。
/// 不包含玩家存档、缓存或业务状态。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PlayerQueue : IDisposable
{
    /// <summary>未另行指定时，每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限。此上限包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
    public const int DefaultCapacity = 32;

    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, Lane> _lanes = new();
    bool _disposed;

    /// <summary>使用默认上限创建队列。</summary>
    public PlayerQueue()
        : this(DefaultCapacity)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>创建队列。</summary>
    /// <param name="capacity">每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限，必须是正数。包含正在执行的一项；达到上限时新的入队被拒绝。</param>
    public PlayerQueue(int capacity)
    {
        if (capacity <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(capacity), "每名玩家的队列上限必须是正数");
        Capacity = capacity;
    }

    /// <summary>每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限，包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
    public int Capacity { get; }

    /// <summary>当前仍占着执行器的玩家数量。空闲玩家会被移除，供测试观察回收。</summary>
    internal int ActiveLaneCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _lanes.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>等待指定玩家的当前执行器退出。玩家已经不在字典中时立即完成。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要观察的玩家。</param>
    internal Task WaitForIdleAsync(long playerId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (!_lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out Lane? lane))
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            return lane.Idle.Task;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>把动作排到指定玩家的队尾。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家键。同一键共享一个执行器，不同键可以同时执行。</param>
    /// <param name="action">到达队首且尚未取消时才调用。参数是该次动作的取消标记；返回的 Task 结束前不会开始同玩家的下一项。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">调用方取消标记。入队前已取消则不入队；排到队首时已取消则不调用动作；执行中取消只通知动作，仍要等它返回。</param>
    /// <returns>该次动作的完成任务。动作异常或取消只体现在这个任务上。</returns>
    public Task EnqueueAsync(long playerId, Func<CancellationToken, Task> action, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (action == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(action));

        Lane lane;
        bool startExecutor;
        Task queued;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(PlayerQueue));
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                return Task.FromCanceled(ct);

            if (!_lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out lane!))
            {
                lane = new Lane();
                _lanes.Add(playerId, lane);
            }

            if (lane.Accepted >= Capacity)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"玩家 {playerId} 的队列已满，上限为 {Capacity}，该上限包含正在执行的一项");
            }

            var item = new WorkItem(action, ct);
            lane.Waiting.Enqueue(item);
            lane.Accepted++;
            startExecutor = !lane.ExecutorRunning;
            if (startExecutor)
            {
                lane.ExecutorRunning = true;
                if (lane.Idle.Task.IsCompleted)
                    lane.Idle = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            }

            queued = item.Completion.Task;
        }

        // 锁外启动。锁内已经把 ExecutorRunning 设为真，后到的入队不会再创建执行器。
        if (startExecutor)
            Schedule(playerId, lane);
        return queued;
    }

    /// <summary>拒绝新的入队，取消尚未开始的动作，并立刻返回。正在执行的动作继续被等待，直到它自己结束。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        List<WorkItem> dropped = new();
        List<WorkItem> running = new();
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                return;
            _disposed = true;
            foreach (Lane lane in _lanes.Values)
            {
                if (lane.Current != null)
                    running.Add(lane.Current);
                dropped.AddRange(lane.DrainWaiting());
            }
        }

        // Cancel 会同步调用外部注册的回调，必须离开全局锁；一个回调抛异常不能中断其他玩家清理。
        foreach (WorkItem item in running)
        {
            try { item.Linked.Cancel(); }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException) { /* 动作已经正常结束并释放了标记。 */ }
            catch (AggregateException) { /* 回调错误不能阻止队列关闭及待处理任务完成。 */ }
        }
        CompleteDropped(dropped);
    }

    /// <summary>在锁外启动唯一执行器，并观察它的任务，避免未观察异常。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">这个执行器负责的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="lane">锁内刚刚登记的那一条队列。</param>
    void Schedule(long playerId, Lane lane)
    {
        // 入队只负责提交；同步执行到首个 await 的业务代码也不能阻塞提交者。
        Task worker = Task.Run(() => RunLaneAsync(playerId, lane));
        _ = ObserveAsync(worker);
    }

    /// <summary>吞掉执行器循环自身的异常。动作异常已经写到对应调用者的任务上。</summary>
    /// <param name="worker">执行器任务。</param>
    static async Task ObserveAsync(Task worker)
    {
        try
        {
            await worker.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // 循环内部负责把动作异常交给对应任务。这里只避免后台任务无人观察。
        }
    }

    /// <summary>按入队顺序执行这一名玩家的动作。队列排空时在同一把锁里摘掉执行器并移除玩家。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家键。</param>
    /// <param name="lane">只由这个执行器推进的队列。</param>
    async Task RunLaneAsync(long playerId, Lane lane)
    {
        while (true)
        {
            WorkItem? item;
            List<WorkItem> dropped;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_disposed || lane.Waiting.Count == 0)
                {
                    dropped = lane.DrainWaiting();
                    lane.Current = null;
                    lane.ExecutorRunning = false;
                    if (lane.Waiting.Count == 0
                        && lane.Accepted == 0
                        && _lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out Lane? mapped)
                        && ReferenceEquals(mapped, lane))
                    {
                        _lanes.Remove(playerId);
                    }

                    lane.Idle.TrySetResult();
                    item = null;
                }
                else
                {
                    item = lane.Waiting.Dequeue();
                    lane.Current = item;
                    dropped = new List<WorkItem>();
                }
            }

            CompleteDropped(dropped);
            if (item == null)
                return;

            await ExecuteAsync(lane, item).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>执行一项，或在它已经取消时跳过。无论成功、失败还是取消，都要等本次 Task 结束后才返回。</summary>
    /// <param name="lane">该项所属的玩家队列，用于清除“正在执行”标记。</param>
    /// <param name="item">已经从等待队列取出的动作。</param>
    async Task ExecuteAsync(Lane lane, WorkItem item)
    {
        Exception? error = null;
        bool canceled = false;
        try
        {
            if (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                canceled = true;
            }
            else
            {
                try
                {
                    Task? work = item.Action(item.Token);
                    if (work == null)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家队列动作返回了空 Task");
                    await work.ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    canceled = true;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    error = ex;
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(lane.Current, item))
                    lane.Current = null;
                lane.Accepted--;
            }
        }

        CancellationToken token = item.Token;
        if (canceled)
            item.Completion.TrySetCanceled(token);
        else if (error != null)
            item.Completion.TrySetException(error);
        else
            item.Completion.TrySetResult();
        item.Linked.Dispose();
    }

    /// <summary>把尚未开始的动作完成成取消，不调用其委托。</summary>
    /// <param name="dropped">从等待队列取出的动作。</param>
    static void CompleteDropped(List<WorkItem> dropped)
    {
        foreach (WorkItem item in dropped)
        {
            if (!item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                try
                {
                    item.Linked.Cancel();
                }
                catch (ObjectDisposedException)
                {
                    // 取消标记已经释放时，下面仍尝试结束调用者的任务。
                }
            }

            if (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
                item.Completion.TrySetCanceled(item.Token);
            else
                item.Completion.TrySetCanceled();
            try
            {
                item.Linked.Dispose();
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
                // 重复释放可以忽略。
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一名玩家的等待队列和唯一执行器标记。</summary>
    sealed class Lane
    {
        /// <summary>尚未开始的动作，顺序与成功入队的顺序一致。</summary>
        public Queue<WorkItem> Waiting { get; } = new();

        /// <summary>已接单且尚未结束的数量，包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
        public int Accepted;

        /// <summary>为真时已经有一个执行器会把本队列排空，新的入队不能再启动执行器。</summary>
        public bool ExecutorRunning;

        /// <summary>已经取出、正在等待其 Task 的动作。没有正在执行的动作时为空。</summary>
        public WorkItem? Current;

        /// <summary>执行器退出时完成。续体异步执行，避免在锁内重入。再次启动执行器时若已完成则换新。</summary>
        public TaskCompletionSource Idle = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        /// <summary>取出全部尚未开始的动作，并按取出数量减少已接单计数。</summary>
        public List<WorkItem> DrainWaiting()
        {
            var dropped = new List<WorkItem>(Waiting.Count);
            while (Waiting.Count > 0)
            {
                dropped.Add(Waiting.Dequeue());
                Accepted--;
            }

            return dropped;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一次入队。完成任务只代表这一次动作，不代表整条玩家队列。</summary>
    sealed class WorkItem
    {
        /// <summary>创建一次入队。</summary>
        /// <param name="action">队首才会调用的动作。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">调用方取消标记，与内部标记连接。</param>
        public WorkItem(Func<CancellationToken, Task> action, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            Action = action;
            Linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
            Completion = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        }

        /// <summary>业务动作。</summary>
        public Func<CancellationToken, Task> Action { get; }

        /// <summary>调用方取消或队列关闭时会取消的标记源。</summary>
        public CancellationTokenSource Linked { get; }

        /// <summary>传给动作的取消标记。</summary>
        public CancellationToken Token => Linked.Token;

        /// <summary>交还给 EnqueueAsync 调用者的完成源。</summary>
        public TaskCompletionSource Completion { get; }
    }
}
``` 

```csharp
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>PlayerQueue 的顺序、并发、取消、容量、回收和关闭。</summary>
public sealed class PlayerQueueTests
{
    /// <summary>用户取消回调抛异常时，仍取消排队项且不会提前开始它。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Dispose_ThrowingCancellationCallback_StillCompletesQueuedTasks()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var started = NewSignal();
        var release = NewSignal();
        Task running = queue.EnqueueAsync(1, async ct =>
        {
            using var registration = ct.Register(() => throw new InvalidOperationException("callback"));
            started.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        bool ran = false;
        Task pending = queue.EnqueueAsync(1, _ => { ran = true; return Task.CompletedTask; }, CancellationToken.None);
        try
        {
            Assert.DoesNotThrow(() => queue.Dispose());
            Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () => await pending.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
            Assert.That(ran, Is.False);
            Assert.That(running.IsCompleted, Is.False);
        }
        finally { release.TrySetResult(); }
        await running.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
    }

    /// <summary>业务动作在首次 await 前同步阻塞时，提交任务仍能返回。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task SynchronousAction_DoesNotBlockEnqueueCaller()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var started = NewSignal();
        var release = NewSignal();
        Task<Task> submission = Task.Factory.StartNew(() => queue.EnqueueAsync(1, _ =>
        {
            started.TrySetResult();
            release.Task.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None), CancellationToken.None, TaskCreationOptions.DenyChildAttach, TaskScheduler.Default);
        Task? action = null;
        try
        {
            await started.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            action = await submission.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            Assert.That(action.IsCompleted, Is.False);
        }
        finally { release.TrySetResult(); }
        await (action ?? await submission).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
    }

    static TaskCompletionSource NewSignal() =>
        new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

    /// <summary>同一玩家三次入队的完成顺序与入队顺序一致。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task SamePlayer_CompletesInEnqueueOrder()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(8);
        var release = NewSignal();
        var order = new List<int>();

        Task first = queue.EnqueueAsync(1, async _ =>
        {
            await release.Task;
            order.Add(1);
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        Task second = queue.EnqueueAsync(1, _ =>
        {
            order.Add(2);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        Task third = queue.EnqueueAsync(1, _ =>
        {
            order.Add(3);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        release.TrySetResult();
        await Task.WhenAll(first, second, third).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(order, Is.EqualTo(new[] { 1, 2, 3 }));
    }

    /// <summary>两名玩家同时停在动作内部，说明不同玩家没有共用一把串行锁。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task DifferentPlayers_RunConcurrently()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(4);
        var release = NewSignal();
        var bothInside = NewSignal();
        int inside = 0;

        Task Enter(long playerId) => queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, async _ =>
        {
            if (Interlocked.Increment(ref inside) == 2)
                bothInside.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        Task first = Enter(10);
        Task second = Enter(11);
        await bothInside.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(inside, Is.EqualTo(2));
        release.TrySetResult();
        await Task.WhenAll(first, second).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
    }

    /// <summary>前一个动作的异常只出现在它自己的任务上，同玩家下一项仍会执行。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Exception_IsDeliveredAndNextRuns()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(4);
        var started = NewSignal();
        var release = NewSignal();
        bool nextRan = false;

        Task gate = queue.EnqueueAsync(5, async _ =>
        {
            started.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        Task failed = queue.EnqueueAsync(5, _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("boom"), CancellationToken.None);
        Task next = queue.EnqueueAsync(5, _ =>
        {
            nextRan = true;
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        release.TrySetResult();
        InvalidOperationException error = Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
            await failed.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
        await next.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await gate.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(error.Message, Is.EqualTo("boom"));
        Assert.That(nextRan, Is.True);
    }

    /// <summary>入队前或排队期间取消时，动作委托不会运行，后面的动作仍会运行。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task CancelWhileQueued_DoesNotRunAction()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(4);
        var started = NewSignal();
        var release = NewSignal();
        int sideEffects = 0;

        using var alreadyCanceled = new CancellationTokenSource();
        alreadyCanceled.Cancel();
        Task beforeQueue = queue.EnqueueAsync(6, _ =>
        {
            Interlocked.Increment(ref sideEffects);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, alreadyCanceled.Token);

        Task first = queue.EnqueueAsync(6, async _ =>
        {
            started.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        using var queuedCancel = new CancellationTokenSource();
        Task queued = queue.EnqueueAsync(6, _ =>
        {
            Interlocked.Increment(ref sideEffects);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, queuedCancel.Token);
        queuedCancel.Cancel();

        bool laterRan = false;
        Task later = queue.EnqueueAsync(6, _ =>
        {
            laterRan = true;
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        release.TrySetResult();
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () => await beforeQueue.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () => await queued.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
        await first.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await later.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(sideEffects, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(laterRan, Is.True);
    }

    /// <summary>执行中的协作取消不会在动作返回前启动同玩家的下一项。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task CancelWhileRunning_WaitsForActionBeforeNext()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(4);
        using var runningCancel = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var started = NewSignal();
        var sawCancel = NewSignal();
        var finish = NewSignal();
        var secondStarted = NewSignal();
        int busy = 0;
        int overlap = 0;

        Task running = queue.EnqueueAsync(7, async ct =>
        {
            if (Interlocked.Increment(ref busy) != 1)
                Interlocked.Increment(ref overlap);
            started.TrySetResult();
            using (ct.Register(() => sawCancel.TrySetResult()))
                await sawCancel.Task;
            await finish.Task;
            Interlocked.Decrement(ref busy);
        }, runningCancel.Token);

        await started.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Task second = queue.EnqueueAsync(7, _ =>
        {
            if (Interlocked.Increment(ref busy) != 1)
                Interlocked.Increment(ref overlap);
            secondStarted.TrySetResult();
            Interlocked.Decrement(ref busy);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        runningCancel.Cancel();
        await sawCancel.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(secondStarted.Task.IsCompleted, Is.False);
        Assert.That(running.IsCompleted, Is.False);

        finish.TrySetResult();
        await running.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await second.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(secondStarted.Task.IsCompleted, Is.True);
        Assert.That(overlap, Is.Zero);
    }

    /// <summary>上限包含正在执行的一项。满时同步拒绝且不调用动作；腾出位置后可以再入队。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Capacity_IncludesRunningItem_RejectsThenRecovers()
    {
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new PlayerQueue(0));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new PlayerQueue(-1));

        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(2);
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => queue.EnqueueAsync(8, null!, CancellationToken.None));

        var firstStarted = NewSignal();
        var releaseFirst = NewSignal();
        var secondStarted = NewSignal();
        var releaseSecond = NewSignal();
        int rejectedCalls = 0;

        Task first = queue.EnqueueAsync(8, async _ =>
        {
            firstStarted.TrySetResult();
            await releaseFirst.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await firstStarted.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        Task second = queue.EnqueueAsync(8, async _ =>
        {
            secondStarted.TrySetResult();
            await releaseSecond.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        InvalidOperationException full = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            queue.EnqueueAsync(8, _ =>
            {
                Interlocked.Increment(ref rejectedCalls);
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }, CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.That(full.Message, Does.Contain("包含正在执行"));
        Assert.That(rejectedCalls, Is.Zero);

        releaseFirst.TrySetResult();
        await secondStarted.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Task recovered = queue.EnqueueAsync(8, _ => Task.CompletedTask, CancellationToken.None);
        releaseSecond.TrySetResult();
        await Task.WhenAll(first, second, recovered).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
    }

    /// <summary>玩家队列清空并移除后，再次并发入队仍然只有一个执行器。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ReclaimedLane_AcceptsConcurrentEnqueueWithoutOverlap()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(32);
        const long playerId = 4;
        int overlap = 0;

        for (int round = 0; round < 25; round++)
        {
            await queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, _ => Task.CompletedTask, CancellationToken.None).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            await queue.WaitForIdleAsync(playerId).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            Assert.That(queue.ActiveLaneCount, Is.Zero);

            int busy = 0;
            var burst = new Task[8];
            for (int i = 0; i < burst.Length; i++)
            {
                burst[i] = Task.Run(() => queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, async _ =>
                {
                    if (Interlocked.Increment(ref busy) != 1)
                        Interlocked.Increment(ref overlap);
                    await Task.Yield();
                    Interlocked.Decrement(ref busy);
                }, CancellationToken.None));
            }

            await Task.WhenAll(burst).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            await queue.WaitForIdleAsync(playerId).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            Assert.That(queue.ActiveLaneCount, Is.Zero);
        }

        Assert.That(overlap, Is.Zero);
    }

    /// <summary>关闭后排队任务结束为取消，并发入队不会挂起，关闭之后的新入队被拒绝。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Dispose_CancelsQueuedWorkAndRejectsConcurrentEnqueue()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(8);
        var started = NewSignal();
        var release = NewSignal();
        int queuedSideEffects = 0;
        int concurrentSideEffects = 0;

        Task running = queue.EnqueueAsync(3, async _ =>
        {
            started.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        var pending = new Task[4];
        for (int i = 0; i < pending.Length; i++)
        {
            pending[i] = queue.EnqueueAsync(3, _ =>
            {
                Interlocked.Increment(ref queuedSideEffects);
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }, CancellationToken.None);
        }

        var go = NewSignal();
        var workers = new Task<string>[24];
        for (int i = 0; i < workers.Length; i++)
        {
            workers[i] = Task.Run(async () =>
            {
                await go.Task;
                try
                {
                    await queue.EnqueueAsync(9, _ =>
                    {
                        Interlocked.Increment(ref concurrentSideEffects);
                        return Task.CompletedTask;
                    }, CancellationToken.None);
                    return "ok";
                }
                catch (ObjectDisposedException)
                {
                    return "disposed";
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                {
                    return "canceled";
                }
            });
        }

        go.TrySetResult();
        queue.Dispose();
        string[] outcomes = await Task.WhenAll(workers).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        foreach (Task pendingTask in pending)
            Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () => await pendingTask.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));

        Assert.That(queuedSideEffects, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(running.IsCompleted, Is.False);
        foreach (string outcome in outcomes)
            Assert.That(outcome, Is.EqualTo("ok").Or.EqualTo("disposed").Or.EqualTo("canceled"));
        Assert.That(concurrentSideEffects, Is.EqualTo(outcomes.Count(static value => value == "ok")));
        Assert.Throws<ObjectDisposedException>(() => queue.EnqueueAsync(9, _ => Task.CompletedTask, CancellationToken.None));

        release.TrySetResult();
        await running.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
    }
}

```


## T31：实现 PlayerStore 与 PlayerCache

- 来源：`06_M1_基础框架任务拆解.md` 第 3.1 / 4.5 / 5.4 节 T31，依赖 T29/T30
- 需求：R-S02
- 依据：第 3.1 节 `PlayerState`；第 4.5 节 `PlayerStore.LoadAsync` / `SaveAsync`、`PlayerCache.GetAsync` / `MarkDirty` / `Remove`；04 第 7.3 节玩家基础列与完整快照
- 通过条件：首次加载走数据库，后续访问复用缓存；只能在对应玩家队列中访问或修改状态
- 日期：2026-10-19
- 范围：不实现 T32 及以后。不实现 5 秒定时器、登出落库、注册或登录。不新增生产玩法写接口。不改 PoC 库，不在生产路径插入账号。

### 任务、流程与验证

玩家状态分三层。`PlayerState` 是一次已经配对的快照：`PlayerId`、`PlayerFullData Data`、`Revision`、`SavedRevision`。`Dirty` 只在 `Revision != SavedRevision` 时为真，没有单独的脏标记字段。`PlayerStore` 只负责经 `SqliteStore.ExecuteAsync` 做参数化读写，不另开数据库线程。`PlayerCache` 把成功加载的结果留在内存里，并规定这些内存只能由 `PlayerQueue` 正在执行的同一 `playerId` 动作访问。

队列所有权用 `AsyncLocal` 实际校验。`PlayerQueue` 在调用动作之前写入当前玩家，动作返回后恢复原值。`PlayerCache` 的读取、标脏、修改昵称夹具、确认保存、持有和移除都会调用 `PlayerQueue.IsCurrentPlayer`。不在任何玩家动作里，或当前动作属于别的玩家时，抛出 `InvalidOperationException`。调用方不能只靠注释约束自己。

`GetAsync` 第一次调用 `PlayerStore.LoadAsync`。加载抛错时不放入字典，避免留下半成品。同一玩家之后的 `GetAsync` 不再查询。返回值是缓存条目的深拷贝：`PlayerFullData.Clone()` 与当时的 `Revision`、`SavedRevision` 在同一把锁里读取。调用方改返回对象不会改缓存。`PlayerFullData` 本身可变，因此不能把缓存里的那一份直接交给队列外。

测试要改昵称时，只走测试夹具 `PlayerCache.ReplaceNickname`（`internal`）。它仍要求当前就是该玩家的队列动作，改的是缓存里的那一份，并把 `Revision` 加一。这不是对外玩法接口。`MarkDirty` 不改业务字段，只把 `Revision` 加一。两者在 `long.MaxValue` 时拒绝回绕。

保存不在 `PlayerStore` 里清脏。`SaveAsync` 一开始就把数据和 `Revision` 拷成独立快照，再交给 SQLite 队列。一个事务里更新正式 `player` 基础列，并写入或替换 `player_snapshot`。任一步失败则回滚，不留下新基础列配旧快照，或相反。成功之后缓存仍是脏的，直到同玩家队列调用 `ConfirmSaved(playerId, savedRevision)`。只有被确认的版本不大于当前 `Revision`、且不小于已确认的 `SavedRevision` 时才前移 `SavedRevision`。若保存期间又有修改，`Revision` 更大，`Dirty` 仍为真。`AcquireHold` 给后续 `SaveService` 留活跃持有：`Remove` 在 `Dirty` 或持有计数大于 0 时拒绝。本项不启动定时保存。

数据映射：

| 快照 | 库 |
|---|---|
| `Info.PlayerId` | 必须等于 `player.id`，保存不改主键 |
| `Info.Nickname` / `Level` / `Exp` / `Gold` / `Gem` / `Ticket` / `Shard` / `BagSlots` / `GuideStep` | 同名 `player` 列，与快照同一事务更新 |
| `player.last_daily_reset`、`player.account_id` | 不在 `PlayerFullData` 里。保存不改这两列 |
| `Bag`、`Plots`、`Nodes`、`Tools`、`Facilities`、`Orders`、`GachaStates`、`Activities` 以及 `OrderProgress`、`Home`、`Avatar` | `player_snapshot.body`，整份 `PlayerFullData` 的 protobuf |
| 已成功写入的 `Revision` | `player_snapshot.saved_revision`。载入后内存中的 `Revision` 与 `SavedRevision` 都等于它 |

没有快照行的旧玩家：用 `player` 列组装 `Info`，重复字段保持 protobuf 的空集合，`OrderProgress`、`Home`、`Avatar` 保持 null。不把列默认值再填进这些空集合，也不另造账号。快照体存在但 `Info` 缺失、`PlayerId` 对不上，或基础列与 `Info` 不一致时，加载失败并且不进缓存。

Schema 从 1 升到 2。版本小于 1 时仍先建 T28 的 `account`、`player`、`auth_token`、`schema_meta`；版本小于 2 时只追加空的 `player_snapshot(player_id 主键并引用 player，saved_revision，body)`。同一事务末尾把 `schema_meta.version` 写成 2。失败回滚。高于 2 的库拒绝且不改。T29 的队列异常后重开连接逻辑不改。

```csharp
Task SaveAsync(PlayerState snapshot, CancellationToken ct)
Task<PlayerState> GetAsync(long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
void MarkDirty(long playerId)
void Remove(long playerId)
void ConfirmSaved(long playerId, long savedRevision)
IDisposable AcquireHold(long playerId)
```
