#### Server/CloudIsle.Server/Players/PlayerQueue.cs

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Players;

/// <summary>
/// 按玩家串行执行异步动作。同一玩家严格按入队顺序执行；不同玩家各有执行器，可以并发。
/// 空闲玩家会从字典移除，避免一直留下历史玩家对象。
/// 不包含玩家存档、缓存或业务状态。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PlayerQueue : IDisposable
{
    /// <summary>未另行指定时，每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限。此上限包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
    public const int DefaultCapacity = 32;

    /// <summary>当前异步流正在执行的玩家。只由执行器在调用动作前写入，动作结束后恢复。</summary>
    static readonly AsyncLocal<ExecutionScope?> CurrentScope = new();

    /// <summary>动作及其派生异步流共用的生命周期；动作结束时统一失效。</summary>
    sealed class ExecutionScope
    {
        public readonly long PlayerId;
        public int Active = 1;

        /// <param name="playerId">本次动作所属玩家。</param>
        public ExecutionScope(long playerId) { PlayerId = playerId; }
    }

    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, Lane> _lanes = new();
    bool _disposed;

    /// <summary>使用默认上限创建队列。</summary>
    public PlayerQueue()
        : this(DefaultCapacity)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>创建队列。</summary>
    /// <param name="capacity">每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限，必须是正数。包含正在执行的一项；达到上限时新的入队被拒绝。</param>
    public PlayerQueue(int capacity)
    {
        if (capacity <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(capacity), "每名玩家的队列上限必须是正数");
        Capacity = capacity;
    }

    /// <summary>每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限，包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
    public int Capacity { get; }

    /// <summary>当前异步流是否正在执行这名玩家的队列动作。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要核对的玩家。与执行器写入的玩家不同，或根本不在动作里时返回 false。</param>
    public static bool IsCurrentPlayer(long playerId)
    {
        ExecutionScope? scope = CurrentScope.Value;
        return scope != null && scope.PlayerId == playerId && Volatile.Read(ref scope.Active) != 0;
    }

    /// <summary>当前仍占着执行器的玩家数量。空闲玩家会被移除，供测试观察回收。</summary>
    internal int ActiveLaneCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _lanes.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>等待指定玩家的当前执行器退出。玩家已经不在字典中时立即完成。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要观察的玩家。</param>
    internal Task WaitForIdleAsync(long playerId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (!_lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out Lane? lane))
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            return lane.Idle.Task;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>把动作排到指定玩家的队尾。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家键。同一键共享一个执行器，不同键可以同时执行。</param>
    /// <param name="action">到达队首且尚未取消时才调用。参数是该次动作的取消标记；返回的 Task 结束前不会开始同玩家的下一项。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">调用方取消标记。入队前已取消则不入队；排到队首时已取消则不调用动作；执行中取消只通知动作，仍要等它返回。</param>
    /// <returns>该次动作的完成任务。动作异常或取消只体现在这个任务上。</returns>
    public Task EnqueueAsync(long playerId, Func<CancellationToken, Task> action, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (action == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(action));

        Lane lane;
        bool startExecutor;
        Task queued;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(PlayerQueue));
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                return Task.FromCanceled(ct);

            if (!_lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out lane!))
            {
                lane = new Lane();
                _lanes.Add(playerId, lane);
            }

            if (lane.Accepted >= Capacity)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"玩家 {playerId} 的队列已满，上限为 {Capacity}，该上限包含正在执行的一项");
            }

            var item = new WorkItem(action, ct);
            lane.Waiting.Enqueue(item);
            lane.Accepted++;
            startExecutor = !lane.ExecutorRunning;
            if (startExecutor)
            {
                lane.ExecutorRunning = true;
                if (lane.Idle.Task.IsCompleted)
                    lane.Idle = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            }

            queued = item.Completion.Task;
        }

        // 锁外启动。锁内已经把 ExecutorRunning 设为真，后到的入队不会再创建执行器。
        if (startExecutor)
            Schedule(playerId, lane);
        return queued;
    }

    /// <summary>拒绝新的入队，取消尚未开始的动作，并立刻返回。正在执行的动作继续被等待，直到它自己结束。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        List<WorkItem> dropped = new();
        List<WorkItem> running = new();
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                return;
            _disposed = true;
            foreach (Lane lane in _lanes.Values)
            {
                if (lane.Current != null)
                    running.Add(lane.Current);
                dropped.AddRange(lane.DrainWaiting());
            }
        }

        // Cancel 会同步调用外部注册的回调，必须离开全局锁；一个回调抛异常不能中断其他玩家清理。
        foreach (WorkItem item in running)
        {
            try { item.Linked.Cancel(); }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException) { /* 动作已经正常结束并释放了标记。 */ }
            catch (AggregateException) { /* 回调错误不能阻止队列关闭及待处理任务完成。 */ }
        }
        CompleteDropped(dropped);
    }

    /// <summary>在锁外启动唯一执行器，并观察它的任务，避免未观察异常。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">这个执行器负责的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="lane">锁内刚刚登记的那一条队列。</param>
    void Schedule(long playerId, Lane lane)
    {
        // 入队只负责提交；同步执行到首个 await 的业务代码也不能阻塞提交者。
        Task worker = Task.Run(() => RunLaneAsync(playerId, lane));
        _ = ObserveAsync(worker);
    }

    /// <summary>吞掉执行器循环自身的异常。动作异常已经写到对应调用者的任务上。</summary>
    /// <param name="worker">执行器任务。</param>
    static async Task ObserveAsync(Task worker)
    {
        try
        {
            await worker.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // 循环内部负责把动作异常交给对应任务。这里只避免后台任务无人观察。
        }
    }

    /// <summary>按入队顺序执行这一名玩家的动作。队列排空时在同一把锁里摘掉执行器并移除玩家。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家键。</param>
    /// <param name="lane">只由这个执行器推进的队列。</param>
    async Task RunLaneAsync(long playerId, Lane lane)
    {
        while (true)
        {
            WorkItem? item;
            List<WorkItem> dropped;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_disposed || lane.Waiting.Count == 0)
                {
                    dropped = lane.DrainWaiting();
                    lane.Current = null;
                    lane.ExecutorRunning = false;
                    if (lane.Waiting.Count == 0
                        && lane.Accepted == 0
                        && _lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out Lane? mapped)
                        && ReferenceEquals(mapped, lane))
                    {
                        _lanes.Remove(playerId);
                    }

                    lane.Idle.TrySetResult();
                    item = null;
                }
                else
                {
                    item = lane.Waiting.Dequeue();
                    lane.Current = item;
                    dropped = new List<WorkItem>();
                }
            }

            CompleteDropped(dropped);
            if (item == null)
                return;

            await ExecuteAsync(playerId, lane, item).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>执行一项，或在它已经取消时跳过。无论成功、失败还是取消，都要等本次 Task 结束后才返回。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">这一项所属的玩家。只在动作执行期间写进异步流。</param>
    /// <param name="lane">该项所属的玩家队列，用于清除“正在执行”标记。</param>
    /// <param name="item">已经从等待队列取出的动作。</param>
    async Task ExecuteAsync(long playerId, Lane lane, WorkItem item)
    {
        Exception? error = null;
        bool canceled = false;
        try
        {
            if (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                canceled = true;
            }
            else
            {
                ExecutionScope? previous = CurrentScope.Value;
                var scope = new ExecutionScope(playerId);
                CurrentScope.Value = scope;
                try
                {
                    Task? work = item.Action(item.Token);
                    if (work == null)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家队列动作返回了空 Task");
                    await work.ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    canceled = true;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    error = ex;
                }
                finally
                {
                    Volatile.Write(ref scope.Active, 0);
                    CurrentScope.Value = previous;
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(lane.Current, item))
                    lane.Current = null;
                lane.Accepted--;
            }
        }

        CancellationToken token = item.Token;
        if (canceled)
            item.Completion.TrySetCanceled(token);
        else if (error != null)
            item.Completion.TrySetException(error);
        else
            item.Completion.TrySetResult();
        item.Linked.Dispose();
    }

    /// <summary>把尚未开始的动作完成成取消，不调用其委托。</summary>
    /// <param name="dropped">从等待队列取出的动作。</param>
    static void CompleteDropped(List<WorkItem> dropped)
    {
        foreach (WorkItem item in dropped)
        {
            if (!item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                try
                {
                    item.Linked.Cancel();
                }
                catch (ObjectDisposedException)
                {
                    // 取消标记已经释放时，下面仍尝试结束调用者的任务。
                }
            }

            if (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
                item.Completion.TrySetCanceled(item.Token);
            else
                item.Completion.TrySetCanceled();
            try
            {
                item.Linked.Dispose();
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
                // 重复释放可以忽略。
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一名玩家的等待队列和唯一执行器标记。</summary>
    sealed class Lane
    {
        /// <summary>尚未开始的动作，顺序与成功入队的顺序一致。</summary>
        public Queue<WorkItem> Waiting { get; } = new();

        /// <summary>已接单且尚未结束的数量，包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
        public int Accepted;

        /// <summary>为真时已经有一个执行器会把本队列排空，新的入队不能再启动执行器。</summary>
        public bool ExecutorRunning;

        /// <summary>已经取出、正在等待其 Task 的动作。没有正在执行的动作时为空。</summary>
        public WorkItem? Current;

        /// <summary>执行器退出时完成。续体异步执行，避免在锁内重入。再次启动执行器时若已完成则换新。</summary>
        public TaskCompletionSource Idle = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        /// <summary>取出全部尚未开始的动作，并按取出数量减少已接单计数。</summary>
        public List<WorkItem> DrainWaiting()
        {
            var dropped = new List<WorkItem>(Waiting.Count);
            while (Waiting.Count > 0)
            {
                dropped.Add(Waiting.Dequeue());
                Accepted--;
            }

            return dropped;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一次入队。完成任务只代表这一次动作，不代表整条玩家队列。</summary>
    sealed class WorkItem
    {
        /// <summary>创建一次入队。</summary>
        /// <param name="action">队首才会调用的动作。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">调用方取消标记，与内部标记连接。</param>
        public WorkItem(Func<CancellationToken, Task> action, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            Action = action;
            Linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
            Completion = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        }

        /// <summary>业务动作。</summary>
        public Func<CancellationToken, Task> Action { get; }

        /// <summary>调用方取消或队列关闭时会取消的标记源。</summary>
        public CancellationTokenSource Linked { get; }

        /// <summary>传给动作的取消标记。</summary>
        public CancellationToken Token => Linked.Token;

        /// <summary>交还给 EnqueueAsync 调用者的完成源。</summary>
        public TaskCompletionSource Completion { get; }
    }
}
```

#### Server/CloudIsle.Server/Players/PlayerCache.cs

```csharp
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Data;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Players;

/// <summary>
/// 玩家内存缓存。只有 PlayerQueue 正在执行的同一玩家动作可以访问或修改。
/// 不负责定时保存。保存成功后要由调用方在该玩家队列里 ConfirmSaved。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PlayerCache
{
    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, Entry> _entries = new();
    readonly PlayerStore _store;

    /// <summary>使用指定的玩家存储。缓存不自己打开数据库连接。</summary>
    /// <param name="store">加载和保存都走它的 SQLite 队列。</param>
    public PlayerCache(PlayerStore store)
    {
        _store = store ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(store));
    }

    /// <summary>当前缓存中的玩家数量，供测试观察移除和失败不入缓存。</summary>
    internal int Count
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _entries.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>取得玩家快照。第一次查数据库，之后复用缓存。返回值是独立深拷贝。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要读取的玩家。当前异步流必须正在执行这名玩家的队列动作。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">传给数据库加载。取消时不放入缓存。</param>
    public async Task<PlayerState> GetAsync(long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_entries.TryGetValue(playerId, out Entry? cached))
                return cached.Capture(playerId);
        }

        PlayerState loaded = await _store.LoadAsync(playerId, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(playerId, out Entry? cached))
            {
                cached = new Entry(loaded.Data, loaded.Revision, loaded.SavedRevision);
                _entries.Add(playerId, cached);
            }

            return cached.Capture(playerId);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>只把版本加一，不改玩家数据。已经载入的玩家才会被标脏。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要标脏的玩家。必须是当前队列动作的玩家。</param>
    public void MarkDirty(long playerId)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
            Bump(Required(playerId));
    }

    /// <summary>从缓存移除已经保存且没有活跃持有的玩家。脏数据或仍被持有时拒绝。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要移除的玩家。必须是当前队列动作的玩家，且已经在缓存中。</param>
    public void Remove(long playerId)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            Entry entry = Required(playerId);
            if (entry.Revision != entry.SavedRevision)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家仍有未保存修改，拒绝移除");
            if (entry.Holds > 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家仍被活跃持有，拒绝移除");
            _entries.Remove(playerId);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>确认某个版本已经成功写入。不大于当前版本时才前移 SavedRevision；期间又有修改则仍算脏。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要确认的玩家。必须是当前队列动作的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="savedRevision">已经成功写入数据库的那个版本。</param>
    public void ConfirmSaved(long playerId, long savedRevision)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        if (savedRevision < 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(savedRevision), "已保存版本不能为负");

        lock (_gate)
        {
            Entry entry = Required(playerId);
            if (savedRevision > entry.Revision)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("确认的保存版本超出当前版本");
            if (savedRevision < entry.SavedRevision)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("拒绝把已保存版本回退");
            entry.SavedRevision = savedRevision;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>登记一次活跃持有。后续保存服务可在落库期间持有，本项不启动定时器。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要持有的玩家。必须是当前队列动作的玩家，且已经载入。</param>
    /// <returns>在同一玩家队列里释放的句柄。重复释放不会把计数减成负数。</returns>
    public IDisposable AcquireHold(long playerId)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            Required(playerId).Holds++;
            return new Hold(this, playerId);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>测试夹具用来修改缓存中的昵称，并让版本加一。不是生产玩法接口。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要修改的玩家。必须是当前队列动作的玩家，且已经载入。</param>
    /// <param name="nickname">新的昵称。写入缓存里的 Info，不直接写数据库。</param>
    internal void ReplaceNickname(long playerId, string nickname)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        if (nickname == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(nickname));

        lock (_gate)
        {
            Entry entry = Required(playerId);
            // 版本到达上限时必须在改变任何业务字段之前拒绝。
            Bump(entry);
            if (entry.Data.Info == null)
                entry.Data.Info = new PlayerInfo { PlayerId = playerId };
            entry.Data.Info.Nickname = nickname;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>减少一次持有。必须仍处在该玩家的队列动作里。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要释放的玩家。</param>
    void ReleaseHold(long playerId)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            Entry entry = Required(playerId);
            if (entry.Holds <= 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家没有可释放的持有");
            entry.Holds--;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>核对当前异步流就是这名玩家的队列动作。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">调用方声称要访问的玩家。</param>
    static void RequireCurrent(long playerId)
    {
        if (!PlayerQueue.IsCurrentPlayer(playerId))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"玩家 {playerId} 的状态只能由该玩家队列中的动作访问或修改");
    }

    /// <summary>取出已经载入的条目。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家主键。</param>
    Entry Required(long playerId)
    {
        if (!_entries.TryGetValue(playerId, out Entry? entry))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"玩家 {playerId} 尚未载入缓存");
        return entry;
    }

    /// <summary>把版本加一。已经到达上限时拒绝，避免回绕。</summary>
    /// <param name="entry">要递增的缓存条目。</param>
    static void Bump(Entry entry)
    {
        if (entry.Revision == long.MaxValue)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家版本已到上限");
        entry.Revision++;
    }

    /// <summary>一名玩家的缓存条目。对外只交出深拷贝。</summary>
    sealed class Entry
    {
        /// <summary>记下加载得到的那一份数据。调用方拿到的是它的拷贝。</summary>
        /// <param name="data">缓存持有的玩家数据。</param>
        /// <param name="revision">当前内存版本。</param>
        /// <param name="savedRevision">已确认保存的版本。</param>
        public Entry(PlayerFullData data, long revision, long savedRevision)
        {
            Data = data;
            Revision = revision;
            SavedRevision = savedRevision;
        }

        /// <summary>缓存持有的玩家数据。</summary>
        public PlayerFullData Data { get; }

        /// <summary>当前内存版本。</summary>
        public long Revision { get; set; }

        /// <summary>已确认保存的版本。</summary>
        public long SavedRevision { get; set; }

        /// <summary>尚未释放的活跃持有次数。</summary>
        public int Holds { get; set; }

        /// <summary>同时拷贝数据和两个版本。</summary>
        /// <param name="playerId">缓存键上的玩家主键。不从可变的 Info 里重新取值。</param>
        public PlayerState Capture(long playerId)
        {
            return new PlayerState(playerId, Data.Clone(), Revision, SavedRevision);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一次持有。释放时回到缓存计数。</summary>
    sealed class Hold : IDisposable
    {
        readonly PlayerCache _cache;
        readonly long _playerId;
        int _released;

        /// <summary>记下要释放的缓存和玩家。</summary>
        /// <param name="cache">发出这次持有的缓存。</param>
        /// <param name="playerId">被持有的玩家。</param>
        public Hold(PlayerCache cache, long playerId)
        {
            _cache = cache;
            _playerId = playerId;
        }

        /// <summary>在该玩家队列中把持有计数减一。重复调用不再减少。</summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            lock (this)
            {
                if (_released != 0)
                    return;
                // 验证与释放成功后才消耗句柄，错误异步上下文调用不能泄漏持有计数。
                _cache.ReleaseHold(_playerId);
                _released = 1;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

#### Server/CloudIsle.Server/Data/PlayerStore.cs

```csharp
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using Google.Protobuf;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Data;

/// <summary>
/// 经 SqliteStore 的唯一队列读写玩家快照。不另开数据库线程，也不修改缓存里的脏标记。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PlayerStore
{
    readonly SqliteStore _store;
    int _loadQueryCount;

    /// <summary>使用已经初始化的库。</summary>
    /// <param name="store">提供队列连接的 SQLite 存储。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public PlayerStore(SqliteStore store)
    {
        _store = store ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(store));
    }

    /// <summary>实际执行过的加载查询次数。缓存命中不会增加。</summary>
    internal int LoadQueryCount => Volatile.Read(ref _loadQueryCount);

    /// <summary>按主键加载一名玩家。没有玩家行时失败，不插入账号或玩家。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家主键，必须是正数。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">入队前取消则不查询。</param>
    public Task<PlayerState> LoadAsync(long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (playerId <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(playerId), "玩家主键必须是正数");

        return _store.ExecuteAsync(connection =>
        {
            Interlocked.Increment(ref _loadQueryCount);
            return Read(connection, playerId);
        }, ct);
    }

    /// <summary>把一份完整快照写入正式玩家列和快照表。调用当下就复制数据和版本。</summary>
    /// <param name="snapshot">要保存的快照。Info 必须存在，且 Info.PlayerId 等于 PlayerId。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">入队前取消则不写库。</param>
    public Task SaveAsync(PlayerState snapshot, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (snapshot == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(snapshot));
        if (snapshot.Data.Info == null)
            throw new ArgumentException("快照缺少 Info", nameof(snapshot));
        if (snapshot.Data.Info.PlayerId != snapshot.PlayerId)
            throw new ArgumentException("快照 Info.PlayerId 与 PlayerId 不一致", nameof(snapshot));

        PlayerFullData copy = snapshot.Data.Clone();
        long playerId = snapshot.PlayerId;
        long revision = snapshot.Revision;
        byte[] body = copy.ToByteArray();
        return _store.ExecuteAsync(connection =>
        {
            Write(connection, playerId, copy.Info, revision, body);
            return true;
        }, ct);
    }

    /// <summary>读取玩家行。没有快照时用基础列组装空集合；有快照时必须和基础列一致。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">队列当前持有的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">要读取的玩家主键。</param>
    static PlayerState Read(SqliteConnection connection, long playerId)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = """
            SELECT p.nickname, p.level, p.exp, p.gold, p.gem, p.ticket, p.shard, p.bag_slots, p.guide_step,
                   s.saved_revision, s.body
            FROM player p
            LEFT JOIN player_snapshot s ON s.player_id = p.id
            WHERE p.id = $playerId;
            """;
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$playerId", playerId);
        using var reader = command.ExecuteReader();
        if (!reader.Read())
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"玩家 {playerId} 不存在");

        var row = new BaseRow(
            reader.GetString(0),
            reader.GetInt32(1),
            reader.GetInt32(2),
            reader.GetInt64(3),
            reader.GetInt64(4),
            reader.GetInt64(5),
            reader.GetInt64(6),
            reader.GetInt32(7),
            reader.GetInt32(8));

        if (reader.IsDBNull(10))
            return new PlayerState(playerId, FromBaseRow(playerId, row), 0, 0);

        long savedRevision = reader.GetInt64(9);
        if (savedRevision < 0)
            throw new InvalidDataException("已保存版本不能为负");

        byte[] body = (byte[])reader.GetValue(10);
        PlayerFullData data = Parse(body);
        EnsureMatches(playerId, data, row);
        return new PlayerState(playerId, data, savedRevision, savedRevision);
    }

    /// <summary>在一个事务里更新基础列并替换快照。任一步失败都回滚。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">队列当前持有的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">要更新的玩家主键。不存在时失败，不插入新玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="info">要写回正式玩家列的基础字段。</param>
    /// <param name="revision">这次成功写入后记录的版本。</param>
    /// <param name="body">调用时已经序列化好的完整 PlayerFullData。</param>
    static void Write(SqliteConnection connection, long playerId, PlayerInfo info, long revision, byte[] body)
    {
        using var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();
        // 已成功提交的新版本不能被迟到的旧快照覆盖。
        using (var current = connection.CreateCommand())
        {
            current.Transaction = transaction;
            current.CommandText = "SELECT saved_revision FROM player_snapshot WHERE player_id = $playerId;";
            current.Parameters.AddWithValue("$playerId", playerId);
            object? saved = current.ExecuteScalar();
            if (saved != null && saved != DBNull.Value && Convert.ToInt64(saved) > revision)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("拒绝用旧版本覆盖已保存的玩家快照");
        }
        using (var update = connection.CreateCommand())
        {
            update.Transaction = transaction;
            update.CommandText = """
                UPDATE player
                SET nickname = $nickname,
                    level = $level,
                    exp = $exp,
                    gold = $gold,
                    gem = $gem,
                    ticket = $ticket,
                    shard = $shard,
                    bag_slots = $bagSlots,
                    guide_step = $guideStep
                WHERE id = $playerId;
                """;
            update.Parameters.AddWithValue("$nickname", info.Nickname);
            update.Parameters.AddWithValue("$level", info.Level);
            update.Parameters.AddWithValue("$exp", info.Exp);
            update.Parameters.AddWithValue("$gold", info.Gold);
            update.Parameters.AddWithValue("$gem", info.Gem);
            update.Parameters.AddWithValue("$ticket", info.Ticket);
            update.Parameters.AddWithValue("$shard", info.Shard);
            update.Parameters.AddWithValue("$bagSlots", info.BagSlots);
            update.Parameters.AddWithValue("$guideStep", info.GuideStep);
            update.Parameters.AddWithValue("$playerId", playerId);
            if (update.ExecuteNonQuery() != 1)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"玩家 {playerId} 不存在，拒绝保存");
        }

        using (var snapshot = connection.CreateCommand())
        {
            snapshot.Transaction = transaction;
            snapshot.CommandText = """
                INSERT INTO player_snapshot (player_id, saved_revision, body)
                VALUES ($playerId, $revision, $body)
                ON CONFLICT(player_id) DO UPDATE SET
                  saved_revision = excluded.saved_revision,
                  body = excluded.body;
                """;
            snapshot.Parameters.AddWithValue("$playerId", playerId);
            snapshot.Parameters.AddWithValue("$revision", revision);
            snapshot.Parameters.Add("$body", SqliteType.Blob).Value = body;
            if (snapshot.ExecuteNonQuery() != 1)
                throw new InvalidDataException("玩家快照没有写成一行");
        }

        transaction.Commit();
    }

    /// <summary>用正式玩家列组装快照。重复字段保持空集合，三个嵌套消息保持 null。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家主键，写入 Info.PlayerId。</param>
    /// <param name="row">正式玩家表上的基础列。last_daily_reset 不在协议里，不放进快照。</param>
    static PlayerFullData FromBaseRow(long playerId, BaseRow row)
    {
        return new PlayerFullData
        {
            Info = new PlayerInfo
            {
                PlayerId = playerId,
                Nickname = row.Nickname,
                Level = row.Level,
                Exp = row.Exp,
                Gold = row.Gold,
                Gem = row.Gem,
                Ticket = row.Ticket,
                Shard = row.Shard,
                BagSlots = row.BagSlots,
                GuideStep = row.GuideStep
            }
        };
    }

    /// <summary>解析快照体。字节不是合法 protobuf 时失败。</summary>
    /// <param name="body">player_snapshot.body。</param>
    static PlayerFullData Parse(byte[] body)
    {
        try
        {
            return PlayerFullData.Parser.ParseFrom(body);
        }
        catch (InvalidProtocolBufferException ex)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("玩家快照无法解析", ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>核对快照里的基础字段和正式玩家列。不一致时拒绝载入。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">行主键。</param>
    /// <param name="data">刚解析出的快照。</param>
    /// <param name="row">同一行的正式基础列。</param>
    static void EnsureMatches(long playerId, PlayerFullData data, BaseRow row)
    {
        if (data.Info == null)
            throw new InvalidDataException("玩家快照缺少 Info，拒绝载入");
        if (data.Info.PlayerId != playerId
            || data.Info.Nickname != row.Nickname
            || data.Info.Level != row.Level
            || data.Info.Exp != row.Exp
            || data.Info.Gold != row.Gold
            || data.Info.Gem != row.Gem
            || data.Info.Ticket != row.Ticket
            || data.Info.Shard != row.Shard
            || data.Info.BagSlots != row.BagSlots
            || data.Info.GuideStep != row.GuideStep)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("玩家基础列与快照 Info 不一致，拒绝载入");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>正式 player 表上、且协议 Info 也有的那些列。</summary>
    /// <param name="Nickname">昵称。</param>
    /// <param name="Level">等级。</param>
    /// <param name="Exp">经验。</param>
    /// <param name="Gold">金币。</param>
    /// <param name="Gem">钻石。</param>
    /// <param name="Ticket">抽卡券。</param>
    /// <param name="Shard">碎片。</param>
    /// <param name="BagSlots">背包格数。</param>
    /// <param name="GuideStep">引导步骤。</param>
    readonly record struct BaseRow(
        string Nickname,
        int Level,
        int Exp,
        long Gold,
        long Gem,
        long Ticket,
        long Shard,
        int BagSlots,
        int GuideStep);
}
```

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Data;
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

public sealed class PlayerCacheTests
{
    /// <summary>动作结束后，派生任务继承的异步上下文不能继续访问玩家状态。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task EscapedChild_AfterActionEnds_CannotModifyCache()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann", 42);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(new PlayerStore(store));
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        Task? child = null;
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            child = Task.Run(async () =>
            {
                await release.Task;
                Assert.That(PlayerQueue.IsCurrentPlayer(11), Is.False);
                Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "escaped"));
            });
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        release.TrySetResult();
        await child!.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            Assert.That((await cache.GetAsync(11, ct)).Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Ann"));
        }, CancellationToken.None);
    }

    /// <summary>错误上下文释放失败后，仍能回到玩家队列正确释放同一句柄。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Hold_DisposeOutsideQueue_DoesNotConsumeHandle()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann", 42);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(new PlayerStore(store));
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        IDisposable? hold = null;
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            hold = cache.AcquireHold(11);
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => hold!.Dispose());
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, _ =>
        {
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => cache.Remove(11));
            hold!.Dispose();
            hold.Dispose();
            cache.Remove(11);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(cache.Count, Is.Zero);
    }

    /// <summary>旧版本保存失败时，基础列和完整快照都保持新版本。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task StaleSnapshot_CannotOverwriteNewerSavedRevision()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann", 42);
        var players = new PlayerStore(store);
        PlayerFullData data = (await players.LoadAsync(11, CancellationToken.None)).Data;
        data.Info.Nickname = "new";
        await players.SaveAsync(new PlayerState(11, data, 2, 0), CancellationToken.None);
        data.Info.Nickname = "stale";
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
            await players.SaveAsync(new PlayerState(11, data, 1, 0), CancellationToken.None));
        PlayerState reloaded = await players.LoadAsync(11, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(reloaded.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("new"));
        Assert.That(reloaded.SavedRevision, Is.EqualTo(2));
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task FirstLoad_HitsCacheWithoutSecondQuery()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann", 42);
        var players = new PlayerStore(store);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(players);
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();

        PlayerState? first = null;
        PlayerState? second = null;
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            first = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            second = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.That(players.LoadQueryCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(second!.Data, Is.Not.SameAs(first!.Data));
        Assert.That(second.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Ann"));
        Assert.That(second.Revision, Is.EqualTo(first.Revision));
        Assert.That(second.SavedRevision, Is.EqualTo(first.SavedRevision));
        Assert.That(first.Dirty, Is.False);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task DifferentPlayers_DoNotShareData()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann", 1);
        Seed(dir, 12, 2, "Bea", 2);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(new PlayerStore(store));
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var bothInside = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        int inside = 0;

        Task left = queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            if (Interlocked.Increment(ref inside) == 2)
                bothInside.TrySetResult();
            await bothInside.Task;
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Ann2");
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        Task right = queue.EnqueueAsync(12, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(12, ct);
            if (Interlocked.Increment(ref inside) == 2)
                bothInside.TrySetResult();
            await bothInside.Task;
            cache.ReplaceNickname(12, "Bea2");
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await Task.WhenAll(left, right);

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            PlayerState state = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            Assert.That(state.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Ann2"));
            Assert.That(state.Revision, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(12, async ct =>
        {
            PlayerState state = await cache.GetAsync(12, ct);
            Assert.That(state.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Bea2"));
            Assert.That(state.Revision, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }, CancellationToken.None);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task ConcurrentEdits_OnSamePlayer_KeepFinalNicknameAndRevision()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann", 1);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(new PlayerStore(store));
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct => { await cache.GetAsync(11, ct); }, CancellationToken.None);

        int last = -1;
        var edits = new Task[6];
        for (int i = 0; i < edits.Length; i++)
        {
            int name = i;
            edits[i] = Task.Run(async () => await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, _ =>
            {
                cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "n" + name.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
                Volatile.Write(ref last, name);
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }, CancellationToken.None));
        }

        await Task.WhenAll(edits);
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            PlayerState state = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            Assert.That(state.Revision, Is.EqualTo(edits.Length));
            Assert.That(state.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("n" + Volatile.Read(ref last).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
            Assert.That(state.Dirty, Is.True);
        }, CancellationToken.None);
    }

    public async Task FailedTransaction_LeavesNoPartialSnapshotAndKeepsDirty()
    {

        {

            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "New");

        using (var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir)))
        {
            Execute(connection, """
                CREATE TRIGGER player_snapshot_fail BEFORE INSERT ON player_snapshot
                BEGIN
                  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'snapshot-fail');
                END;
                """);
        }

        SqliteException? error = null;
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            PlayerState snapshot = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            try
            {

            {
                error = ex;

    [Test]
    public async Task Remove_RejectsDirtyOrHold_AndReloadsAfterCleanRemoval()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann", 7);
        var players = new PlayerStore(store);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(players);
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            IDisposable hold = cache.AcquireHold(11);
            InvalidOperationException held = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => cache.Remove(11));
            Assert.That(held.Message, Does.Contain("持有"));
            hold.Dispose();
            cache.Remove(11);
            Assert.That(cache.Count, Is.Zero);

            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Kept");
            InvalidOperationException dirty = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => cache.Remove(11));
            Assert.That(dirty.Message, Does.Contain("未保存"));

            PlayerState snapshot = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Later");
            await players.SaveAsync(snapshot, ct);
            cache.ConfirmSaved(11, snapshot.Revision);
            PlayerState afterOlderSave = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            Assert.That(afterOlderSave.Dirty, Is.True);
            Assert.That(afterOlderSave.SavedRevision, Is.EqualTo(snapshot.Revision));
            Assert.That(afterOlderSave.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Later"));

            PlayerState latest = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            await players.SaveAsync(latest, ct);
            PlayerState beforeConfirm = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            Assert.That(beforeConfirm.Dirty, Is.True);
            cache.ConfirmSaved(11, latest.Revision);
            PlayerState clean = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            Assert.That(clean.Dirty, Is.False);
            cache.Remove(11);
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        int queriesAfterRemove = players.LoadQueryCount;
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            PlayerState reloaded = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            Assert.That(reloaded.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Later"));
            Assert.That(reloaded.Dirty, Is.False);
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(players.LoadQueryCount, Is.EqualTo(queriesAfterRemove + 1));
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task Version1Database_UpgradesAndKeepsRows()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        string database = DatabasePath(dir);
        using (var connection = Open(database))
        {
            Execute(connection, """
                CREATE TABLE account (
                  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                  username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                  pwd_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                  salt TEXT NOT NULL,
                  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
                );
                """);
            Execute(connection, """
                CREATE TABLE player (
                  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                  account_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES account(id),
                  nickname TEXT NOT NULL,
                  level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                  exp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                  gold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 200,
                  gem INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 300,
                  ticket INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
                  shard INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                  bag_slots INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60,
                  guide_step INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                  last_daily_reset INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
                );
                """);
            Execute(connection, """
                CREATE TABLE auth_token (
                  token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                  player_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES player(id),
                  expires_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
                  revoked INTEGER NOT NULL
                );
                """);
            Execute(connection, """
                CREATE TABLE schema_meta (
                  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
                  version INTEGER NOT NULL
                );
                """);
            Execute(connection, "INSERT INTO schema_meta (id, version) VALUES (1, 1);");
            Execute(connection, "INSERT INTO account (id, username, pwd_hash, salt, created_at) VALUES (1, 'ada', 'hash', 'salt', 10);");
            Execute(connection, "INSERT INTO player (id, account_id, nickname, level, gold, last_daily_reset) VALUES (11, 1, 'Ada', 4, 15, 77);");
            Execute(connection, "INSERT INTO auth_token (token_hash, player_id, expires_at_ms, revoked) VALUES ('abc', 11, 99, 0);");
        }

        using var store = new SqliteStore();
        store.Initialize(database);
        PlayerState loaded = await new PlayerStore(store).LoadAsync(11, CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Ada"));
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Info.Level, Is.EqualTo(4));
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Info.Gold, Is.EqualTo(15));
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Bag, Is.Empty);
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Plots, Is.Empty);
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.OrderProgress, Is.Null);
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Home, Is.Null);
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Avatar, Is.Null);
        Assert.That(loaded.Revision, Is.Zero);
        using var check = Open(database);
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(check, "SELECT version FROM schema_meta WHERE id = 1;"), Is.EqualTo(SqliteStore.CurrentVersion));
        Assert.That(ScalarString(check, "SELECT username FROM account WHERE id = 1;"), Is.EqualTo("ada"));
        Assert.That(ScalarString(check, "SELECT token_hash FROM auth_token WHERE player_id = 11;"), Is.EqualTo("abc"));
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(check, "SELECT last_daily_reset FROM player WHERE id = 11;"), Is.EqualTo(77));
        Assert.That(Count(check, "player_snapshot"), Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(Count(check, "account"), Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    static SqliteStore OpenStore(IsolatedDirectory dir)
    {
        var store = new SqliteStore();
        store.Initialize(DatabasePath(dir));
        return store;
    }

    static void Seed(IsolatedDirectory dir, long playerId, long accountId, string nickname, long lastDailyReset)
    {
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Execute(connection, string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
            "INSERT INTO account (id, username, pwd_hash, salt, created_at) VALUES ({0}, 'user{0}', 'hash', 'salt', 1);",
            accountId));
        Execute(connection, string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
            "INSERT INTO player (id, account_id, nickname, last_daily_reset) VALUES ({0}, {1}, '{2}', {3});",
            playerId, accountId, nickname, lastDailyReset));
    }

    static string DatabasePath(IsolatedDirectory dir)
    {
        return Path.Combine(dir.FullPath, "game.db");
    }

    static SqliteConnection Open(string database)
    {
        var builder = new SqliteConnectionStringBuilder
        {
            DataSource = database,
            Mode = SqliteOpenMode.ReadWriteCreate,
            Pooling = false
        };
        var connection = new SqliteConnection(builder.ToString());
        connection.Open();
        using var pragma = connection.CreateCommand();
        pragma.CommandText = "PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;";
        pragma.ExecuteNonQuery();
        return connection;
    }

    static void Execute(SqliteConnection connection, string sql)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = sql;
        command.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }

    static long Count(SqliteConnection connection, string table)
    {
        return ScalarLong(connection, string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {0};", table));
    }

    static long ScalarLong(SqliteConnection connection, string sql)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = sql;
        return Convert.ToInt64(command.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    static string ScalarString(SqliteConnection connection, string sql)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = sql;
        return Convert.ToString(command.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) ?? "";
    }

    sealed class IsolatedDirectory : IDisposable
    {
        public IsolatedDirectory()
        {
            string root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "FarmingPlayerCacheTests");
            FullPath = Path.Combine(root, Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(FullPath);
        }

        public string FullPath { get; }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            string full = Path.GetFullPath(FullPath);
            string root = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "FarmingPlayerCacheTests"));
            string prefix = root.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
            if (!full.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("拒绝删除测试目录之外的路径");
            if (Directory.Exists(full))
                Directory.Delete(full, true);
        }
    }
}
```

## T32：实现 SaveService 定时和登出落库

- 来源：`06_M1_基础框架任务拆解.md` 第 3.1 / 4.5 / 5.4 节 T32，依赖 T31/T11
- 需求：R-S02
- 依据：第 4.5 节 `SaveService.FlushDirtyAsync(CancellationToken ct)`、`FlushPlayerAsync(long playerId, CancellationToken ct)`；第 3.1 节 `PlayerState` 的 `Revision` / `SavedRevision`；T11 的循环间隔必须大于 0、取消后不再触发。服务端不引用 Unity `TimerService`
- 通过条件：修改后 5 秒保存；失败保留 Dirty；重试成功才更新 SavedRevision
- 日期：2026-10-19
- 范围：只做 T32。不实现 T33 及以后，不写账号 Handler，不改 PoC `Program` 的现有启动路径

### 任务、流程与验证

保存服务接在已经完成的玩家队列、缓存和存储后面。定时器线程只负责到点后把保存动作投进对应玩家的队列，不直接改缓存里的 `PlayerState`。快照和 `Revision` 在该玩家的队列动作里成对复制。数据库写入成功后，只对这一份已提交版本调用 `ConfirmSaved`。保存过程中又出现的新版本仍保持 Dirty。

生产侧用 `Start`、`StopAsync`、`Dispose` 作为组合点。`Start` 只保留一个周期循环；已经在跑时再次 `Start` 直接返回。`StopAsync` 取消等待和尚未确认的保存，并等到本轮保存有完成或取消结果后再返回。取消不调用 `ConfirmSaved`。某一轮保存抛错只记到可观察的失败状态，下一轮间隔到了继续尝试。`Dispose` 等价于停止后拒绝新的刷新。

`FlushDirtyAsync` 只复制缓存里已经脏的玩家主键，不加载未缓存玩家，也不碰干净玩家。`FlushPlayerAsync` 在登出时由调用方等待。若当前异步流已经在这名玩家的队列动作里，就在当前动作中直接保存，避免再次 `EnqueueAsync` 把同一条队列等死。其他玩家仍各自入队，可以并行。

测试时钟是 `ManualSaveClock`。用例用 `Advance` 把虚拟时间推进到 5 秒，不真等。改昵称只用 `PlayerCache.ReplaceNickname`。

```csharp
Task FlushDirtyAsync(CancellationToken ct)
Task FlushPlayerAsync(long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
void Start()
Task StopAsync()
void Dispose()
```

| 验证对象 | 验证方法 | 期待结果 | 实际结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 未到 5 秒与到期一次 | 改昵称后 `Start`，先推进 4999 毫秒，再推进 1 毫秒 | 4999 毫秒时库中昵称不变且成功保存次数为 0；到点只完成一轮，库中为最新昵称 | 通过。`BeforeFiveSeconds_DoesNotSave_AndDueCycleSavesOnce`，TRX `outcome=Passed`，耗时 45 ms。4999 毫秒时周期数 0、确认次数 0、库中仍是 Ann；再推进 1 毫秒后周期数 1，昵称 Due，`saved_revision` 为 1 |
| 多次修改一次保存 | 连续改三次昵称后推进一个间隔 | 只确认一次；库中昵称与内存最新值一致 | 通过。`RepeatedEdits_SaveLatestSnapshotOnce`，耗时 37 ms。确认次数 1，周期数 1，库中昵称 Three，`saved_revision` 为 3，内存 Dirty 为假 |
| 失败后重试 | 快照插入触发器中止第一次周期，去掉触发器后再推进一个间隔 | 失败后 Dirty 仍为真、SavedRevision 不变；重试成功后 SavedRevision 等于已提交版本 | 通过。`Failure_KeepsDirty_RetryUpdatesSavedRevision`，耗时 64 ms。第一次 `FailedSaveCount` 为 1，`LastFailure` 是 `SqliteException`，确认次数 0，库中昵称仍是 Ann，快照 0 行，内存 Dirty 为真、`SavedRevision` 为 0。去掉触发器后第二轮确认次数 1，失败次数仍是 1，昵称 Kept，`SavedRevision` 为 1 |
| 并发刷新与修改 | 捕获快照后、写入前再改一次昵称 | 第一次确认不覆盖新版本；再次刷新后重载昵称与新版本一致 | 通过。`ConcurrentFlushAndEdit_DoesNotDropNewRevision`，耗时 56 ms。第一次库中为 Mid、版本 1；内存昵称 New、版本 2、`SavedRevision` 1、Dirty 为真。再次刷新后重载昵称 New，版本 2 |
| 登出刷新 | 在该玩家队列内调用 `FlushPlayerAsync` 并等待，再重新打开库 | 不发生嵌套死锁；重载昵称与登出前一致 | 通过。`LogoutFlush_ReloadsSameNickname`，耗时 32 ms。队列内等待结束，确认次数 1；重开库后昵称 Bye，版本与已保存版本都是 1 |
| 停止与取消 | 周期进入保存前取消；停止后再推进时间 | 不标记已保存；停止后周期数不再增加；玩家队列无挂起动作 | 通过。`StopAndCancel_DoesNotStartAnotherCycleOrLeaveWork`，耗时 21 ms。停止时周期数为 1，确认次数为 0，库中仍是 Ann，内存 Dirty 为真。再推进 15 秒后周期数仍是 1。已取消标记调用 `FlushPlayerAsync` 得到 `TaskCanceledException`，确认次数仍是 0，`ActiveLaneCount` 为 0 |

```csharp
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Data;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Players;

/// <summary>
/// 玩家内存缓存。只有 PlayerQueue 正在执行的同一玩家动作可以访问或修改。
/// 不负责定时保存。保存成功后要由调用方在该玩家队列里 ConfirmSaved。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PlayerCache
{
    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, Entry> _entries = new();
    readonly PlayerStore _store;

    /// <summary>使用指定的玩家存储。缓存不自己打开数据库连接。</summary>
    /// <param name="store">加载和保存都走它的 SQLite 队列。</param>
    public PlayerCache(PlayerStore store)
    {
        _store = store ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(store));
    }

    /// <summary>当前缓存中的玩家数量，供测试观察移除和失败不入缓存。</summary>
    internal int Count
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _entries.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>这名玩家是否已经在缓存里。不访问数据库，也不要求调用方处在玩家队列中。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要查看的玩家主键。</param>
    /// <returns>缓存里有该玩家时为 true。没有时为 false，不会因此去加载。</returns>
    internal bool IsCached(long playerId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
            return _entries.ContainsKey(playerId);
    }

    /// <summary>复制当前缓存里仍脏的玩家主键。不修改状态，不访问数据库，也不要求调用方处在玩家队列中。</summary>
    /// <returns>Revision 与 SavedRevision 不同的玩家主键，按主键升序。</returns>
    internal long[] CopyDirtyPlayerIds()
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            var ids = new List<long>();
            foreach (KeyValuePair<long, Entry> pair in _entries)
            {
                if (pair.Value.Revision != pair.Value.SavedRevision)
                    ids.Add(pair.Key);
            }

            ids.Sort();
            return ids.ToArray();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>若该玩家已在缓存且仍脏，复制一份独立快照。未缓存或已干净时不访问数据库。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要复制的玩家。当前异步流必须正在执行这名玩家的队列动作。</param>
    /// <param name="snapshot">成功时为数据和两个版本的深拷贝；失败时为 null。</param>
    /// <returns>拿到一份脏快照时为 true。</returns>
    internal bool TryCopyDirty(long playerId, out PlayerState? snapshot)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(playerId, out Entry? entry) || entry.Revision == entry.SavedRevision)
            {
                snapshot = null;
                return false;
            }

            snapshot = entry.Capture(playerId);
            return true;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>取得玩家快照。第一次查数据库，之后复用缓存。返回值是独立深拷贝。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要读取的玩家。当前异步流必须正在执行这名玩家的队列动作。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">传给数据库加载。取消时不放入缓存。</param>
    public async Task<PlayerState> GetAsync(long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_entries.TryGetValue(playerId, out Entry? cached))
                return cached.Capture(playerId);
        }

        PlayerState loaded = await _store.LoadAsync(playerId, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(playerId, out Entry? cached))
            {
                cached = new Entry(loaded.Data, loaded.Revision, loaded.SavedRevision);
                _entries.Add(playerId, cached);
            }

            return cached.Capture(playerId);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>只把版本加一，不改玩家数据。已经载入的玩家才会被标脏。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要标脏的玩家。必须是当前队列动作的玩家。</param>
    public void MarkDirty(long playerId)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
            Bump(Required(playerId));
    }

    /// <summary>从缓存移除已经保存且没有活跃持有的玩家。脏数据或仍被持有时拒绝。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要移除的玩家。必须是当前队列动作的玩家，且已经在缓存中。</param>
    public void Remove(long playerId)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            Entry entry = Required(playerId);
            if (entry.Revision != entry.SavedRevision)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家仍有未保存修改，拒绝移除");
            if (entry.Holds > 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家仍被活跃持有，拒绝移除");
            _entries.Remove(playerId);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>确认某个版本已经成功写入。不大于当前版本时才前移 SavedRevision；期间又有修改则仍算脏。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要确认的玩家。必须是当前队列动作的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="savedRevision">已经成功写入数据库的那个版本。</param>
    public void ConfirmSaved(long playerId, long savedRevision)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        if (savedRevision < 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(savedRevision), "已保存版本不能为负");

        lock (_gate)
        {
            Entry entry = Required(playerId);
            if (savedRevision > entry.Revision)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("确认的保存版本超出当前版本");
            if (savedRevision < entry.SavedRevision)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("拒绝把已保存版本回退");
            entry.SavedRevision = savedRevision;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>登记一次活跃持有。后续保存服务可在落库期间持有，本项不启动定时器。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要持有的玩家。必须是当前队列动作的玩家，且已经载入。</param>
    /// <returns>在同一玩家队列里释放的句柄。重复释放不会把计数减成负数。</returns>
    public IDisposable AcquireHold(long playerId)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            Required(playerId).Holds++;
            return new Hold(this, playerId);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>测试夹具用来修改缓存中的昵称，并让版本加一。不是生产玩法接口。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要修改的玩家。必须是当前队列动作的玩家，且已经载入。</param>
    /// <param name="nickname">新的昵称。写入缓存里的 Info，不直接写数据库。</param>
    internal void ReplaceNickname(long playerId, string nickname)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        if (nickname == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(nickname));

        lock (_gate)
        {
            Entry entry = Required(playerId);
            // 版本到达上限时必须在改变任何业务字段之前拒绝。
            Bump(entry);
            if (entry.Data.Info == null)
                entry.Data.Info = new PlayerInfo { PlayerId = playerId };
            entry.Data.Info.Nickname = nickname;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>减少一次持有。必须仍处在该玩家的队列动作里。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要释放的玩家。</param>
    void ReleaseHold(long playerId)
    {
        RequireCurrent(playerId);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            Entry entry = Required(playerId);
            if (entry.Holds <= 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家没有可释放的持有");
            entry.Holds--;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>核对当前异步流就是这名玩家的队列动作。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">调用方声称要访问的玩家。</param>
    static void RequireCurrent(long playerId)
    {
        if (!PlayerQueue.IsCurrentPlayer(playerId))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"玩家 {playerId} 的状态只能由该玩家队列中的动作访问或修改");
    }

    /// <summary>取出已经载入的条目。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家主键。</param>
    Entry Required(long playerId)
    {
        if (!_entries.TryGetValue(playerId, out Entry? entry))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"玩家 {playerId} 尚未载入缓存");
        return entry;
    }

    /// <summary>把版本加一。已经到达上限时拒绝，避免回绕。</summary>
    /// <param name="entry">要递增的缓存条目。</param>
    static void Bump(Entry entry)
    {
        if (entry.Revision == long.MaxValue)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家版本已到上限");
        entry.Revision++;
    }

    /// <summary>一名玩家的缓存条目。对外只交出深拷贝。</summary>
    sealed class Entry
    {
        /// <summary>记下加载得到的那一份数据。调用方拿到的是它的拷贝。</summary>
        /// <param name="data">缓存持有的玩家数据。</param>
        /// <param name="revision">当前内存版本。</param>
        /// <param name="savedRevision">已确认保存的版本。</param>
        public Entry(PlayerFullData data, long revision, long savedRevision)
        {
            Data = data;
            Revision = revision;
            SavedRevision = savedRevision;
        }

        /// <summary>缓存持有的玩家数据。</summary>
        public PlayerFullData Data { get; }

        /// <summary>当前内存版本。</summary>
        public long Revision { get; set; }

        /// <summary>已确认保存的版本。</summary>
        public long SavedRevision { get; set; }

        /// <summary>尚未释放的活跃持有次数。</summary>
        public int Holds { get; set; }

        /// <summary>同时拷贝数据和两个版本。</summary>
        /// <param name="playerId">缓存键上的玩家主键。不从可变的 Info 里重新取值。</param>
        public PlayerState Capture(long playerId)
        {
            return new PlayerState(playerId, Data.Clone(), Revision, SavedRevision);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一次持有。释放时回到缓存计数。</summary>
    sealed class Hold : IDisposable
    {
        readonly PlayerCache _cache;
        readonly long _playerId;
        int _released;

        /// <summary>记下要释放的缓存和玩家。</summary>
        /// <param name="cache">发出这次持有的缓存。</param>
        /// <param name="playerId">被持有的玩家。</param>
        public Hold(PlayerCache cache, long playerId)
        {
            _cache = cache;
            _playerId = playerId;
        }

        /// <summary>在该玩家队列中把持有计数减一。重复调用不再减少。</summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            lock (this)
            {
                if (_released != 0)
                    return;
                // 验证与释放成功后才消耗句柄，错误异步上下文调用不能泄漏持有计数。
                _cache.ReleaseHold(_playerId);
                _released = 1;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using CloudIsle.Server.Data;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Players;

/// <summary>
/// 单调毫秒时钟。生产使用系统计时；测试推进虚拟时间。
/// 间隔语义对齐 T11：循环间隔大于 0，取消后不再把本次等待算成到期。不引用 Unity。
/// </summary>
public interface ISaveClock
{
    /// <summary>当前单调毫秒。</summary>
    long NowMilliseconds { get; }

    /// <summary>等到绝对时间，或等到取消。</summary>
    /// <param name="dueMilliseconds">到期的单调毫秒。小于等于当前时间时立即返回 true。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消标记。取消后返回 false，调用方不得把这次等待当成一次到期。</param>
    /// <returns>时间到达时为 true；取消时为 false。</returns>
    Task<bool> WaitUntilAsync(long dueMilliseconds, CancellationToken ct);
}

/// <summary>用系统单调计时等待。组合根没有测试时钟时使用它。</summary>
public sealed class SystemSaveClock : ISaveClock
{
    /// <summary>进程内共用的系统时钟。</summary>
    public static readonly SystemSaveClock Shared = new();

    /// <summary>系统单调毫秒。</summary>
    public long NowMilliseconds => Environment.TickCount64;

    /// <summary>按剩余时间分段等待，避免一次 Delay 超过 int 范围。</summary>
    /// <param name="dueMilliseconds">到期的单调毫秒。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消标记。</param>
    public async Task<bool> WaitUntilAsync(long dueMilliseconds, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            long remaining = dueMilliseconds - Environment.TickCount64;
            if (remaining <= 0)
                return true;

            long slice = Math.Min(remaining, 1_000);
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(slice), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }
}

/// <summary>测试用虚拟时钟。Advance 推进时间，不真实等待间隔。</summary>
public sealed class ManualSaveClock : ISaveClock
{
    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly List<Waiter> _waiters = new();
    long _now;

    /// <summary>当前虚拟毫秒。</summary>
    public long NowMilliseconds
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _now;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>把虚拟时间向前推进一段。</summary>
    /// <param name="elapsed">要增加的时间。负值抛出异常。已经到期的等待会完成一次。</param>
    public void Advance(TimeSpan elapsed)
    {
        if (elapsed < TimeSpan.Zero)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(elapsed), "推进时间不能为负");

        var ready = new List<Waiter>();
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _now += (long)elapsed.TotalMilliseconds;
            for (int i = _waiters.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (_waiters[i].Due <= _now)
                {
                    ready.Add(_waiters[i]);
                    _waiters.RemoveAt(i);
                }
            }
        }

        foreach (Waiter waiter in ready)
        {
            waiter.Registration.Dispose();
            waiter.Done.TrySetResult(true);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>虚拟时间到达 dueMilliseconds 时返回 true。</summary>
    /// <param name="dueMilliseconds">到期的虚拟毫秒。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消标记。取消后返回 false，并且不再占用等待名额。</param>
    public Task<bool> WaitUntilAsync(long dueMilliseconds, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            return Task.FromResult(false);

        Waiter waiter;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                return Task.FromResult(false);
            if (_now >= dueMilliseconds)
                return Task.FromResult(true);

            waiter = new Waiter(dueMilliseconds);
            _waiters.Add(waiter);
        }

        waiter.Registration = ct.Register(() =>
        {
            bool removed;
            lock (_gate)
                removed = _waiters.Remove(waiter);
            if (removed)
                waiter.Done.TrySetResult(false);
        });
        return waiter.Done.Task;
    }

    sealed class Waiter
    {
        public Waiter(long due)
        {
            Due = due;
        }

        public long Due { get; }
        public TaskCompletionSource<bool> Done { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        public CancellationTokenRegistration Registration;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// 每 5 秒把脏玩家的保存动作投到对应玩家队列。成功后只确认本次提交的版本。
/// Start、StopAsync、Dispose 是生产组合的接线点。不包含账号 Handler。
/// </summary>
public sealed class SaveService : IDisposable
{
    /// <summary>固定保存间隔。大于 0，满足循环计时契约。</summary>
    public const long IntervalMilliseconds = 5000;

    readonly PlayerQueue _queue;
    readonly PlayerCache _cache;
    readonly PlayerStore _store;
    readonly ISaveClock _clock;
    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly List<TaskCompletionSource> _cycleWaiters = new();

    CancellationTokenSource? _stop;
    Task? _loop;
    long _nextDue;
    int _confirmedSaves;
    int _failedSaves;
    int _cycles;
    int _disposed;
    Exception? _lastFailure;

    /// <summary>使用系统时钟创建保存服务。</summary>
    /// <param name="queue">保存动作要投递到的玩家队列。</param>
    /// <param name="cache">读取脏玩家和确认版本的缓存。</param>
    /// <param name="store">写入快照的存储。</param>
    public SaveService(PlayerQueue queue, PlayerCache cache, PlayerStore store)
        : this(queue, cache, store, SystemSaveClock.Shared)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>使用指定时钟创建保存服务。测试传入 ManualSaveClock。</summary>
    /// <param name="queue">保存动作要投递到的玩家队列。</param>
    /// <param name="cache">读取脏玩家和确认版本的缓存。</param>
    /// <param name="store">写入快照的存储。</param>
    /// <param name="clock">决定 5 秒何时到期的时钟。</param>
    public SaveService(PlayerQueue queue, PlayerCache cache, PlayerStore store, ISaveClock clock)
    {
        _queue = queue ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(queue));
        _cache = cache ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(cache));
        _store = store ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(store));
        _clock = clock ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(clock));
    }

    /// <summary>已经成功确认的保存次数。</summary>
    internal int ConfirmedSaveCount => Volatile.Read(ref _confirmedSaves);

    /// <summary>写入失败次数。取消不计入。</summary>
    internal int FailedSaveCount => Volatile.Read(ref _failedSaves);

    /// <summary>最近一次写入失败。没有失败时为 null。</summary>
    internal Exception? LastFailure
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _lastFailure;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>已经开始的保存周期数。停止后不再增加。</summary>
    internal int CycleCount => Volatile.Read(ref _cycles);

    /// <summary>
    /// 测试在写入前插入同步点。参数是已经在队列里复制好的快照，以及本次刷新的取消标记。
    /// 生产路径保持 null。
    /// </summary>
    internal Func<PlayerState, CancellationToken, Task>? BeforePersistAsync { get; set; }

    /// <summary>启动唯一的 5 秒循环。已经在运行时直接返回，不再开第二个定时器。</summary>
    public void Start()
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            ThrowIfDisposed();
            if (_loop != null && !_loop.IsCompleted)
                return;

            _stop = new CancellationTokenSource();
            _nextDue = _clock.NowMilliseconds + IntervalMilliseconds;
            CancellationToken token = _stop.Token;
            _loop = Task.Run(() => RunAsync(token));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>取消后续周期，并等待已经开始的保存得到完成或取消结果。</summary>
    public async Task StopAsync()
    {
        Task? loop;
        CancellationTokenSource? stop;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            loop = _loop;
            stop = _stop;
            _stop = null;
        }

        if (stop != null)
        {
            try
            {
                stop.Cancel();
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
                // 重复停止可以忽略。
            }
        }

        if (loop != null)
        {
            try
            {
                await loop.ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                // 循环因停止而结束，这是确定的取消结果。
            }
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(_loop, loop))
                _loop = null;
        }

        stop?.Dispose();
    }

    /// <summary>停止循环并拒绝之后的刷新。重复调用没有额外效果。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
            return;
        StopAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        lock (_gate)
        {
            Volatile.Write(ref _disposed, 1);
            TaskCompletionSource[] waiters = _cycleWaiters.ToArray();
            _cycleWaiters.Clear();
            foreach (TaskCompletionSource waiter in waiters)
                waiter.TrySetCanceled();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>把当前缓存里的脏玩家各自投到自己的队列里保存。</summary>
    /// <param name="ct">取消标记。取消后不确认任何尚未确认的版本。</param>
    public async Task FlushDirtyAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ThrowIfDisposed();
        long[] ids = _cache.CopyDirtyPlayerIds();
        if (ids.Length == 0)
            return;

        var pending = new Task[ids.Length];
        for (int i = 0; i < ids.Length; i++)
            pending[i] = FlushPlayerAsync(ids[i], ct);
        await Task.WhenAll(pending).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>保存一名玩家当前的脏快照并等待结束。未缓存时不加载。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要保存的玩家。必须是正数。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消标记。入队前取消则不保存；保存过程中取消则不确认版本。</param>
    public Task FlushPlayerAsync(long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (playerId <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(playerId), "玩家主键必须是正数");
        ThrowIfDisposed();
        if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            return Task.FromCanceled(ct);

        // 已经在这名玩家的队列动作里时直接保存，避免嵌套入队把自己等死。
        if (PlayerQueue.IsCurrentPlayer(playerId))
            return SaveInlineAsync(playerId, ct);
        if (!_cache.IsCached(playerId))
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        return SaveQueuedAsync(playerId, ct);
    }

    /// <summary>等到下一次周期的刷新结束。须在推进时钟前登记，供测试观察到期。</summary>
    internal Task WaitNextCycleAsync()
    {
        var waiter = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            ThrowIfDisposed();
            _cycleWaiters.Add(waiter);
        }

        return waiter.Task;
    }

    /// <summary>按到期时间循环。保存异常只记录，不让循环停住。</summary>
    /// <param name="ct">Start 配套的停止标记。</param>
    async Task RunAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            long due;
            lock (_gate)
                due = _nextDue;

            bool dueNow = await _clock.WaitUntilAsync(due, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (!dueNow || ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                break;

            lock (_gate)
                _nextDue += IntervalMilliseconds;
            Interlocked.Increment(ref _cycles);
            try
            {
                await FlushDirtyAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                FinishCycle();
                break;
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                // 单轮失败已经记在保存路径上。这里只保证下一轮仍会等待。
            }

            FinishCycle();
        }

        CancelCycleWaiters();
    }

    /// <summary>在当前玩家队列动作里复制、写入并确认。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">当前队列正在执行的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">本次刷新的取消标记。</param>
    async Task SaveInlineAsync(long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (!_cache.TryCopyDirty(playerId, out PlayerState? snapshot) || snapshot == null)
            return;

        using IDisposable hold = _cache.AcquireHold(playerId);
        await PersistAsync(snapshot, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            throw new OperationCanceledException(ct);
        _cache.ConfirmSaved(playerId, snapshot.Revision);
        Interlocked.Increment(ref _confirmedSaves);
    }

    /// <summary>先入队复制快照，写入放在队列外，再入队确认。写入期间同玩家的新修改可以排队执行。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要保存的已缓存玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">本次刷新的取消标记。</param>
    async Task SaveQueuedAsync(long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        PlayerState? captured = null;
        IDisposable? hold = null;
        await _queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, _ =>
        {
            if (_cache.TryCopyDirty(playerId, out PlayerState? snapshot) && snapshot != null)
            {
                captured = snapshot;
                hold = _cache.AcquireHold(playerId);
            }

            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

        if (captured == null || hold == null)
            return;

        try
        {
            await PersistAsync(captured, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                throw new OperationCanceledException(ct);

            long revision = captured.Revision;
            await _queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, _ =>
            {
                _cache.ConfirmSaved(playerId, revision);
                Interlocked.Increment(ref _confirmedSaves);
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally
        {
            IDisposable releasing = hold;
            hold = null;
            await _queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, _ =>
            {
                releasing.Dispose();
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>调用测试钩子后写入存储。钩子和写入都不在定时线程上改玩家状态。</summary>
    /// <param name="snapshot">队列里已经复制好的那一版。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">本次刷新的取消标记。</param>
    async Task PersistAsync(PlayerState snapshot, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Func<PlayerState, CancellationToken, Task>? hook = BeforePersistAsync;
        if (hook != null)
            await hook(snapshot, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            throw new OperationCanceledException(ct);
        try
        {
            await _store.SaveAsync(snapshot, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            RecordFailure(ex);
            throw;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>记下失败，供调用方和测试观察。不修改 SavedRevision。</summary>
    /// <param name="error">存储或钩子抛出的异常。</param>
    void RecordFailure(Exception error)
    {
        Interlocked.Increment(ref _failedSaves);
        lock (_gate)
            _lastFailure = error;
    }

    /// <summary>放开正在等待这一轮结束的测试。</summary>
    void FinishCycle()
    {
        TaskCompletionSource[] waiters;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            waiters = _cycleWaiters.ToArray();
            _cycleWaiters.Clear();
        }

        foreach (TaskCompletionSource waiter in waiters)
            waiter.TrySetResult();
    }

    /// <summary>循环退出后，还在等周期的调用方得到取消，避免留下挂起任务。</summary>
    void CancelCycleWaiters()
    {
        TaskCompletionSource[] waiters;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            waiters = _cycleWaiters.ToArray();
            _cycleWaiters.Clear();
        }

        foreach (TaskCompletionSource waiter in waiters)
            waiter.TrySetCanceled();
    }

    /// <summary>释放后拒绝新的刷新。</summary>
    void ThrowIfDisposed()
    {
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
            throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(SaveService));
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Globalization;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>SaveService 的 5 秒周期、失败重试、登出刷新和停止。</summary>

{
    /// <summary>5 秒前不写库；虚拟时间到达 5 秒时只保存一轮最新昵称。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task BeforeFiveSeconds_DoesNotSave_AndDueCycleSavesOnce()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann");
        var players = new PlayerStore(store);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(players);
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var clock = new ManualSaveClock();
        using var service = new SaveService(queue, cache, players, clock);

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Due");
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        service.Start();
        Task cycle = service.WaitNextCycleAsync();
        clock.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(4999));
        Assert.That(service.CycleCount, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(ReadNickname(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo("Ann"));

        clock.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1));
        await cycle;

        Assert.That(service.CycleCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(ReadNickname(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo("Due"));
        Assert.That(ReadSavedRevision(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo(1));
    }
```
