#### 脚本：Server/CloudIsle.Server/Account/PasswordHasher.cs


```csharp
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 服务端密码派生。只接受固定的 PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 参数，不保存密码原文。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PasswordHasher
{
    /// <summary>注册时生成并传入的盐长度。更长或更短的盐都不参与派生。</summary>
    public const int SaltLength = 16;

    /// <summary>唯一接受的迭代次数。库存格式里的其他数字直接拒绝。</summary>
    public const int IterationCount = 100_000;

    /// <summary>派生结果的字节数。库存格式里的其他长度直接拒绝。</summary>
    public const int OutputLength = 32;

    const int MaxPasswordUtf8Bytes = 4096;
    const int MaxHashTextLength = 80;
    const string Algorithm = "pbkdf2-sha256";
    const string Version = "1";

    /// <summary>用给定盐做一次 PBKDF2，并返回带算法版本和参数的文本。</summary>
    /// <param name="password">密码原文。只在本次派生中使用，不写入日志。</param>
    /// <param name="salt">16 字节随机盐。盐本身不放进返回值。</param>
    /// <returns>形如 pbkdf2-sha256$1$100000$32$ 再接派生结果 Base64 的文本。</returns>
    public string Hash(string password, byte[] salt)
    {
        if (password == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(password));
        if (salt == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(salt));
        if (salt.Length != SaltLength)
            throw new ArgumentException("盐必须是 16 字节", nameof(salt));
        if (Utf8Length(password) > MaxPasswordUtf8Bytes)
            throw new ArgumentException("密码超出派生输入上限", nameof(password));

        byte[] derived = Derive(password, salt);
        return string.Concat(Prefix(), Convert.ToBase64String(derived));
    }

    /// <summary>按库存格式重新派生并比较。格式损坏、算法未知或参数不受支持时返回 false。</summary>
    /// <param name="password">待核对的密码原文。</param>
    /// <param name="salt">注册时保存的 16 字节盐。</param>
    /// <param name="expectedHash">先前 Hash 返回并保存的文本。</param>
    /// <returns>格式有效且派生结果一致时为 true，否则为 false。</returns>
    public bool Verify(string password, byte[] salt, string expectedHash)
    {
        if (password == null || salt == null || salt.Length != SaltLength)
            return false;
        if (Utf8Length(password) > MaxPasswordUtf8Bytes)
            return false;
        if (!TryReadDerived(expectedHash, out byte[] expected))
            return false;

        byte[] actual = Derive(password, salt);
        return CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(actual, expected);
    }

    /// <summary>拼出当前算法固定前缀，后面只再接派生结果。</summary>
    static string Prefix()
    {
        return string.Concat(
            Algorithm, "$",
            Version, "$",
            IterationCount.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "$",
            OutputLength.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "$");
    }

    /// <summary>只接受当前这一组算法、版本、迭代和输出长度。不按文本里的数字执行派生。</summary>
    /// <param name="expectedHash">库存的派生文本。</param>
    /// <param name="derived">解析出的 32 字节结果。</param>
    static bool TryReadDerived(string expectedHash, out byte[] derived)
    {
        derived = Array.Empty<byte>();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(expectedHash) || expectedHash.Length > MaxHashTextLength)
            return false;

        string prefix = Prefix();
        if (!expectedHash.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return false;

        string encoded = expectedHash.Substring(prefix.Length);
        byte[] buffer = new byte[OutputLength];
        if (!Convert.TryFromBase64String(encoded, buffer, out int written) || written != OutputLength)
            return false;

        derived = buffer;
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>按固定迭代和输出长度派生。调用前已经限制了密码和盐的大小。</summary>
    /// <param name="password">密码原文。</param>
    /// <param name="salt">16 字节盐。</param>
    static byte[] Derive(string password, byte[] salt)
    {
        return Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(
            password,
            salt,
            IterationCount,
            HashAlgorithmName.SHA256,
            OutputLength);
    }

    /// <summary>计算 UTF-8 字节数，用来拦住过长输入。</summary>
    /// <param name="text">密码原文。</param>
    static int Utf8Length(string text)
    {
        return System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(text);
    }
}
```

#### 脚本：Server/CloudIsle.Server/Account/AccountRepository.cs

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Data;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 在现有 SQLite 队列里注册账号和玩家，并按库存盐核对密码。不签发 Token，也不绑定会话。
/// </summary>
public sealed class AccountRepository
{
    /// <summary>SQLite SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE。只有 account.username 这一条才映射为 201。</summary>
    const int SqliteConstraintUnique = 2067;

    readonly SqliteStore _store;
    readonly PasswordHasher _hasher;

    /// <summary>使用已经初始化的库和密码派生器。</summary>
    /// <param name="store">提供唯一队列连接的存储。</param>
    /// <param name="hasher">生成和核对派生结果。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public AccountRepository(SqliteStore store, PasswordHasher hasher)
    {
        _store = store ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(store));
        _hasher = hasher ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(hasher));
    }

    /// <summary>同一事务创建账号和玩家。成功返回 0，用户名唯一冲突返回 201。</summary>
    /// <param name="request">05 的注册请求。用户名和昵称原样写入，本项不另造格式规则。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">入队前或轮到执行前取消则不写库。</param>
    /// <returns>成功为 0，用户名已存在为 201。</returns>
    public Task<int> RegisterAsync(RegisterReq request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (request == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(request));
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

        byte[] salt = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(PasswordHasher.SaltLength);
        string pwdHash = _hasher.Hash(request.Password ?? "", salt);
        string saltText = Convert.ToBase64String(salt);
        long createdAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();
        string username = request.Username ?? "";
        string nickname = request.Nickname ?? "";
        return _store.ExecuteAsync(
            connection => InsertAccountAndPlayer(connection, username, pwdHash, saltText, createdAt, nickname),
            ct);
    }

    /// <summary>按用户名取出盐和派生结果。密码不对或没有这个用户名时返回 0。</summary>
    /// <param name="username">要查找的用户名，按数据库二进制比较。</param>
    /// <param name="password">待核对的密码原文。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">入队前取消则不查询。</param>
    /// <returns>密码正确时返回 player.id，否则返回 0。</returns>
    public Task<long> AuthenticateAsync(string username, string password, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (username == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(username));
        if (password == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(password));

        return _store.ExecuteAsync(connection => Authenticate(connection, username, password), ct);
    }

    /// <summary>插入账号后再插入玩家。玩家业务列留空，让 schema 默认值生效。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">队列当前持有的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="username">请求中的用户名。</param>
    /// <param name="pwdHash">Hash 返回的派生文本。</param>
    /// <param name="saltText">16 字节盐的 Base64。</param>
    /// <param name="createdAt">注册时刻的 UTC Unix 毫秒。</param>
    /// <param name="nickname">请求中的昵称。非法昵称的业务码不在本项处理。</param>
    static int InsertAccountAndPlayer(
        SqliteConnection connection,
        string username,
        string pwdHash,
        string saltText,
        long createdAt,
        string nickname)
    {
        using var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();
        try
        {
            using (var account = connection.CreateCommand())
            {
                account.Transaction = transaction;
                account.CommandText = """
                    INSERT INTO account (username, pwd_hash, salt, created_at)
                    VALUES ($username, $pwdHash, $salt, $createdAt);
                    """;
                account.Parameters.AddWithValue("$username", username);
                account.Parameters.AddWithValue("$pwdHash", pwdHash);
                account.Parameters.AddWithValue("$salt", saltText);
                account.Parameters.AddWithValue("$createdAt", createdAt);
                account.ExecuteNonQuery();
            }

            long accountId;
            using (var id = connection.CreateCommand())
            {
                id.Transaction = transaction;
                id.CommandText = "SELECT last_insert_rowid();";
                accountId = Convert.ToInt64(id.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            }

            using (var player = connection.CreateCommand())
            {
                player.Transaction = transaction;
                player.CommandText = """
                    INSERT INTO player (account_id, nickname)
                    VALUES ($accountId, $nickname);
                    """;
                player.Parameters.AddWithValue("$accountId", accountId);
                player.Parameters.AddWithValue("$nickname", nickname);
                player.ExecuteNonQuery();
            }

            transaction.Commit();
            return 0;
        }
        catch (SqliteException ex)
        {
            Rollback(transaction);
            if (IsUsernameConflict(ex))
                return 201;
            throw;
        }
        catch
        {
            Rollback(transaction);
            throw;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>先查账号，再查玩家。数据库读写失败继续抛出，不改写成 0。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">队列当前持有的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="username">要查找的用户名。</param>
    /// <param name="password">待核对的密码原文。</param>
    long Authenticate(SqliteConnection connection, string username, string password)
    {
        using var account = connection.CreateCommand();
        account.CommandText = """
            SELECT id, pwd_hash, salt
            FROM account
            WHERE username = $username;
            """;
        account.Parameters.AddWithValue("$username", username);
        using var reader = account.ExecuteReader();
        if (!reader.Read())
            return 0;

        long accountId = reader.GetInt64(0);
        if (reader.IsDBNull(1) || reader.IsDBNull(2))
            throw new InvalidDataException("账号缺少派生结果或盐");
        string pwdHash = reader.GetString(1);
        string saltText = reader.GetString(2);
        if (reader.Read())
            throw new InvalidDataException("同一用户名读到多行账号");
        reader.Close();

        if (!TryDecodeSalt(saltText, out byte[] salt))
            throw new InvalidDataException("账号盐无法按 16 字节解码");

        if (!_hasher.Verify(password, salt, pwdHash))
            return 0;

        using var player = connection.CreateCommand();
        player.CommandText = "SELECT id FROM player WHERE account_id = $accountId;";
        player.Parameters.AddWithValue("$accountId", accountId);
        object? playerId = player.ExecuteScalar();
        if (playerId == null || playerId is DBNull)
            throw new InvalidDataException("账号没有对应玩家");
        return Convert.ToInt64(playerId, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    /// <summary>判断是不是 account.username 的唯一约束。其他约束保持原异常。</summary>
    /// <param name="exception">SQLite 抛出的异常。</param>
    static bool IsUsernameConflict(SqliteException exception)
    {
        if (exception.SqliteExtendedErrorCode != SqliteConstraintUnique)
            return false;
        string message = exception.Message ?? "";
        return message.Contains("account.username", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            && !message.Contains("player.", StringComparison.Ordinal);
    }

    /// <summary>把盐文本解成恰好 16 字节。失败时不把损坏数据拿去派生。</summary>
    /// <param name="saltText">account.salt。</param>
    /// <param name="salt">解码后的盐。</param>
    static bool TryDecodeSalt(string saltText, out byte[] salt)
    {
        salt = Array.Empty<byte>();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(saltText))
            return false;
        byte[] buffer = new byte[PasswordHasher.SaltLength];
        if (!Convert.TryFromBase64String(saltText, buffer, out int written) || written != PasswordHasher.SaltLength)
            return false;
        salt = buffer;
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>结束未提交的事务。已经结束时忽略，避免盖住原来的异常。</summary>
    /// <param name="transaction">当前注册事务。</param>
    static void Rollback(SqliteTransaction transaction)
    {
        try
        {
            transaction.Rollback();
        }
        catch (SqliteException)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Account;
using CloudIsle.Server.Data;
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>PasswordHasher 不连接数据库。断言不输出密码、盐或派生结果。</summary>
public sealed class PasswordHasherTests
{
    /// <summary>同一密码配两次随机盐，结果必须不同，而且各自都能核对。</summary>
    [Test]
    public void SamePassword_DifferentSalts_HashDifferAndBothVerify()
    {
        var hasher = new PasswordHasher();
        byte[] firstSalt = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(PasswordHasher.SaltLength);
        byte[] secondSalt = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(PasswordHasher.SaltLength);
        string first = hasher.Hash("correct horse", firstSalt);
        string second = hasher.Hash("correct horse", secondSalt);

        Assert.That(first, Is.Not.EqualTo(second));
        Assert.That(hasher.Verify("correct horse", firstSalt, first), Is.True);
        Assert.That(hasher.Verify("correct horse", secondSalt, second), Is.True);
        Assert.That(hasher.Verify("other horse", firstSalt, first), Is.False);
    }

    /// <summary>损坏文本、未知算法和不受支持的迭代都直接失败。</summary>
    [Test]
    public void DamagedOrUnknownFormat_ReturnsFalseWithoutLargeWork()
    {
        var hasher = new PasswordHasher();
        byte[] salt = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(PasswordHasher.SaltLength);
        string valid = hasher.Hash("correct horse", salt);
        string unknown = valid.Replace("pbkdf2-sha256", "sha256", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        string hugeIterations = "pbkdf2-sha256$1$999999999$32$" + new string('A', 44);
        var watch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

        Assert.That(hasher.Verify("correct horse", salt, ""), Is.False);
        Assert.That(hasher.Verify("correct horse", salt, valid.Substring(0, 12)), Is.False);
        Assert.That(hasher.Verify("correct horse", salt, unknown), Is.False);
        Assert.That(hasher.Verify("correct horse", salt, hugeIterations), Is.False);
        watch.Stop();

        Assert.That(watch.ElapsedMilliseconds, Is.LessThan(500));
        Assert.That(hasher.Verify("correct horse", salt, valid), Is.True);
    }
}

/// <summary>注册事务、唯一冲突和认证闭环。</summary>
public sealed class AccountRepositoryTests
{
    /// <summary>并发使用同一个用户名时，只有一次注册成功。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ConcurrentSameUsername_CreatesOneAccountAndPlayer()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var repository = new AccountRepository(store, new PasswordHasher());
        var tasks = new Task<int>[8];
        for (int i = 0; i < tasks.Length; i++)
            tasks[i] = repository.RegisterAsync(Request("same", "secret", "Ann"), CancellationToken.None);

        int[] codes = await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
        Assert.That(codes.Count(code => code == 0), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(codes.Count(code => code == 201), Is.EqualTo(7));
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "player"), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "auth_token"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(OrphanAccounts(connection), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(OrphanPlayers(connection), Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>未写的玩家列使用 schema 默认值，并且没有快照。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Register_UsesSchemaDefaults()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var repository = new AccountRepository(store, new PasswordHasher());
        Assert.That(await repository.RegisterAsync(Request("ada", "secret", "Ada"), CancellationToken.None), Is.EqualTo(0));

        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        long playerId = ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT id FROM player;");
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT level FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT exp FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT gold FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo(200));
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT gem FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo(300));
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT ticket FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo(5));
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT shard FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT bag_slots FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo(60));
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT guide_step FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT last_daily_reset FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "player_snapshot"), Is.EqualTo(0));

        var loaded = await new PlayerStore(store).LoadAsync(playerId, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Ada"));
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Info.Level, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Info.Gold, Is.EqualTo(200));
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Info.Gem, Is.EqualTo(300));
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Info.Ticket, Is.EqualTo(5));
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Info.BagSlots, Is.EqualTo(60));
        Assert.That(loaded.Revision, Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>注册后可以认证；关闭库再打开仍然可以。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Register_ThenAuthenticate_SurvivesReopen()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        string database = DatabasePath(dir);
        long playerId;
        using (var store = OpenStore(dir))
        {
            var repository = new AccountRepository(store, new PasswordHasher());
            Assert.That(await repository.RegisterAsync(Request("ada", "secret", "Ada"), CancellationToken.None), Is.EqualTo(0));
            playerId = await repository.AuthenticateAsync("ada", "secret", CancellationToken.None);
            Assert.That(playerId, Is.GreaterThan(0));
            Assert.That(await repository.AuthenticateAsync("ada", "wrong", CancellationToken.None), Is.EqualTo(0));
            Assert.That(await repository.AuthenticateAsync("missing", "secret", CancellationToken.None), Is.EqualTo(0));
        }

        using var again = new SqliteStore();
        again.Initialize(database);
        var reopened = new AccountRepository(again, new PasswordHasher());
        Assert.That(await reopened.AuthenticateAsync("ada", "secret", CancellationToken.None), Is.EqualTo(playerId));
    }

    /// <summary>大小写不同的用户名按现有二进制唯一规则各算一个账号。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task UsernameComparison_KeepsBinaryCase()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var repository = new AccountRepository(store, new PasswordHasher());
        Assert.That(await repository.RegisterAsync(Request("Ada", "secret", "A"), CancellationToken.None), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(await repository.RegisterAsync(Request("ada", "secret", "B"), CancellationToken.None), Is.EqualTo(0));
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(2));
    }

    /// <summary>玩家插入失败时，账号插入一并回滚，并且不返回重名。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task PlayerInsertFailure_RollsBackAccount()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        using (var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir)))
        {
            Execute(connection, """
                CREATE TRIGGER abort_player BEFORE INSERT ON player
                BEGIN
                  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'player-insert-aborted');
                END;
                """);
        }

        var repository = new AccountRepository(store, new PasswordHasher());
        SqliteException? error = null;
        try
        {
            await repository.RegisterAsync(Request("ada", "secret", "Ada"), CancellationToken.None);
            Assert.Fail("玩家插入失败时应抛出数据库异常");
        }
        catch (SqliteException ex)
        {
            error = ex;
        }

        Assert.That(error, Is.Not.Null);
        Assert.That(error!.Message, Does.Contain("player-insert-aborted"));
        Assert.That(error.Message, Does.Not.Contain("account.username"));
        using var check = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(check, "account"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(Count(check, "player"), Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>带引号和语句片段的用户名只作为参数值。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task InjectedUsername_IsStoredAsLiteral()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        string username = "x' OR 1=1; DROP TABLE account; --";
        var repository = new AccountRepository(store, new PasswordHasher());
        Assert.That(await repository.RegisterAsync(Request(username, "secret", "Ann"), CancellationToken.None), Is.EqualTo(0));

        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(ScalarString(connection, "SELECT username FROM account;"), Is.EqualTo(username));
        long playerId = ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT id FROM player;");
        Assert.That(await repository.AuthenticateAsync(username, "secret", CancellationToken.None), Is.EqualTo(playerId));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>注册已经排进队列但还没执行时取消，不留下账号。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task CancelWhileQueued_LeavesNoAccount()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var entered = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        Task<int> hold = store.ExecuteAsync(_ =>
        {
            entered.TrySetResult();
            if (!release.Task.Wait(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)))
                throw new TimeoutException("排队占用没有被放开");
            return 0;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        await entered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var repository = new AccountRepository(store, new PasswordHasher());
        Task<int> pending = repository.RegisterAsync(Request("queued", "secret", "Ann"), cts.Token);
        cts.Cancel();
        release.TrySetResult();

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () => await pending);
        await hold;
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "player"), Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    static RegisterReq Request(string username, string password, string nickname)
    {
        return new RegisterReq
        {
            Username = username,
            Password = password,
            Nickname = nickname
        };
    }

    static SqliteStore OpenStore(IsolatedDirectory dir)
    {
        var store = new SqliteStore();
        store.Initialize(DatabasePath(dir));
        return store;
    }

    static string DatabasePath(IsolatedDirectory dir)
    {
        return Path.Combine(dir.FullPath, "game.db");
    }

    static SqliteConnection Open(string database)
    {
        var builder = new SqliteConnectionStringBuilder
        {
            DataSource = database,
            Mode = SqliteOpenMode.ReadWriteCreate,
            Pooling = false
        };
        var connection = new SqliteConnection(builder.ToString());
        connection.Open();
        using var pragma = connection.CreateCommand();
        pragma.CommandText = "PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;";
        pragma.ExecuteNonQuery();
        return connection;
    }

    static void Execute(SqliteConnection connection, string sql)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = sql;
        command.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }

    static long Count(SqliteConnection connection, string table)
    {
        return ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM " + table + ";");
    }

    static long OrphanAccounts(SqliteConnection connection)
    {
        return ScalarLong(connection, """
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM account a
            LEFT JOIN player p ON p.account_id = a.id
            WHERE p.id IS NULL;
            """);
    }

    static long OrphanPlayers(SqliteConnection connection)
    {
        return ScalarLong(connection, """
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM player p
            LEFT JOIN account a ON a.id = p.account_id
            WHERE a.id IS NULL;
            """);
    }

    static long ScalarLong(SqliteConnection connection, string sql)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = sql;
        return Convert.ToInt64(command.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    static string ScalarString(SqliteConnection connection, string sql)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = sql;
        return Convert.ToString(command.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) ?? "";
    }

    /// <summary>只删除系统临时目录里本测试创建的子目录。</summary>
    sealed class IsolatedDirectory : IDisposable
    {
        public IsolatedDirectory()
        {
            string root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "FarmingAccountRepositoryTests");
            FullPath = Path.Combine(root, Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(FullPath);
        }

        public string FullPath { get; }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            string full = Path.GetFullPath(FullPath);
            string root = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "FarmingAccountRepositoryTests"));
            string prefix = root.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
            if (!full.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("拒绝删除测试目录之外的路径");
            if (Directory.Exists(full))
                Directory.Delete(full, true);
        }
    }
}
```

### T33 协调复核：密码派生参数

- [x] 复核场景：首版实现完成后检查密码派生工作因子。首版PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256使用100000次迭代。
- 原因：初版选择的工作因子低于当前OWASP Password Storage Cheat Sheet对PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256建议的600000次，作为新M1账号实现需要修正。
- 修复：PasswordHasher.IterationCount改为600000，格式示例同步为pbkdf2-sha256$1$600000$32$；仍严格解析支持的参数并使用恒定时间比较。只影响新M1实现和隔离测试库，没有读取或修改PoC账号库。
- 依据：[OWASP Password Storage Cheat Sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Password_Storage_Cheat_Sheet.html)。本复核参数覆盖本节首版100000的说明，历史测试结果保留。

|---|---|---|---|
| 600000次派生与验证 | 运行PasswordHasherTests，同密码不同随机盐派生，各自验证，检查错误密码和未知格式 | 真实生产参数派生正确，未知格式拒绝 | 2项通过 |
| 注册及认证事务 | 运行AccountRepositoryTests：并发同名、默认值、重开库认证、大小写、回滚、参数化、取消 | 只有一组同名账号/玩家，事务与认证一致 | 7项通过 |

复核后的完整PasswordHasher.cs（替代本节首版对应源码，函数参数注释随源码）：

```csharp
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 服务端密码派生。只接受固定的 PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 参数，不保存密码原文。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PasswordHasher
{
    /// <summary>注册时生成并传入的盐长度。更长或更短的盐都不参与派生。</summary>
    public const int SaltLength = 16;

    /// <summary>唯一接受的迭代次数。库存格式里的其他数字直接拒绝。</summary>
    public const int IterationCount = 600_000;

    /// <summary>派生结果的字节数。库存格式里的其他长度直接拒绝。</summary>
    public const int OutputLength = 32;

    const int MaxPasswordUtf8Bytes = 4096;
    const int MaxHashTextLength = 80;
    const string Algorithm = "pbkdf2-sha256";
    const string Version = "1";

    /// <summary>用给定盐做一次 PBKDF2，并返回带算法版本和参数的文本。</summary>
    /// <param name="password">密码原文。只在本次派生中使用，不写入日志。</param>
    /// <param name="salt">16 字节随机盐。盐本身不放进返回值。</param>
    /// <returns>形如 pbkdf2-sha256$1$600000$32$ 再接派生结果 Base64 的文本。</returns>
    public string Hash(string password, byte[] salt)
    {
        if (password == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(password));
        if (salt == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(salt));
        if (salt.Length != SaltLength)
            throw new ArgumentException("盐必须是 16 字节", nameof(salt));
        if (Utf8Length(password) > MaxPasswordUtf8Bytes)
            throw new ArgumentException("密码超出派生输入上限", nameof(password));

        byte[] derived = Derive(password, salt);
        return string.Concat(Prefix(), Convert.ToBase64String(derived));
    }

    /// <summary>按库存格式重新派生并比较。格式损坏、算法未知或参数不受支持时返回 false。</summary>
    /// <param name="password">待核对的密码原文。</param>
    /// <param name="salt">注册时保存的 16 字节盐。</param>
    /// <param name="expectedHash">先前 Hash 返回并保存的文本。</param>
    /// <returns>格式有效且派生结果一致时为 true，否则为 false。</returns>
    public bool Verify(string password, byte[] salt, string expectedHash)
    {
        if (password == null || salt == null || salt.Length != SaltLength)
            return false;
        if (Utf8Length(password) > MaxPasswordUtf8Bytes)
            return false;
        if (!TryReadDerived(expectedHash, out byte[] expected))
            return false;

        byte[] actual = Derive(password, salt);
        return CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(actual, expected);
    }

    /// <summary>拼出当前算法固定前缀，后面只再接派生结果。</summary>
    static string Prefix()
    {
        return string.Concat(
            Algorithm, "$",
            Version, "$",
            IterationCount.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "$",
            OutputLength.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "$");
    }

    /// <summary>只接受当前这一组算法、版本、迭代和输出长度。不按文本里的数字执行派生。</summary>
    /// <param name="expectedHash">库存的派生文本。</param>
    /// <param name="derived">解析出的 32 字节结果。</param>
    static bool TryReadDerived(string expectedHash, out byte[] derived)
    {
        derived = Array.Empty<byte>();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(expectedHash) || expectedHash.Length > MaxHashTextLength)
            return false;

        string prefix = Prefix();
        if (!expectedHash.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return false;

        string encoded = expectedHash.Substring(prefix.Length);
        byte[] buffer = new byte[OutputLength];
        if (!Convert.TryFromBase64String(encoded, buffer, out int written) || written != OutputLength)
            return false;

        derived = buffer;
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>按固定迭代和输出长度派生。调用前已经限制了密码和盐的大小。</summary>
    /// <param name="password">密码原文。</param>
    /// <param name="salt">16 字节盐。</param>
    static byte[] Derive(string password, byte[] salt)
    {
        return Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(
            password,
            salt,
            IterationCount,
            HashAlgorithmName.SHA256,
            OutputLength);
    }

    /// <summary>计算 UTF-8 字节数，用来拦住过长输入。</summary>
    /// <param name="text">密码原文。</param>
    static int Utf8Length(string text)
    {
        return System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(text);
    }
}

```

## T34：接入 HandleRegisterAsync

- 来源：`06_M1_基础框架任务拆解.md` 第 4.5 / 5.4 节 T34，依赖 T33 / T24
- 需求：R-S03
- 依据：第 4.5 节 `AccountHandler.HandleRegisterAsync`；05 的 `RegisterReq` / `RegisterResp`（1003 / 1004，响应只有 `code`）及错误码 0 / 201 / 203；T24 的 `MessageRouter.Register` / `DispatchAsync` 与认证前白名单；T25 心跳的发送委托和注册方式；T33 的 `AccountRepository.RegisterAsync` 只返回 0 或 201，数据库错误原样抛出
- 通过条件：成功 code=0；重名 201；昵称非法 203；注册后仍不能发业务消息
- 日期：2026-10-19
- 范围：只做 T34。不实现 T35 及以后，不发 Token，不绑定玩家，不实现登录 / 重连 / 登出处理，不改 PoC 默认入口，不改协议生成物，不提交推送

### 任务、流程与验证

注册从正式路由进入。`AccountHandler.RegisterRoutes` 用 `MsgRegistry` 里的 `RegisterReq` ID 注册 `HandleRegisterAsync`，供以后的正式组合根调用。本项不改 `Program.cs`。回包走和心跳相同的发送委托，响应消息 ID 是正式 `RegisterResp`，序号沿用请求的 `seq`。成功只表示账号和玩家已经按 T33 事务创建，不写 `auth_token`，也不改会话的玩家编号。同一条未认证会话随后发已有受保护请求 `LogoutReq`（1009，协议规定无响应）时，仍由现有路由拒绝为 102，测试不另造 `LogoutResp`，也不发明 1001–1010 以外的生产消息。

05 和拆解没有规定昵称长度、字符集或是否去掉空白。`player.nickname` 只是非空文本列，空字符串可以入库。T33 因此原样写入。本项只在 Handler 做下面这个选择，不新增协议字段：`nickname` 为 null、空串，或每个字符都是 `char.IsWhiteSpace`（含空格、制表、换行、不换行空格）时返回 203；任一字符 `char.IsControl` 为真时也返回 203。不设最大长度，不限制中英文，不去掉首尾空格，「 Ann 」按原样入库。用户名、密码、`proto_version`、`device_id` 本项不另造规则，版本码 106 留给登录。非法昵称在调用仓库之前返回，所以不会变成 201，也不会写库。

取消和真实数据库错误继续抛出。不把它们改写成 0 或 201，也不发 code 为 0 的 RegisterResp。用户名唯一冲突仍是仓库返回的 201。SQL 继续只用 T33 的参数化写入。分发开始前取消由路由抛出 OperationCanceledException。已经排进数据库队列后取消，仓库返回的任务抛出 TaskCanceledException。两种都不发送 RegisterResp。

```csharp
void RegisterRoutes(MessageRouter router)
Task HandleRegisterAsync(RequestContext context, RegisterReq request, CancellationToken ct)
```

| 验证对象 | 验证方法 | 期待结果 | 实际结果 |
|---|---|---|---|

```csharp
using CloudIsle.Net;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Network;
using Google.Protobuf;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 正式注册入口。只创建账号和玩家，不绑定会话，不签发 Token。
/// </summary>
public sealed class AccountHandler
{
    readonly AccountRepository _accounts;
    readonly Func<RequestContext, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> _sendAsync;

    /// <summary>记下仓库和回包委托。回包委托与心跳、路由使用同一种签名。</summary>
    /// <param name="accounts">已有的账号仓库。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="sendAsync">把响应帧交给当前会话。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public AccountHandler(
        AccountRepository accounts,
        Func<RequestContext, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> sendAsync)
    {
        _accounts = accounts ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(accounts));
        _sendAsync = sendAsync ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sendAsync));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 向已有路由注册正式 RegisterReq。重复注册由路由拒绝，本方法不覆盖旧处理函数。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="router">启动时持有的路由。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public void RegisterRoutes(MessageRouter router)
    {
        if (router == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(router));
        router.Register<RegisterReq>(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(RegisterReq)), HandleRegisterAsync);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 校验昵称后创建账号和玩家，并回送正式 RegisterResp。
    /// 取消或数据库错误原样抛出，不改写成成功或重名，也不发送 code 为 0 的响应。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">当前帧的会话和 seq。本方法不改玩家编号。</param>
    /// <param name="request">正式注册请求。只读取已有字段。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消校验之后的写库和回包。</param>
    public async Task HandleRegisterAsync(RequestContext context, RegisterReq request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (context == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
        if (request == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(request));

        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (!IsNicknameAllowed(request.Nickname))
        {
            await SendRegisterAsync(context, 203, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return;
        }

        int code = await _accounts.RegisterAsync(request, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (code != 0 && code != 201)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("注册结果不是成功或用户名已存在");

        await SendRegisterAsync(context, code, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 05 没有规定昵称长度和字符集。空串、纯空白和控制字符在这里视为非法。
    /// 不裁剪、不设上限，其余文本原样交给仓库。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="nickname">请求中的昵称。</param>
    static bool IsNicknameAllowed(string? nickname)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(nickname))
            return false;

        foreach (char character in nickname)
        {
            if (char.IsControl(character))
                return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>用请求的 seq 发送只含 code 的正式注册响应。</summary>
    /// <param name="context">提供 seq 的当前帧上下文。</param>
    /// <param name="code">0、201 或 203。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消回包。</param>
    async Task SendRegisterAsync(RequestContext context, int code, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var response = new RegisterResp { Code = code };
        ushort responseId = MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(RegisterResp));
        await _sendAsync(context, new Packet(responseId, context.Seq, response.ToByteArray()), ct)
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
}
```

#### 脚本：Server/CloudIsle.Tests/AccountHandlerTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Collections;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Reflection;
using CloudIsle.Net;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Account;
using CloudIsle.Server.Data;
using CloudIsle.Server.Network;
using Google.Protobuf;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>经 MessageRouter 调用正式注册。临时库与 PoC 账号库分开。</summary>
public sealed class AccountHandlerTests
{
    /// <summary>正式路由注册成功后只回一条 code 为 0 的 RegisterResp，且会话仍未认证。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task RegisterRoutes_Success_LeavesSessionUnauthenticated()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var sent = new List<Packet>();
        var traces = new List<string>();
        var router = new MessageRouter(
            (context, packet, token) =>
            {
                Assert.That(context.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(0));
                sent.Add(packet);
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            },
            (context, reason, token) => Task.CompletedTask,
            new SteadyClock(),
            line => traces.Add(line));
        var accounts = new AccountHandler(new AccountRepository(store, new PasswordHasher()), (context, packet, token) =>
        {
            Assert.That(context.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(0));
            sent.Add(packet);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        });
        var heartbeat = new HeartbeatHandler((context, packet, token) =>
        {
            Assert.That(context.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(0));
            sent.Add(packet);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        });
        accounts.RegisterRoutes(router);
        heartbeat.Register(router);
        int logoutCalls = 0;
        router.Register<LogoutReq>(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(LogoutReq)), (context, request, token) =>
        {
            logoutCalls++;
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        });

        await DispatchAsync(router, 41, new RegisterReq
        {
            Username = "ada",
            Password = "secret",
            Nickname = "Ann",
            ProtoVersion = 1,
            DeviceId = "device-1"
        }, 44);

        Assert.That(sent, Has.Count.EqualTo(1));
        AssertRegister(sent[0], 44, 0);
        using (var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir)))
        {
            Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(Count(connection, "player"), Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(Count(connection, "auth_token"), Is.EqualTo(0));
            Assert.That(ScalarString(connection, "SELECT nickname FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo("Ann"));
        }

        await DispatchAsync(router, 41, new HeartbeatReq { ClientTime = 5 }, 45);
        Assert.That(sent, Has.Count.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(sent[1].MsgId, Is.EqualTo(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(HeartbeatResp))));
        Assert.That(sent[1].Seq, Is.EqualTo(45));
        Assert.That(HeartbeatResp.Parser.ParseFrom(sent[1].Body).Code, Is.EqualTo(0));

        await DispatchAsync(router, 41, new LogoutReq(), 46);
        Assert.That(logoutCalls, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(sent, Has.Count.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(string.Join("\n", traces), Does.Contain("session=41 msg=1009 seq=46 code=102 action=reject"));
    }

    /// <summary>同一用户名第二次注册返回 201，库里仍然各一行。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task DuplicateUsername_Returns201AndKeepsOneRow()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var sent = new List<Packet>();
        MessageRouter router = Router(sent);
        Handler(store, sent).RegisterRoutes(router);

        await DispatchAsync(router, 7, Request("ada", "secret", "Ann"), 1);
        await DispatchAsync(router, 7, Request("ada", "other", "Bea"), 2);

        Assert.That(sent, Has.Count.EqualTo(2));
        AssertRegister(sent[0], 1, 0);
        AssertRegister(sent[1], 2, 201);
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "player"), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(ScalarString(connection, "SELECT nickname FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo("Ann"));
    }

    /// <summary>空串和纯空白昵称返回 203，不创建账号或玩家。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task BlankNickname_Returns203AndWritesNothing()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var sent = new List<Packet>();
        MessageRouter router = Router(sent);
        Handler(store, sent).RegisterRoutes(router);
        string[] nicknames = { "", " ", "\t\r\n", "\u00a0" };

        for (uint seq = 1; seq <= nicknames.Length; seq++)
            await DispatchAsync(router, 8, Request("ada" + seq.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "secret", nicknames[seq - 1]), seq);

        Assert.That(sent, Has.Count.EqualTo(nicknames.Length));
        for (int i = 0; i < nicknames.Length; i++)
            AssertRegister(sent[i], (uint)(i + 1), 203);
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "player"), Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>含控制字符的昵称返回 203，不写库。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ControlNickname_Returns203AndWritesNothing()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var sent = new List<Packet>();
        MessageRouter router = Router(sent);
        Handler(store, sent).RegisterRoutes(router);

        await DispatchAsync(router, 9, Request("ada", "secret", "Ann\u0001"), 6);

        Assert.That(sent, Has.Count.EqualTo(1));
        AssertRegister(sent[0], 6, 203);
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "player"), Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>协议未规定是否裁剪。两端有空格的昵称原样入库。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task SurroundingSpaces_AreStoredVerbatim()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var sent = new List<Packet>();
        MessageRouter router = Router(sent);
        Handler(store, sent).RegisterRoutes(router);

        await DispatchAsync(router, 10, Request("ada", "secret", " Ann "), 3);

        Assert.That(sent, Has.Count.EqualTo(1));
        AssertRegister(sent[0], 3, 0);
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(ScalarString(connection, "SELECT nickname FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo(" Ann "));
    }

    /// <summary>引号和语句片段只作为参数值，不删除表。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task InjectedText_IsStoredAsLiteral()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var sent = new List<Packet>();
        MessageRouter router = Router(sent);
        Handler(store, sent).RegisterRoutes(router);
        string username = "x' OR 1=1; DROP TABLE account; --";
        string nickname = "n'; DELETE FROM player; --";

        await DispatchAsync(router, 11, Request(username, "p' OR '1'='1", nickname), 4);

        Assert.That(sent, Has.Count.EqualTo(1));
        AssertRegister(sent[0], 4, 0);
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "player"), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "auth_token"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(ScalarString(connection, "SELECT username FROM account;"), Is.EqualTo(username));
        Assert.That(ScalarString(connection, "SELECT nickname FROM player;"), Is.EqualTo(nickname));
        Assert.That(ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE name = 'account';"), Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>玩家插入失败时不发送成功响应，账号和玩家都回滚。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task PlayerInsertFailure_DoesNotSendSuccessAndRollsBack()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        using (var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir)))
        {
            Execute(connection, """
                CREATE TRIGGER abort_player BEFORE INSERT ON player
                BEGIN
                  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'player-insert-aborted');
                END;
                """);
        }

        var sent = new List<Packet>();
        MessageRouter router = Router(sent);
        Handler(store, sent).RegisterRoutes(router);

        SqliteException? error = null;
        try
        {
            await DispatchAsync(router, 12, Request("ada", "secret", "Ann"), 5);
            Assert.Fail("玩家插入失败时应抛出数据库异常");
        }
        catch (SqliteException ex)
        {
            error = ex;
        }

        Assert.That(error, Is.Not.Null);
        Assert.That(error!.Message, Does.Contain("player-insert-aborted"));
        Assert.That(sent, Is.Empty);
        using var check = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(check, "account"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(Count(check, "player"), Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>分发开始前已经取消时，不回包也不写库。</summary>
    [Test]
    public void AlreadyCanceled_SendsNothing()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var sent = new List<Packet>();
        MessageRouter router = Router(sent);
        Handler(store, sent).RegisterRoutes(router);
        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        cts.Cancel();

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<OperationCanceledException>(() => DispatchAsync(
            router,
            13,
            Request("ada", "secret", "Ann"),
            7,
            cts.Token));
        Assert.That(sent, Is.Empty);
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "player"), Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>注册已排进数据库队列但还没执行时取消，不回成功包，也不留账号。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task CancelWhileQueued_SendsNothingAndLeavesNoRows()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var entered = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        Task<int> hold = store.ExecuteAsync(_ =>
        {
            entered.TrySetResult();
            if (!release.Task.Wait(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)))
                throw new TimeoutException("排队占用没有被放开");
            return 0;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await entered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        var sent = new List<Packet>();
        MessageRouter router = Router(sent);
        Handler(store, sent).RegisterRoutes(router);
        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        Task pending = DispatchAsync(router, 14, Request("queued", "secret", "Ann"), 8, cts.Token);
        try
        {
            var deadline = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(10);
            while (PendingCount(store) < 1)
            {
                if (pending.IsCompleted)
                    Assert.Fail("注册在入队前就结束了");
                if (DateTime.UtcNow > deadline)
                    Assert.Fail("注册没有排进数据库队列");
                await Task.Delay(15);
            }

            cts.Cancel();
            release.TrySetResult();
            Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () => await pending);
            await hold;
        }
        finally
        {
            release.TrySetResult();
        }

        Assert.That(sent, Is.Empty);
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "account"), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(Count(connection, "player"), Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>构造路由。拒绝响应会进入这个列表；注册成功的回包由处理器自己的发送委托写入同一列表。</summary>
    /// <param name="sent">收到的响应帧。</param>
    static MessageRouter Router(List<Packet> sent)
    {
        return new MessageRouter(
            (context, packet, token) =>
            {
                sent.Add(packet);
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            },
            (context, reason, token) => Task.CompletedTask);
    }

    /// <summary>构造处理器。正式注册响应由这里的发送委托写出。</summary>
    /// <param name="store">已经初始化的临时库。</param>
    /// <param name="sent">处理器回包写入的列表。</param>
    static AccountHandler Handler(SqliteStore store, List<Packet> sent)
    {
        return new AccountHandler(
            new AccountRepository(store, new PasswordHasher()),
            (context, packet, token) =>
            {
                sent.Add(packet);
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            });
    }

    /// <summary>用玩家编号 0 把正式消息交给路由。</summary>
    /// <param name="router">已注册注册处理函数的路由。</param>
    /// <param name="sessionId">连接会话编号。</param>
    /// <param name="message">正式请求。</param>
    /// <param name="seq">请求序号。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消这一次分发。</param>
    static Task DispatchAsync(MessageRouter router, long sessionId, IMessage message, uint seq, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        ushort msgId = MsgRegistry.GetId(message.GetType());
        return router.DispatchAsync(
            new RequestContext(sessionId, 0, msgId, seq),
            new Packet(msgId, seq, message.ToByteArray()),
            ct);
    }

    /// <summary>组装一条注册请求。</summary>
    /// <param name="username">用户名。</param>
    /// <param name="password">密码原文。</param>
    /// <param name="nickname">昵称。</param>
    static RegisterReq Request(string username, string password, string nickname)
    {
        return new RegisterReq
        {
            Username = username,
            Password = password,
            Nickname = nickname
        };
    }

    /// <summary>核对注册响应的消息 ID、序号和 code。</summary>
    /// <param name="packet">路由写出的帧。</param>
    /// <param name="seq">期待的序号。</param>
    /// <param name="code">期待的业务码。</param>
    static void AssertRegister(Packet packet, uint seq, int code)
    {
        Assert.That(packet.MsgId, Is.EqualTo(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(RegisterResp))));
        Assert.That(packet.MsgId, Is.EqualTo((ushort)1004));
        Assert.That(packet.Seq, Is.EqualTo(seq));
        Assert.That(RegisterResp.Parser.ParseFrom(packet.Body).Code, Is.EqualTo(code));
    }

    /// <summary>打开临时库并迁移到当前 schema。</summary>
    /// <param name="dir">本用例的临时目录。</param>
    static SqliteStore OpenStore(IsolatedDirectory dir)
    {
        var store = new SqliteStore();
        store.Initialize(DatabasePath(dir));
        return store;
    }

    /// <summary>临时库文件路径。</summary>
    /// <param name="dir">本用例的临时目录。</param>
    static string DatabasePath(IsolatedDirectory dir)
    {
        return Path.Combine(dir.FullPath, "game.db");
    }

    /// <summary>另开一条连接读取结果。外键打开，避免和队列连接混用事务。</summary>
    /// <param name="database">数据库文件路径。</param>
    static SqliteConnection Open(string database)
    {
        var builder = new SqliteConnectionStringBuilder
        {
            DataSource = database,
            Mode = SqliteOpenMode.ReadWriteCreate,
            Pooling = false
        };
        var connection = new SqliteConnection(builder.ToString());
        connection.Open();
        using var pragma = connection.CreateCommand();
        pragma.CommandText = "PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;";
        pragma.ExecuteNonQuery();
        return connection;
    }

    /// <summary>执行一段不带外部拼接值的 SQL。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">当前读取连接。</param>
    /// <param name="sql">固定 SQL 文本。</param>
    static void Execute(SqliteConnection connection, string sql)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = sql;
        command.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }

    /// <summary>统计一张表的行数。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">当前读取连接。</param>
    /// <param name="table">已知表名。</param>
    static long Count(SqliteConnection connection, string table)
    {
        return ScalarLong(connection, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM " + table + ";");
    }

    /// <summary>读取一个整数结果。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">当前读取连接。</param>
    /// <param name="sql">固定查询。</param>
    static long ScalarLong(SqliteConnection connection, string sql)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = sql;
        return Convert.ToInt64(command.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    /// <summary>读取一个文本结果。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">当前读取连接。</param>
    /// <param name="sql">固定查询。</param>
    static string ScalarString(SqliteConnection connection, string sql)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = sql;
        return Convert.ToString(command.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) ?? "";
    }

    /// <summary>读取尚未被队列线程取走的数据库操作数量。</summary>
    /// <param name="store">正在使用的存储。</param>
    static int PendingCount(SqliteStore store)
    {
        FieldInfo? field = typeof(SqliteStore).GetField("_queue", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
        var queue = field?.GetValue(store) as ICollection;
        return queue?.Count ?? 0;
    }

    /// <summary>只删除系统临时目录里本测试创建的子目录。</summary>
    sealed class IsolatedDirectory : IDisposable
    {
        public IsolatedDirectory()
        {
            string root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "FarmingAccountHandlerTests");
            FullPath = Path.Combine(root, Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(FullPath);
        }

        public string FullPath { get; }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            string full = Path.GetFullPath(FullPath);
            string root = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "FarmingAccountHandlerTests"));
            string prefix = root.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
            if (!full.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("拒绝删除测试目录之外的路径");
            if (Directory.Exists(full))
                Directory.Delete(full, true);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>限流窗口用的固定时钟。本项不断言限流。</summary>
    sealed class SteadyClock : IRouterClock
    {
        public long UnixMilliseconds => 1_700_000_000_000L;
    }
}
```

## T35：实现 TokenService 三个接口

- 来源：`06_M1_基础框架任务拆解.md` 第 1.2 节第 2 条、第 3.1 / 4.5 / 5.4 节 T35，依赖 T29
- 需求：R-S03
- 依据：Token 持久化 SHA-256 摘要、player_id、到期时间和撤销状态，明文只发给调用方；新登录撤销旧 Token；重启后仍可验证。`auth_token(token_hash PRIMARY KEY, player_id, expires_at_ms, revoked)` 已由 T28 建好，外键指向 `player(id)`。SQL 只经 `SqliteStore.ExecuteAsync`。期限由调用方传入，本项不读取组合根配置，也不实现 24 小时默认值
- 通过条件：新 Token 落库摘要可查；重启有效；撤销或到期返回 204
- 日期：2026-10-19
- 范围：只做 T35。不实现 T36 及以后，不写 SessionRegistry、AccountHandler 登录/重连/登出，不改协议，不改 PoC 库，不降低 PasswordHasher 的 600000 次迭代

### 任务、流程与验证

发放、校验和撤销都走现有数据库队列，不另开数据库线程。Token 原文由平台 CSPRNG 生成 32 字节，再编成 64 位小写十六进制。SHA-256 对这段原文的 UTF-8 字节计算，摘要同样存成 64 位小写十六进制。原文只作为 `IssueAsync` 的返回值，不写入 `auth_token`，不写日志，也不放进异常消息。

`IssueAsync` 在返回之前必须提交。它在同一个事务里把该玩家尚未撤销的记录改为已撤销，再插入新摘要。插入失败则整笔回滚，旧记录的撤销状态保持原样。`playerId` 小于等于 0 时直接拒绝，不返回 Token。玩家不存在时由外键失败抛出数据库异常，同样不返回 Token。

`ValidateAsync` 只按库里的摘要判断。新的 `TokenService` 或重新打开同一个库都能验证。`nowUnixMs >= expiresAtMs` 视为到期，返回 204，玩家编号为 0。已撤销、查无此摘要、空白和坏格式都是 204，玩家编号为 0。坏格式指不是恰好 64 位小写十六进制。数据库异常继续抛出，不改写成 204。调用前已取消或已入队但尚未执行时取消，都抛出取消异常，不返回 Token，也不返回 204。

`RevokePlayerAsync` 只把指定玩家尚未撤销的记录全部标成已撤销。没有记录或已经撤销时再调用仍然成功。其他玩家的记录不动。

```csharp
Task<string> IssueAsync(long playerId, long expiresAtMs, CancellationToken ct)
Task<TokenValidation> ValidateAsync(string token, long nowUnixMs, CancellationToken ct)
Task RevokePlayerAsync(long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
```

| 验证对象 | 验证方法 | 期待结果 | 实际结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 随机发放与摘要 | 为 4 名玩家各发放一次，用布尔比较原文是否重复，并独立计算 SHA-256 对照库存 | 原文互不相同；行数等于发放次数；库存是 SHA-256 摘要，不含原文 | 通过。`RandomIssues_AreDistinctAndStoreOnlyDigest`，控制台耗时 82 ms。4 行都是摘要且互不相同，未撤销行数为 4；`PasswordHasher.IterationCount` 为 600000 |
| 发放后验证 | 发放后立即用早于到期的时间验证 | Code 为 0，PlayerId 等于该玩家 | 通过。`Issue_ValidatesAfterNewServiceAndReopen` 的前半段，控制台耗时 59 ms（含重建与重开）。Code 为 0，PlayerId 等于发放时的玩家 |
| 重建服务与重开库 | 同一库上新建 TokenService，再关掉库重新打开并新建服务 | 两次验证都是 Code 0，且玩家编号不变 | 通过。同一用例。重建服务后 Code 为 0；Dispose 后用新 SqliteStore 打开同一文件，Code 仍为 0，玩家编号不变 |
| 到期边界 | 同一 Token 分别用到期前 1 毫秒、恰到期、到期后 1 毫秒验证 | 到期前为 0；恰到期和到期后都是 204，玩家编号为 0 | 通过。`ExpiryBoundary_RejectsAtAndAfterExpiry`，耗时 46 ms。到期时间 5000：4999 为 Code 0；5000 与 5001 都是 Code 204、PlayerId 0 |
| 撤销幂等与隔离 | 一名玩家有两条未撤销记录，另一名玩家有一条；对前者撤销两次 | 被撤销者两条都失效；另一人仍有效；第二次撤销不报错 | 通过。`Revoke_IsIdempotentAndLeavesOtherPlayer`，耗时 76 ms。前者已撤销 2 行、未撤销 0 行，校验 204；后者未撤销 1 行、已撤销 0 行，校验 Code 0 |
| 同玩家再发放 | 同一玩家发放两次 | 旧 Token 为 204；新 Token 为 0 且对应同一玩家 | 通过。`Reissue_RevokesPreviousToken`，耗时 73 ms。库存 2 行、未撤销 1 行；旧结果 204，新结果 Code 0 且玩家编号相同；两次原文的相等比较为 false |
| 新发放失败回滚 | 先发放成功，再用插入触发器让下一次发放失败 | 抛出数据库异常；旧 Token 仍为 0，且未撤销 | 通过。`InsertFailure_KeepsPreviousToken`，耗时 86 ms。SqliteException 消息含 token-insert-aborted；旧校验 Code 0；库存 1 行且未撤销 |
| 未知、坏格式、空白 | 未发放的合法格式、大写或过短、null、空串和空白 | 全部 Code 204，PlayerId 为 0 | 通过。`UnknownOrMalformed_Returns204WithoutPlayer`，耗时 45 ms。64 位 `a`、64 位大写、`abc`、空串、空白和 null 都是 204，PlayerId 为 0 |
| 非法玩家与外键 | playerId 为 0 或负数，以及不存在的正数玩家 | 不返回可用 Token；令牌行数仍为 0 | 通过。`IllegalPlayer_DoesNotReturnToken`，耗时 47 ms。0 和 -1 抛出 ArgumentOutOfRangeException；玩家 424242 抛出 SqliteException；令牌行数为 0 |
| 校验时数据库错误 | 把 auth_token 改名后再校验已发放的合法 Token | 抛出数据库异常，不返回 204 | 通过。`DatabaseError_PropagatesFromValidate`，耗时 77 ms。SqliteException 消息含 no such table，没有得到 TokenValidation |
| 排队取消 | 调用前取消，以及占住队列后取消尚未执行的发放和校验 | 取消异常；取消的发放不写行；取消的校验不返回 204 | 通过。`CancelWhileQueued_WritesNothingAndDoesNotValidate`，耗时 105 ms。调用前取消为 OperationCanceledException。排队发放为 TaskCanceledException，当时行数为 0。排队校验为 TaskCanceledException；随后正常校验仍为 Code 0，行数为 1 |
| 回归 | 过滤 TokenService、SqliteStore 与 AccountRepository | 失败 0；PasswordHasher 迭代次数仍为 600000 | 通过。TRX `failed=0`，`passed=30`，跳过 0。`TokenServiceTests` 10，`AccountRepositoryTests` 7，`SqliteStoreQueueTests` 7，`SqliteStoreTests` 6。迭代次数断言为 600000 |

```csharp
namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 已持久化的令牌摘要。只保存摘要和状态，不保存令牌原文。
/// </summary>
public sealed class TokenRecord
{
    /// <summary>用库中的一行组成记录。</summary>
    /// <param name="tokenHash">auth_token.token_hash，SHA-256 摘要的小写十六进制。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">auth_token.player_id，对应的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="expiresAtMs">auth_token.expires_at_ms，到期的 UTC Unix 毫秒。</param>
    /// <param name="revoked">auth_token.revoked 非 0 时为 true。</param>
    public TokenRecord(string tokenHash, long playerId, long expiresAtMs, bool revoked)
    {
        TokenHash = tokenHash;
        PlayerId = playerId;
        ExpiresAtMs = expiresAtMs;
        Revoked = revoked;
    }

    /// <summary>令牌摘要。不是令牌原文。</summary>
    public string TokenHash { get; }

    /// <summary>这条摘要所属的玩家。</summary>
    public long PlayerId { get; }

    /// <summary>到期时刻。校验时 now 大于等于该值则拒绝。</summary>
    public long ExpiresAtMs { get; }

    /// <summary>是否已撤销。</summary>
    public bool Revoked { get; }
}
```

#### 脚本：Server/CloudIsle.Server/Account/TokenValidation.cs

```csharp
namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 令牌校验结果。有效时 Code 为 0 并带玩家编号；无效时 Code 为 204 且玩家编号为 0。
/// </summary>
public sealed class TokenValidation
{
    /// <summary>摘要仍有效。</summary>
    public const int ValidCode = 0;

    /// <summary>空白、坏格式、未知、到期或已撤销。</summary>
    public const int InvalidCode = 204;

    /// <summary>记录一次校验结论。</summary>
    /// <param name="code">0 表示有效，204 表示无效。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">有效时为玩家编号，无效时必须为 0。</param>
    public TokenValidation(int code, long playerId)
    {
        Code = code;
        PlayerId = playerId;
    }

    /// <summary>0 有效，204 无效。</summary>
    public int Code { get; }

    /// <summary>有效时的玩家编号。无效时为 0，不带回玩家快照。</summary>
    public long PlayerId { get; }

    /// <summary>组成一条有效结果。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">库中读到的正数玩家编号。</param>
    public static TokenValidation Valid(long playerId)
    {
        return new TokenValidation(ValidCode, playerId);
    }

    /// <summary>组成一条无效结果，玩家编号固定为 0。</summary>
    public static TokenValidation Invalid()
    {
        return new TokenValidation(InvalidCode, 0);
    }
}
```

#### 脚本：Server/CloudIsle.Server/Account/TokenService.cs

```csharp
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using CloudIsle.Server.Data;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 发放、校验和撤销玩家令牌。原文只从发放返回，库里只留 SHA-256 摘要。
/// </summary>
public sealed class TokenService
{
    /// <summary>CSPRNG 输出的字节数。十六进制后长度为 64。</summary>
    const int TokenByteLength = 32;

    readonly SqliteStore _store;

    /// <summary>使用已经初始化的存储。不打开新的数据库线程。</summary>
    /// <param name="store">T29 的唯一队列。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public TokenService(SqliteStore store)
    {
        _store = store ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(store));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 撤销该玩家尚未撤销的摘要，并在同一事务写入新摘要。提交成功后才返回原文。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">必须是已存在玩家的正数编号。非法值不返回令牌。</param>
    /// <param name="expiresAtMs">调用方给定的到期 UTC Unix 毫秒。本方法不改期限。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">入队前取消则不写库，也不返回令牌。</param>
    /// <returns>64 位小写十六进制原文。调用方负责只把它交给客户端。</returns>
    public async Task<string> IssueAsync(long playerId, long expiresAtMs, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (playerId <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(playerId), "玩家编号必须为正数");

        string token = CreateToken();
        string tokenHash = Digest(token);
        await _store.ExecuteAsync(connection =>
        {
            Replace(connection, playerId, expiresAtMs, tokenHash);
            return 0;
        }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return token;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 按持久化摘要校验。到期边界是 now 大于等于库存到期时间。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="token">调用方持有的原文。空白或坏格式直接无效，不查库。</param>
    /// <param name="nowUnixMs">调用方给定的当前 UTC Unix 毫秒。测试不必真实等待。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">入队前取消则抛出取消，不返回 204。</param>
    /// <returns>有效时 Code 为 0；无效时 Code 为 204 且 PlayerId 为 0。</returns>
    public Task<TokenValidation> ValidateAsync(string token, long nowUnixMs, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (!IsCanonicalToken(token))
            return Task.FromResult(TokenValidation.Invalid());

        string tokenHash = Digest(token);
        return _store.ExecuteAsync(connection => Judge(connection, tokenHash, nowUnixMs), ct);
    }

    /// <summary>把指定玩家全部未撤销记录标成已撤销。没有可撤销记录时也成功。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要撤销的正数玩家编号。其他玩家不受影响。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">入队前取消则不写库。</param>
    public Task RevokePlayerAsync(long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (playerId <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(playerId), "玩家编号必须为正数");

        return _store.ExecuteAsync(connection =>
        {
            Revoke(connection, transaction: null, playerId);
            return 0;
        }, ct);
    }

    /// <summary>生成 32 字节高熵原文，并编成小写十六进制。</summary>
    static string CreateToken()
    {
        byte[] bytes = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(TokenByteLength);
        return ToHex(bytes);
    }

    /// <summary>计算原文 UTF-8 的 SHA-256，再编成小写十六进制。</summary>
    /// <param name="token">恰好 64 位小写十六进制的原文。</param>
    static string Digest(string token)
    {
        byte[] hash = SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(token));
        return ToHex(hash);
    }

    /// <summary>把字节编成小写十六进制，不附加分隔符。</summary>
    /// <param name="bytes">待编码的字节。</param>
    static string ToHex(byte[] bytes)
    {
        return Convert.ToHexString(bytes).ToLowerInvariant();
    }

    /// <summary>只接受 64 位小写十六进制。null、空白、大写和其他长度都不是原文格式。</summary>
    /// <param name="token">待检查的文本。</param>
    static bool IsCanonicalToken(string? token)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(token) || token.Length != TokenByteLength * 2)
            return false;

        foreach (char character in token)
        {
            bool hex = character is >= '0' and <= '9' or >= 'a' and <= 'f';
            if (!hex)
                return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>同一事务先撤销该玩家的旧摘要，再插入新摘要。任一语句失败都回滚。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">队列当前持有的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">新摘要所属玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="expiresAtMs">新摘要的到期时间。</param>
    /// <param name="tokenHash">新摘要。不是原文。</param>
    static void Replace(SqliteConnection connection, long playerId, long expiresAtMs, string tokenHash)
    {
        using var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();
        try
        {
            Revoke(connection, transaction, playerId);
            Insert(connection, transaction, playerId, expiresAtMs, tokenHash);
            transaction.Commit();
        }
        catch
        {
            Rollback(transaction);
            throw;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>按摘要读取一行。没有记录时返回无效，不把数据库异常改成 204。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">队列当前持有的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="tokenHash">原文算出的摘要。</param>
    /// <param name="nowUnixMs">调用方传入的当前时间。</param>
    static TokenValidation Judge(SqliteConnection connection, string tokenHash, long nowUnixMs)
    {
        TokenRecord? record = Read(connection, tokenHash);
        if (record == null || record.Revoked || nowUnixMs >= record.ExpiresAtMs || record.PlayerId <= 0)
            return TokenValidation.Invalid();
        return TokenValidation.Valid(record.PlayerId);
    }

    /// <summary>按主键读取摘要行。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">队列当前持有的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="tokenHash">要查找的摘要。</param>
    static TokenRecord? Read(SqliteConnection connection, string tokenHash)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = """
            SELECT player_id, expires_at_ms, revoked
            FROM auth_token
            WHERE token_hash = $tokenHash;
            """;
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$tokenHash", tokenHash);
        using var reader = command.ExecuteReader();
        if (!reader.Read())
            return null;

        long playerId = reader.GetInt64(0);
        long expiresAtMs = reader.GetInt64(1);
        bool revoked = reader.GetInt64(2) != 0;
        if (reader.Read())
            throw new InvalidDataException("同一令牌摘要读到多行");
        return new TokenRecord(tokenHash, playerId, expiresAtMs, revoked);
    }

    /// <summary>把该玩家尚未撤销的行全部标成已撤销。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">队列当前持有的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="transaction">发放事务。单独撤销时为空，语句自动提交。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">要撤销的玩家。</param>
    static void Revoke(SqliteConnection connection, SqliteTransaction? transaction, long playerId)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.Transaction = transaction;
        command.CommandText = """
            UPDATE auth_token
            SET revoked = 1
            WHERE player_id = $playerId AND revoked = 0;
            """;
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$playerId", playerId);
        command.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }

    /// <summary>插入一条未撤销摘要。玩家不存在时由外键失败，事务回滚。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">队列当前持有的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="transaction">当前发放事务。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">新摘要所属玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="expiresAtMs">新摘要的到期时间。</param>
    /// <param name="tokenHash">新摘要。</param>
    static void Insert(
        SqliteConnection connection,
        SqliteTransaction transaction,
        long playerId,
        long expiresAtMs,
        string tokenHash)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.Transaction = transaction;
        command.CommandText = """
            INSERT INTO auth_token (token_hash, player_id, expires_at_ms, revoked)
            VALUES ($tokenHash, $playerId, $expiresAtMs, 0);
            """;
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$tokenHash", tokenHash);
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$playerId", playerId);
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$expiresAtMs", expiresAtMs);
        if (command.ExecuteNonQuery() != 1)
            throw new InvalidDataException("新令牌摘要没有写入一行");
    }

    /// <summary>结束未提交的事务。已经结束时忽略，避免盖住原来的异常。</summary>
    /// <param name="transaction">当前发放事务。</param>
    static void Rollback(SqliteTransaction transaction)
    {
        try
        {
            transaction.Rollback();
        }
        catch (SqliteException)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using CloudIsle.Server.Account;
using CloudIsle.Server.Data;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>
/// TokenService 的发放、校验、撤销和失败回滚。断言只用布尔、计数和错误码。
/// </summary>
public sealed class TokenServiceTests
{
    const long ExpiresAt = 5_000;

    /// <summary>多次随机发放互不相同，库存只有 SHA-256 摘要。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task RandomIssues_AreDistinctAndStoreOnlyDigest()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        var service = new TokenService(store);
        long[] players = new long[4];
        string[] tokens = new string[players.Length];
        for (int i = 0; i < players.Length; i++)
        {
            players[i] = await AddPlayer(store, "player-" + i.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            tokens[i] = await service.IssueAsync(players[i], ExpiresAt, CancellationToken.None);
        }

        Assert.That(AllDistinct(tokens), Is.True);
        Assert.That(PasswordHasher.IterationCount, Is.EqualTo(600_000));
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        List<string> stored = ReadHashes(connection);
        Assert.That(stored.Count, Is.EqualTo(tokens.Length));
        Assert.That(StoredPlaintext(stored, tokens), Is.False);
        Assert.That(StoredDigests(stored, tokens), Is.True);
        Assert.That(CountWhere(connection, "revoked = 0"), Is.EqualTo(tokens.Length));
    }

    /// <summary>发放后立即验证，重建服务并重开库后仍然有效。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Issue_ValidatesAfterNewServiceAndReopen()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        string database = DatabasePath(dir);
        string token;
        long playerId;
        using (var store = OpenStore(dir))
        {
            playerId = await AddPlayer(store, "ada");
            var first = new TokenService(store);
            token = await first.IssueAsync(playerId, ExpiresAt, CancellationToken.None);
            TokenValidation issued = await first.ValidateAsync(token, ExpiresAt - 1, CancellationToken.None);
            Assert.That(issued.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.ValidCode));
            Assert.That(issued.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(playerId));

            var rebuilt = new TokenService(store);
            TokenValidation again = await rebuilt.ValidateAsync(token, ExpiresAt - 1, CancellationToken.None);
            Assert.That(again.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.ValidCode));
            Assert.That(again.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(playerId));
        }

        using var reopenedStore = new SqliteStore();
        reopenedStore.Initialize(database);
        var reopened = new TokenService(reopenedStore);
        TokenValidation restored = await reopened.ValidateAsync(token, ExpiresAt - 1, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(restored.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.ValidCode));
        Assert.That(restored.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(playerId));
    }

    /// <summary>到期前有效，恰到期和到期后都拒绝。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ExpiryBoundary_RejectsAtAndAfterExpiry()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        long playerId = await AddPlayer(store, "ada");
        var service = new TokenService(store);
        string token = await service.IssueAsync(playerId, ExpiresAt, CancellationToken.None);

        TokenValidation before = await service.ValidateAsync(token, ExpiresAt - 1, CancellationToken.None);
        TokenValidation exact = await service.ValidateAsync(token, ExpiresAt, CancellationToken.None);
        TokenValidation after = await service.ValidateAsync(token, ExpiresAt + 1, CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.That(before.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.ValidCode));
        Assert.That(before.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(playerId));
        Assert.That(exact.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.InvalidCode));
        Assert.That(exact.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(after.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.InvalidCode));
        Assert.That(after.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>重复撤销只影响指定玩家。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Revoke_IsIdempotentAndLeavesOtherPlayer()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        long firstPlayer = await AddPlayer(store, "ada");
        long secondPlayer = await AddPlayer(store, "bea");
        var service = new TokenService(store);
        string first = await service.IssueAsync(firstPlayer, ExpiresAt, CancellationToken.None);
        string second = await service.IssueAsync(secondPlayer, ExpiresAt, CancellationToken.None);
        await store.ExecuteAsync(connection =>
        {
            using var extra = connection.CreateCommand();
            extra.CommandText = """
                INSERT INTO auth_token (token_hash, player_id, expires_at_ms, revoked)
                VALUES ($tokenHash, $playerId, $expiresAtMs, 0);
                """;
            extra.Parameters.AddWithValue("$tokenHash", new string('c', 64));
            extra.Parameters.AddWithValue("$playerId", firstPlayer);
            extra.Parameters.AddWithValue("$expiresAtMs", ExpiresAt);
            extra.ExecuteNonQuery();
            return 0;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        await service.RevokePlayerAsync(firstPlayer, CancellationToken.None);
        await service.RevokePlayerAsync(firstPlayer, CancellationToken.None);

        TokenValidation revoked = await service.ValidateAsync(first, ExpiresAt - 1, CancellationToken.None);
        TokenValidation kept = await service.ValidateAsync(second, ExpiresAt - 1, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(revoked.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.InvalidCode));
        Assert.That(revoked.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(kept.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.ValidCode));
        Assert.That(kept.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(secondPlayer));

        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(CountFor(connection, firstPlayer, revokedOnly: true), Is.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(CountFor(connection, firstPlayer, revokedOnly: false), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(CountFor(connection, secondPlayer, revokedOnly: false), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(CountFor(connection, secondPlayer, revokedOnly: true), Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>同一玩家再次发放后，旧原文失效，新原文有效。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Reissue_RevokesPreviousToken()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        long playerId = await AddPlayer(store, "ada");
        var service = new TokenService(store);
        string previous = await service.IssueAsync(playerId, ExpiresAt, CancellationToken.None);
        string current = await service.IssueAsync(playerId, ExpiresAt + 10, CancellationToken.None);

        TokenValidation oldResult = await service.ValidateAsync(previous, ExpiresAt - 1, CancellationToken.None);
        TokenValidation newResult = await service.ValidateAsync(current, ExpiresAt - 1, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(SameText(previous, current), Is.False);
        Assert.That(oldResult.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.InvalidCode));
        Assert.That(oldResult.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(newResult.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.ValidCode));
        Assert.That(newResult.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(playerId));

        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection), Is.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(CountWhere(connection, "revoked = 0"), Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>新摘要插入失败时，旧令牌仍有效且未撤销。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task InsertFailure_KeepsPreviousToken()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        long playerId = await AddPlayer(store, "ada");
        var service = new TokenService(store);
        string previous = await service.IssueAsync(playerId, ExpiresAt, CancellationToken.None);
        using (var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir)))
        {
            Execute(connection, """
                CREATE TRIGGER abort_token BEFORE INSERT ON auth_token
                BEGIN
                  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'token-insert-aborted');
                END;
                """);
        }

        SqliteException? error = null;
        try
        {
            await service.IssueAsync(playerId, ExpiresAt + 10, CancellationToken.None);
            Assert.Fail("新摘要插入失败时应抛出数据库异常");

        catch (SqliteException ex)
        {
```
