```csharp
        }

        Assert.That(error, Is.Not.Null);
        Assert.That(error!.Message, Does.Contain("token-insert-aborted"));
        TokenValidation stillValid = await service.ValidateAsync(previous, ExpiresAt - 1, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(stillValid.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.ValidCode));
        Assert.That(stillValid.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(playerId));
        using var check = Open(DatabasePath(dir));

    /// <summary>未知、坏格式和空白都是 204，且不带回玩家。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task UnknownOrMalformed_Returns204WithoutPlayer()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();

        TokenValidation blank = await service.ValidateAsync("   ", ExpiresAt - 1, CancellationToken.None);

        AssertRejected(missing);

    /// <summary>已入队但尚未执行时取消，不写令牌，也不返回伪造的校验结果。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task CancelWhileQueued_WritesNothingAndDoesNotValidate()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        long playerId = await AddPlayer(store, "ada");
        var service = new TokenService(store);
        using var issuedCancel = new CancellationTokenSource();
        issuedCancel.Cancel();
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<OperationCanceledException>(async () =>
            await service.IssueAsync(playerId, ExpiresAt, issuedCancel.Token));

        var entered = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        Task<int> hold = store.ExecuteAsync(_ =>
        {
            entered.TrySetResult();
            if (!release.Task.Wait(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)))
                throw new TimeoutException("排队占用没有被放开");
            return 0;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        await entered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        Task<string> pending = service.IssueAsync(playerId, ExpiresAt, cts.Token);
        cts.Cancel();
        release.TrySetResult();

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () => await pending);
        await hold;
        using var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(connection), Is.EqualTo(0));

        string token = await service.IssueAsync(playerId, ExpiresAt, CancellationToken.None);
        var validateEntered = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var validateRelease = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        Task<int> validateHold = store.ExecuteAsync(_ =>
        {
            validateEntered.TrySetResult();
            if (!validateRelease.Task.Wait(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)))
                throw new TimeoutException("校验排队占用没有被放开");
            return 0;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await validateEntered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        using var validateCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        Task<TokenValidation> validation = service.ValidateAsync(token, ExpiresAt - 1, validateCts.Token);
        validateCts.Cancel();
        validateRelease.TrySetResult();

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () => await validation);
        await validateHold;
        TokenValidation after = await service.ValidateAsync(token, ExpiresAt - 1, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(after.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.ValidCode));
        Assert.That(after.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(playerId));
        using var afterConnection = Open(DatabasePath(dir));
        Assert.That(Count(afterConnection), Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>无效结果必须是 204 且玩家编号为 0。</summary>
    /// <param name="validation">一次校验结果。</param>
    static void AssertRejected(TokenValidation validation)
    {
        Assert.That(validation.Code, Is.EqualTo(TokenValidation.InvalidCode));
        Assert.That(validation.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>插入账号和玩家，返回玩家编号。不经过密码派生。</summary>
    /// <param name="store">已经初始化的测试库。</param>
    /// <param name="username">本用例内唯一的用户名。</param>
    static Task<long> AddPlayer(SqliteStore store, string username)
    {
        return store.ExecuteAsync(connection =>
        {
            using var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();
            using (var account = connection.CreateCommand())
            {
                account.Transaction = transaction;
                account.CommandText = """
                    INSERT INTO account (username, pwd_hash, salt, created_at)
                    VALUES ($username, $pwdHash, $salt, $createdAt);
                    """;
                account.Parameters.AddWithValue("$username", username);
                account.Parameters.AddWithValue("$pwdHash", "not-a-password-hash");
                account.Parameters.AddWithValue("$salt", "not-a-salt");
                account.Parameters.AddWithValue("$createdAt", 1L);
                account.ExecuteNonQuery();
            }

            long accountId;
            using (var id = connection.CreateCommand())
            {
                id.Transaction = transaction;
                id.CommandText = "SELECT last_insert_rowid();";
                accountId = Convert.ToInt64(id.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            }

            using var player = connection.CreateCommand();
            player.Transaction = transaction;
            player.CommandText = """
                INSERT INTO player (account_id, nickname)
                VALUES ($accountId, $nickname);
                """;
            player.Parameters.AddWithValue("$accountId", accountId);
            player.Parameters.AddWithValue("$nickname", username);
            player.ExecuteNonQuery();
            using var playerId = connection.CreateCommand();
            playerId.Transaction = transaction;
            playerId.CommandText = "SELECT last_insert_rowid();";
            long idValue = Convert.ToInt64(playerId.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            transaction.Commit();
            return idValue;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
    }

    /// <summary>原文两两都不相同。失败时只报告布尔值。</summary>
    /// <param name="tokens">本次发放返回的原文。</param>
    static bool AllDistinct(IReadOnlyList<string> tokens)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < tokens.Count; i++)
        {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < tokens.Count; j++)
            {
                if (SameText(tokens[i], tokens[j]))
                    return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>库存是否出现过任一原文。</summary>
    /// <param name="stored">token_hash 列。</param>
    /// <param name="tokens">发放返回的原文。</param>
    static bool StoredPlaintext(IReadOnlyList<string> stored, IReadOnlyList<string> tokens)
    {
        foreach (string hash in stored)
        {
            foreach (string token in tokens)
            {
                if (SameText(hash, token))
                    return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>每一份原文的 SHA-256 是否都能在库里找到。</summary>
    /// <param name="stored">token_hash 列。</param>
    /// <param name="tokens">发放返回的原文。</param>
    static bool StoredDigests(IReadOnlyList<string> stored, IReadOnlyList<string> tokens)
    {
        foreach (string token in tokens)
        {
            string digest = Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(token))).ToLowerInvariant();
            bool found = false;
            foreach (string hash in stored)
            {
                if (SameText(hash, digest))
                    found = true;
            }

            if (!found)
                return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>等长时做固定时间比较。长度不同直接视为不同，避免把原文写进断言。</summary>
    /// <param name="left">第一段文本。</param>
    /// <param name="right">第二段文本。</param>
    static bool SameText(string left, string right)
    {
        if (left.Length != right.Length)
            return false;
        return CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(left), Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(right));
    }

    /// <summary>打开隔离库并完成现有迁移。</summary>
    /// <param name="dir">本用例的临时目录。</param>
    static SqliteStore OpenStore(IsolatedDirectory dir)
    {
        var store = new SqliteStore();
        store.Initialize(DatabasePath(dir));
        return store;
    }

    /// <summary>返回本用例数据库文件路径。</summary>
    /// <param name="dir">本用例的临时目录。</param>
    static string DatabasePath(IsolatedDirectory dir)
    {
        return Path.Combine(dir.FullPath, "game.db");
    }

    /// <summary>另开一条不进连接池的连接，供计数使用。</summary>
    /// <param name="database">数据库文件路径。</param>
    static SqliteConnection Open(string database)
    {
        var builder = new SqliteConnectionStringBuilder
        {
            DataSource = database,
            Mode = SqliteOpenMode.ReadWriteCreate,
            Pooling = false
        };
        var connection = new SqliteConnection(builder.ToString());
        connection.Open();
        using var pragma = connection.CreateCommand();
        pragma.CommandText = "PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;";
        pragma.ExecuteNonQuery();
        return connection;
    }

    /// <summary>执行一段测试夹具 SQL。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">已经打开的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="sql">触发器或改名语句。</param>
    static void Execute(SqliteConnection connection, string sql)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = sql;
        command.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }

    /// <summary>读取全部摘要文本，调用方只用它做布尔比较。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">已经打开的连接。</param>
    static List<string> ReadHashes(SqliteConnection connection)
    {
        var hashes = new List<string>();
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = "SELECT token_hash FROM auth_token ORDER BY rowid;";
        using var reader = command.ExecuteReader();
        while (reader.Read())
            hashes.Add(reader.GetString(0));
        return hashes;
    }

    /// <summary>统计令牌行数。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">已经打开的连接。</param>
    static long Count(SqliteConnection connection)
    {
        return CountWhere(connection, "1 = 1");
    }

    /// <summary>按固定条件统计令牌行数。条件只来自测试代码。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">已经打开的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="where">不含外部输入的条件。</param>
    static long CountWhere(SqliteConnection connection, string where)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_token WHERE " + where + ";";
        return Convert.ToInt64(command.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    /// <summary>统计某玩家已撤销或未撤销的行数。</summary>
    /// <param name="connection">已经打开的连接。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家编号。</param>
    /// <param name="revokedOnly">true 统计已撤销，false 统计未撤销。</param>
    static long CountFor(SqliteConnection connection, long playerId, bool revokedOnly)
    {
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = """
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM auth_token
            WHERE player_id = $playerId AND revoked = $revoked;
            """;
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$playerId", playerId);
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$revoked", revokedOnly ? 1 : 0);
        return Convert.ToInt64(command.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }

    /// <summary>只删除系统临时目录里本测试创建的子目录。</summary>
    sealed class IsolatedDirectory : IDisposable
    {
        public IsolatedDirectory()
        {
            string root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "FarmingTokenServiceTests");
            FullPath = Path.Combine(root, Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(FullPath);
        }

        /// <summary>本用例独占的绝对路径。</summary>
        public string FullPath { get; }

        /// <summary>确认路径仍在指定根目录下后再删除。</summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            string full = Path.GetFullPath(FullPath);
            string root = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "FarmingTokenServiceTests"));
            string prefix = root.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
            if (!full.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("拒绝删除测试目录之外的路径");
            if (Directory.Exists(full))
                Directory.Delete(full, true);
        }
    }
}
```


## T36：实现 SessionRegistry.BindAsync

- 来源：`06_M1_基础框架任务拆解.md` 第 2.4 / 4.5 / 5.4 节 T36，依赖 T30、T35、T23
- 需求：R-S03
- 依据：同账号单在线。新连接替换时先让旧连接失去当前身份，再发送正式 `KickNtf`（生成枚举 `KickReason.KickElsewhere`，序号 0），然后关闭旧连接。旧连接的完成回调只按会话编号匹配清理，不能解绑新连接。绑定与现有 `PlayerQueue` 同一玩家串行；已经处在该玩家动作里时直接执行，避免嵌套入队死锁
- 通过条件：新连接取代旧连接；旧连接清理不会移除新连接
- 日期：2026-10-19
- 范围：只做 T36。不实现 T37 及以后，不签发 Token，不实现 Login/Logout，不改注册协议，不改 PoC 入口，不降低 PasswordHasher 的 600000 次迭代。Token 撤旧换新已在 T35，留给 T37 接线

### 任务、流程与验证

同一玩家的绑定进入该玩家已有的 `PlayerQueue`。调用发生在这个玩家自己的队列动作里时，直接执行本次绑定，不再入队。不同玩家仍由队列并行执行。

改映射之前如果调用已取消，抛出取消异常，字典保持原样。改映射在一把字典锁里完成：先把同一连接从原玩家摘下，再让本玩家的旧连接退出当前映射并记为正在关闭，最后写入新连接。锁内不做网络等待，也不调用日志或关闭回调。

锁外向旧连接发送正式 `KickNtf`。通知和等待关闭共用一个有限预算，默认 2 秒，测试可改短。写入失败、超时或对端无响应都只记日志，说明不保证送达，然后仍然发起关闭。预算用尽后绑定返回，不再占住该玩家队列；旧连接的完成仍由观察任务收尾。

同一会话再次绑定给同一玩家时不发送踢线。已完成或正在关闭的会话拒绝绑定。自然断线监听 `ClientSession.Completion`，只在反向索引仍指向该会话时删除。观察任务结束后从集合移除。

后续组合根用服务端 `ClientSession.SessionId` 构造 `RequestContext`。玩家编号只来自这里的反向索引，未绑定时为 0。

```csharp
Task BindAsync(long playerId, ClientSession session, CancellationToken ct)
bool IsCurrent(long playerId, long sessionId)
bool TryGetCurrentSession(long playerId, out ClientSession? session)
bool TryGetPlayerId(long sessionId, out long playerId)
RequestContext CreateRequestContext(ClientSession session, ushort msgId, uint seq)
```

| 验证对象 | 验证方法 | 期待结果 | 实际结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| B 替换 A | 同一玩家先后绑定两个已运行会话。旧连接写出立即完成 | A 只收到一帧正式 KickNtf，reason 为 KickElsewhere，seq 为 0；A 关闭；B 仍是 current | 通过。`Replace_SendsOneKickAndKeepsNewCurrent`，9 ms。A 只有一帧，消息 1010，seq 为 0，reason 为 KickElsewhere；A 的 Completion 已完成；B 仍 current。日志含“不代表对端已经处理” |
| A 晚到完成 | 替换后先确认 A 已失去 current，再放行 A 的完成 | A 的完成回调之后 B 仍是 current | 通过。`LateClose_DoesNotRemoveReplacement`，6 ms。写出进入屏障时 B 已是 current，A 不是。此时把 A 再绑给玩家 9 被拒绝。放行并等到 A 的 Completion 之后，B 仍 current，A 收到一帧 KickElsewhere |
| 连续三次顶号 | 同一玩家连续绑定三个会话 | 只有最后一条是 current；前两条各一帧踢线 | 通过。`ThreeReplacements_OnlyLastStaysCurrent`，1 ms。前两条各一帧 KickElsewhere、seq 0；第三条没有踢线帧；只有第三条 current；在线玩家数为 1 |
| 重复绑定 | 同一会话对同一玩家绑定两次 | 不向自己发送 KickNtf，映射仍是该会话 | 通过。`RebindSameSession_DoesNotKickItself`，1 ms。写出字节为空；会话仍 current；观察数为 1；Completion 未完成 |
| 同连接换玩家 | 会话先属玩家 1，再绑定到已有另一条连接的玩家 2 | 会话只属于玩家 2；玩家 2 的旧连接收到踢线；玩家 1 不再 current | 通过。`MoveSessionToOtherPlayer_DropsPreviousOwner`，4 ms。移动的连接没有踢线帧；玩家 2 的旧连接有一帧 KickElsewhere；反向索引只剩玩家 2；两边计数值都是 1。另有 `ConcurrentBindSameSession_BelongsToOnePlayer`，2 ms，两名玩家同时绑定同一连接后归属数是 1 |
| 自然断线 | 绑定后结束读流，等待 Completion 和观察任务 | 正向、反向和观察集合都为空 | 通过。`NaturalDisconnect_ReleasesMapsAndWatch`，不足 1 ms。读端结束后 Completion 完成，WhenIdle 返回。current 为 false，玩家、会话、观察、正在关闭四项计数都是 0 |
| 关闭后拒绝 | 会话 CloseAsync 完成后再绑定 | 抛出 InvalidOperationException，不进入映射 | 通过。`ClosedSession_BindIsRejected`，1 ms。异常消息含“已关闭”。玩家数和观察数都是 0 |
| 通知失败 | 旧连接写出立即失败 | 新连接仍 current；日志写明未能确认送达；旧连接仍被关闭 | 通过。`KickSendFailure_StillClosesOldAndKeepsNew`，1 ms。新连接仍 current。日志含“未能确认送达”和“不保证对方收到”。旧连接 Completion 完成之后新连接仍 current |
| 通知阻塞 | 旧连接写出不返回，预算 200 毫秒 | 绑定在预算附近返回，不等待无限写出；新连接仍 current | 通过。`KickSendBlocks_ReturnsWithinBudget`，217 ms，低于 1.5 秒。新连接 current，旧连接不是。日志含“未能确认送达”和“不再等待”。随后旧连接 Completion 完成 |
| 改映射前取消 | 先占住该玩家队列，再取消尚未开始的绑定 | 取消异常；没有映射，没有观察任务 | 通过。`CancelBeforeMap_LeavesNoMapping`，1 ms。占住队列时尚未 current。取消后任务类型是 TaskCanceledException。玩家、会话、观察计数都是 0 |
| 改映射后取消 | 映射已经换成新连接、旧通知仍阻塞时取消 | 不回滚新映射；旧连接在预算内收尾 | 通过。`CancelAfterMap_KeepsNewAndFinishesOld`，6 ms。写出屏障内新连接已是 current。取消后仍是 current。放行后绑定任务正常结束，旧连接 Completion 完成，新连接仍 current |
| 队列内绑定 | 在该玩家队列动作里调用 BindAsync | 动作能结束，不嵌套死锁 | 通过。`BindInsidePlayerAction_DoesNotDeadlock`，21 ms。外层动作和 BindAsync 都在 5 秒内结束，会话成为 current |
| 不同玩家 | 两名玩家的替换同时停在踢线写出 | 两边都进入写出后才放行，互不等待 | 通过。`DifferentPlayers_ReplaceInParallel`，2 ms。两个 Entered 都完成时，两个绑定任务都还没结束。放行后两边的新连接都是 current |
| 请求上下文 | 用服务端会话构造 RequestContext | SessionId 是会话自己的编号；玩家编号来自注册表，未绑定为 0 | 通过。`CreateRequestContext_UsesServerSessionAndRegistryPlayer`，3 ms。绑定前 SessionId 为 151、PlayerId 为 0、msgId 1005、seq 3。绑定后 PlayerId 为 18，msgId 为 LoginReq 的正式编号，seq 4。TryGetCurrentSession 取到同一会话 |
| 真实套接字 | 环回上 B 顶替 A | A 只收到 KickNtf 后断开；B 仍 current 且能回包 | 通过。`Loopback_ReplacementReceivesFormalKick`，33 ms。A 读到的帧是 KickNtf、seq 0、KickElsewhere，随后对端结束。B 仍 current，seq 3 的回包正文是 9。关闭 B 并 WhenIdle 后四项计数都是 0 |

#### 脚本：Server/CloudIsle.Server/Account/SessionRegistry.cs

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using CloudIsle.Net;
using Google.Protobuf;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Network;
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 同一玩家只保留一条当前连接。新连接写入映射后，旧连接才收到正式踢线并关闭。
/// 不签发令牌，也不处理登录或登出。
/// </summary>
public sealed class SessionRegistry
{
    /// <summary>未另行指定时，踢线写入和等待旧连接关闭共用的上限。</summary>
    public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultKickBudget = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);

    readonly PlayerQueue _queue;
    readonly TimeSpan _kickBudget;
    readonly Action<string> _log;
    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, ClientSession> _byPlayer = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, long> _bySession = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, Task> _watches = new();
    readonly HashSet<long> _retiring = new();

    /// <summary>使用共享玩家队列，踢线预算为 2 秒，日志写到控制台。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerQueue">同玩家串行的队列。本对象不释放它。</param>
    public SessionRegistry(PlayerQueue playerQueue)
        : this(playerQueue, DefaultKickBudget, null)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>使用共享玩家队列，并指定踢线预算和日志。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerQueue">同玩家串行的队列。绑定会进入这名玩家的队列；本对象不释放它。</param>
    /// <param name="kickBudget">旧连接通知和等待关闭的合计上限，必须为正。用尽后不再占住玩家队列。</param>
    /// <param name="log">诊断输出。为空时写到控制台。回调在字典锁外调用。</param>
    public SessionRegistry(PlayerQueue playerQueue, TimeSpan kickBudget, Action<string>? log)
    {
        if (playerQueue == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(playerQueue));
        if (kickBudget <= TimeSpan.Zero)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(kickBudget), "踢线预算必须为正");

        _queue = playerQueue;
        _kickBudget = kickBudget;
        _log = log ?? (static message => Console.WriteLine(message));
    }

    /// <summary>当前仍登记为在线的玩家数。</summary>
    internal int MappedPlayerCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _byPlayer.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>会话到玩家的反向索引数量。</summary>
    internal int MappedSessionCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _bySession.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>尚未结束的会话观察数。结束后会从集合删除。</summary>
    internal int WatchCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _watches.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>已失去当前身份、关闭尚未观察结束的会话数。</summary>
    internal int RetiringCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _retiring.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>等待已经登记的观察任务结束。仍在运行的会话会使这个等待一直停着。</summary>
    internal async Task WhenIdleAsync()
    {
        while (true)
        {
            Task[] pending;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_watches.Count == 0)
                    return;
                pending = _watches.Values.ToArray();
            }

            await Task.WhenAll(pending).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 把连接登记为该玩家的唯一在线会话。同一会话重复绑定不踢自己。
    /// 已经处在该玩家队列动作中时直接执行，避免再次入队死锁。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要占线的玩家。必须是正数。不从客户端报文读取。</param>
    /// <param name="session">服务端这条连接。已关闭或正在因顶号关闭时拒绝。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">只在改映射前生效。改映射之后取消不回滚新映射，旧连接仍按预算收尾。</param>
    public Task BindAsync(long playerId, ClientSession session, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (session == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(session));
        if (playerId <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(playerId), "玩家编号必须为正数");

        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (PlayerQueue.IsCurrentPlayer(playerId))
            return BindCoreAsync(playerId, session, ct);

        return _queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, token => BindCoreAsync(playerId, session, token), ct);
    }

    /// <summary>这名玩家的当前连接是不是这条会话。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要核对的玩家。没有在线会话时返回 false。</param>
    /// <param name="sessionId">服务端会话编号。</param>
    public bool IsCurrent(long playerId, long sessionId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == sessionId
                && _bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long mapped)
                && mapped == playerId;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>按玩家取当前连接。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要查询的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="session">找到时是当前连接；否则为 null。</param>
    /// <returns>该玩家有当前连接时为 true。</returns>
    public bool TryGetCurrentSession(long playerId, [NotNullWhen(true)] out ClientSession? session)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current))
            {
                session = current;
                return true;
            }
        }

        session = null;
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>按服务端会话编号反查玩家。</summary>
    /// <param name="sessionId">服务端会话编号。不采用客户端自行声明的编号。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">找到时为注册表里的玩家；否则为 0。</param>
    /// <returns>该会话仍是某玩家的当前连接时为 true。</returns>
    public bool TryGetPlayerId(long sessionId, out long playerId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long mapped)
                && _byPlayer.TryGetValue(mapped, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == sessionId)
            {
                playerId = mapped;
                return true;
            }
        }

        playerId = 0;
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 用这条服务端连接构造请求上下文。玩家编号只取注册表，未绑定为 0。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="session">正在处理的服务端连接。会话编号取自该对象。</param>
    /// <param name="msgId">本帧的正式消息编号。不从正文推断玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="seq">本帧序号。</param>
    public RequestContext CreateRequestContext(ClientSession session, ushort msgId, uint seq)
    {
        if (session == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(session));

        long playerId = 0;
        if (TryGetPlayerId(session.SessionId, out long mapped))
            playerId = mapped;

        return new RequestContext(session.SessionId, playerId, msgId, seq);
    }

    /// <summary>在玩家队列内完成一次绑定。调用方保证同一玩家不会并发进入这里。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">本次占线的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="session">要成为当前连接的会话。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">改映射前取消则原样抛出，并且不改字典。</param>
    async Task BindCoreAsync(long playerId, ClientSession session, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ClientSession? retiring = null;
        TaskCompletionSource? watch = null;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            if (session.Completion.IsCompleted)
            {
                UnmapIfMatch(session.SessionId);
                throw new InvalidOperationException("已关闭的会话不能绑定");
            }

            if (_retiring.Contains(session.SessionId))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("正在关闭的会话不能重新绑定");

            bool sameCurrent = _byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == session.SessionId;
            if (!sameCurrent)
            {
                if (_bySession.TryGetValue(session.SessionId, out long previousPlayer) && previousPlayer != playerId)
                {
                    if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(previousPlayer, out ClientSession? previous)
                        && previous.SessionId == session.SessionId)
                    {
                        _byPlayer.Remove(previousPlayer);
                    }

                    _bySession.Remove(session.SessionId);
                }

                if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? old) && old.SessionId != session.SessionId)
                {
                    _byPlayer.Remove(playerId);
                    _bySession.Remove(old.SessionId);
                    _retiring.Add(old.SessionId);
                    retiring = old;
                }

                _byPlayer[playerId] = session;
                _bySession[session.SessionId] = playerId;
            }

            if (!_watches.ContainsKey(session.SessionId))
            {
                watch = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
                _watches[session.SessionId] = watch.Task;
            }
        }

        if (watch != null)
            Observe(RunWatchAsync(session, watch));

        if (retiring != null)
            await RetireAsync(retiring, playerId).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>等会话结束后，仅当反向索引仍是它时才删除。然后丢掉观察项。</summary>
    /// <param name="session">被观察的连接。完成任务是它自己的 Completion。</param>
    /// <param name="done">交给 WhenIdleAsync 的完成源。清理后再完成，避免漏等。</param>
    async Task RunWatchAsync(ClientSession session, TaskCompletionSource done)
    {
        try
        {
            await Task.Yield();
            await session.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally
        {
            try
            {
                lock (_gate)
                {
                    UnmapIfMatch(session.SessionId);
                    _retiring.Remove(session.SessionId);
                    if (_watches.TryGetValue(session.SessionId, out Task? task) && ReferenceEquals(task, done.Task))
                        _watches.Remove(session.SessionId);
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                done.TrySetResult();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>锁外发送正式踢线并关闭。失败或超时只记日志，不把新映射撤掉。</summary>
    /// <param name="oldSession">已经从当前映射移除的旧连接。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">这次绑定的玩家，只写入日志。</param>
    async Task RetireAsync(ClientSession oldSession, long playerId)
    {
        Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 已失去当前身份。KickNtf 与关闭等待预算 {_kickBudget.TotalMilliseconds.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} 毫秒。超时或失败不保证通知送达，仍会关闭旧连接。");
        using var budget = new CancellationTokenSource(_kickBudget);
        try
        {
            await oldSession.SendAsync(CreateKickPacket(), budget.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 已写入 KickNtf（KickElsewhere，seq=0）。写入完成不代表对端已经处理。");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 的 KickNtf 未能确认送达（{ex.GetType().Name}）。不保证对方收到，仍关闭旧连接。");
        }

        try
        {
            await oldSession.CloseAsync("顶号", budget.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 在预算内没有完成关闭（{ex.GetType().Name}）。关闭已经发起，玩家队列不再等待。");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>调用方必须已经持有字典锁。只删除仍然指向这个会话编号的索引。</summary>
    /// <param name="sessionId">完成或被拒绝的服务端会话编号。</param>
    void UnmapIfMatch(long sessionId)
    {
        if (!_bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long playerId))
            return;

        _bySession.Remove(sessionId);
        if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current) && current.SessionId == sessionId)
            _byPlayer.Remove(playerId);
    }

    /// <summary>组装正式踢线。原因使用生成枚举的顶号值，序号固定为 0。</summary>
    static Packet CreateKickPacket()
    {
        var notification = new KickNtf { Reason = KickReason.KickElsewhere };
        return new Packet(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(KickNtf)), 0, notification.ToByteArray());
    }

    /// <summary>观察后台任务，避免未观察异常。</summary>
    /// <param name="task">会话观察任务。</param>
    static void Observe(Task task)
    {
        if (task.IsCompleted)
        {
            _ = task.Exception;
            return;
        }

        _ = task.ContinueWith(
            static finished => _ = finished.Exception,
            CancellationToken.None,
            TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted | TaskContinuationOptions.ExecuteSynchronously,
            TaskScheduler.Default);
    }

    /// <summary>写诊断。回调异常不影响关闭。</summary>
    /// <param name="message">已经写好的说明，不含令牌或密码。</param>
    void Log(string message)
    {
        try
        {
            _log("[SessionRegistry] " + message);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Buffers.Binary;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using CloudIsle.Net;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Account;
using CloudIsle.Server.Network;
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>SessionRegistry 的顶号、断线、取消和玩家队列配合。</summary>
public sealed class SessionRegistryTests
{
    /// <summary>B 替换 A 后，A 只有一帧正式踢线，B 仍是当前连接。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Replace_SendsOneKickAndKeepsNewCurrent()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var logs = new List<string>();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2), message => logs.Add(message));
        await using var older = await LiveSession.StartAsync(11, new RecordingTransport());
        await using var newer = await LiveSession.StartAsync(12, new RecordingTransport());

        await registry.BindAsync(4, older.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.BindAsync(4, newer.Session, CancellationToken.None);

        AssertSingleKick(older.Transport.Snapshot());
        Assert.That(newer.Transport.Snapshot(), Is.Empty);
        await older.Session.Completion.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(4, newer.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(4, older.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        Assert.That(logs.Exists(message => message.Contains("不代表对端已经处理", StringComparison.Ordinal)), Is.True);
        await DrainAsync(registry, older, newer);
    }

    /// <summary>旧连接失去当前身份后才完成，完成回调不能清掉新连接。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task LateClose_DoesNotRemoveReplacement()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2), static _ => { });
        var blocking = new BlockingTransport();
        await using var older = await LiveSession.StartAsync(21, blocking);
        await using var newer = await LiveSession.StartAsync(22, new RecordingTransport());

        await registry.BindAsync(5, older.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        Task replacing = registry.BindAsync(5, newer.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        await blocking.Entered.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(5, newer.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(5, older.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
            await registry.BindAsync(9, older.Session, CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(5, newer.Session.SessionId), Is.True);

        blocking.Release();
        await replacing.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await older.Session.Completion.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(5, newer.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(5, older.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        AssertSingleKick(blocking.Snapshot());
        await DrainAsync(registry, older, newer);
    }

    /// <summary>连续三次绑定后，只有最后一条还是当前连接。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ThreeReplacements_OnlyLastStaysCurrent()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue);
        await using var first = await LiveSession.StartAsync(31, new RecordingTransport());
        await using var second = await LiveSession.StartAsync(32, new RecordingTransport());
        await using var third = await LiveSession.StartAsync(33, new RecordingTransport());

        await registry.BindAsync(6, first.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.BindAsync(6, second.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.BindAsync(6, third.Session, CancellationToken.None);

        AssertSingleKick(first.Transport.Snapshot());
        AssertSingleKick(second.Transport.Snapshot());
        Assert.That(third.Transport.Snapshot(), Is.Empty);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(6, third.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(6, first.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(6, second.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        Assert.That(registry.MappedPlayerCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        await DrainAsync(registry, first, second, third);
    }

    /// <summary>同一会话再次绑定不向自己发踢线。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task RebindSameSession_DoesNotKickItself()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue);
        await using var session = await LiveSession.StartAsync(41, new RecordingTransport());

        await registry.BindAsync(7, session.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.BindAsync(7, session.Session, CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.That(session.Transport.Snapshot(), Is.Empty);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(7, session.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.WatchCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(session.Session.Completion.IsCompleted, Is.False);
        await DrainAsync(registry, session);
    }

    /// <summary>同一连接改到另一名玩家后，只属于新玩家，并踢掉新玩家原来的连接。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task MoveSessionToOtherPlayer_DropsPreviousOwner()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue);
        await using var moving = await LiveSession.StartAsync(51, new RecordingTransport());
        await using var previous = await LiveSession.StartAsync(52, new RecordingTransport());

        await registry.BindAsync(1, moving.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.BindAsync(2, previous.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.BindAsync(2, moving.Session, CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.That(moving.Transport.Snapshot(), Is.Empty);
        AssertSingleKick(previous.Transport.Snapshot());
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(2, moving.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(1, moving.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(2, previous.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        Assert.That(registry.TryGetPlayerId(moving.Session.SessionId, out long owner), Is.True);
        Assert.That(owner, Is.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(registry.TryGetPlayerId(previous.Session.SessionId, out _), Is.False);
        Assert.That(registry.MappedPlayerCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedSessionCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        await DrainAsync(registry, moving, previous);
    }

    /// <summary>两条队列同时绑定同一连接时，结束后只剩一个玩家。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ConcurrentBindSameSession_BelongsToOnePlayer()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue);
        await using var session = await LiveSession.StartAsync(61, new RecordingTransport());
        var firstEntered = NewSignal();
        var secondEntered = NewSignal();
        var release = NewSignal();

        Task first = queue.EnqueueAsync(1, async _ =>
        {
            firstEntered.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        Task second = queue.EnqueueAsync(2, async _ =>
        {
            secondEntered.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await Task.WhenAll(firstEntered.Task, secondEntered.Task).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        Task bindFirst = registry.BindAsync(1, session.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        Task bindSecond = registry.BindAsync(2, session.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        release.TrySetResult();
        await Task.WhenAll(first, second, bindFirst, bindSecond).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        int owners = (registry.IsCurrent(1, session.Session.SessionId) ? 1 : 0)
            + (registry.IsCurrent(2, session.Session.SessionId) ? 1 : 0);
        Assert.That(owners, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(session.Transport.Snapshot(), Is.Empty);
        Assert.That(registry.MappedPlayerCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedSessionCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        await DrainAsync(registry, session);
    }

    /// <summary>对端结束后，映射和观察集合不再保留这条会话。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task NaturalDisconnect_ReleasesMapsAndWatch()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue);
        await using var session = await LiveSession.StartAsync(71, new RecordingTransport());
        await registry.BindAsync(8, session.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(registry.WatchCount, Is.EqualTo(1));

        session.Stream.End();
        await session.Session.Completion.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await registry.WhenIdleAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(8, session.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        Assert.That(registry.MappedPlayerCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedSessionCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.WatchCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.RetiringCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>已经关闭的会话不能再登记为在线。</summary>

    /// <summary>旧连接写出失败时，新连接仍然留下，旧连接仍被关闭。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task KickSendFailure_StillClosesOldAndKeepsNew()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var logs = new List<string>();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2), message => logs.Add(message));
        await using var older = await LiveSession.StartAsync(91, new FailingTransport());
        await using var newer = await LiveSession.StartAsync(92, new RecordingTransport());

        await registry.BindAsync(10, older.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.BindAsync(10, newer.Session, CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(10, newer.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(logs.Exists(message => message.Contains("未能确认送达", StringComparison.Ordinal)), Is.True);
        Assert.That(logs.Exists(message => message.Contains("不保证对方收到", StringComparison.Ordinal)), Is.True);
        await older.Session.Completion.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

    /// <summary>旧连接不响应时，绑定在预算内返回，不占住玩家队列。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task KickSendBlocks_ReturnsWithinBudget()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var logs = new List<string>();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(200), message => logs.Add(message));
        var blocking = new BlockingTransport();
        await using var older = await LiveSession.StartAsync(101, blocking);
        await using var newer = await LiveSession.StartAsync(102, new RecordingTransport());
        await registry.BindAsync(11, older.Session, CancellationToken.None);

        var clock = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        await registry.BindAsync(11, newer.Session, CancellationToken.None).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        clock.Stop();

        Assert.That(clock.Elapsed, Is.LessThan(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.5)));
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(11, newer.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(11, older.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        Assert.That(logs.Exists(message => message.Contains("未能确认送达", StringComparison.Ordinal)), Is.True);
        Assert.That(logs.Exists(message => message.Contains("不再等待", StringComparison.Ordinal)), Is.True);
        await older.Session.Completion.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await DrainAsync(registry, older, newer);
    }

    /// <summary>改映射前取消不留下映射或观察。</summary>

    /// <summary>两名玩家的踢线可以同时停在写出上。</summary>

    /// <summary>上下文里的会话编号来自服务端对象，玩家编号来自注册表。</summary>
```
