```csharp
    /// <summary>真实环回连接上，后进入的会话顶掉先进入的会话。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Loopback_ReplacementReceivesFormalKick()
    {
        ClientSession? older = null;
        ClientSession? newer = null;
        var olderReady = NewSignal();
        var newerReady = NewSignal();
        await using var gate = new ServerGate(async (session, packet, ct) =>
        {
            if (packet.Seq == 1)
            {
                older = session;
                olderReady.TrySetResult();
                return;
            }

            if (packet.Seq == 2)
            {
                newer = session;
                newerReady.TrySetResult();
                return;
            }

            await session.SendAsync(new Packet(packet.MsgId, packet.Seq, packet.Body.ToArray()), ct);
        });

        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue);
        await using var clientA = await OwnedClient.ConnectAsync(gate.Port);
        await using var clientB = await OwnedClient.ConnectAsync(gate.Port);
        await clientA.Stream.WriteAsync(FrameCodec.Encode(1, 1, new byte[] { 1 }));
        await clientB.Stream.WriteAsync(FrameCodec.Encode(1, 2, new byte[] { 2 }));
        await Task.WhenAll(olderReady.Task, newerReady.Task).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        await registry.BindAsync(19, older!, CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.BindAsync(19, newer!, CancellationToken.None);

        Packet kick = await ReadFrameAsync(clientA.Stream);
        Assert.That(kick.MsgId, Is.EqualTo(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(KickNtf))));
        Assert.That(kick.Seq, Is.EqualTo(0u));
        KickNtf notification = KickNtf.Parser.ParseFrom(kick.Body);
        Assert.That(notification.Reason, Is.EqualTo(KickReason.KickElsewhere));
        await AssertPeerEndedAsync(clientA.Stream);
        await older!.Completion.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(19, newer!.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(19, older.SessionId), Is.False);

        await clientB.Stream.WriteAsync(FrameCodec.Encode(7, 3, new byte[] { 9 }));
        Packet echo = await ReadFrameAsync(clientB.Stream);
        Assert.That(echo.MsgId, Is.EqualTo((ushort)7));
        Assert.That(echo.Seq, Is.EqualTo(3u));
        Assert.That(echo.Body, Is.EqualTo(new byte[] { 9 }));

        await newer.CloseAsync("测试结束", CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.WhenIdleAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedPlayerCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedSessionCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.WatchCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.RetiringCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>关掉全部会话后，注册表不再保留历史项。</summary>
    static async Task DrainAsync(SessionRegistry registry, params LiveSession[] sessions)
    {
        foreach (LiveSession session in sessions)
            await session.DisposeAsync();
        await registry.WhenIdleAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedPlayerCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedSessionCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.WatchCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.RetiringCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>缓冲里只能有一帧顶号通知。</summary>
    /// <param name="bytes">这条连接写出的全部字节。</param>
    static void AssertSingleKick(byte[] bytes)
    {
        List<Packet> frames = DecodeAll(bytes);
        Assert.That(frames, Has.Count.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(frames[0].MsgId, Is.EqualTo(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(KickNtf))));
        Assert.That(frames[0].Seq, Is.EqualTo(0u));
        KickNtf notification = KickNtf.Parser.ParseFrom(frames[0].Body);
        Assert.That(notification.Reason, Is.EqualTo(KickReason.KickElsewhere));
    }

    /// <summary>按帧边界拆开已经写出的字节。</summary>
    /// <param name="bytes">一条连接上按顺序拼好的字节。</param>
    static List<Packet> DecodeAll(byte[] bytes)
    {
        var frames = new List<Packet>();
        while (bytes.Length > 0)
        {
            DecodeStatus status = FrameCodec.TryDecode(bytes, out Packet packet, out int consumed);
            Assert.That(status, Is.EqualTo(DecodeStatus.Success));
            frames.Add(packet);
            bytes = bytes.AsSpan(consumed).ToArray();
        }

        return frames;
    }

    /// <summary>从套接字读出一整帧。</summary>
    /// <param name="stream">客户端网络流。</param>
    static async Task<Packet> ReadFrameAsync(NetworkStream stream)
    {
        byte[] header = await ReadExactAsync(stream, 4);
        uint payloadLength = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32LittleEndian(header);
        Assert.That(payloadLength, Is.InRange((uint)FrameCodec.HeaderSize, (uint)FrameCodec.MaxPayloadLength));
        byte[] rest = await ReadExactAsync(stream, (int)payloadLength);
        byte[] frame = new byte[header.Length + rest.Length];
        header.CopyTo(frame, 0);
        rest.CopyTo(frame, header.Length);
        DecodeStatus status = FrameCodec.TryDecode(frame, out Packet packet, out int consumed);
        Assert.That(status, Is.EqualTo(DecodeStatus.Success));
        Assert.That(consumed, Is.EqualTo(frame.Length));
        return packet;
    }

    /// <summary>读满指定长度。对端提前结束则失败。</summary>
    /// <param name="stream">客户端网络流。</param>
    /// <param name="count">要读的字节数。</param>
    static async Task<byte[]> ReadExactAsync(NetworkStream stream, int count)
    {
        byte[] buffer = new byte[count];
        int got = 0;
        while (got < count)
        {
            int read = await stream.ReadAsync(buffer.AsMemory(got, count - got));
            if (read == 0)
                throw new EndOfStreamException("对端提前结束");
            got += read;
        }

        return buffer;
    }

    /// <summary>对端关闭后，再读要么得到 0，要么得到连接错误。</summary>
    /// <param name="stream">客户端网络流。</param>
    static async Task AssertPeerEndedAsync(NetworkStream stream)
    {
        using var timeout = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        try
        {
            int read = await stream.ReadAsync(new byte[8], timeout.Token);
            Assert.That(read, Is.EqualTo(0));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or SocketException or ObjectDisposedException or OperationCanceledException)
        {
            Assert.That(timeout.IsCancellationRequested, Is.False, "等待对端结束超时");
        }
    }

    static TaskCompletionSource NewSignal() =>
        new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

    /// <summary>一条已经跑起来的测试会话。</summary>
    sealed class LiveSession : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        LiveSession(ClientSession session, RecordingOrBlocking transport, GateStream stream, Task run)
        {
            Session = session;
            Transport = transport;
            Stream = stream;
            _run = run;
        }

        readonly Task _run;

        /// <summary>被绑定的服务端会话。</summary>
        public ClientSession Session { get; }

        /// <summary>这条会话的写出记录或阻塞控制。</summary>
        public RecordingOrBlocking Transport { get; }

        /// <summary>用来制造对端结束的读流。</summary>
        public GateStream Stream { get; }

        /// <summary>创建会话并等到收发循环已经开始。</summary>
        /// <param name="sessionId">测试指定的会话编号。</param>
        /// <param name="transport">可控写出端。</param>
        public static async Task<LiveSession> StartAsync(long sessionId, RecordingOrBlocking transport)
        {
            var stream = new GateStream();
            ClientSession session = ClientSession.CreateForTransport(sessionId, stream, transport, 8, null);
            Task run = session.RunAsync(CancellationToken.None);
            await Task.Yield();
            return new LiveSession(session, transport, stream, run);
        }

        /// <summary>结束读流并等待会话任务。</summary>
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            Stream.End();
            try
            {
                await Session.CloseAsync("测试结束", CancellationToken.None).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
            }

            try
            {
                await _run.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>测试传输的共同取字节口。</summary>
    abstract class RecordingOrBlocking : IFrameTransport
    {
        /// <summary>目前已经成功写出的字节。</summary>
        public abstract byte[] Snapshot();

        /// <summary>写出一段。返回值可以小于缓冲。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">这一段待写字节。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">会话取消时停止等待。</param>
        public abstract ValueTask<int> WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    }

    /// <summary>把写出的字节按顺序留下。</summary>
    sealed class RecordingTransport : RecordingOrBlocking
    {
        readonly List<byte> _bytes = new();

        /// <summary>复制目前的全部字节。</summary>
        public override byte[] Snapshot()
        {
            lock (_bytes)
                return _bytes.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>整段收下并立刻完成。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">这一段待写字节。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">已经取消时不再记录。</param>
        public override ValueTask<int> WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            lock (_bytes)
            {
                ReadOnlySpan<byte> span = buffer.Span;
                for (int i = 0; i < span.Length; i++)
                    _bytes.Add(span[i]);
            }

            return ValueTask.FromResult(buffer.Length);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>第一次写出停住，直到放行或取消。</summary>
    sealed class BlockingTransport : RecordingOrBlocking
    {
        readonly List<byte> _bytes = new();
        readonly TaskCompletionSource _entered = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        readonly TaskCompletionSource _release = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        int _seen;

        /// <summary>第一次写出已经进入等待。</summary>
        public Task Entered => _entered.Task;

        /// <summary>放行正在等待的写出。</summary>
        public void Release() => _release.TrySetResult();

        /// <summary>复制放行之后写下的字节。</summary>
        public override byte[] Snapshot()
        {
            lock (_bytes)
                return _bytes.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>第一次调用先报告进入，再等放行。取消时不记录字节。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">这一段待写字节。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">会话关闭时取消等待。</param>
        public override async ValueTask<int> WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _seen, 1) == 0)
                _entered.TrySetResult();

            await _release.Task.WaitAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            byte[] copy = buffer.ToArray();
            lock (_bytes)
                _bytes.AddRange(copy);

            return buffer.Length;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>任何写出都失败。</summary>
    sealed class FailingTransport : RecordingOrBlocking
    {
        /// <summary>没有成功写出的字节。</summary>
        public override byte[] Snapshot() => Array.Empty<byte>();

        /// <summary>立即用 IO 异常失败。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">被拒绝的字节。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">本实现不等待。</param>
        public override ValueTask<int> WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            throw new IOException("写出失败");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>读端一直等待，End 之后返回 0。</summary>
    sealed class GateStream : Stream
    {
        readonly TaskCompletionSource _done = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        public override bool CanRead => true;
        public override bool CanSeek => false;
        public override bool CanWrite => false;
        public override long Length => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override long Position
        {
            get => throw new NotSupportedException();
            set => throw new NotSupportedException();
        }

        /// <summary>让下一次读返回流结束。</summary>
        public void End() => _done.TrySetResult();

        public override void Flush()
        {
        }

        public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override void SetLength(long value) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new NotSupportedException();

        /// <summary>等到结束或取消。取消继续抛出，结束返回 0。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">调用方提供的缓冲。结束时不写入。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">会话关闭时取消等待。</param>
        public override async ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            using var _ = cancellationToken.Register(() => _done.TrySetResult());
            await _done.Task.ConfigureAwait(false);
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            return 0;
        }

        protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
        {
            _done.TrySetResult();
            base.Dispose(disposing);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>端口 0 的环回监听。</summary>
    sealed class ServerGate : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        readonly CancellationTokenSource _cts = new();
        readonly TcpServer _server;

        /// <summary>开始监听。</summary>
        /// <param name="onPacket">每个完整包交给它。</param>
        public ServerGate(Func<ClientSession, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> onPacket)
        {
            _server = new TcpServer(onPacket, 8);
            Run = _server.RunAsync(new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Loopback, 0), _cts.Token);
        }

        /// <summary>监听任务。</summary>
        public Task Run { get; }

        /// <summary>系统分配的端口。</summary>
        public int Port
        {
            get
            {
                _server.Started.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
                return _server.LocalEndpoint!.Port;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>停止监听并等待会话结束。</summary>
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            _cts.Cancel();
            Task finished = await Task.WhenAny(Run, Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
            Assert.That(finished, Is.SameAs(Run), "停止服务器超时");
            await Run;
            _cts.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>测试用的客户端套接字。</summary>
    sealed class OwnedClient : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        OwnedClient(TcpClient client) => Client = client;

        /// <summary>已连接的客户端。</summary>
        public TcpClient Client { get; }

        /// <summary>客户端网络流。</summary>
        public NetworkStream Stream => Client.GetStream();

        /// <summary>连到本机端口。</summary>
        /// <param name="port">服务器实际监听端口。</param>
        public static async Task<OwnedClient> ConnectAsync(int port)
        {
            var client = new TcpClient();
            await client.ConnectAsync(IPAddress.Loopback, port);
            return new OwnedClient(client);
        }

        /// <summary>关闭套接字。</summary>
        public ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            Client.Dispose();
            return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
        }
    }
}
```

### T36 协调复核：关闭已开始但收发尚未完成

现有35项通过未覆盖外部关闭中窗口：ClientSession已经BeginClose，但业务收包回调还未返回，Completion尚未完成。原BindCore只看Completion及本注册表的retiring集合，可能让此会话重新成为current。

- [x] 增加只读IsCloseRequested状态，在关闭开始时即可观察，不等Completion。
- [x] BindCore在更改映射前拒绝已开始关闭的会话。
- [x] 用已接收消息的回调屏障阻塞Completion，先Close再Bind，预期拒绝且无映射/观察遗留；放行后完成收发收尾。

| 名称 | 具体步骤 | 预期结果 | 实际结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 关闭中绑定 | ClosingSession_BeforeCompletion_BindIsRejected 阻塞回包回调，外部关闭后立即绑定 | 拒绝，两个索引及观察数量均0 | Passed |
| 必要回归 | SessionRegistryTests、TcpServerSessionTests、PlayerQueueTests | 全通过 | 36 Passed，0 Failed |

问题原因、修复及最终完整源码在复验后补充。


实际问题发生条件是业务回调尚未返回时调用CloseAsync。BeginClose已经设置关闭标记，但Completion要等回调结束；仅检查Completion漏掉这个时间窗口。已增加ClientSession.IsCloseRequested只读属性，BindCore在改映射前检查它。关闭中会话现在拒绝绑定，两个映射及观察集合保持空；放行回调后关闭正常完成。

复验命令（--no-restore复用依赖；--filter限定会话注册、真实Socket会话及玩家队列；--results-directory和--logger指定独立证据）：

```powershell
dotnet test Server/CloudIsle.Tests/CloudIsle.Tests.csproj --no-restore --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~SessionRegistryTests|FullyQualifiedName~TcpServerSessionTests|FullyQualifiedName~PlayerQueueTests' --results-directory Docs/Acceptance/M1/20261019-T36 --logger 'trx;LogFileName=T36-review.trx' --logger 'console;verbosity=normal'
```

实际结果：36 Passed，0 Failed，1.2476秒；T36-review.trx及T36-review-console.txt。本复验覆盖首轮35项结果，首次编译/取消断言失败证据仍保留。

复核后完整修改脚本如下，覆盖本节之前对应首版：

#### Server/CloudIsle.Server/Network/ClientSession.cs
```csharp
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.IO.Pipelines;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Channels;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using CloudIsle.Net;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Network
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 一次 TCP 连接上的接收和发送。接收交给 PipelineFrameReader。
    /// 发送只有一个循环，帧在入队时已经是自己的字节。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class ClientSession
    {
        const int LifeIdle = 0;
        const int LifeRunning = 1;
        const int LifeClosed = 2;

        static readonly AsyncLocal<bool> InSessionLoop = new AsyncLocal<bool>();

        readonly TcpClient? _client;
        readonly Stream _stream;
        readonly IFrameTransport _transport;
        readonly Channel<PendingSend> _outbound;
        readonly CancellationTokenSource _sessionCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        readonly TaskCompletionSource _closed = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        Func<ClientSession, Packet, CancellationToken, Task>? _deliver;
        int _life = LifeIdle;
        int _closeOnce;
        int _ioReleased;
        string _closeReason = "会话结束";

        ClientSession(
            long sessionId,
            TcpClient? client,
            Stream stream,
            IFrameTransport transport,
            int sendQueueCapacity)
        {
            if (sessionId <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(sessionId));
            if (stream == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(stream));
            if (transport == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(transport));
            if (sendQueueCapacity <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(sendQueueCapacity));

            SessionId = sessionId;
            SendQueueCapacity = sendQueueCapacity;
            _client = client;
            _stream = stream;
            _transport = transport;
            _outbound = Channel.CreateBounded<PendingSend>(new BoundedChannelOptions(sendQueueCapacity)
            {
                SingleReader = true,
                SingleWriter = false,
                AllowSynchronousContinuations = false,
                FullMode = BoundedChannelFullMode.Wait
            });
        }

        /// <summary>本连接的编号。进程内递增，关闭后不复用。</summary>
        public long SessionId { get; }

        /// <summary>一旦开始关闭即为 true，不必等待所有收发回调结束。</summary>
        public bool IsCloseRequested => Volatile.Read(ref _closeOnce) != 0;

        /// <summary>发送队列能同时放下的帧数。正在写出的那一帧不占这个名额。</summary>
        internal int SendQueueCapacity { get; }

        /// <summary>会话运行结束并且排队发送已经收尾。</summary>
        internal Task Completion => _closed.Task;

        /// <summary>从刚接受的套接字创建会话。</summary>
        /// <param name="sessionId">这条连接的编号，不会复用。</param>
        /// <param name="client">已经 Accept 的套接字。</param>
        /// <param name="sendQueueCapacity">发送队列最多容纳的帧数。</param>
        /// <param name="onPacket">每个完整包交给它。</param>
        internal static ClientSession Accept(
            long sessionId,
            TcpClient client,
            int sendQueueCapacity,
            Func<ClientSession, Packet, CancellationToken, Task>? onPacket)
        {
            if (client == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(client));

            client.NoDelay = true;
            NetworkStream stream = client.GetStream();
            var session = new ClientSession(
                sessionId,
                client,
                stream,
                new StreamFrameTransport(stream),
                sendQueueCapacity);
            session._deliver = onPacket;
            return session;
        }

        /// <summary>用测试传输创建会话，不打开真实套接字。</summary>
        /// <param name="sessionId">这条连接的编号。</param>
        /// <param name="readStream">接收端读取的流。</param>
        /// <param name="transport">测试用的写边界。</param>
        /// <param name="sendQueueCapacity">发送队列最多容纳的帧数。</param>
        /// <param name="onPacket">每个完整包交给它。</param>
        internal static ClientSession CreateForTransport(
            long sessionId,
            Stream readStream,
            IFrameTransport transport,
            int sendQueueCapacity,
            Func<ClientSession, Packet, CancellationToken, Task>? onPacket)
        {
            var session = new ClientSession(sessionId, client: null, readStream, transport, sendQueueCapacity);
            session._deliver = onPacket;
            return session;
        }

        /// <summary>同时跑接收和发送。任一环结束就关闭本会话。</summary>
        /// <param name="ct">停止这个会话。</param>
        public async Task RunAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            int previous = Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _life, LifeRunning, LifeIdle);
            if (previous == LifeRunning)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("会话已经在运行");
            if (previous == LifeClosed)
            {
                _closed.TrySetResult();
                return;
            }

            InSessionLoop.Value = true;
            using var linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct, _sessionCts.Token);
            Task sendTask = SendLoopAsync(linked.Token);
            try
            {
                if (Volatile.Read(ref _closeOnce) != 0)
                    return;

                PipeReader reader = PipeReader.Create(_stream, new StreamPipeReaderOptions(leaveOpen: true));
                await PipelineFrameReader.ReadLoopAsync(
                    reader,
                    packet => DeliverAsync(packet, linked.Token),
                    linked.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }
            catch (IOException)
            {
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
            }
            finally
            {
                BeginClose(_closeReason);
                try
                {
                    await sendTask.ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Observe(Task.FromException(ex));
                }

                ReleaseIo();
                Interlocked.Exchange(ref _life, LifeClosed);
                _closed.TrySetResult();
                try
                {
                    _sessionCts.Dispose();
                }
                catch (ObjectDisposedException)
                {
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>把一帧编成独立字节后排队。队列已满时关闭本连接。</summary>
        /// <param name="packet">要发送的包。正文不能为空。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">入队前取消则不发送。</param>
        public async Task SendAsync(Packet packet, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            if (packet.Body == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(packet));

            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            if (Volatile.Read(ref _closeOnce) != 0)
                throw new IOException("会话已关闭");

            byte[] ownedFrame = FrameCodec.Encode(packet.MsgId, packet.Seq, packet.Body);
            var pending = new PendingSend(ownedFrame);
            if (Volatile.Read(ref _closeOnce) != 0 || !_outbound.Writer.TryWrite(pending))
            {
                if (Volatile.Read(ref _closeOnce) == 0)
                    BeginClose("发送队列已满");

                var error = new IOException(Volatile.Read(ref _closeOnce) != 0 ? _closeReason : "发送队列已满");
                pending.Completed.TrySetException(error);
                Observe(pending.Completed.Task);
                throw error;
            }

            Observe(pending.Completed.Task);
            await pending.Completed.Task.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        /// <summary>关闭会话并等待收发结束。从收发循环里调用时只发信号。</summary>
        /// <param name="reason">关闭原因，写入等待中的发送。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">等待收发结束时的取消令牌。</param>
        public async Task CloseAsync(string reason, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            BeginClose(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason) ? "关闭" : reason);
            if (InSessionLoop.Value)
                return;

            int previous = Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _life, LifeClosed, LifeIdle);
            if (previous == LifeIdle)
            {
                ReleaseIo();
                _closed.TrySetResult();
                return;
            }

            await _closed.Task.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        /// <summary>把一帧交给业务回调。</summary>
        /// <param name="packet">已经复制出来的包。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">取消这次回调。</param>
        async Task DeliverAsync(Packet packet, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            InSessionLoop.Value = true;
            if (_deliver == null)
                return;
            await _deliver(this, packet, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        /// <summary>一次写完一整帧再取下一帧。</summary>
        /// <param name="ct">停止发送循环。</param>
        async Task SendLoopAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            InSessionLoop.Value = true;
            try
            {
                while (await _outbound.Reader.WaitToReadAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false))
                {
                    while (_outbound.Reader.TryRead(out PendingSend? pending))
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            ReadOnlyMemory<byte> remaining = pending!.Frame;
                            while (!remaining.IsEmpty)
                            {
                                int written = await _transport.WriteAsync(remaining, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                                if (written <= 0 || written > remaining.Length)
                                    throw new IOException("发送写出长度非法");
                                remaining = remaining.Slice(written);
                            }

                            pending.Completed.TrySetResult();
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            pending.Completed.TrySetException(ex);
                            BeginClose(_closeReason == "会话结束" ? "发送失败" : _closeReason);
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                BeginClose("发送失败");
            }
            finally
            {
                while (_outbound.Reader.TryRead(out PendingSend? pending))
                    pending!.Completed.TrySetException(new IOException(_closeReason));
            }
        }

        /// <summary>标记关闭并让还排着队的发送失败。</summary>
        /// <param name="reason">关闭原因。</param>
        void BeginClose(string reason)
        {
            if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _closeOnce, 1) != 0)
                return;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason))
                _closeReason = reason;

            try
            {
                _outbound.Writer.TryComplete();
            }
            catch (ChannelClosedException)
            {
            }

            try
            {
                _sessionCts.Cancel();
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
            }

            ReleaseIo();
        }

        /// <summary>释放套接字或测试流。</summary>
        void ReleaseIo()
        {
            if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _ioReleased, 1) != 0)
                return;

            try
            {
                _stream.Dispose();
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
            }

            if (_client == null)
                return;

            try
            {
                _client.Dispose();
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
            }
        }

        /// <summary>观察收发任务，避免未观察异常。</summary>
        /// <param name="task">要观察的任务。</param>
        static void Observe(Task task)
        {
            if (task.IsCompleted)
            {
                _ = task.Exception;
                return;
            }

            _ = task.ContinueWith(
                static finished => _ = finished.Exception,
                CancellationToken.None,
                TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted | TaskContinuationOptions.ExecuteSynchronously,
                TaskScheduler.Default);
        }

        sealed class PendingSend
        {
            /// <summary>记住已经编好的一帧。</summary>
            /// <param name="frame">这一帧自己的字节。</param>
            public PendingSend(byte[] frame)
            {
                Frame = frame;
                Completed = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            }

            public byte[] Frame { get; }

            public TaskCompletionSource Completed { get; }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 会话写出的最小边界。返回本次实际写出的字节数，可以小于缓冲长度。
    /// </summary>
    internal interface IFrameTransport
    {
        /// <summary>写出一段字节。返回值可以小于缓冲长度。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">要写出的字节。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">取消这次写出。</param>
        ValueTask<int> WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    }

    /// <summary>把一截字节写到流上。NetworkStream 一次写完时返回全部长度。</summary>
    internal sealed class StreamFrameTransport : IFrameTransport
    {
        readonly Stream _stream;

        /// <summary>用流写出帧。</summary>
        /// <param name="stream">底层流。</param>
        public StreamFrameTransport(Stream stream)
        {
            _stream = stream ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(stream));
        }

        /// <summary>向流写出一段。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">要写出的字节。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">取消这次写出。</param>
        public async ValueTask<int> WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            await _stream.WriteAsync(buffer, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return buffer.Length;
        }
    }
}

```

#### Server/CloudIsle.Server/Account/SessionRegistry.cs
```csharp
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using CloudIsle.Net;
using Google.Protobuf;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Network;
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 同一玩家只保留一条当前连接。新连接写入映射后，旧连接才收到正式踢线并关闭。
/// 不签发令牌，也不处理登录或登出。
/// </summary>
public sealed class SessionRegistry
{
    /// <summary>未另行指定时，踢线写入和等待旧连接关闭共用的上限。</summary>
    public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultKickBudget = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);

    readonly PlayerQueue _queue;
    readonly TimeSpan _kickBudget;
    readonly Action<string> _log;
    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, ClientSession> _byPlayer = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, long> _bySession = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, Task> _watches = new();
    readonly HashSet<long> _retiring = new();

    /// <summary>使用共享玩家队列，踢线预算为 2 秒，日志写到控制台。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerQueue">同玩家串行的队列。本对象不释放它。</param>
    public SessionRegistry(PlayerQueue playerQueue)
        : this(playerQueue, DefaultKickBudget, null)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>使用共享玩家队列，并指定踢线预算和日志。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerQueue">同玩家串行的队列。绑定会进入这名玩家的队列；本对象不释放它。</param>
    /// <param name="kickBudget">旧连接通知和等待关闭的合计上限，必须为正。用尽后不再占住玩家队列。</param>
    /// <param name="log">诊断输出。为空时写到控制台。回调在字典锁外调用。</param>
    public SessionRegistry(PlayerQueue playerQueue, TimeSpan kickBudget, Action<string>? log)
    {
        if (playerQueue == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(playerQueue));
        if (kickBudget <= TimeSpan.Zero)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(kickBudget), "踢线预算必须为正");

        _queue = playerQueue;
        _kickBudget = kickBudget;
        _log = log ?? (static message => Console.WriteLine(message));
    }

    /// <summary>当前仍登记为在线的玩家数。</summary>
    internal int MappedPlayerCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _byPlayer.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>会话到玩家的反向索引数量。</summary>
    internal int MappedSessionCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _bySession.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>尚未结束的会话观察数。结束后会从集合删除。</summary>
    internal int WatchCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _watches.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>已失去当前身份、关闭尚未观察结束的会话数。</summary>
    internal int RetiringCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _retiring.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>等待已经登记的观察任务结束。仍在运行的会话会使这个等待一直停着。</summary>
    internal async Task WhenIdleAsync()
    {
        while (true)
        {
            Task[] pending;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_watches.Count == 0)
                    return;
                pending = _watches.Values.ToArray();
            }

            await Task.WhenAll(pending).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 把连接登记为该玩家的唯一在线会话。同一会话重复绑定不踢自己。
    /// 已经处在该玩家队列动作中时直接执行，避免再次入队死锁。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要占线的玩家。必须是正数。不从客户端报文读取。</param>
    /// <param name="session">服务端这条连接。已关闭或正在因顶号关闭时拒绝。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">只在改映射前生效。改映射之后取消不回滚新映射，旧连接仍按预算收尾。</param>
    public Task BindAsync(long playerId, ClientSession session, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (session == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(session));
        if (playerId <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(playerId), "玩家编号必须为正数");

        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (PlayerQueue.IsCurrentPlayer(playerId))
            return BindCoreAsync(playerId, session, ct);

        return _queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, token => BindCoreAsync(playerId, session, token), ct);
    }

    /// <summary>这名玩家的当前连接是不是这条会话。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要核对的玩家。没有在线会话时返回 false。</param>
    /// <param name="sessionId">服务端会话编号。</param>
    public bool IsCurrent(long playerId, long sessionId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == sessionId
                && _bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long mapped)
                && mapped == playerId;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>按玩家取当前连接。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要查询的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="session">找到时是当前连接；否则为 null。</param>
    /// <returns>该玩家有当前连接时为 true。</returns>
    public bool TryGetCurrentSession(long playerId, [NotNullWhen(true)] out ClientSession? session)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current))
            {
                session = current;
                return true;
            }
        }

        session = null;
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>按服务端会话编号反查玩家。</summary>
    /// <param name="sessionId">服务端会话编号。不采用客户端自行声明的编号。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">找到时为注册表里的玩家；否则为 0。</param>
    /// <returns>该会话仍是某玩家的当前连接时为 true。</returns>
    public bool TryGetPlayerId(long sessionId, out long playerId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long mapped)
                && _byPlayer.TryGetValue(mapped, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == sessionId)
            {
                playerId = mapped;
                return true;
            }
        }

        playerId = 0;
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 用这条服务端连接构造请求上下文。玩家编号只取注册表，未绑定为 0。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="session">正在处理的服务端连接。会话编号取自该对象。</param>
    /// <param name="msgId">本帧的正式消息编号。不从正文推断玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="seq">本帧序号。</param>
    public RequestContext CreateRequestContext(ClientSession session, ushort msgId, uint seq)
    {
        if (session == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(session));

        long playerId = 0;
        if (TryGetPlayerId(session.SessionId, out long mapped))
            playerId = mapped;

        return new RequestContext(session.SessionId, playerId, msgId, seq);
    }

    /// <summary>在玩家队列内完成一次绑定。调用方保证同一玩家不会并发进入这里。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">本次占线的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="session">要成为当前连接的会话。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">改映射前取消则原样抛出，并且不改字典。</param>
    async Task BindCoreAsync(long playerId, ClientSession session, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ClientSession? retiring = null;
        TaskCompletionSource? watch = null;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            if (session.IsCloseRequested || session.Completion.IsCompleted)
            {
                UnmapIfMatch(session.SessionId);
                throw new InvalidOperationException("已关闭的会话不能绑定");
            }

            if (_retiring.Contains(session.SessionId))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("正在关闭的会话不能重新绑定");

            bool sameCurrent = _byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == session.SessionId;
            if (!sameCurrent)
            {
                if (_bySession.TryGetValue(session.SessionId, out long previousPlayer) && previousPlayer != playerId)
                {
                    if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(previousPlayer, out ClientSession? previous)
                        && previous.SessionId == session.SessionId)
                    {
                        _byPlayer.Remove(previousPlayer);
                    }

                    _bySession.Remove(session.SessionId);
                }

                if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? old) && old.SessionId != session.SessionId)
                {
                    _byPlayer.Remove(playerId);
                    _bySession.Remove(old.SessionId);
                    _retiring.Add(old.SessionId);
                    retiring = old;
                }

                _byPlayer[playerId] = session;
                _bySession[session.SessionId] = playerId;
            }

            if (!_watches.ContainsKey(session.SessionId))
            {
                watch = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
                _watches[session.SessionId] = watch.Task;
            }
        }

        if (watch != null)
            Observe(RunWatchAsync(session, watch));

        if (retiring != null)
            await RetireAsync(retiring, playerId).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>等会话结束后，仅当反向索引仍是它时才删除。然后丢掉观察项。</summary>
    /// <param name="session">被观察的连接。完成任务是它自己的 Completion。</param>
    /// <param name="done">交给 WhenIdleAsync 的完成源。清理后再完成，避免漏等。</param>
    async Task RunWatchAsync(ClientSession session, TaskCompletionSource done)
    {
        try
        {
            await Task.Yield();
            await session.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally
        {
            try
            {
                lock (_gate)
                {
                    UnmapIfMatch(session.SessionId);
                    _retiring.Remove(session.SessionId);
                    if (_watches.TryGetValue(session.SessionId, out Task? task) && ReferenceEquals(task, done.Task))
                        _watches.Remove(session.SessionId);
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                done.TrySetResult();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>锁外发送正式踢线并关闭。失败或超时只记日志，不把新映射撤掉。</summary>
    /// <param name="oldSession">已经从当前映射移除的旧连接。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">这次绑定的玩家，只写入日志。</param>
    async Task RetireAsync(ClientSession oldSession, long playerId)
    {
        Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 已失去当前身份。KickNtf 与关闭等待预算 {_kickBudget.TotalMilliseconds.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} 毫秒。超时或失败不保证通知送达，仍会关闭旧连接。");
        using var budget = new CancellationTokenSource(_kickBudget);
        try
        {
            await oldSession.SendAsync(CreateKickPacket(), budget.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 已写入 KickNtf（KickElsewhere，seq=0）。写入完成不代表对端已经处理。");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 的 KickNtf 未能确认送达（{ex.GetType().Name}）。不保证对方收到，仍关闭旧连接。");
        }

        try
        {
            await oldSession.CloseAsync("顶号", budget.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 在预算内没有完成关闭（{ex.GetType().Name}）。关闭已经发起，玩家队列不再等待。");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>调用方必须已经持有字典锁。只删除仍然指向这个会话编号的索引。</summary>
    /// <param name="sessionId">完成或被拒绝的服务端会话编号。</param>
    void UnmapIfMatch(long sessionId)
    {
        if (!_bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long playerId))
            return;

        _bySession.Remove(sessionId);
        if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current) && current.SessionId == sessionId)
            _byPlayer.Remove(playerId);
    }

    /// <summary>组装正式踢线。原因使用生成枚举的顶号值，序号固定为 0。</summary>
    static Packet CreateKickPacket()
    {
        var notification = new KickNtf { Reason = KickReason.KickElsewhere };
        return new Packet(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(KickNtf)), 0, notification.ToByteArray());
    }

    /// <summary>观察后台任务，避免未观察异常。</summary>
    /// <param name="task">会话观察任务。</param>
    static void Observe(Task task)
    {
        if (task.IsCompleted)
        {
            _ = task.Exception;
            return;
        }

        _ = task.ContinueWith(
            static finished => _ = finished.Exception,
            CancellationToken.None,
            TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted | TaskContinuationOptions.ExecuteSynchronously,
            TaskScheduler.Default);
    }

    /// <summary>写诊断。回调异常不影响关闭。</summary>
    /// <param name="message">已经写好的说明，不含令牌或密码。</param>
    void Log(string message)
    {
        try
        {
            _log("[SessionRegistry] " + message);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Buffers.Binary;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>SessionRegistry 的顶号、断线、取消和玩家队列配合。</summary>

{
    /// <summary>外部关闭已开始而业务回调尚未结束时，也不能重新绑定该连接。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ClosingSession_BeforeCompletion_BindIsRejected()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue);
        var entered = NewSignal();
        var release = NewSignal();
        using var input = new MemoryStream(FrameCodec.Encode(1, 1, Array.Empty<byte>()));
        ClientSession session = ClientSession.CreateForTransport(901, input, new RecordingTransport(), 8,
            async (_, _, _) =>
            {
                entered.TrySetResult();
                // 故意等待业务屏障，使关闭已开始而 Completion 仍未完成。
                await release.Task;
            });
        Task run = session.RunAsync(CancellationToken.None);
        try
        {
            await entered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            Task closing = session.CloseAsync("外部关闭", CancellationToken.None);
            Assert.That(session.IsCloseRequested, Is.True);
            Assert.That(session.Completion.IsCompleted, Is.False);
            Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
                await registry.BindAsync(9, session, CancellationToken.None));
            Assert.That(registry.MappedPlayerCount, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(registry.MappedSessionCount, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(registry.WatchCount, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(closing.IsCompleted, Is.False);
        }
        finally
        {
            release.TrySetResult();
            await session.CloseAsync("测试收尾", CancellationToken.None).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            await run.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>B 替换 A 后，A 只有一帧正式踢线，B 仍是当前连接。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Replace_SendsOneKickAndKeepsNewCurrent()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var logs = new List<string>();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2), message => logs.Add(message));
        await using var older = await LiveSession.StartAsync(11, new RecordingTransport());
        await using var newer = await LiveSession.StartAsync(12, new RecordingTransport());

        await registry.BindAsync(4, older.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.BindAsync(4, newer.Session, CancellationToken.None);

        AssertSingleKick(older.Transport.Snapshot());
        Assert.That(newer.Transport.Snapshot(), Is.Empty);
        await older.Session.Completion.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(4, newer.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(4, older.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        Assert.That(logs.Exists(message => message.Contains("不代表对端已经处理", StringComparison.Ordinal)), Is.True);
        await DrainAsync(registry, older, newer);

    /// <summary>旧连接失去当前身份后才完成，完成回调不能清掉新连接。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task LateClose_DoesNotRemoveReplacement()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2), static _ => { });
        var blocking = new BlockingTransport();
        await using var older = await LiveSession.StartAsync(21, blocking);
        await using var newer = await LiveSession.StartAsync(22, new RecordingTransport());

        await registry.BindAsync(5, older.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        Task replacing = registry.BindAsync(5, newer.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        await blocking.Entered.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(5, newer.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(5, older.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
            await registry.BindAsync(9, older.Session, CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(5, newer.Session.SessionId), Is.True);

        blocking.Release();
        await replacing.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await older.Session.Completion.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(5, newer.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(5, older.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        AssertSingleKick(blocking.Snapshot());
        await DrainAsync(registry, older, newer);
    }

    /// <summary>两条队列同时绑定同一连接时，结束后只剩一个玩家。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ConcurrentBindSameSession_BelongsToOnePlayer()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue);
        await using var session = await LiveSession.StartAsync(61, new RecordingTransport());
        var firstEntered = NewSignal();
        var secondEntered = NewSignal();
        var release = NewSignal();

        Task first = queue.EnqueueAsync(1, async _ =>
        {
            firstEntered.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        Task second = queue.EnqueueAsync(2, async _ =>
        {
            secondEntered.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await Task.WhenAll(firstEntered.Task, secondEntered.Task).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        Task bindFirst = registry.BindAsync(1, session.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        Task bindSecond = registry.BindAsync(2, session.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        release.TrySetResult();
        await Task.WhenAll(first, second, bindFirst, bindSecond).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        int owners = (registry.IsCurrent(1, session.Session.SessionId) ? 1 : 0)
            + (registry.IsCurrent(2, session.Session.SessionId) ? 1 : 0);
        Assert.That(owners, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(session.Transport.Snapshot(), Is.Empty);
        Assert.That(registry.MappedPlayerCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedSessionCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        await DrainAsync(registry, session);
    }

    {

    /// <summary>上下文里的会话编号来自服务端对象，玩家编号来自注册表。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task CreateRequestContext_UsesServerSessionAndRegistryPlayer()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue);
        await using var session = await LiveSession.StartAsync(151, new RecordingTransport());

        RequestContext before = registry.CreateRequestContext(session.Session, 1005, 3);
        Assert.That(before.SessionId, Is.EqualTo(session.Session.SessionId));
        Assert.That(before.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(before.MsgId, Is.EqualTo((ushort)1005));
        Assert.That(before.Seq, Is.EqualTo(3u));

        await registry.BindAsync(18, session.Session, CancellationToken.None);
        ushort loginId = MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(LoginReq));
        RequestContext after = registry.CreateRequestContext(session.Session, loginId, 4);
        Assert.That(after.SessionId, Is.EqualTo(151));
        Assert.That(after.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(18));
        Assert.That(after.MsgId, Is.EqualTo(loginId));
        Assert.That(after.Seq, Is.EqualTo(4u));
        Assert.That(registry.TryGetCurrentSession(18, out ClientSession? current), Is.True);
        Assert.That(current!.SessionId, Is.EqualTo(151));
        await DrainAsync(registry, session);
    }

    /// <summary>真实环回连接上，后进入的会话顶掉先进入的会话。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Loopback_ReplacementReceivesFormalKick()
    {
        ClientSession? older = null;
        ClientSession? newer = null;
        var olderReady = NewSignal();
        var newerReady = NewSignal();
        await using var gate = new ServerGate(async (session, packet, ct) =>
        {
            if (packet.Seq == 1)
            {
                older = session;
                olderReady.TrySetResult();
                return;
            }

            if (packet.Seq == 2)
            {
                newer = session;
                newerReady.TrySetResult();
                return;
            }

            await session.SendAsync(new Packet(packet.MsgId, packet.Seq, packet.Body.ToArray()), ct);
        });

        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var registry = new SessionRegistry(queue);
        await using var clientA = await OwnedClient.ConnectAsync(gate.Port);
        await using var clientB = await OwnedClient.ConnectAsync(gate.Port);
        await clientA.Stream.WriteAsync(FrameCodec.Encode(1, 1, new byte[] { 1 }));
        await clientB.Stream.WriteAsync(FrameCodec.Encode(1, 2, new byte[] { 2 }));
        await Task.WhenAll(olderReady.Task, newerReady.Task).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        await registry.BindAsync(19, older!, CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.BindAsync(19, newer!, CancellationToken.None);

        Packet kick = await ReadFrameAsync(clientA.Stream);
        Assert.That(kick.MsgId, Is.EqualTo(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(KickNtf))));
        Assert.That(kick.Seq, Is.EqualTo(0u));
        KickNtf notification = KickNtf.Parser.ParseFrom(kick.Body);
        Assert.That(notification.Reason, Is.EqualTo(KickReason.KickElsewhere));
        await AssertPeerEndedAsync(clientA.Stream);
        await older!.Completion.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(19, newer!.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(registry.IsCurrent(19, older.SessionId), Is.False);

        await clientB.Stream.WriteAsync(FrameCodec.Encode(7, 3, new byte[] { 9 }));
        Packet echo = await ReadFrameAsync(clientB.Stream);
        Assert.That(echo.MsgId, Is.EqualTo((ushort)7));
        Assert.That(echo.Seq, Is.EqualTo(3u));
        Assert.That(echo.Body, Is.EqualTo(new byte[] { 9 }));

        await newer.CloseAsync("测试结束", CancellationToken.None);
        await registry.WhenIdleAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedPlayerCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedSessionCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.WatchCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.RetiringCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>关掉全部会话后，注册表不再保留历史项。</summary>
    static async Task DrainAsync(SessionRegistry registry, params LiveSession[] sessions)
    {
        foreach (LiveSession session in sessions)
            await session.DisposeAsync();
        await registry.WhenIdleAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedPlayerCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.MappedSessionCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.WatchCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(registry.RetiringCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>缓冲里只能有一帧顶号通知。</summary>
    /// <param name="bytes">这条连接写出的全部字节。</param>
    static void AssertSingleKick(byte[] bytes)
    {
        List<Packet> frames = DecodeAll(bytes);
        Assert.That(frames, Has.Count.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(frames[0].MsgId, Is.EqualTo(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(KickNtf))));
        Assert.That(frames[0].Seq, Is.EqualTo(0u));
        KickNtf notification = KickNtf.Parser.ParseFrom(frames[0].Body);
        Assert.That(notification.Reason, Is.EqualTo(KickReason.KickElsewhere));
    }

    /// <summary>按帧边界拆开已经写出的字节。</summary>
    /// <param name="bytes">一条连接上按顺序拼好的字节。</param>
    static List<Packet> DecodeAll(byte[] bytes)
    {
        var frames = new List<Packet>();
        while (bytes.Length > 0)
        {
            DecodeStatus status = FrameCodec.TryDecode(bytes, out Packet packet, out int consumed);
            Assert.That(status, Is.EqualTo(DecodeStatus.Success));
            frames.Add(packet);
            bytes = bytes.AsSpan(consumed).ToArray();
        }

        return frames;
    }

    /// <summary>从套接字读出一整帧。</summary>
    /// <param name="stream">客户端网络流。</param>
    static async Task<Packet> ReadFrameAsync(NetworkStream stream)
    {
        byte[] header = await ReadExactAsync(stream, 4);
        uint payloadLength = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32LittleEndian(header);
        Assert.That(payloadLength, Is.InRange((uint)FrameCodec.HeaderSize, (uint)FrameCodec.MaxPayloadLength));
        byte[] rest = await ReadExactAsync(stream, (int)payloadLength);
        byte[] frame = new byte[header.Length + rest.Length];
        header.CopyTo(frame, 0);
        rest.CopyTo(frame, header.Length);
        DecodeStatus status = FrameCodec.TryDecode(frame, out Packet packet, out int consumed);
        Assert.That(status, Is.EqualTo(DecodeStatus.Success));
        Assert.That(consumed, Is.EqualTo(frame.Length));
        return packet;
    }

    /// <summary>读满指定长度。对端提前结束则失败。</summary>
    /// <param name="stream">客户端网络流。</param>
    /// <param name="count">要读的字节数。</param>
    static async Task<byte[]> ReadExactAsync(NetworkStream stream, int count)
    {
        byte[] buffer = new byte[count];
        int got = 0;
        while (got < count)
        {
            int read = await stream.ReadAsync(buffer.AsMemory(got, count - got));
            if (read == 0)
                throw new EndOfStreamException("对端提前结束");
            got += read;
        }

        return buffer;
    }

    /// <summary>对端关闭后，再读要么得到 0，要么得到连接错误。</summary>
    /// <param name="stream">客户端网络流。</param>
    static async Task AssertPeerEndedAsync(NetworkStream stream)
    {
        using var timeout = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        try
        {
            int read = await stream.ReadAsync(new byte[8], timeout.Token);
            Assert.That(read, Is.EqualTo(0));
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or SocketException or ObjectDisposedException or OperationCanceledException)
        {
            Assert.That(timeout.IsCancellationRequested, Is.False, "等待对端结束超时");
        }
    }

    static TaskCompletionSource NewSignal() =>
        new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

    /// <summary>一条已经跑起来的测试会话。</summary>
    sealed class LiveSession : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        LiveSession(ClientSession session, RecordingOrBlocking transport, GateStream stream, Task run)
        {
            Session = session;
            Transport = transport;
            Stream = stream;
            _run = run;
        }

        readonly Task _run;

        /// <summary>被绑定的服务端会话。</summary>
        public ClientSession Session { get; }

        /// <summary>这条会话的写出记录或阻塞控制。</summary>
        public RecordingOrBlocking Transport { get; }

        /// <summary>用来制造对端结束的读流。</summary>
        public GateStream Stream { get; }

        /// <summary>创建会话并等到收发循环已经开始。</summary>
        /// <param name="sessionId">测试指定的会话编号。</param>
        /// <param name="transport">可控写出端。</param>
        public static async Task<LiveSession> StartAsync(long sessionId, RecordingOrBlocking transport)
        {
            var stream = new GateStream();
            ClientSession session = ClientSession.CreateForTransport(sessionId, stream, transport, 8, null);
            Task run = session.RunAsync(CancellationToken.None);
            await Task.Yield();
            return new LiveSession(session, transport, stream, run);
        }

        /// <summary>结束读流并等待会话任务。</summary>
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            Stream.End();
            try
            {
                await Session.CloseAsync("测试结束", CancellationToken.None).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
            }

            try
            {
                await _run.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>测试传输的共同取字节口。</summary>
    abstract class RecordingOrBlocking : IFrameTransport
    {
        /// <summary>目前已经成功写出的字节。</summary>
        public abstract byte[] Snapshot();

        /// <summary>写出一段。返回值可以小于缓冲。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">这一段待写字节。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">会话取消时停止等待。</param>
        public abstract ValueTask<int> WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    }

    /// <summary>把写出的字节按顺序留下。</summary>
    sealed class RecordingTransport : RecordingOrBlocking
    {
        readonly List<byte> _bytes = new();

        /// <summary>复制目前的全部字节。</summary>
        public override byte[] Snapshot()
        {
            lock (_bytes)
                return _bytes.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>整段收下并立刻完成。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">这一段待写字节。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">已经取消时不再记录。</param>
        public override ValueTask<int> WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            lock (_bytes)
            {
                ReadOnlySpan<byte> span = buffer.Span;
                for (int i = 0; i < span.Length; i++)
                    _bytes.Add(span[i]);
            }

            return ValueTask.FromResult(buffer.Length);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>第一次写出停住，直到放行或取消。</summary>
    sealed class BlockingTransport : RecordingOrBlocking
    {
        readonly List<byte> _bytes = new();
        readonly TaskCompletionSource _entered = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        readonly TaskCompletionSource _release = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        int _seen;

        /// <summary>第一次写出已经进入等待。</summary>
        public Task Entered => _entered.Task;

        /// <summary>放行正在等待的写出。</summary>
        public void Release() => _release.TrySetResult();

        /// <summary>复制放行之后写下的字节。</summary>
        public override byte[] Snapshot()
        {
            lock (_bytes)
                return _bytes.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>第一次调用先报告进入，再等放行。取消时不记录字节。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">这一段待写字节。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">会话关闭时取消等待。</param>
        public override async ValueTask<int> WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _seen, 1) == 0)
                _entered.TrySetResult();

            await _release.Task.WaitAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            byte[] copy = buffer.ToArray();
            lock (_bytes)
                _bytes.AddRange(copy);

            return buffer.Length;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>任何写出都失败。</summary>
    sealed class FailingTransport : RecordingOrBlocking
    {
        /// <summary>没有成功写出的字节。</summary>
        public override byte[] Snapshot() => Array.Empty<byte>();

        /// <summary>立即用 IO 异常失败。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">被拒绝的字节。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">本实现不等待。</param>
        public override ValueTask<int> WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            throw new IOException("写出失败");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>读端一直等待，End 之后返回 0。</summary>
    sealed class GateStream : Stream
    {
        readonly TaskCompletionSource _done = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        public override bool CanRead => true;
        public override bool CanSeek => false;
        public override bool CanWrite => false;
        public override long Length => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override long Position
        {
            get => throw new NotSupportedException();
            set => throw new NotSupportedException();
        }

        /// <summary>让下一次读返回流结束。</summary>
        public void End() => _done.TrySetResult();

        public override void Flush()
        {
        }

        public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override void SetLength(long value) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new NotSupportedException();

        /// <summary>等到结束或取消。取消继续抛出，结束返回 0。</summary>
        /// <param name="buffer">调用方提供的缓冲。结束时不写入。</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">会话关闭时取消等待。</param>
        public override async ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            using var _ = cancellationToken.Register(() => _done.TrySetResult());
            await _done.Task.ConfigureAwait(false);
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            return 0;
        }

        protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
        {
            _done.TrySetResult();
            base.Dispose(disposing);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>端口 0 的环回监听。</summary>
    sealed class ServerGate : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        readonly CancellationTokenSource _cts = new();
        readonly TcpServer _server;

        /// <summary>开始监听。</summary>
        /// <param name="onPacket">每个完整包交给它。</param>
        public ServerGate(Func<ClientSession, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> onPacket)
        {
            _server = new TcpServer(onPacket, 8);
            Run = _server.RunAsync(new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Loopback, 0), _cts.Token);
        }

        /// <summary>监听任务。</summary>
        public Task Run { get; }

        /// <summary>系统分配的端口。</summary>
        public int Port
        {
            get
            {
                _server.Started.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
                return _server.LocalEndpoint!.Port;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>停止监听并等待会话结束。</summary>
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            _cts.Cancel();
            Task finished = await Task.WhenAny(Run, Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
            Assert.That(finished, Is.SameAs(Run), "停止服务器超时");
            await Run;
            _cts.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>测试用的客户端套接字。</summary>
    sealed class OwnedClient : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        OwnedClient(TcpClient client) => Client = client;

        /// <summary>已连接的客户端。</summary>
        public TcpClient Client { get; }

        /// <summary>客户端网络流。</summary>
        public NetworkStream Stream => Client.GetStream();

        /// <summary>连到本机端口。</summary>
        /// <param name="port">服务器实际监听端口。</param>
        public static async Task<OwnedClient> ConnectAsync(int port)
        {
            var client = new TcpClient();
            await client.ConnectAsync(IPAddress.Loopback, port);
            return new OwnedClient(client);
        }

        /// <summary>关闭套接字。</summary>
        public ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            Client.Dispose();
            return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
        }
    }
}
```

## T37：接入 HandleLoginAsync

- 来源：`06_M1_基础框架任务拆解.md` 第 1.2 / 3.1 / 4.5 / 5.4 节 T37，依赖 T31、T35、T36
- 需求：R-S03
- 依据：05 `LoginReq` / `LoginResp`；正确密码回 Token 与完整 `PlayerFullData`；错误密码 202；协议不兼容 106。注册成功仍不登录
- 通过条件：正确密码返回 Token 与 PlayerFullData；错误密码 202；协议不兼容 106
- 日期：2026-10-19
- 范围：只做 T37。不实现 T38 及以后，不改 PoC 默认 `Program`，不降低 PasswordHasher 的 600000 次迭代，不覆盖 T36 的关闭标记

### 任务、流程与验证

正式登录加在现有 `AccountHandler` 上。T34 的两参数构造和只注册 `RegisterReq` 的路径保持不变。带齐依赖的构造才注册 `LoginReq`。依赖是同一条玩家队列、玩家缓存、`TokenService`、`SessionRegistry`、按服务端 `SessionId` 取当前 `ClientSession` 的解析函数，以及版本和令牌期限配置。组合根留到 T60，本项不改 PoC 入口。

未登录的连接不在 `SessionRegistry` 里。解析函数必须拿到这条连接本身。玩家编号只来自 `AuthenticateAsync` 的返回值，再写入注册表。不能把客户端放进上下文的玩家编号当成登录身份。

处理顺序是：先确认会话存在且尚未开始关闭；再按配置核对版本；版本通过后才调用 `AuthenticateAsync`。用户名不存在和密码错误都回 202，响应里没有 Token，也没有玩家快照，不绑定会话。协议、过低的资源或配置、以及已配置最低包体版本时的不兼容包体，回 106，不签发、不撤销、不绑定。

认证得到玩家后进入该玩家队列。队列里读取缓存中的完整快照，用 `TokenService.IssueAsync` 在同一事务撤销旧摘要并写入新摘要，等提交完成。然后在同一队列动作里调用 `SessionRegistry.BindAsync`。该调用发现已经处在这名玩家的动作中，会直接绑定，不再入队。绑定让新会话成为 current，并向旧会话发送 `KickNtf`。成功回包在绑定之后发送。旧 Token 在 Kick 写出之前已经撤销，旧连接不能再成为 current。

取消和真实数据库错误原样抛出，不改成 202 或 0，也不发送成功响应。已保存或已在缓存中的字段按原样放进 `PlayerFullData`，登录不重新初始化。令牌期限默认 24 小时，可配置。期限无效，或当前时间加期限溢出时，明确失败，不发过期 Token。密码和 Token 原文不写入日志、异常消息或测试断言输出。

版本边界：协议整数必须等于配置的 `expectedProto`，不相等就是 106。资源版本和配置版本只拒绝低于配置最低值的请求；文档写的是最低版本，没有规定更高版本要拒绝，因此更高版本允许登录，响应里的 `need_res_version` 和 `need_config_version` 仍是服务端要求的最低值。最低包体版本未配置时，登录不比较 `app_version`，整包门槛留给 T44。配置了最低包体版本时，按主、次、修订的数值比较，`0.1.10` 高于 `0.1.9`。本项不做补丁下载，也不实现 T44 的 `VersionService`。

```csharp
using System.Globalization;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 登录时使用的版本门槛和令牌期限。不下载补丁，也不代替 T44 的版本服务。
/// </summary>
public sealed class LoginSessionOptions
{
    /// <summary>未另行指定时，新令牌从当前 UTC 起算的有效期。</summary>
    public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultTokenLifetime = TimeSpan.FromHours(24);

    readonly long _lifetimeMs;
    readonly Func<long> _utcNowMs;
    readonly AppVersion? _minimumApp;

    /// <summary>
    /// 记下调用方明确给出的协议、资源和配置门槛。
    /// 最低包体版本留空时，登录不比较 app_version。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="expectedProtoVersion">客户端 proto_version 必须等于这个整数。不相等即不兼容。</param>
    /// <param name="requiredResVersion">允许登录的最低资源版本。不能为负。更高的客户端版本允许通过。</param>
    /// <param name="requiredConfigVersion">允许登录的最低配置版本。不能为负。更高的客户端版本允许通过。</param>
    /// <param name="tokenLifetime">新令牌的有效期。为空时用 24 小时。零、负数或不足 1 毫秒时拒绝。</param>
    /// <param name="minimumAppVersion">最低包体版本，格式为主.次.修订。空白表示本项不检查包体。</param>
    /// <param name="utcNowMs">当前 UTC Unix 毫秒。为空时读取系统时钟。返回值只用于时间和到期计算。</param>
    public LoginSessionOptions(
        int expectedProtoVersion,
        int requiredResVersion,
        int requiredConfigVersion,
        TimeSpan? tokenLifetime = null,
        string? minimumAppVersion = null,
        Func<long>? utcNowMs = null)
    {
        if (requiredResVersion < 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(requiredResVersion), "最低资源版本不能为负");
        if (requiredConfigVersion < 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(requiredConfigVersion), "最低配置版本不能为负");

        TimeSpan lifetime = tokenLifetime ?? DefaultTokenLifetime;
        _lifetimeMs = ToLifetimeMilliseconds(lifetime);
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(minimumAppVersion))
        {
            if (!AppVersion.TryParse(minimumAppVersion, out AppVersion parsed))
                throw new ArgumentException("最低包体版本必须是主.次.修订", nameof(minimumAppVersion));
            _minimumApp = parsed;
            MinimumAppVersion = parsed.Text;
        }

        ExpectedProtoVersion = expectedProtoVersion;
        RequiredResVersion = requiredResVersion;
        RequiredConfigVersion = requiredConfigVersion;
        TokenLifetime = lifetime;
        _utcNowMs = utcNowMs ?? (() => DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds());
    }

    /// <summary>客户端协议整数必须与它相等。</summary>
    public int ExpectedProtoVersion { get; }

    /// <summary>响应 need_res_version 使用的最低资源版本。</summary>
    public int RequiredResVersion { get; }

    /// <summary>响应 need_config_version 使用的最低配置版本。</summary>
    public int RequiredConfigVersion { get; }

    /// <summary>本次采用的令牌有效期。默认是 24 小时。</summary>
    public TimeSpan TokenLifetime { get; }

    /// <summary>已配置的最低包体版本原文。未配置时为空。</summary>
    public string? MinimumAppVersion { get; }

    /// <summary>读取当前 UTC Unix 毫秒。</summary>
    public long UtcNowMs()
    {
        return _utcNowMs();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 用当前时间和配置期限计算到期毫秒。
    /// 当前时间为负、相加溢出，或结果不晚于当前时间时失败，不返回可用期限。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="nowUnixMs">调用方刚刚读取的 UTC Unix 毫秒。</param>
    public long ExpiresAtUtcMs(long nowUnixMs)
    {
        if (nowUnixMs < 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("当前 UTC 毫秒无效");

        long expires;
        try
        {
            expires = checked(nowUnixMs + _lifetimeMs);
        }
        catch (OverflowException ex)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("令牌到期时间溢出", ex);
        }

        if (expires <= nowUnixMs)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("令牌到期时间无效");
        return expires;
    }

    /// <summary>协议必须精确等于期望值。文档只把不相容变更递增为新整数，这里不做字段级兼容。</summary>
    /// <param name="protoVersion">请求里的 proto_version。</param>
    public bool IsProtoCompatible(int protoVersion)
    {
        return protoVersion == ExpectedProtoVersion;
    }

    /// <summary>低于最低资源版本则不兼容。负值不是递增版本。高于最低值允许通过。</summary>
    /// <param name="resVersion">请求里的 res_version。</param>
    public bool IsResCompatible(int resVersion)
    {
        return resVersion >= 0 && resVersion >= RequiredResVersion;
    }

    /// <summary>低于最低配置版本则不兼容。负值不是递增版本。高于最低值允许通过。</summary>
    /// <param name="configVersion">请求里的 config_version。</param>
    public bool IsConfigCompatible(int configVersion)
    {
        return configVersion >= 0 && configVersion >= RequiredConfigVersion;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 未配置最低包体版本时直接通过。
    /// 已配置时，客户端必须是主.次.修订，并且数值上不低于最低版本。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="appVersion">请求里的 app_version。</param>
    public bool IsAppCompatible(string? appVersion)
    {
        if (_minimumApp == null)
            return true;
        if (!AppVersion.TryParse(appVersion, out AppVersion client))
            return false;
        return client.CompareTo(_minimumApp.Value) >= 0;
    }

    /// <summary>把正的期限折成毫秒。不足 1 毫秒或不是正数时拒绝。</summary>
    /// <param name="lifetime">调用方给出的期限。</param>
    static long ToLifetimeMilliseconds(TimeSpan lifetime)
    {
        if (lifetime <= TimeSpan.Zero)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(lifetime), "令牌期限必须为正");

        long milliseconds = lifetime.Ticks / TimeSpan.TicksPerMillisecond;
        if (milliseconds <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(lifetime), "令牌期限必须至少为 1 毫秒");
        return milliseconds;
    }

    /// <summary>主.次.修订三个非负整数。比较时按数值，不按字符串字典序。</summary>
    readonly struct AppVersion
    {
        AppVersion(int major, int minor, int patch, string text)
        {
            Major = major;
            Minor = minor;
            Patch = patch;
            Text = text;
        }

        /// <summary>主版本。</summary>
        public int Major { get; }

        /// <summary>次版本。</summary>
        public int Minor { get; }

        /// <summary>修订版本。</summary>
        public int Patch { get; }

        /// <summary>规范化后的主.次.修订原文。</summary>
        public string Text { get; }

        /// <summary>只接受三段非负整数。空串、缺段、符号和空白都不是包体版本。</summary>
        /// <param name="text">待解析的版本文本。</param>
        /// <param name="version">成功时为三个数值；失败时为默认值。</param>
        public static bool TryParse(string? text, out AppVersion version)
        {
            version = default;
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
                return false;

            string[] parts = text.Split('.');
            if (parts.Length != 3)
                return false;
            if (!TryPart(parts[0], out int major) || !TryPart(parts[1], out int minor) || !TryPart(parts[2], out int patch))
                return false;

            version = new AppVersion(
                major,
                minor,
                patch,
                string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}.{1}.{2}", major, minor, patch));
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>先比主版本，再比次版本，最后比修订。负数表示小于另一个。</summary>
        /// <param name="other">配置中的最低包体版本。</param>
        public int CompareTo(AppVersion other)
        {
            int major = Major.CompareTo(other.Major);
            if (major != 0)
                return major;
            int minor = Minor.CompareTo(other.Minor);
            if (minor != 0)
                return minor;
            return Patch.CompareTo(other.Patch);
        }

        /// <summary>一段必须是不带符号和空白的十进制非负整数。</summary>
        /// <param name="text">点号之间的一段。</param>
        /// <param name="value">成功时的数值。</param>
        static bool TryPart(string text, out int value)
        {
            return int.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out value) && value >= 0;
        }
    }
}
```
