```csharp
using CloudIsle.Net;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Data;
using CloudIsle.Server.Network;
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;
using Google.Protobuf;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 正式账号入口。两参数构造只处理注册，不绑定会话，不签发 Token。
/// 登录构造在此之外处理登录：先版本，再认证，再在玩家队列里换发令牌并绑定当前连接。
/// 带保存服务的构造再处理重连和显式登出。重连不换发 Token。登出不回包。
/// </summary>
public sealed class AccountHandler
{
    readonly AccountRepository _accounts;
    readonly Func<RequestContext, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> _sendAsync;
    readonly PlayerQueue? _players;
    readonly PlayerCache? _cache;
    readonly TokenService? _tokens;
    readonly SessionRegistry? _sessions;
    readonly Func<long, ClientSession?>? _resolveSession;
    readonly LoginSessionOptions? _options;
    readonly SaveService? _saves;

    /// <summary>只记下注册仓库和回包委托。这个构造不注册登录路由。</summary>
    /// <param name="accounts">已有的账号仓库。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="sendAsync">把响应帧交给当前会话。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public AccountHandler(
        AccountRepository accounts,
        Func<RequestContext, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> sendAsync)
    {
        _accounts = accounts ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(accounts));
        _sendAsync = sendAsync ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sendAsync));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 记下注册和登录所需的明确依赖。玩家队列必须与会话注册表是同一实例，绑定才能在队列内直接执行。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="accounts">认证和注册使用的仓库。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="players">登录成功后串行化该玩家状态变化的队列。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="cache">在该玩家队列中读取完整快照的缓存。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="tokens">提交新令牌并撤销旧令牌的服务。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="sessions">绑定当前连接的注册表，必须使用同一个玩家队列。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="resolveSession">用服务端会话编号取实际连接。为空时抛出异常。找不到时返回空。</param>
    /// <param name="options">协议、资源、配置、包体和令牌期限。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="sendAsync">把响应帧交给当前会话。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public AccountHandler(
        AccountRepository accounts,
        PlayerQueue players,
        PlayerCache cache,
        TokenService tokens,
        SessionRegistry sessions,
        Func<long, ClientSession?> resolveSession,
        LoginSessionOptions options,
        Func<RequestContext, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> sendAsync)
        : this(accounts, sendAsync)
    {
        _players = players ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(players));
        _cache = cache ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(cache));
        _tokens = tokens ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tokens));
        _sessions = sessions ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sessions));
        _resolveSession = resolveSession ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(resolveSession));
        _options = options ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(options));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 在登录依赖之外记下保存服务。这个构造才注册重连和登出。
    /// 保存服务必须使用同一个玩家队列和玩家缓存，登出才能在队列内直接等待落库。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="accounts">认证和注册使用的仓库。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="players">重连和登出要进入的玩家队列。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="cache">读取和移除快照的缓存。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="tokens">校验和撤销令牌的服务。为空时抛出异常。重连不调用发放。</param>
    /// <param name="sessions">绑定和按身份解绑的注册表，必须使用同一个玩家队列。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="resolveSession">用服务端会话编号取实际连接。为空时抛出异常。找不到时返回空。</param>
    /// <param name="options">协议门槛和当前 UTC 毫秒。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="saves">显式登出等待的保存服务。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="sendAsync">把重连响应交给当前会话。为空时抛出异常。登出不使用它发送业务响应。</param>
    public AccountHandler(
        AccountRepository accounts,
        PlayerQueue players,
        PlayerCache cache,
        TokenService tokens,
        SessionRegistry sessions,
        Func<long, ClientSession?> resolveSession,
        LoginSessionOptions options,
        SaveService saves,
        Func<RequestContext, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> sendAsync)
        : this(accounts, players, cache, tokens, sessions, resolveSession, options, sendAsync)
    {
        _saves = saves ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(saves));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 测试在重连首次校验已经返回、尚未入队时暂停。生产保持 null。
    /// 用来证明队列内必须重新校验，不能沿用入队前的结果。
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>参数是这一次重连的取消标记。回调异常会原样传出，并且不会入队。</remarks>
    internal Func<CancellationToken, Task>? BeforeReconnectEnqueueAsync { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 测试在登出已经取得上下文、尚未入队时暂停。生产保持 null。
    /// 用来证明队列内必须重新核对当前会话。
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>参数是这一次登出的取消标记。回调异常会原样传出，并且不会入队。</remarks>
    internal Func<CancellationToken, Task>? BeforeLogoutEnqueueAsync { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 向已有路由注册正式 RegisterReq。登录构造再注册 LoginReq。
    /// 带保存服务的构造再注册 ReconnectReq 和 LogoutReq。
    /// 重复注册由路由拒绝，本方法不覆盖旧处理函数。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="router">启动时持有的路由。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public void RegisterRoutes(MessageRouter router)
    {
        if (router == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(router));
        router.Register<RegisterReq>(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(RegisterReq)), HandleRegisterAsync);
        if (_options != null)
            router.Register<LoginReq>(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(LoginReq)), HandleLoginAsync);
        if (_saves != null)
        {
            router.Register<ReconnectReq>(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(ReconnectReq)), HandleReconnectAsync);
            router.Register<LogoutReq>(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(LogoutReq)), HandleLogoutAsync);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 校验昵称后创建账号和玩家，并回送正式 RegisterResp。
    /// 取消或数据库错误原样抛出，不改写成成功或重名，也不发送 code 为 0 的响应。
    /// 成功后不绑定会话，不签发 Token。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">当前帧的会话和 seq。本方法不改玩家编号。</param>
    /// <param name="request">正式注册请求。只读取已有字段。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消校验之后的写库和回包。</param>
    public async Task HandleRegisterAsync(RequestContext context, RegisterReq request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (context == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
        if (request == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(request));

        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (!IsNicknameAllowed(request.Nickname))
        {
            await SendRegisterAsync(context, 203, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return;
        }

        int code = await _accounts.RegisterAsync(request, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (code != 0 && code != 201)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("注册结果不是成功或用户名已存在");

        await SendRegisterAsync(context, code, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 处理正式登录。版本不通过时回 106；认证失败回 202。
    /// 成功时在玩家队列内读取缓存快照、提交新令牌、绑定这条服务端连接，再回 1006。
    /// 取消或数据库错误不改成 202 或 0，也不发送成功响应。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">当前帧的服务端会话和 seq。其中的玩家编号不作为登录身份。</param>
    /// <param name="request">正式登录请求。只读取版本、用户名和密码。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消版本通过后的认证、换发、绑定和回包。</param>
    public async Task HandleLoginAsync(RequestContext context, LoginReq request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (context == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
        if (request == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(request));
        if (_options == null || _players == null || _cache == null || _tokens == null || _sessions == null || _resolveSession == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("登录依赖未配置");

        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        RequireOpenSession(context.SessionId);

        if (!_options.IsProtoCompatible(request.ProtoVersion)
            || !_options.IsResCompatible(request.ResVersion)
            || !_options.IsConfigCompatible(request.ConfigVersion)
            || !_options.IsAppCompatible(request.AppVersion))
        {
            await SendLoginAsync(context, VersionRejected(), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return;
        }

        long playerId = await _accounts.AuthenticateAsync(request.Username ?? "", request.Password ?? "", ct)
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (playerId <= 0)
        {
            await SendLoginAsync(context, AuthRejected(), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return;
        }

        await _players.EnqueueAsync(playerId, token => CompleteLoginAsync(context, playerId, token), ct)
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 在该玩家队列中完成快照、换发和绑定。绑定使用队列内直接执行，避免再次入队。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">要回包的原始帧。会话编号取自这里。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">认证得到的玩家编号。不取自客户端上下文。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消尚未提交的换发，或取消绑定前的后续步骤。</param>
    async Task CompleteLoginAsync(RequestContext context, long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        ClientSession session = RequireOpenSession(context.SessionId);
        PlayerState state = await _cache!.GetAsync(playerId, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        long now = _options!.UtcNowMs();
        long expiresAt = _options.ExpiresAtUtcMs(now);
        string token = await _tokens!.IssueAsync(playerId, expiresAt, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        session = RequireOpenSession(context.SessionId);
        await _sessions!.BindAsync(playerId, session, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (!_sessions.IsCurrent(playerId, session.SessionId))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("登录会话没有成为当前连接");

        await SendLoginAsync(context, Accepted(token, now, state.Data), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 处理正式重连。会话已关闭时拒绝。协议不兼容回 106，不改绑定。
    /// 入队前的校验只用来选择玩家队列。队列内用当时的 UTC 再校验同一个 Token。
    /// 有效时回 1008、服务器 UTC 毫秒和缓存中的完整快照，并绑定这条连接。不换发 Token。
    /// 无效回 204 且没有快照。取消或数据库错误不改成 204 或 0。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">当前帧的服务端会话和 seq。玩家编号不作为重连身份。</param>
    /// <param name="request">正式重连请求。只读取 Token 原文和 proto_version。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消入队前的校验，以及队列内尚未写出的响应。</param>
    public async Task HandleReconnectAsync(RequestContext context, ReconnectReq request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (context == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
        if (request == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(request));
        if (_options == null || _players == null || _cache == null || _tokens == null || _sessions == null || _resolveSession == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("重连依赖未配置");

        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        RequireOpenSession(context.SessionId);
        if (!_options.IsProtoCompatible(request.ProtoVersion))
        {
            await SendReconnectAsync(context, new ReconnectResp { Code = 106 }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return;
        }

        long previewNow = _options.UtcNowMs();
        TokenValidation preview = await _tokens.ValidateAsync(request.Token ?? "", previewNow, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (preview.Code != TokenValidation.ValidCode || preview.PlayerId <= 0)
        {
            await SendReconnectAsync(context, new ReconnectResp { Code = 204 }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return;
        }

        Func<CancellationToken, Task>? beforeEnqueue = BeforeReconnectEnqueueAsync;
        if (beforeEnqueue != null)
            await beforeEnqueue(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

        long playerId = preview.PlayerId;
        string token = request.Token ?? "";
        await _players.EnqueueAsync(playerId, queueToken => CompleteReconnectAsync(context, token, playerId, queueToken), ct)
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 在该玩家队列中重新校验 Token。通过后读取快照并绑定。失败只回 204。
    /// 不调用 IssueAsync，因此不会撤销当前有效令牌，也不会产生无法放进响应的新原文。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">要回包的原始帧。会话编号取自这里。</param>
    /// <param name="token">客户端这次带来的原文。队列内再次校验的就是这一串。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">入队前校验得到的玩家。队列内结果必须仍然是这名玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消尚未写出的响应。取消不改写成 204。</param>
    async Task CompleteReconnectAsync(RequestContext context, string token, long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        ClientSession session = RequireOpenSession(context.SessionId);
        long now = _options!.UtcNowMs();
        TokenValidation again = await _tokens!.ValidateAsync(token, now, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (again.Code != TokenValidation.ValidCode || again.PlayerId != playerId)
        {
            await SendReconnectAsync(context, new ReconnectResp { Code = 204 }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return;
        }

        PlayerState state = await _cache!.GetAsync(playerId, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        session = RequireOpenSession(context.SessionId);
        await _sessions!.BindAsync(playerId, session, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (!_sessions.IsCurrent(playerId, session.SessionId))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("重连会话没有成为当前连接");

        await SendReconnectAsync(context, new ReconnectResp
        {
            Code = 0,
            ServerTime = now,
            Data = state.Data.Clone()
        }, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 处理正式登出。不发送 LogoutResp，也不发送伪造成功的其他帧。
    /// 入队前的身份只决定进哪一条玩家队列。队列内必须重新确认这条会话仍是 current。
    /// 保存成功才丢缓存。保存失败仍尝试撤销和按身份关闭，并保留 Dirty。
    /// 撤销失败原样抛出。清理不读取已取消的请求标记来决定跳过。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">分发时由注册表生成的上下文。玩家编号和会话编号都取自这里。</param>
    /// <param name="request">正式登出请求。没有字段。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消入队前的等待，以及队列内的落库。已开始的撤销和关闭不使用它。</param>
    public async Task HandleLogoutAsync(RequestContext context, LogoutReq request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (context == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
        if (request == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(request));
        if (_players == null || _cache == null || _tokens == null || _sessions == null || _resolveSession == null || _saves == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("登出依赖未配置");

        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        ClientSession session = RequireOpenSession(context.SessionId);
        if (context.PlayerId <= 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("登出缺少服务端玩家身份");

        Func<CancellationToken, Task>? beforeEnqueue = BeforeLogoutEnqueueAsync;
        if (beforeEnqueue != null)
            await beforeEnqueue(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

        long playerId = context.PlayerId;
        await _players.EnqueueAsync(playerId, queueToken => CompleteLogoutAsync(session, playerId, queueToken), ct)
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 在该玩家队列中完成保存、撤销和身份匹配关闭。
    /// 若这条会话已经不是 current，则不撤销、不解绑、不改缓存。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="session">入队前解析到的那条连接。关闭时只用这个对象，不改查当前连接。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">入队前上下文中的玩家。队列内用它和会话编号重新核对。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">只交给落库。撤销和关闭使用不受这次请求取消影响的标记。</param>
    async Task CompleteLogoutAsync(ClientSession session, long playerId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (!_sessions!.IsCurrent(playerId, session.SessionId))
            return;

        Exception? saveError = null;
        bool saved = false;
        try
        {
            await _saves!.FlushPlayerAsync(playerId, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            saved = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            saveError = ex;
        }

        Exception? revokeError = null;
        try
        {
            await _tokens!.RevokePlayerAsync(playerId, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            revokeError = ex;
        }

        Exception? closeError = null;
        try
        {
            if (_sessions.IsCurrent(playerId, session.SessionId))
            {
                _sessions.UnbindIfCurrent(playerId, session.SessionId);
                if (saved)
                    DropCacheIfClean(playerId);
                await CloseLogoutSessionAsync(session).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            closeError = ex;
        }

        if (revokeError != null)
            throw revokeError;
        if (saveError != null)
            throw saveError;
        if (closeError != null)
            throw closeError;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 保存已经成功且缓存不再脏、也没有持有时才移除。
    /// 仍脏或仍被持有时留下缓存，供后续重试。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">刚刚完成保存尝试的玩家。调用时必须仍在该玩家队列内。</param>
    void DropCacheIfClean(long playerId)
    {
        if (!_cache!.IsCached(playerId))
            return;
        if (_cache.TryCopyDirty(playerId, out _))
            return;
        if (_cache.CopyHoldCount(playerId) > 0)
            return;
        _cache.Remove(playerId);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 关闭登出对应的那条连接。预算用尽后不再等待。
    /// 若调用栈已经在该会话自己的收发循环里，CloseAsync 只发信号并返回，避免等待自身 Completion。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="session">身份匹配通过时的那条连接。</param>
    async Task CloseLogoutSessionAsync(ClientSession session)
    {
        using var budget = new CancellationTokenSource(SessionRegistry.DefaultKickBudget);
        try
        {
            await session.CloseAsync("登出", budget.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (budget.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
        }
    }

    /// <summary>按服务端会话编号取仍可登录的连接。已开始关闭或不在解析结果里时拒绝。</summary>
    /// <param name="sessionId">请求上下文中的服务端会话编号。</param>
    ClientSession RequireOpenSession(long sessionId)
    {
        ClientSession? session = _resolveSession!(sessionId);
        if (session == null || session.SessionId != sessionId || session.IsCloseRequested)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("会话不存在或已开始关闭");
        return session;
    }

    /// <summary>106 只带版本门槛，不带令牌和快照。</summary>
    LoginResp VersionRejected()
    {
        return new LoginResp
        {
            Code = 106,
            NeedResVersion = _options!.RequiredResVersion,
            NeedConfigVersion = _options.RequiredConfigVersion
        };
    }

    /// <summary>202 不带令牌、快照和版本门槛。</summary>
    static LoginResp AuthRejected()
    {
        return new LoginResp { Code = 202 };
    }

    /// <summary>成功响应带令牌、同一时刻的 UTC 毫秒、最低版本和缓存中的完整快照。</summary>
    /// <param name="token">已经提交的令牌原文。只放进这一次响应。</param>
    /// <param name="nowUnixMs">计算到期时间时使用的 UTC 毫秒。</param>
    /// <param name="data">缓存返回的完整玩家数据。这里再复制一份放进响应。</param>
    LoginResp Accepted(string token, long nowUnixMs, PlayerFullData data)
    {
        return new LoginResp
        {
            Code = 0,
            Token = token,
            ServerTime = nowUnixMs,
            NeedResVersion = _options!.RequiredResVersion,
            NeedConfigVersion = _options.RequiredConfigVersion,
            Data = data.Clone()
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 05 没有规定昵称长度和字符集。空串、纯空白和控制字符在这里视为非法。
    /// 不裁剪、不设上限，其余文本原样交给仓库。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="nickname">请求中的昵称。</param>
    static bool IsNicknameAllowed(string? nickname)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(nickname))
            return false;

        foreach (char character in nickname)
        {
            if (char.IsControl(character))
                return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>用请求的 seq 发送只含 code 的正式注册响应。</summary>
    /// <param name="context">提供 seq 的当前帧上下文。</param>
    /// <param name="code">0、201 或 203。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消回包。</param>
    async Task SendRegisterAsync(RequestContext context, int code, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var response = new RegisterResp { Code = code };
        ushort responseId = MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(RegisterResp));
        await _sendAsync(context, new Packet(responseId, context.Seq, response.ToByteArray()), ct)
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>用请求的 seq 发送正式登录响应。消息编号来自 LoginResp。</summary>
    /// <param name="context">提供 seq 的当前帧上下文。</param>
    /// <param name="response">已经填好的登录响应。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消回包。</param>
    async Task SendLoginAsync(RequestContext context, LoginResp response, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ushort responseId = MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(LoginResp));
        await _sendAsync(context, new Packet(responseId, context.Seq, response.ToByteArray()), ct)
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>用请求的 seq 发送正式重连响应。消息编号来自 ReconnectResp。不附加 Token。</summary>
    /// <param name="context">提供 seq 的当前帧上下文。</param>
    /// <param name="response">已经填好的重连响应。204 和 106 不带快照。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消回包。</param>
    async Task SendReconnectAsync(RequestContext context, ReconnectResp response, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ushort responseId = MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(ReconnectResp));
        await _sendAsync(context, new Packet(responseId, context.Seq, response.ToByteArray()), ct)
            .ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using CloudIsle.Net;
using Google.Protobuf;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Network;
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 同一玩家只保留一条当前连接。新连接写入映射后，旧连接才收到正式踢线并关闭。
/// 不签发令牌，也不处理登录或登出。
/// </summary>
public sealed class SessionRegistry
{
    /// <summary>未另行指定时，踢线写入和等待旧连接关闭共用的上限。</summary>
    public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultKickBudget = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);

    readonly PlayerQueue _queue;
    readonly TimeSpan _kickBudget;
    readonly Action<string> _log;
    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, ClientSession> _byPlayer = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, long> _bySession = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, Task> _watches = new();
    readonly HashSet<long> _retiring = new();

    /// <summary>使用共享玩家队列，踢线预算为 2 秒，日志写到控制台。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerQueue">同玩家串行的队列。本对象不释放它。</param>
    public SessionRegistry(PlayerQueue playerQueue)
        : this(playerQueue, DefaultKickBudget, null)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>使用共享玩家队列，并指定踢线预算和日志。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerQueue">同玩家串行的队列。绑定会进入这名玩家的队列；本对象不释放它。</param>
    /// <param name="kickBudget">旧连接通知和等待关闭的合计上限，必须为正。用尽后不再占住玩家队列。</param>
    /// <param name="log">诊断输出。为空时写到控制台。回调在字典锁外调用。</param>
    public SessionRegistry(PlayerQueue playerQueue, TimeSpan kickBudget, Action<string>? log)
    {
        if (playerQueue == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(playerQueue));
        if (kickBudget <= TimeSpan.Zero)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(kickBudget), "踢线预算必须为正");

        _queue = playerQueue;
        _kickBudget = kickBudget;
        _log = log ?? (static message => Console.WriteLine(message));
    }

    /// <summary>当前仍登记为在线的玩家数。</summary>
    internal int MappedPlayerCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _byPlayer.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>会话到玩家的反向索引数量。</summary>
    internal int MappedSessionCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _bySession.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>尚未结束的会话观察数。结束后会从集合删除。</summary>
    internal int WatchCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _watches.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>已失去当前身份、关闭尚未观察结束的会话数。</summary>
    internal int RetiringCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _retiring.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>等待已经登记的观察任务结束。仍在运行的会话会使这个等待一直停着。</summary>
    internal async Task WhenIdleAsync()
    {
        while (true)
        {
            Task[] pending;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_watches.Count == 0)
                    return;
                pending = _watches.Values.ToArray();
            }

            await Task.WhenAll(pending).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 把连接登记为该玩家的唯一在线会话。同一会话重复绑定不踢自己。
    /// 已经处在该玩家队列动作中时直接执行，避免再次入队死锁。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要占线的玩家。必须是正数。不从客户端报文读取。</param>
    /// <param name="session">服务端这条连接。已关闭或正在因顶号关闭时拒绝。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">只在改映射前生效。改映射之后取消不回滚新映射，旧连接仍按预算收尾。</param>
    public Task BindAsync(long playerId, ClientSession session, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (session == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(session));
        if (playerId <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(playerId), "玩家编号必须为正数");

        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (PlayerQueue.IsCurrentPlayer(playerId))
            return BindCoreAsync(playerId, session, ct);

        return _queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, token => BindCoreAsync(playerId, session, token), ct);
    }

    /// <summary>这名玩家的当前连接是不是这条会话。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要核对的玩家。没有在线会话时返回 false。</param>
    /// <param name="sessionId">服务端会话编号。</param>
    public bool IsCurrent(long playerId, long sessionId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == sessionId
                && _bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long mapped)
                && mapped == playerId;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>按玩家取当前连接。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要查询的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="session">找到时是当前连接；否则为 null。</param>
    /// <returns>该玩家有当前连接时为 true。</returns>
    public bool TryGetCurrentSession(long playerId, [NotNullWhen(true)] out ClientSession? session)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current))
            {
                session = current;
                return true;
            }
        }

        session = null;
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>按服务端会话编号反查玩家。</summary>
    /// <param name="sessionId">服务端会话编号。不采用客户端自行声明的编号。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">找到时为注册表里的玩家；否则为 0。</param>
    /// <returns>该会话仍是某玩家的当前连接时为 true。</returns>
    public bool TryGetPlayerId(long sessionId, out long playerId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long mapped)
                && _byPlayer.TryGetValue(mapped, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == sessionId)
            {
                playerId = mapped;
                return true;
            }
        }

        playerId = 0;
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 用这条服务端连接构造请求上下文。玩家编号只取注册表，未绑定为 0。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="session">正在处理的服务端连接。会话编号取自该对象。</param>
    /// <param name="msgId">本帧的正式消息编号。不从正文推断玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="seq">本帧序号。</param>
    public RequestContext CreateRequestContext(ClientSession session, ushort msgId, uint seq)
    {
        if (session == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(session));

        long playerId = 0;
        if (TryGetPlayerId(session.SessionId, out long mapped))
            playerId = mapped;

        return new RequestContext(session.SessionId, playerId, msgId, seq);
    }

    /// <summary>在玩家队列内完成一次绑定。调用方保证同一玩家不会并发进入这里。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">本次占线的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="session">要成为当前连接的会话。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">改映射前取消则原样抛出，并且不改字典。</param>
    async Task BindCoreAsync(long playerId, ClientSession session, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ClientSession? retiring = null;
        TaskCompletionSource? watch = null;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            if (session.IsCloseRequested || session.Completion.IsCompleted)
            {
                UnmapIfMatch(session.SessionId);
                throw new InvalidOperationException("已关闭的会话不能绑定");
            }

            if (_retiring.Contains(session.SessionId))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("正在关闭的会话不能重新绑定");

            bool sameCurrent = _byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == session.SessionId;
            if (!sameCurrent)
            {
                if (_bySession.TryGetValue(session.SessionId, out long previousPlayer) && previousPlayer != playerId)
                {
                    if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(previousPlayer, out ClientSession? previous)
                        && previous.SessionId == session.SessionId)
                    {
                        _byPlayer.Remove(previousPlayer);
                    }

                    _bySession.Remove(session.SessionId);
                }

                if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? old) && old.SessionId != session.SessionId)
                {
                    _byPlayer.Remove(playerId);
                    _bySession.Remove(old.SessionId);
                    _retiring.Add(old.SessionId);
                    retiring = old;
                }

                _byPlayer[playerId] = session;
                _bySession[session.SessionId] = playerId;
            }

            if (!_watches.ContainsKey(session.SessionId))
            {
                watch = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
                _watches[session.SessionId] = watch.Task;
            }
        }

        if (watch != null)
            Observe(RunWatchAsync(session, watch));

        if (retiring != null)
            await RetireAsync(retiring, playerId).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>等会话结束后，仅当反向索引仍是它时才删除。然后丢掉观察项。</summary>
    /// <param name="session">被观察的连接。完成任务是它自己的 Completion。</param>
    /// <param name="done">交给 WhenIdleAsync 的完成源。清理后再完成，避免漏等。</param>
    async Task RunWatchAsync(ClientSession session, TaskCompletionSource done)
    {
        try
        {
            await Task.Yield();
            await session.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally
        {
            try
            {
                lock (_gate)
                {
                    UnmapIfMatch(session.SessionId);
                    _retiring.Remove(session.SessionId);
                    if (_watches.TryGetValue(session.SessionId, out Task? task) && ReferenceEquals(task, done.Task))
                        _watches.Remove(session.SessionId);
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                done.TrySetResult();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>锁外发送正式踢线并关闭。失败或超时只记日志，不把新映射撤掉。</summary>
    /// <param name="oldSession">已经从当前映射移除的旧连接。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">这次绑定的玩家，只写入日志。</param>
    async Task RetireAsync(ClientSession oldSession, long playerId)
    {
        Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 已失去当前身份。KickNtf 与关闭等待预算 {_kickBudget.TotalMilliseconds.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} 毫秒。超时或失败不保证通知送达，仍会关闭旧连接。");
        using var budget = new CancellationTokenSource(_kickBudget);
        try
        {
            await oldSession.SendAsync(CreateKickPacket(), budget.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 已写入 KickNtf（KickElsewhere，seq=0）。写入完成不代表对端已经处理。");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 的 KickNtf 未能确认送达（{ex.GetType().Name}）。不保证对方收到，仍关闭旧连接。");
        }

        try
        {
            await oldSession.CloseAsync("顶号", budget.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 在预算内没有完成关闭（{ex.GetType().Name}）。关闭已经发起，玩家队列不再等待。");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 仅当该玩家的当前映射仍是这条会话时，同时删除玩家索引和会话索引。
    /// 已经换成其他会话时不改任何映射。必须在该玩家的队列动作里调用。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">登出上下文里的玩家。必须是正数。</param>
    /// <param name="sessionId">要解除的服务端会话编号。只删除仍指向它的映射。</param>
    public void UnbindIfCurrent(long playerId, long sessionId)
    {
        if (playerId <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(playerId), "玩家编号必须为正数");
        if (!PlayerQueue.IsCurrentPlayer(playerId))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("只能在该玩家的队列内按身份解绑");

        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (!_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current) || current.SessionId != sessionId)
                return;
            if (!_bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long mapped) || mapped != playerId)
                return;

            _byPlayer.Remove(playerId);
            _bySession.Remove(sessionId);
            _retiring.Add(sessionId);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>调用方必须已经持有字典锁。只删除仍然指向这个会话编号的索引。</summary>
    /// <param name="sessionId">完成或被拒绝的服务端会话编号。</param>
    void UnmapIfMatch(long sessionId)
    {
        if (!_bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long playerId))
            return;

        _bySession.Remove(sessionId);
        if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current) && current.SessionId == sessionId)
            _byPlayer.Remove(playerId);
    }

    /// <summary>组装正式踢线。原因使用生成枚举的顶号值，序号固定为 0。</summary>
    static Packet CreateKickPacket()
    {
        var notification = new KickNtf { Reason = KickReason.KickElsewhere };
        return new Packet(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(KickNtf)), 0, notification.ToByteArray());
    }

    /// <summary>观察后台任务，避免未观察异常。</summary>
    /// <param name="task">会话观察任务。</param>
    static void Observe(Task task)
    {
        if (task.IsCompleted)
        {
            _ = task.Exception;
            return;
        }

        _ = task.ContinueWith(
            static finished => _ = finished.Exception,
            CancellationToken.None,
            TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted | TaskContinuationOptions.ExecuteSynchronously,
            TaskScheduler.Default);
    }

    /// <summary>写诊断。回调异常不影响关闭。</summary>
    /// <param name="message">已经写好的说明，不含令牌或密码。</param>
    void Log(string message)
    {
        try
        {
            _log("[SessionRegistry] " + message);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Buffers.Binary;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>经正式路由和真实 ClientSession 验证重连与显式登出。临时库与 PoC 账号库分开。</summary>
public sealed class AccountReconnectTests
{
    const long NowMs = 1_700_000_000_000L;
    static readonly long DayMs = (long)TimeSpan.FromHours(24).TotalMilliseconds;

    /// <summary>有效 Token 重连回 1008、同一玩家和完整快照，并且不换发 Token。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ValidToken_RestoresSamePlayerWithoutIssuingToken()
    {
        await using var world = await ReconnectWorld.OpenAsync();
        await using LiveSession current = await world.AddSessionAsync(71);
        await using LiveSession again = await world.AddSessionAsync(72);
        await world.RegisterAsync(current, "ada", "secret-value", "Ann", 1);
        LoginResp login = await world.LoginAsync(current, "ada", "secret-value", 2);
        int tokensBefore = world.ActiveTokenCount();

        ReconnectResp response = await world.ReconnectAsync(again, login.Token, 3);

        Assert.That(response.Code, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(response.ServerTime, Is.EqualTo(NowMs));
        AssertSame(login.Data, response.Data);
        Assert.That(response.Data.Info.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(login.Data.Info.PlayerId));
        Assert.That(world.ActiveTokenCount(), Is.EqualTo(tokensBefore));
        TokenValidation still = await world.Tokens.ValidateAsync(login.Token, NowMs, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(still.Code, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(still.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(login.Data.Info.PlayerId));
        Assert.That(world.Sessions.IsCurrent(login.Data.Info.PlayerId, again.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
        Assert.That(world.Sessions.IsCurrent(login.Data.Info.PlayerId, current.Session.SessionId), Is.False);
        Assert.That(string.Join("\n", world.Logs).Contains(login.Token), Is.False);
    }

    /// <summary>同进程自然断线后复用权威缓存，不把昵称重写成库里的旧值。</summary>

    /// <summary>未知、已经到期和已撤销的 Token 都回 204，不带快照，也不改原绑定。</summary>

    {

    /// <summary>首次校验早于 B 登录，队列内校验晚于 B。旧重连不能抢回。</summary>

    {

        TokenValidation newerToken = await world.Tokens.ValidateAsync(fresh.Token, NowMs, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(newerToken.Code, Is.EqualTo(0));
        TokenValidation oldToken = await world.Tokens.ValidateAsync(oldLogin.Token, NowMs, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(oldToken.Code, Is.EqualTo(204));
        Assert.That(world.ActiveTokenCount(), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(string.Join("\n", world.Logs).Contains(fresh.Token), Is.False);
        Assert.That(string.Join("\n", world.Logs).Contains(oldLogin.Token), Is.False);

        long playerId = login.Data.Info.PlayerId;
        await world.MutateNicknameAsync(playerId, "Held");
        world.Saves.BeforePersistAsync = (_, _) => throw new InvalidOperationException("logout-save-aborted");
        int frames = world.Frames(session).Count;

        InvalidOperationException error = Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => world.LogoutAsync(session, 3));

        Assert.That(error.Message, Does.Contain("logout-save-aborted"));

        Assert.That(world.ScalarString("SELECT nickname FROM player WHERE id = $id;", playerId), Is.EqualTo("Ann"));
        TokenValidation revoked = await world.Tokens.ValidateAsync(login.Token, NowMs, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(revoked.Code, Is.EqualTo(204));
        Assert.That(session.Session.IsCloseRequested, Is.True);
        Assert.That(world.Sessions.MappedPlayerCount, Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(world.Saves.FailedSaveCount, Is.EqualTo(1));

        world.Saves.BeforePersistAsync = null;
        await world.Saves.FlushPlayerAsync(playerId, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(world.ScalarString("SELECT nickname FROM player WHERE id = $id;", playerId), Is.EqualTo("Held"));

    /// <summary>取消和令牌表不可读都不回 0 或 204。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task CancelOrDatabaseFailure_DoesNotSendSuccess()
    {
        await using var world = await ReconnectWorld.OpenAsync();
        await using LiveSession early = await world.AddSessionAsync(93);
        await world.RegisterAsync(early, "ada", "secret-value", "Ann", 1);
        LoginResp login = await world.LoginAsync(early, "ada", "secret-value", 2);
        using var canceled = new CancellationTokenSource();
        canceled.Cancel();
        int frames = world.Frames(early).Count;
        OperationCanceledException earlyError = Assert.CatchAsync<OperationCanceledException>(() =>
            world.DispatchReconnectAsync(early, login.Token, 3, ct: canceled.Token));
        Assert.That(earlyError.Message.Contains(login.Token), Is.False);
        Assert.That(world.Frames(early).Count, Is.EqualTo(frames));

        await using LiveSession queued = await world.AddSessionAsync(94);
        var entered = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        Task<int> hold = world.Store.ExecuteAsync(_ =>
        {
            entered.TrySetResult();
            if (!release.Task.Wait(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8)))
                throw new TimeoutException("数据库占用没有被放开");
            return 0;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await entered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        using var queuedCancel = new CancellationTokenSource();
        Task pending = world.DispatchReconnectAsync(queued, login.Token, 4, ct: queuedCancel.Token);
        queuedCancel.Cancel();
        release.TrySetResult();
        OperationCanceledException queuedError = Assert.CatchAsync<OperationCanceledException>(async () => await pending);
        await hold;
        Assert.That(queuedError.Message.Contains(login.Token), Is.False);
        Assert.That(world.Frames(queued), Is.Empty);
        Assert.That(world.Sessions.IsCurrent(login.Data.Info.PlayerId, early.Session.SessionId), Is.True);

        world.Execute("ALTER TABLE auth_token RENAME TO auth_token_hidden;");
        await using LiveSession broken = await world.AddSessionAsync(95);
        SqliteException database = Assert.ThrowsAsync<SqliteException>(() => world.DispatchReconnectAsync(broken, login.Token, 5));
        Assert.That(database.Message.Contains(login.Token), Is.False);
        Assert.That(world.Frames(broken), Is.Empty);
        Assert.That(world.Sessions.IsCurrent(login.Data.Info.PlayerId, early.Session.SessionId), Is.True);
    }

    /// <summary>登出已经进入保存后，请求取消仍撤销并关闭，且不回成功帧。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task LogoutCancel_StillRevokesWithoutResponse()
    {

        Assert.That(error.Message.Contains(login.Token), Is.False);

        DirtyCopy dirty = await world.CopyDirtyAsync(playerId);

        TokenValidation revoked = await world.Tokens.ValidateAsync(login.Token, NowMs, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(revoked.Code, Is.EqualTo(204));

    /// <summary>204 和 106 都没有快照。</summary>
    /// <param name="response">重连响应。</param>
    /// <param name="code">期待的业务码。</param>
    static void AssertRejected(ReconnectResp response, int code)
    {
        Assert.That(response.Code, Is.EqualTo(code));
        Assert.That(response.Data, Is.Null);
        Assert.That(response.ServerTime, Is.EqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>核对两份登录或重连快照的基础列一致。</summary>
    static void AssertSame(PlayerFullData expected, PlayerFullData actual)
    {
        Assert.That(actual, Is.Not.Null);
        Assert.That(actual.Info.PlayerId, Is.EqualTo(expected.Info.PlayerId));
        Assert.That(actual.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo(expected.Info.Nickname));
        Assert.That(actual.Info.Level, Is.EqualTo(expected.Info.Level));
        Assert.That(actual.Info.Exp, Is.EqualTo(expected.Info.Exp));
        Assert.That(actual.Info.Gold, Is.EqualTo(expected.Info.Gold));
        Assert.That(actual.Info.Gem, Is.EqualTo(expected.Info.Gem));
        Assert.That(actual.Info.Ticket, Is.EqualTo(expected.Info.Ticket));
        Assert.That(actual.Info.Shard, Is.EqualTo(expected.Info.Shard));
        Assert.That(actual.Info.BagSlots, Is.EqualTo(expected.Info.BagSlots));
        Assert.That(actual.Info.GuideStep, Is.EqualTo(expected.Info.GuideStep));
    }

    /// <summary>组装一份带集合字段的已保存快照。</summary>
    static PlayerFullData SavedData(long playerId, string nickname)
    {
        var data = new PlayerFullData
        {
            Info = new PlayerInfo
            {
                PlayerId = playerId,
                Nickname = nickname,
                Level = 4,
                Exp = 15,
                Gold = 90,
                Gem = 8,
                Ticket = 2,
                Shard = 6,
                BagSlots = 70,
                GuideStep = 9
            },
            OrderProgress = new OrderProgress { DayIndex = 4, DoneCount = 1, NextRefreshTime = 88 },
            Home = new HomeLayout { Version = 5 }
        };
        data.Bag.Add(new ItemStack { ItemId = 100, Count = 3 });
        data.Plots.Add(new PlotData { PlotId = 2, CropId = 9, PlantTime = 10 });
        return data;
    }

    /// <summary>核对重连响应保留保存时的基础列和集合。</summary>
    static void AssertSameSnapshot(PlayerFullData saved, PlayerFullData actual)
    {
        AssertSame(saved, actual);
        Assert.That(actual.Bag.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(actual.Bag[0].ItemId, Is.EqualTo(100));
        Assert.That(actual.Bag[0].Count, Is.EqualTo(3));
        Assert.That(actual.Plots.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(actual.Plots[0].PlotId, Is.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(actual.OrderProgress.DayIndex, Is.EqualTo(4));
        Assert.That(actual.Home.Version, Is.EqualTo(5));
    }

    /// <summary>重连和登出测试用的临时服务端。</summary>
    sealed class ReconnectWorld : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        readonly IsolatedDirectory _dir;
        readonly ConcurrentDictionary<long, ClientSession> _connections;
        readonly List<LiveSession> _lives = new();
        readonly List<PlayerQueue> _queues = new();
        readonly List<SessionRegistry> _registries = new();

        ReconnectWorld(
            IsolatedDirectory dir,
            SqliteStore store,
            ConcurrentDictionary<long, ClientSession> connections,
            List<string> logs,
            MutableClock clock)
        {
            _dir = dir;
            _connections = connections;
            Store = store;
            Logs = logs;
            Clock = clock;
        }

        public SqliteStore Store { get; }
        public PlayerQueue Queue { get; private set; } = null!;
        public PlayerCache Cache { get; private set; } = null!;
        public TokenService Tokens { get; private set; } = null!;
        public SessionRegistry Sessions { get; private set; } = null!;
        public SaveService Saves { get; private set; } = null!;
        public AccountHandler Handler { get; private set; } = null!;
        public MessageRouter Router { get; private set; } = null!;
        public MutableClock Clock { get; }
        public List<string> Logs { get; }

        /// <summary>创建隔离库，并接上带保存服务的正式处理器。</summary>
        public static Task<ReconnectWorld> OpenAsync()
        {
            var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
            var store = new SqliteStore();
            store.Initialize(Path.Combine(dir.FullPath, "game.db"));
            var logs = new List<string>();
            var connections = new ConcurrentDictionary<long, ClientSession>();
            var world = new ReconnectWorld(dir, store, connections, logs, new MutableClock { Now = NowMs });
            world.Install(new PlayerQueue(), new PlayerCache(new PlayerStore(store)));
            return Task.FromResult(world);
        }

        /// <summary>换一套新的队列、缓存、注册表和处理器。数据库和令牌行保持不变。</summary>
        public void ReplaceWithFreshCache()
        {
            Install(new PlayerQueue(), new PlayerCache(new PlayerStore(Store)));
        }

        /// <summary>把当前对外入口换成这套新对象。旧队列和注册表留到用例结束再释放。</summary>
        /// <param name="queue">新的玩家队列。</param>
        /// <param name="cache">新的玩家缓存。</param>
        void Install(PlayerQueue queue, PlayerCache cache)
        {
            var sessions = new SessionRegistry(queue, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8), Logs.Add);
            var tokens = new TokenService(Store);
            var saves = new SaveService(queue, cache, new PlayerStore(Store));
            var options = new LoginSessionOptions(1, 100, 100, null, "0.1.0", () => Clock.Now);
            Func<RequestContext, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> send = (context, packet, token) =>
            {
                if (!_connections.TryGetValue(context.SessionId, out ClientSession? target))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("会话不存在或已开始关闭");
                return target.SendAsync(packet, token);
            };
            var router = new MessageRouter(send, (context, reason, token) => Task.CompletedTask, new FixedClock(), Logs.Add);
            var handler = new AccountHandler(
                new AccountRepository(Store, new PasswordHasher()),
                queue,
                cache,
                tokens,
                sessions,
                sessionId => _connections.TryGetValue(sessionId, out ClientSession? found) ? found : null,
                options,
                saves,
                send);
            handler.RegisterRoutes(router);
            _queues.Add(queue);
            _registries.Add(sessions);
            Queue = queue;
            Cache = cache;
            Tokens = tokens;
            Sessions = sessions;
            Saves = saves;
            Handler = handler;
            Router = router;
        }

        /// <summary>启动一条受控会话并放进解析表。</summary>
        public async Task<LiveSession> AddSessionAsync(long sessionId)
        {
            var transport = new RecordingTransport();
            var stream = new GateStream();
            ClientSession session = ClientSession.CreateForTransport(sessionId, stream, transport, 8, null);
            Task run = session.RunAsync(CancellationToken.None);
            await Task.Yield();
            var live = new LiveSession(session, stream, run, transport.Snapshot);
            _connections[sessionId] = session;
            _lives.Add(live);
            return live;
        }

        /// <summary>经路由注册。</summary>
        public async Task RegisterAsync(LiveSession session, string username, string password, string nickname, uint seq)
        {
            await DispatchAsync(session, new RegisterReq
            {
                Username = username,
                Password = password,
                Nickname = nickname,
                ProtoVersion = 1,
                DeviceId = "device-1"
            }, seq);
            Packet frame = Frames(session).Last();
            Assert.That(frame.MsgId, Is.EqualTo((ushort)1004));
            Assert.That(RegisterResp.Parser.ParseFrom(frame.Body).Code, Is.EqualTo(0));
        }

        /// <summary>经路由登录并读取响应。</summary>
        public async Task<LoginResp> LoginAsync(LiveSession session, string username, string password, uint seq)
        {
            await DispatchAsync(session, new LoginReq
            {
                Username = username,
                Password = password,
                AppVersion = "0.1.0",
                ResVersion = 100,
                ProtoVersion = 1,
                ConfigVersion = 100,
                DeviceId = "device-1"
            }, seq);
            Packet frame = Frames(session).Single(item => item.MsgId == MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(LoginResp)) && item.Seq == seq);
            return LoginResp.Parser.ParseFrom(frame.Body);
        }

        /// <summary>经路由重连并读取响应。</summary>
        public async Task<ReconnectResp> ReconnectAsync(LiveSession session, string token, uint seq, int protoVersion = 1)
        {
            await DispatchReconnectAsync(session, token, seq, protoVersion);
            return ReadReconnect(session, seq);
        }

        /// <summary>只分发重连。</summary>
        public Task DispatchReconnectAsync(LiveSession session, string token, uint seq, int protoVersion = 1, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            return DispatchAsync(session, new ReconnectReq { Token = token, ProtoVersion = protoVersion }, seq, ct);
        }

        /// <summary>读取指定序号的重连响应。</summary>
        public ReconnectResp ReadReconnect(LiveSession session, uint seq)
        {
            Packet frame = Frames(session).Single(item => item.MsgId == MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(ReconnectResp)) && item.Seq == seq);
            Assert.That(frame.MsgId, Is.EqualTo((ushort)1008));
            return ReconnectResp.Parser.ParseFrom(frame.Body);
        }

        /// <summary>经路由登出。</summary>
        public Task LogoutAsync(LiveSession session, uint seq)
        {
            return DispatchLogoutAsync(session, seq);
        }

        /// <summary>只分发登出。</summary>
        public Task DispatchLogoutAsync(LiveSession session, uint seq, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            return DispatchAsync(session, new LogoutReq(), seq, ct);
        }

        /// <summary>用当前注册表构造上下文后分发。</summary>
        public Task DispatchAsync(LiveSession session, IMessage message, uint seq, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            ushort msgId = MsgRegistry.GetId(message.GetType());
            RequestContext context = Sessions.CreateRequestContext(session.Session, msgId, seq);
            return Router.DispatchAsync(context, new Packet(msgId, seq, message.ToByteArray()), ct);
        }

        /// <summary>在玩家队列里修改缓存昵称。</summary>
        public Task MutateNicknameAsync(long playerId, string nickname)
        {
            return Queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, _ =>
            {
                Cache.ReplaceNickname(playerId, nickname);
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }, CancellationToken.None);
        }

        /// <summary>在玩家队列里复制当前脏状态。</summary>
        public async Task<DirtyCopy> CopyDirtyAsync(long playerId)
        {
            bool dirty = false;
            string nickname = "";
            await Queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, _ =>
            {
                dirty = Cache.TryCopyDirty(playerId, out PlayerState? snapshot);
                nickname = snapshot?.Data.Info.Nickname ?? "";
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }, CancellationToken.None);
            return new DirtyCopy(dirty, nickname);
        }

        /// <summary>拆开这条会话已经写出的帧。</summary>
        public List<Packet> Frames(LiveSession session)
        {
            var frames = new List<Packet>();
            byte[] bytes = session.Snapshot();
            while (bytes.Length > 0)
            {
                DecodeStatus status = FrameCodec.TryDecode(bytes, out Packet packet, out int consumed);
                Assert.That(status, Is.EqualTo(DecodeStatus.Success));
                frames.Add(packet);
                bytes = bytes.AsSpan(consumed).ToArray();
            }

            return frames;
        }

        /// <summary>未撤销的令牌行数。</summary>
        public int ActiveTokenCount()
        {
            return (int)ScalarLong("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_token WHERE revoked = 0;");
        }

        /// <summary>读取一个整数。</summary>
        public long ScalarLong(string sql)
        {
            using SqliteConnection connection = Open();
            using SqliteCommand command = connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = sql;
            return Convert.ToInt64(command.ExecuteScalar(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        /// <summary>读取一个字符串。</summary>
        public string ScalarString(string sql, long id)
        {
            using SqliteConnection connection = Open();
            using SqliteCommand command = connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = sql;
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$id", id);
            return (string)command.ExecuteScalar()!;
        }

        /// <summary>在队列外执行一段管理语句。</summary>
        public void Execute(string sql)
        {
            using SqliteConnection connection = Open();
            using SqliteCommand command = connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = sql;
            command.ExecuteNonQuery();
        }

        /// <summary>另开连接，避免和队列连接混用事务。</summary>
        SqliteConnection Open()
        {
            var builder = new SqliteConnectionStringBuilder
            {
                DataSource = Path.Combine(_dir.FullPath, "game.db"),
                Mode = SqliteOpenMode.ReadWriteCreate,
                Pooling = false
            };
            var connection = new SqliteConnection(builder.ConnectionString);
            connection.Open();
            using var pragma = connection.CreateCommand();
            pragma.CommandText = "PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;";
            pragma.ExecuteNonQuery();
            return connection;
        }

        /// <summary>结束会话、注册表、队列和库，并删除临时目录。</summary>
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            foreach (LiveSession live in _lives)
                await live.DisposeAsync();
            foreach (SessionRegistry registry in _registries)
            {
                try
                {
                    await registry.WhenIdleAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
                }
                catch (TimeoutException)
                {
                }
            }

            foreach (PlayerQueue queue in _queues)
                queue.Dispose();
            Store.Dispose();
            _dir.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>队列内看到的脏昵称。</summary>
    /// <param name="Dirty">缓存版本尚未全部落库时为 true。</param>
    /// <param name="Nickname">脏副本里的昵称。不脏时为空串。</param>
    sealed record DirtyCopy(bool Dirty, string Nickname);

    /// <summary>测试可推进的 UTC 毫秒。</summary>
    sealed class MutableClock
    {
        /// <summary>下一次读取返回的 UTC Unix 毫秒。</summary>
        public long Now;
    }

    /// <summary>限流窗口用的固定时钟。</summary>
    sealed class FixedClock : IRouterClock
    {
        public long UnixMilliseconds => NowMs;
    }

    /// <summary>把写出的字节按顺序留下。</summary>
    sealed class RecordingTransport : IFrameTransport
    {
        readonly List<byte> _bytes = new();

        /// <summary>复制目前的全部字节。</summary>
        public byte[] Snapshot()
        {
            lock (_bytes)
                return _bytes.ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>整段收下并立刻完成。</summary>
        public ValueTask<int> WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            lock (_bytes)
            {
                ReadOnlySpan<byte> span = buffer.Span;
                for (int i = 0; i < span.Length; i++)
                    _bytes.Add(span[i]);
            }

            return ValueTask.FromResult(buffer.Length);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一条已经跑起来的测试会话。</summary>
    sealed class LiveSession : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        readonly Task _run;
        readonly Func<byte[]> _snapshot;

        public LiveSession(ClientSession session, GateStream stream, Task run, Func<byte[]> snapshot)
        {
            Session = session;
            _run = run;
            _snapshot = snapshot;
        }

        /// <summary>被绑定的服务端会话。</summary>
        public ClientSession Session { get; }

        /// <summary>复制这条会话已经记下的写出字节。</summary>
        public byte[] Snapshot() => _snapshot();

        /// <summary>结束读流并等待会话任务。</summary>
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                await Session.CloseAsync("测试结束", CancellationToken.None).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
            }

            try
            {
                await _run.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>读端一直等待，取消或释放之后返回。</summary>
    sealed class GateStream : Stream
    {
        readonly TaskCompletionSource _done = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        public override bool CanRead => true;
        public override bool CanSeek => false;
        public override bool CanWrite => false;
        public override long Length => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override long Position
        {
            get => throw new NotSupportedException();
            set => throw new NotSupportedException();
        }

        public override void Flush()
        {
        }

        public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override void SetLength(long value) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new NotSupportedException();

        /// <summary>等到结束或取消。取消继续抛出，结束返回 0。</summary>
        public override async ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            using var _ = cancellationToken.Register(() => _done.TrySetResult());
            await _done.Task.ConfigureAwait(false);
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            return 0;
        }

        /// <summary>释放时放开等待中的读。</summary>
        protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
        {
            _done.TrySetResult();
            base.Dispose(disposing);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>只删除系统临时目录里本测试创建的子目录。</summary>
    sealed class IsolatedDirectory : IDisposable
    {
        public IsolatedDirectory()
        {
            string root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "FarmingAccountReconnectTests");
            FullPath = Path.Combine(root, Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(FullPath);
        }

        /// <summary>本用例的绝对目录。</summary>
        public string FullPath { get; }

        /// <summary>目录仍在指定根下时才递归删除。</summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            string full = Path.GetFullPath(FullPath);
            string root = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "FarmingAccountReconnectTests"));
            string prefix = root.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
            if (!full.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("拒绝删除测试目录之外的路径");
            if (Directory.Exists(full))
                Directory.Delete(full, true);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using CloudIsle.Server.Data;
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>SaveService 的 5 秒周期、失败重试、登出刷新和停止。</summary>
public sealed class SaveServiceTests
{
    /// <summary>5 秒前不写库；虚拟时间到达 5 秒时只保存一轮最新昵称。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task BeforeFiveSeconds_DoesNotSave_AndDueCycleSavesOnce()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann");
        var players = new PlayerStore(store);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(players);
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var clock = new ManualSaveClock();
        using var service = new SaveService(queue, cache, players, clock);

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Due");
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        service.Start();
        Task cycle = service.WaitNextCycleAsync();
        clock.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(4999));
        Assert.That(service.CycleCount, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(ReadNickname(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo("Ann"));

        clock.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1));
        await cycle;

        Assert.That(service.CycleCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(ReadNickname(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo("Due"));
        Assert.That(ReadSavedRevision(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>一个间隔内多次改昵称，只落最新的一份快照。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task RepeatedEdits_SaveLatestSnapshotOnce()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann");
        var players = new PlayerStore(store);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(players);
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var clock = new ManualSaveClock();
        using var service = new SaveService(queue, cache, players, clock);

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "One");
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Two");
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Three");
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        service.Start();
        Task cycle = service.WaitNextCycleAsync();
        clock.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(SaveService.IntervalMilliseconds));
        await cycle;

        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(service.CycleCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(ReadNickname(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo("Three"));
        Assert.That(ReadSavedRevision(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo(3));
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            PlayerState state = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            Assert.That(state.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Three"));
            Assert.That(state.Dirty, Is.False);
            Assert.That(state.SavedRevision, Is.EqualTo(3));
        }, CancellationToken.None);
    }

    /// <summary>第一次周期失败后 Dirty 和 SavedRevision 保持原样；去掉故障后下一轮才确认。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Failure_KeepsDirty_RetryUpdatesSavedRevision()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann");
        var players = new PlayerStore(store);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(players);
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var clock = new ManualSaveClock();
        using var service = new SaveService(queue, cache, players, clock);

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Kept");
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        using (var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir)))
        {
            Execute(connection, """
                CREATE TRIGGER player_snapshot_fail BEFORE INSERT ON player_snapshot
                BEGIN
                  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'snapshot-fail');
                END;
                """);
        }

        service.Start();
        Task failed = service.WaitNextCycleAsync();
        clock.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(SaveService.IntervalMilliseconds));
        await failed;

        Assert.That(service.FailedSaveCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(service.LastFailure, Is.InstanceOf<SqliteException>());
        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(ReadNickname(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo("Ann"));
        Assert.That(CountSnapshots(dir), Is.Zero);
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            PlayerState dirty = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            Assert.That(dirty.Dirty, Is.True);
            Assert.That(dirty.SavedRevision, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(dirty.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Kept"));
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        using (var connection = Open(DatabasePath(dir)))
            Execute(connection, "DROP TRIGGER player_snapshot_fail;");

        Task retried = service.WaitNextCycleAsync();
        clock.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(SaveService.IntervalMilliseconds));
        await retried;

        Assert.That(service.CycleCount, Is.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(service.FailedSaveCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(ReadNickname(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo("Kept"));
        Assert.That(ReadSavedRevision(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo(1));
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            PlayerState clean = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            Assert.That(clean.Dirty, Is.False);
            Assert.That(clean.SavedRevision, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }, CancellationToken.None);
    }

    /// <summary>写入前又修改时，先确认的旧版本不能把新昵称标成已保存。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ConcurrentFlushAndEdit_DoesNotDropNewRevision()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann");
        var players = new PlayerStore(store);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(players);
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var clock = new ManualSaveClock();
        using var service = new SaveService(queue, cache, players, clock);

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Mid");
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        service.BeforePersistAsync = (_, _) => queue.EnqueueAsync(11, _ =>
        {
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "New");
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        await service.FlushPlayerAsync(11, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(ReadNickname(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo("Mid"));
        Assert.That(ReadSavedRevision(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo(1));
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            PlayerState newer = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            Assert.That(newer.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("New"));
            Assert.That(newer.Revision, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(newer.SavedRevision, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(newer.Dirty, Is.True);
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        service.BeforePersistAsync = null;
        await service.FlushPlayerAsync(11, CancellationToken.None);
        store.Dispose();
        using var reopened = new SqliteStore();
        reopened.Initialize(DatabasePath(dir));
        PlayerState loaded = await new PlayerStore(reopened).LoadAsync(11, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(loaded.Data.Info.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("New"));
        Assert.That(loaded.SavedRevision, Is.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(loaded.Dirty, Is.False);
    }

    [Test]
    public async Task StopAndCancel_DoesNotStartAnotherCycleOrLeaveWork()
    {

        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Held");
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        var entered = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        service.BeforePersistAsync = async (_, ct) =>
        {
            entered.TrySetResult();
            await release.Task;
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                throw new OperationCanceledException(ct);
        };

        service.Start();
        clock.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(SaveService.IntervalMilliseconds));

        Task stopping = service.StopAsync();
        release.TrySetResult();

        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(ReadNickname(dir, 11), Is.EqualTo("Ann"));
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            PlayerState dirty = await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            Assert.That(dirty.Dirty, Is.True);
            Assert.That(dirty.SavedRevision, Is.Zero);
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await queue.WaitForIdleAsync(11);
        Assert.That(queue.ActiveLaneCount, Is.Zero);

        clock.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(SaveService.IntervalMilliseconds * 3));
        Assert.That(service.CycleCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.Zero);

        var canceled = new CancellationTokenSource();
        canceled.Cancel();
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<TaskCanceledException>(async () =>
            await service.FlushPlayerAsync(11, canceled.Token));
        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.Zero);
        await queue.WaitForIdleAsync(11);
        Assert.That(queue.ActiveLaneCount, Is.Zero);
    }

    /// <summary>关闭标记先于等待生效。之后的 Start 和刷新都不能再开工作，已有周期也不再增加。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Close_RejectsNewLoopAndFlush()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann");
        var players = new PlayerStore(store);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(players);
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var clock = new ManualSaveClock();
        await using var service = new SaveService(queue, cache, players, clock);
        var entered = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var releaseLoop = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        service.BeforePersistAsync = async (_, token) =>
        {
            entered.TrySetResult();
            var canceled = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            using CancellationTokenRegistration registration = token.Register(() => canceled.TrySetResult());
            if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
                canceled.TrySetResult();
            await canceled.Task.ConfigureAwait(false);
            // 取消会同步结束本次保存。先留在钩子里，断言才能看到关闭尚未把循环清掉。
            await releaseLoop.Task.ConfigureAwait(false);
        };

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Due");
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        service.Start();
        await WaitUntilAsync(() => service.ActiveLoopCount == 1);
        clock.Advance(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(SaveService.IntervalMilliseconds));
        await entered.Task;

        Task closing = service.DisposeAsync().AsTask();
        Assert.Throws<ObjectDisposedException>(() => service.Start());
        Assert.Throws<ObjectDisposedException>(() => service.FlushPlayerAsync(11, CancellationToken.None));
        Assert.That(service.ActiveLoopCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        releaseLoop.TrySetResult();
        await closing;

        clock.Advance(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15));
        Assert.That(service.CycleCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(service.ActiveLoopCount, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(cache.CopyHoldCount(11), Is.Zero);
    }

    /// <summary>确认入队因容量失败时保留 Dirty 并释放持有。队列空出来后重试可以确认并移除。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ConfirmEnqueueFull_KeepsDirty_RetryThenRemove()
    {
        using var dir = new IsolatedDirectory();
        using var store = OpenStore(dir);
        Seed(dir, 11, 1, "Ann");
        var players = new PlayerStore(store);
        var cache = new PlayerCache(players);
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue(1);
        var clock = new ManualSaveClock();
        using var service = new SaveService(queue, cache, players, clock);
        var entered = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        service.BeforePersistAsync = (_, _) =>
        {
            entered.TrySetResult();
            return release.Task;
        };

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async ct =>
        {
            await cache.GetAsync(11, ct);
            cache.ReplaceNickname(11, "Held");
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        Task saving = service.FlushPlayerAsync(11, CancellationToken.None);
        await entered.Task;
        var blockerEntered = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var blockerRelease = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        Task blocker = queue.EnqueueAsync(11, async _ =>
        {
            blockerEntered.TrySetResult();
            await blockerRelease.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await blockerEntered.Task;
        release.TrySetResult();

        Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () => await saving);
        Assert.That(saving.IsCompleted, Is.True);
        Assert.That(cache.CopyHoldCount(11), Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(cache.CopyDirtyPlayerIds(), Is.EqualTo(new[] { 11L }));
        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.Zero);

        blockerRelease.TrySetResult();
        await blocker;
        service.BeforePersistAsync = null;
        await service.FlushPlayerAsync(11, CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.That(service.ConfirmedSaveCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(cache.CopyHoldCount(11), Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(cache.CopyDirtyPlayerIds(), Is.Empty);
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(11, _ =>
        {
            cache.Remove(11);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(cache.Count, Is.Zero);
        Assert.That(cache.CopyHoldCount(11), Is.Zero);
    }
```
