```csharp
using System.Text;
using CloudIsle.Net;
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>
/// 幂等窗口的单次执行、冲突、隔离、副本、FIFO 上限、失败重试和队列上下文。
/// 操作类型 49001 只存在于本夹具，不写入生产 MsgRegistry，也不是新的玩法消息。
/// </summary>
public sealed class IdempotencyTests
{
    /// <summary>夹具使用的操作类型。只参与摘要和封帧，不注册为生产消息。</summary>
    const ushort FixtureOperation = 49001;

    /// <summary>
    /// 同一玩家的两次相同提交都先入队，再放开队列。业务只跑一次，两帧正文相同但 seq 各自使用本次请求值。
    /// </summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task DuplicateOp_ConcurrentSameHash_ExecutesOnceAndResealsNewSeq()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var store = new IdempotencyStore();
        var probe = new WriteProbe();
        byte[] payload = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("nickname=Ann");
        string hash = IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(FixtureOperation, payload);
        Array.Clear(payload);

        Task hold = queue.EnqueueAsync(7, async token =>
        {
            probe.HoldEntered.TrySetResult();
            await probe.ReleaseHold.Task;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await probe.HoldEntered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        Task<IdempotentReply> first = store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 7, 3, hash, token => Task.FromResult(probe.Apply("Ann")), CancellationToken.None);
        Task<IdempotentReply> second = store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 7, 3, hash, token => Task.FromResult(probe.Apply("Ann")), CancellationToken.None);
        probe.ReleaseHold.TrySetResult();

        IdempotentReply[] replies = await Task.WhenAll(first, second).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        await hold.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        Assert.That(probe.Writes, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(probe.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Ann"));
        Assert.That(replies[0].CacheHit, Is.False);
        Assert.That(replies[1].CacheHit, Is.True);
        Assert.That(store.CountFor(7), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(replies[0].ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")));
        Assert.That(replies[1].ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(replies[0].ResponseBody));

        Packet older = Reseal(FixtureOperation, 11, replies[0].ResponseBody);
        Packet newer = Reseal(FixtureOperation, 22, replies[1].ResponseBody);
        Assert.That(older.Seq, Is.EqualTo(11));
        Assert.That(newer.Seq, Is.EqualTo(22));
        Assert.That(older.Body, Is.EqualTo(newer.Body));
        Assert.That(older.Body, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")));
        Assert.That(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(store.ConcatenateStoredMaterial(7)), Does.Not.Contain("nickname="));
    }

    /// <summary>同一 opId 换载荷后拒绝执行，原来的昵称和正文都还在。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task ConflictingPayload_IsRejectedAndKeepsOriginal()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var store = new IdempotencyStore();
        var probe = new WriteProbe();
        string original = IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(FixtureOperation, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("nickname=Ann"));
        string other = IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(FixtureOperation, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("nickname=Bea"));

        IdempotentReply saved = await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 4, 8, original, token => Task.FromResult(probe.Apply("Ann")), CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<IdempotencyConflictException>(async () => await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 4, 8, other, token => Task.FromResult(probe.Apply("Bea")), CancellationToken.None));

        IdempotentReply replay = await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 4, 8, original, token => Task.FromResult(probe.Apply("Ann")), CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(probe.Writes, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(probe.Nickname, Is.EqualTo("Ann"));
        Assert.That(saved.CacheHit, Is.False);
        Assert.That(replay.CacheHit, Is.True);
        Assert.That(replay.ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")));
        Assert.That(store.CountFor(4), Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>不同玩家使用同一个 opId 时各自保留自己的结果。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task DifferentPlayers_SameOp_AreIndependent()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var store = new IdempotencyStore();
        var first = new WriteProbe();
        var second = new WriteProbe();
        string ann = IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(FixtureOperation, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("nickname=Ann"));
        string bea = IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(FixtureOperation, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("nickname=Bea"));

        IdempotentReply left = await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 11, 4, ann, token => Task.FromResult(first.Apply("Ann")), CancellationToken.None);
        IdempotentReply right = await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 12, 4, bea, token => Task.FromResult(second.Apply("Bea")), CancellationToken.None);
        IdempotentReply leftAgain = await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 11, 4, ann, token => Task.FromResult(first.Apply("Ann")), CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.That(first.Writes, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(second.Writes, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(left.ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")));
        Assert.That(right.ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Bea")));
        Assert.That(leftAgain.CacheHit, Is.True);
        Assert.That(leftAgain.ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(left.ResponseBody));
        Assert.That(store.CountFor(11), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(store.CountFor(12), Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>保存后修改输入，取出后修改输出，缓存里的正文仍是最初那一份。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task SavedAndLoadedBody_MutationsDoNotPolluteCache()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var store = new IdempotencyStore();
        byte[] input = { 9, 8, 7, 6 };
        byte[] expected = { 9, 8, 7, 6 };

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(3, token =>
        {
            store.Save(3, 4, "HASH-COPY", input);
            input[0] = 1;
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(3, 4, "HASH-COPY", out byte[] loaded), Is.True);
            Assert.That(loaded, Is.EqualTo(expected));
            Assert.That(loaded, Is.Not.SameAs(input));
            loaded[0] = 2;
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(3, 4, "HASH-COPY", out byte[] again), Is.True);
            Assert.That(again, Is.EqualTo(expected));
            Assert.That(again, Is.Not.SameAs(loaded));
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        IdempotentReply reply = await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 3, 4, "HASH-COPY", token => Task.FromResult(new byte[] { 0 }), CancellationToken.None);
        reply.ResponseBody[0] = 5;
        IdempotentReply replay = await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 3, 4, "HASH-COPY", token => Task.FromResult(new byte[] { 0 }), CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(reply.CacheHit, Is.True);
        Assert.That(replay.CacheHit, Is.True);
        Assert.That(replay.ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(expected));
        Assert.That(store.CountFor(3), Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 64 条之后再写入一条新操作，淘汰最早的一条。中途重复命中和相同内容的再次 Save 都不改变队头。
    /// </summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Capacity64_EvictsOldestAndReplayDoesNotRefreshOrder()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var store = new IdempotencyStore();
        var bodies = new Dictionary<long, byte[]>();
        for (long opId = 1; opId <= IdempotencyStore.Capacity; opId++)
            bodies[opId] = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("n" + opId);

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(5, token =>
        {
            for (long opId = 1; opId <= IdempotencyStore.Capacity; opId++)
                store.Save(5, opId, "H" + opId, bodies[opId]);

            Assert.That(store.RetentionOrder(5)[0], Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(5, 1, "H1", out _), Is.True);
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(5, 1, "H1", out _), Is.True);
            Assert.That(store.RetentionOrder(5)[0], Is.EqualTo(1));

            byte[] sixtyFive = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("n65");
            store.Save(5, 65, "H65", sixtyFive);
            long[] afterSixtyFive = store.RetentionOrder(5);
            Assert.That(store.CountFor(5), Is.EqualTo(IdempotencyStore.Capacity));
            Assert.That(afterSixtyFive[0], Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(afterSixtyFive[^1], Is.EqualTo(65));
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(5, 1, "H1", out _), Is.False);
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(5, 2, "H2", out byte[] stillTwo), Is.True);
            Assert.That(stillTwo, Is.EqualTo(bodies[2]));
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(5, 65, "H65", out byte[] newest), Is.True);
            Assert.That(newest, Is.EqualTo(sixtyFive));

            store.Save(5, 2, "H2", bodies[2]);
            Assert.That(store.RetentionOrder(5)[0], Is.EqualTo(2));
            store.Save(5, 66, "H66", Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("n66"));
            Assert.That(store.CountFor(5), Is.EqualTo(IdempotencyStore.Capacity));
            Assert.That(store.RetentionOrder(5)[0], Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(5, 2, "H2", out _), Is.False);
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(5, 3, "H3", out _), Is.True);
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(5, 66, "H66", out _), Is.True);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
    }

    /// <summary>失败不留下成功缓存。同一摘要再次提交会真正执行，其后的重复提交才命中。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task FailedAction_LeavesNoSuccessCache_AndRetryExecutes()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var store = new IdempotencyStore();
        var probe = new WriteProbe();
        string hash = IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(FixtureOperation, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("nickname=Ann"));
        bool fail = true;

        InvalidOperationException? error = Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
            await store.ExecuteAsync(queue, 6, 2, hash, token =>
            {
                probe.Apply("Ann");
                if (fail)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("fixture-write-failed");
                return Task.FromResult(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(probe.Nickname));
            }, CancellationToken.None));

        Assert.That(error!.Message, Is.EqualTo("fixture-write-failed"));
        Assert.That(probe.Writes, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(store.CountFor(6), Is.EqualTo(0));
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(6, token =>
        {
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(6, 2, hash, out _), Is.False);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        fail = false;
        IdempotentReply retried = await store.ExecuteAsync(queue, 6, 2, hash, token =>
        {
            probe.Apply("Ann");
            return Task.FromResult(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann"));
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        IdempotentReply replay = await store.ExecuteAsync(queue, 6, 2, hash, token =>
        {
            probe.Apply("Ann");
            return Task.FromResult(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann"));
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.That(probe.Writes, Is.EqualTo(2));
        Assert.That(retried.CacheHit, Is.False);
        Assert.That(replay.CacheHit, Is.True);
        Assert.That(replay.ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")));
        Assert.That(store.CountFor(6), Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>显式清理后该玩家计数为 0，另一名玩家的窗口还在。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task RemovePlayer_ClearsWindowCount()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var store = new IdempotencyStore();
        await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 1, 1, "KEEP-A", token => Task.FromResult(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")), CancellationToken.None);
        await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 2, 1, "KEEP-B", token => Task.FromResult(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Bea")), CancellationToken.None);

        store.RemovePlayer(1);
        store.RemovePlayer(1);
        Assert.That(store.CountFor(1), Is.EqualTo(0));
        Assert.That(store.CountFor(2), Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(store.PlayerWindowCount, Is.EqualTo(1));

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(1, token =>
        {
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(1, 1, "KEEP-A", out _), Is.False);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        IdempotentReply remaining = await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 2, 1, "KEEP-B", token => Task.FromResult(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("other")), CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.That(remaining.CacheHit, Is.True);
        Assert.That(remaining.ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Bea")));
    }

    /// <summary>队列外、别的玩家动作里，以及非法编号，都不能读写窗口。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task OutsideQueueOrWrongPlayer_IsRejected()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var store = new IdempotencyStore();
        byte[] body = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann");

        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => store.TryGet(1, 1, "HASH", out _));
        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => store.Save(1, 1, "HASH", body));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => store.RemovePlayer(0));
        Assert.That(store.CountFor(1), Is.EqualTo(0));

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(1, token =>
        {
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => store.TryGet(2, 1, "HASH", out _));
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => store.Save(2, 1, "HASH", body));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => store.TryGet(0, 1, "HASH", out _));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => store.TryGet(1, 0, "HASH", out _));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => store.TryGet(-5, 1, "HASH", out _));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => store.Save(1, -1, "HASH", body));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => store.TryGet(1, 1, null!, out _));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => store.Save(1, 1, "   ", body));
            Assert.That(store.CountFor(1), Is.EqualTo(0));
            Assert.That(store.CountFor(2), Is.EqualTo(0));
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
    }

    /// <summary>一名玩家停在屏障上时，另一名玩家的相同操作号仍能完成。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task DifferentPlayers_DoNotBlockEachOther()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var store = new IdempotencyStore();
        var blocked = new WriteProbe();
        var free = new WriteProbe();
        string hash = IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(FixtureOperation, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("nickname=Ann"));

        Task<IdempotentReply> waiting = store.ExecuteAsync(queue, 21, 5, hash, async token =>
        {
            blocked.HoldEntered.TrySetResult();
            await blocked.ReleaseHold.Task;
            return blocked.Apply("Ann");
        }, CancellationToken.None);
        await blocked.HoldEntered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        IdempotentReply finished = await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 22, 5, hash, token => Task.FromResult(free.Apply("Bea")), CancellationToken.None)
            .WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(waiting.IsCompleted, Is.False);
        Assert.That(finished.CacheHit, Is.False);
        Assert.That(free.Writes, Is.EqualTo(1));
        Assert.That(blocked.Writes, Is.EqualTo(0));

        blocked.ReleaseHold.TrySetResult();
        IdempotentReply released = await waiting.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        Assert.That(released.ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")));
        Assert.That(finished.ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Bea")));
        Assert.That(blocked.Writes, Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 相同业务载荷配不同 seq 时正文一致，摘要却不读取 seq。
    /// 操作类型、载荷或摘要大小写变化后都不再等于原摘要。原始秘密载荷不出现在窗口材料里。
    /// </summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task RequestHash_UsesOperationAndPayloadNotSeq()
    {
        byte[] payload = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("password=secret-value");
        string hash = IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(FixtureOperation, payload);
        string again = IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(FixtureOperation, payload);
        string otherType = IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(49002, payload);
        string otherPayload = IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(
            FixtureOperation, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("password=other-value"));
        string lowered = hash.ToLowerInvariant();

        Packet first = Reseal(FixtureOperation, 5, payload);
        Packet second = Reseal(FixtureOperation, 9, payload);
        Assert.That(hash, Is.EqualTo(again));
        Assert.That(hash, Is.Not.EqualTo(otherType));
        Assert.That(hash, Is.Not.EqualTo(otherPayload));
        Assert.That(string.Equals(hash, lowered, StringComparison.Ordinal), Is.False);
        Assert.That(first.Body, Is.EqualTo(second.Body));
        Assert.That(first.Seq, Is.EqualTo(5));
        Assert.That(second.Seq, Is.EqualTo(9));
        Assert.That(IdempotencyStore.ComputeRequestHash(FixtureOperation, first.Body), Is.EqualTo(hash));

        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var store = new IdempotencyStore();
        Array.Clear(payload);
        IdempotentReply saved = await store.ExecuteAsync(
            queue, 9, 1, hash, token => Task.FromResult(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")), CancellationToken.None);
        await queue.EnqueueAsync(9, token =>
        {
            Assert.Throws<IdempotencyConflictException>(() => store.TryGet(9, 1, lowered, out _));
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(9, 1, hash, out byte[] body), Is.True);
            Assert.That(body, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")));
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);

        string material = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(store.ConcatenateStoredMaterial(9));
        Assert.That(material, Does.Not.Contain("secret-value"));
        Assert.That(material, Does.Not.Contain("password="));
        Assert.That(saved.ResponseBody, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")));
        Packet resealed = Reseal(FixtureOperation, 41, saved.ResponseBody);
        Assert.That(resealed.Seq, Is.EqualTo(41));
        Assert.That(resealed.Body, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")));
    }

    /// <summary>同一操作再次保存相同正文不会替换；另一份正文或另一摘要都会拒绝。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task DuplicateSave_DoesNotReplaceStoredResult()
    {
        using var queue = new PlayerQueue();
        var store = new IdempotencyStore();
        byte[] first = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann");
        byte[] second = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Bea");

        await queue.EnqueueAsync(8, token =>
        {
            store.Save(8, 15, "SAME", first);
            store.Save(8, 15, "SAME", Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann"));
            Assert.Throws<IdempotencyConflictException>(() => store.Save(8, 15, "SAME", second));
            Assert.Throws<IdempotencyConflictException>(() => store.Save(8, 15, "OTHER", first));
            Assert.That(store.TryGet(8, 15, "SAME", out byte[] loaded), Is.True);
            Assert.That(loaded, Is.EqualTo(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Ann")));
            Assert.That(store.CountFor(8), Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(store.RetentionOrder(8), Is.EqualTo(new[] { 15L }));
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, CancellationToken.None);
    }

    /// <summary>用本次 seq 把业务正文封成一帧再解出来。</summary>
    /// <param name="operationType">帧里的消息编号。夹具固定用 49001，不登记到生产注册表。</param>
    /// <param name="seq">这一次请求的序号。重放时传入新值，而不是缓存里的旧值。</param>
    /// <param name="body">业务正文。方法会把它放进新帧。</param>
    /// <returns>解出来的包。调用方再核对 seq 和正文。</returns>
    static Packet Reseal(ushort operationType, uint seq, byte[] body)
    {
        byte[] frame = FrameCodec.Encode(operationType, seq, body);
        DecodeStatus status = FrameCodec.TryDecode(frame, out Packet packet, out int consumed);
        Assert.That(status, Is.EqualTo(DecodeStatus.Success));
        Assert.That(consumed, Is.EqualTo(frame.Length));
        return packet;
    }

    /// <summary>夹具里的可观察写入。昵称和次数用来确认业务有没有真的执行。</summary>
    sealed class WriteProbe
    {
        /// <summary>创建屏障。续体异步执行，避免在释放方里面接着跑后半段。</summary>
        public WriteProbe()
        {
            HoldEntered = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            ReleaseHold = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        }

        /// <summary>业务动作已经进入、并停在屏障前时完成。</summary>
        public TaskCompletionSource HoldEntered { get; }

        /// <summary>测试放行被挡住的业务动作。</summary>
        public TaskCompletionSource ReleaseHold { get; }

        /// <summary>成功进入业务函数的次数。缓存命中不会增加。</summary>
        public int Writes { get; private set; }

        /// <summary>最近一次业务函数写下的昵称。被拒绝的调用不会改它。</summary>
        public string Nickname { get; private set; } = "";

        /// <summary>记一次业务写入并返回昵称字节。调用方把返回值当作业务正文。</summary>
        /// <param name="nickname">这次要写成的昵称。会同时增加写入次数。</param>
        /// <returns>昵称的 UTF-8 字节，不含 seq。</returns>
        public byte[] Apply(string nickname)
        {
            Writes++;
            Nickname = nickname;
            return Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(nickname);
        }
    }
}
```

## T40 接入 LoggingSetup/MetricsReporter

- 来源：`06_M1_基础框架任务拆解.md` 第 3.1 / 4.5 / 5.4 节 T40，第 7.8 节日志与指标；依赖 T23、T12

### 任务、流程与验证

这一步给服务端接上真正的 Serilog，而不是再写一套文件日志。依赖固定为 Serilog 4.4.0、Serilog.Sinks.Console 6.1.1、Serilog.Sinks.File 7.0.0，只加这些包，不升级现有的 Sqlite 和 Pipelines。`LoggingSetup` 自己持有 logger，不写入静态 `Serilog.Log.Logger`，避免测试互相覆盖。`Configure` 失败时对象仍可再次配置。`Dispose` 关闭并刷出文件。

控制台和文件都先经过同一道脱敏，再进入 sink。脱敏覆盖属性名大小写（password / token）、消息模板里的 `password=`、`token:` 文本，以及异常消息。不把 `Exception.ToString()` 原样写出，只留异常类型和脱敏后的消息。不记录请求正文，也不声称能识别所有未知秘密。文件大小、保留份数和最低级别可配置，超出明确边界就拒绝。

请求日志是可套在真实 `MessageRouter.DispatchAsync` 上的装饰器。它用 `AsyncLocal` 带上这一次的 `LogContext`，成功、失败和并发都量自己的 ElapsedMs。指标默认间隔 10 秒。连接数来自 `TcpServer` 当前会话，已认证玩家数来自 `SessionRegistry` 当前绑定，不是玩家缓存条数。队列长度是 `PlayerQueue` 尚未结束的动作，包含正在执行的一项。请求率用累计进入分发的次数除以实际经过时间；经过时间为 0 时速率为 0。取消后不再输出。T60 再把这些入口装进正式 Host。本项不改 PoC 默认启动。

```csharp
void Configure(string logDirectory, string minimumLevel)
Task RunAsync(TimeSpan interval, CancellationToken ct)
```

### 遇到的问题和解决方案

| 问题场景 | 现象 | 原因 | 具体修复与复验 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 第一次编译 LoggingSetup | CS0103，找不到 LoggerSinkConfiguration | CreateSink 在 Serilog.Configuration，文件没有 using | 补上 using。复验：同一条 dotnet test 能编过服务端工程 |
| 测试工程第一次编译 | List 不能当 Action；ThrowsAsync 的返回值被当成异常去 await；Directory 属性挡住了 System.IO.Directory；HeartbeatReq 没有 ToByteArray | 把列表本身传给了写回调。本仓库 NUnit 3.14 的 ThrowsAsync 直接返回异常，不返回 Task。属性名 Directory 遮蔽了类型。缺 Google.Protobuf | 改为 lines.Add，不再 await ThrowsAsync，创建目录时写全 System.IO.Directory，补上 using。这些都是测试编译问题，没有改指标或脱敏规则 |
| 模板洞把口令拼进正文 | Secrets 测试里 `PASSWORD={Upper}` 渲染成 PASSWORD=UpperSecret。键名 Upper 不是 password，值本身也没有等号 | 第一版只改秘密键和模板里的纯文本，没有检查渲染之后的整句 | 渲染后再脱敏。渲染前后消失的、长度至少 4 的字符串值改成 ***。复验：Secrets 测试通过，两个 sink 都没有 UpperSecret 等原文 |
| 请求行正则和并发隔离断言 | 完成行是 `request ok 42`，不是 `request "ok"`。玩家 0 的成功行被算进两条并发请求。outside-marker 的时间戳 2026 含有 202 | Serilog 对不带空格的字符串不加引号。断言把所有 request ok 都当成那两个并发请求，又把年份里的 202 当成玩家号 | 正则去掉引号。隔离只看玩家 101 和 202 的行。外部行改为检查没有 PlayerId。复验：FailureAndConcurrentRequests 与 Request_Writes 通过 |
| 接收器抛 IOException 时，Assert.Throws 对不上类型 | 第一次 AuditFailure 在 Logger.Error 失败，异常不是精确的 IOException。CapturingSink 用字典 ToString，看不到 ExceptionType | Serilog 4 的 Audit 管道不一定把接收器异常原样抛出。属性集合的 ToString 只是类型名 | 测试改为任何异常都可以，但 ToString 必须含 sink-failed，并逐个打印属性。生产路径仍不吞掉这次失败。复验：AuditFailure 通过，HadExceptionObject 为 false |
| 立即取消的 Create 去读 server.log | FileNotFoundException | 还没有任何事件时，滚动文件接收器不会先创建空文件 | 没有文件就当成没有指标行。复验：Create_StopsWithoutEmittingWhenCanceledImmediately 通过，文本里没有 connections= |

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using CloudIsle.Diagnostics;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Diagnostics;

/// <summary>
/// 一次请求在当前异步流上的关联字段。并发请求各有各的 AsyncLocal，结束后恢复外层。
/// </summary>
static class RequestAmbient
{
    static readonly AsyncLocal<AmbientRequest?> CurrentSlot = new();

    /// <summary>当前异步流上的请求。没有请求装饰器压栈时为空。</summary>
    public static AmbientRequest? Current => CurrentSlot.Value;

    /// <summary>当前异步流是否还停在某次请求装饰器里。测试用来确认没有泄漏。</summary>
    internal static bool HasCurrent => CurrentSlot.Value != null;

    /// <summary>压入这一次请求。Dispose 时恢复之前的值。</summary>
    /// <param name="request">这一次分发的关联字段。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <returns>恢复用的句柄。</returns>
    public static IDisposable Push(AmbientRequest request)
    {
        if (request == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(request));

        var previous = CurrentSlot.Value;
        CurrentSlot.Value = request;
        return new Pop(previous);
    }

    sealed class Pop : IDisposable
    {
        readonly AmbientRequest? _previous;
        int _disposed;

        /// <summary>记住外层请求。</summary>
        /// <param name="previous">压栈前的请求。没有外层时为空。</param>
        public Pop(AmbientRequest? previous) => _previous = previous;

        /// <summary>恢复外层请求。重复调用只恢复一次。</summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) != 0)
                return;
            CurrentSlot.Value = _previous;
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>一次分发的关联数字。耗时按开始时刻现算，不在并发请求之间共用。</summary>
sealed class AmbientRequest
{
    readonly long _startedAt;

    /// <summary>记下这次请求的五个关联值。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家编号。未认证为 0。</param>
    /// <param name="msgId">消息 ID。</param>
    /// <param name="seq">请求序号。</param>
    /// <param name="opId">幂等操作编号。没有操作时为 0。</param>
    /// <param name="startedAt">Stopwatch 时间戳，用来计算 ElapsedMs。</param>
    public AmbientRequest(long playerId, ushort msgId, uint seq, long opId, long startedAt)
    {
        PlayerId = playerId;
        MsgId = msgId;
        Seq = seq;
        OpId = opId;
        _startedAt = startedAt;
    }

    /// <summary>玩家编号。</summary>
    public long PlayerId { get; }

    /// <summary>消息 ID。</summary>
    public ushort MsgId { get; }

    /// <summary>请求序号。</summary>
    public uint Seq { get; }

    /// <summary>幂等操作编号。</summary>
    public long OpId { get; }

    /// <summary>从开始到现在的毫秒数。</summary>
    public double ElapsedMs => Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(_startedAt).TotalMilliseconds;

    /// <summary>收成共享层的日志上下文。只含这五个数字。</summary>
    public LogContext ToLogContext() => new LogContext(PlayerId, MsgId, Seq, OpId, ElapsedMs);
}
```

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Serilog.Core;
using Serilog.Events;
using Serilog.Parsing;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Diagnostics;

/// <summary>
/// 在事件进入控制台或文件之前改写它。password / token 属性、常见赋值文本和异常消息都会脱敏。
/// 不写出 Exception.ToString()。不识别属性名和这两种文本以外的秘密。
/// </summary>
sealed class RedactingSink : ILogEventSink, IDisposable
{
    static readonly Regex Assignment = new Regex(
        "(?i)\\b(password|token)\\b(\\s*[:=]\\s*)(?:\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'|\\S+)",
        RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    static readonly Regex JsonPair = new Regex(
        "(?i)\"(password|token)\"(\\s*:\\s*)\"(?:[^\"\\\\]|\\\\.)*\"",
        RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    readonly ILogEventSink _inner;

    /// <summary>包住真正的接收器。本对象 Dispose 时会释放它。</summary>
    /// <param name="inner">已经脱敏之后才调用的接收器。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public RedactingSink(ILogEventSink inner)
    {
        _inner = inner ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(inner));
    }

    /// <summary>脱敏后交给内层。内层抛出的异常原样冒泡，不在这里吞掉。</summary>
    /// <param name="logEvent">Serilog 原始事件。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public void Emit(LogEvent logEvent)
    {
        if (logEvent == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logEvent));

        _inner.Emit(Sanitize(logEvent));
    }

    /// <summary>释放内层接收器，让文件 sink 刷出并关闭。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        (_inner as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
    }

    /// <summary>复制一份去掉原始异常、并改写过属性和模板文本的事件。</summary>
    /// <param name="logEvent">原始事件。</param>
    LogEvent Sanitize(LogEvent logEvent)
    {
        var properties = new List<LogEventProperty>(logEvent.Properties.Count + 2);
        foreach (var pair in logEvent.Properties)
            properties.Add(new LogEventProperty(pair.Key, RedactValue(pair.Value, pair.Key, 0)));

        if (logEvent.Exception != null)
        {
            AddIfMissing(properties, "ExceptionType", new ScalarValue(Classify(logEvent.Exception)));
            AddIfMissing(properties, "ExceptionMessage", new ScalarValue(RedactText(Describe(logEvent.Exception))));
        }

        var tokens = new List<MessageTemplateToken>();
        foreach (var token in logEvent.MessageTemplate.Tokens)
        {
            if (token is TextToken text)
                tokens.Add(new TextToken(RedactText(text.Text)));
            else
                tokens.Add(token);
        }

        var candidate = new LogEvent(
            logEvent.Timestamp,
            logEvent.Level,
            exception: null,
            messageTemplate: new MessageTemplate(tokens),
            properties: properties);
        return ScrubRenderedSecrets(candidate);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 模板文本本身没有秘密、但和属性拼起来以后会出现 password= 或 token:。
    /// 这种值也要换成 ***，否则结构化属性或渲染结果仍会泄漏。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="candidate">已经去掉原始异常、并按键名脱敏过的事件。</param>
    static LogEvent ScrubRenderedSecrets(LogEvent candidate)
    {
        string rendered = candidate.RenderMessage(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string redacted = RedactText(rendered);
        if (rendered == redacted)
            return candidate;

        var properties = new List<LogEventProperty>(candidate.Properties.Count);
        foreach (var pair in candidate.Properties)
            properties.Add(new LogEventProperty(pair.Key, ScrubValue(pair.Value, rendered, redacted, 0)));

        var scrubbed = new LogEvent(
            candidate.Timestamp,
            candidate.Level,
            exception: null,
            messageTemplate: candidate.MessageTemplate,
            properties: properties);
        string renderedAgain = scrubbed.RenderMessage(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string redactedAgain = RedactText(renderedAgain);
        if (renderedAgain == redactedAgain)
            return scrubbed;

        return new LogEvent(
            scrubbed.Timestamp,
            scrubbed.Level,
            exception: null,
            messageTemplate: new MessageTemplate(new[] { new TextToken(redactedAgain) }),
            properties: properties);
    }

    /// <summary>渲染后才暴露的字符串值改成 ***。短于 4 个字符的值不按子串猜测。</summary>
    /// <param name="value">当前属性值。</param>
    /// <param name="rendered">脱敏前的渲染文本。</param>
    /// <param name="redacted">脱敏后的渲染文本。</param>
    /// <param name="depth">嵌套层。</param>
    static LogEventPropertyValue ScrubValue(LogEventPropertyValue value, string rendered, string redacted, int depth)
    {
        if (depth >= 16)
            return value;

        switch (value)
        {
            case ScalarValue scalar when scalar.Value is string text
                && text.Length >= 4
                && rendered.Contains(text, StringComparison.Ordinal)
                && !redacted.Contains(text, StringComparison.Ordinal):
                return new ScalarValue("***");
            case StructureValue structure:
                var members = new List<LogEventProperty>(structure.Properties.Count);
                foreach (var member in structure.Properties)
                    members.Add(new LogEventProperty(member.Name, ScrubValue(member.Value, rendered, redacted, depth + 1)));
                return new StructureValue(members, structure.TypeTag);
            case SequenceValue sequence:
                var items = new List<LogEventPropertyValue>(sequence.Elements.Count);
                foreach (var item in sequence.Elements)
                    items.Add(ScrubValue(item, rendered, redacted, depth + 1));
                return new SequenceValue(items);
            case DictionaryValue dictionary:
                var entries = new List<KeyValuePair<ScalarValue, LogEventPropertyValue>>(dictionary.Elements.Count);
                foreach (var entry in dictionary.Elements)
                    entries.Add(new KeyValuePair<ScalarValue, LogEventPropertyValue>(entry.Key, ScrubValue(entry.Value, rendered, redacted, depth + 1)));
                return new DictionaryValue(entries);
            default:
                return value;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>按名字和嵌套值脱敏。秘密键整值替换，不再往下展开。</summary>
    /// <param name="value">当前值。</param>
    /// <param name="name">属性名或结构成员名。没有名字时为空。</param>
    /// <param name="depth">当前嵌套层。过深时不再展开。</param>
    static LogEventPropertyValue RedactValue(LogEventPropertyValue value, string? name, int depth)
    {
        if (IsSecretKey(name))
            return new ScalarValue("***");
        if (depth >= 16)
            return new ScalarValue("***");

        switch (value)
        {
            case ScalarValue scalar when scalar.Value is string text:
                return new ScalarValue(RedactText(text));
            case StructureValue structure:
                var members = new List<LogEventProperty>(structure.Properties.Count);
                foreach (var member in structure.Properties)
                    members.Add(new LogEventProperty(member.Name, RedactValue(member.Value, member.Name, depth + 1)));
                return new StructureValue(members, structure.TypeTag);
            case SequenceValue sequence:
                var items = new List<LogEventPropertyValue>(sequence.Elements.Count);
                foreach (var item in sequence.Elements)
                    items.Add(RedactValue(item, null, depth + 1));
                return new SequenceValue(items);
            case DictionaryValue dictionary:
                var entries = new List<KeyValuePair<ScalarValue, LogEventPropertyValue>>(dictionary.Elements.Count);
                foreach (var entry in dictionary.Elements)
                {
                    string? key = entry.Key.Value as string;
                    var redactedKey = entry.Key.Value is string keyText
                        ? new ScalarValue(RedactText(keyText))
                        : entry.Key;
                    entries.Add(new KeyValuePair<ScalarValue, LogEventPropertyValue>(
                        redactedKey,
                        RedactValue(entry.Value, key, depth + 1)));
                }
                return new DictionaryValue(entries);
            default:
                return value;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>只把名为 password 或 token 的键视为秘密。比较忽略大小写，也认最后一个点或下划线后的名字。</summary>
    /// <param name="name">属性名。为空时不是秘密键。</param>
    static bool IsSecretKey(string? name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
            return false;

        int split = name.LastIndexOfAny(new[] { '.', '_' });
        string leaf = split >= 0 ? name[(split + 1)..] : name;
        return leaf.Equals("password", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || leaf.Equals("token", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    /// <summary>替换 password=、token: 以及这两种键的 JSON 字符串。认不出的文本保持原样。</summary>
    /// <param name="text">可能含有秘密的文本。为空时原样返回。</param>
    public static string RedactText(string? text)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
            return text ?? "";

        string json = JsonPair.Replace(text, "\"$1\"$2\"***\"");
        return Assignment.Replace(json, "$1$2***");
    }

    /// <summary>异常类型全名。不包含消息和堆栈。</summary>
    /// <param name="exception">要分类的异常。</param>
    static string Classify(Exception exception)
    {
        var names = new List<string>();
        var seen = new HashSet<Exception>();
        for (Exception? current = exception; current != null && seen.Add(current); current = current.InnerException)
            names.Add(current.GetType().FullName ?? current.GetType().Name);
        return string.Join(" <- ", names);
    }

    /// <summary>只拼接异常消息。不调用 ToString，因此没有堆栈。</summary>
    /// <param name="exception">要描述的异常。</param>
    static string Describe(Exception exception)
    {
        var messages = new List<string>();
        var seen = new HashSet<Exception>();
        for (Exception? current = exception; current != null && seen.Add(current); current = current.InnerException)
            messages.Add(current.Message ?? "");
        return string.Join(" <- ", messages);
    }

    /// <summary>已经有同名属性时不覆盖。</summary>
    /// <param name="properties">正在组装的属性。</param>
    /// <param name="name">属性名。</param>
    /// <param name="value">属性值。</param>
    static void AddIfMissing(List<LogEventProperty> properties, string name, LogEventPropertyValue value)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < properties.Count; i++)
        {
            if (properties[i].Name == name)
                return;
        }

        properties.Add(new LogEventProperty(name, value));
    }
}

/// <summary>把同一份已脱敏事件交给控制台和文件。任一接收器抛错都会再抛出，另一路仍会尝试写完。</summary>
sealed class FanoutSink : ILogEventSink, IDisposable
{
    readonly ILogEventSink _console;
    readonly ILogEventSink _file;

    /// <summary>记下两个真正的 Serilog 接收器。</summary>
    /// <param name="console">控制台接收器。</param>
    /// <param name="file">滚动文件接收器。</param>
    public FanoutSink(ILogEventSink console, ILogEventSink file)
    {
        _console = console ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(console));
        _file = file ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(file));
    }

    /// <summary>两边都写。先记下的异常在两边都尝试之后抛出。</summary>
    /// <param name="logEvent">已经脱敏的事件。</param>
    public void Emit(LogEvent logEvent)
    {
        Exception? error = null;
        try
        {
            _console.Emit(logEvent);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error = ex;
        }

        try
        {
            _file.Emit(logEvent);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error ??= ex;
        }

        if (error != null)
            throw error;
    }

    /// <summary>关闭两个接收器。关闭文件接收器时会刷出缓冲。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        Exception? error = null;
        try
        {
            (_console as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error = ex;
        }

        try
        {
            (_file as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error ??= ex;
        }

        if (error != null)
            throw error;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using Serilog;
using Serilog.Configuration;
using Serilog.Core;
using Serilog.Events;
using CloudIsleLogContext = CloudIsle.Diagnostics.LogContext;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Diagnostics;

/// <summary>
/// 服务端 Serilog 的持有者。控制台和滚动文件都经过脱敏。
/// 不写入静态 Serilog.Log.Logger。正式 Host 由 T60 组合；本类型只提供可配置入口。
/// </summary>
public sealed class LoggingSetup : IDisposable
{
    /// <summary>未指定大小时，单个文件大约 8 MiB 后滚动。</summary>
    public const long DefaultFileSizeLimitBytes = 8L * 1024 * 1024;

    /// <summary>允许的最小文件上限。再小就拒绝，避免无法滚动的配置。</summary>
    public const long MinFileSizeLimitBytes = 128;

    /// <summary>允许的最大文件上限，256 MiB。</summary>
    public const long MaxFileSizeLimitBytes = 256L * 1024 * 1024;

    /// <summary>未指定时连当前文件在内保留 8 份。</summary>
    public const int DefaultRetainedFileCount = 8;

    /// <summary>至少保留当前这一份。</summary>
    public const int MinRetainedFileCount = 1;

    /// <summary>连当前文件在内最多 32 份。</summary>
    public const int MaxRetainedFileCount = 32;

    const string OutputTemplate = "{Timestamp:O} [{Level:u3}] {Message:lj} {Properties}{NewLine}";

    readonly object _gate = new();
    Logger? _logger;

    /// <summary>用默认文件大小和保留份数配置控制台与滚动文件。</summary>
    /// <param name="logDirectory">日志目录。不存在会创建。空白、或路径已被文件占用时抛出异常。</param>
    /// <param name="minimumLevel">Verbose、Debug、Information/Info、Warning/Warn、Error、Fatal。无法识别时抛出异常。</param>
    public void Configure(string logDirectory, string minimumLevel)
    {
        Configure(logDirectory, minimumLevel, DefaultFileSizeLimitBytes, DefaultRetainedFileCount);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 配置本实例拥有的 Serilog。失败时不留下半套 logger，同一实例可以改正后再调用。
    /// 已经成功配置时必须先 Dispose。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="logDirectory">日志目录。</param>
    /// <param name="minimumLevel">最低级别。低于它的事件不会进入两个 sink。</param>
    /// <param name="fileSizeLimitBytes">单个文件的滚动上限，必须落在 128 字节到 256 MiB。</param>
    /// <param name="retainedFileCount">连当前文件在内保留的份数，必须是 1 到 32。</param>
    public void Configure(string logDirectory, string minimumLevel, long fileSizeLimitBytes, int retainedFileCount)
    {
        LogEventLevel level = ParseLevel(minimumLevel);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(logDirectory))
            throw new ArgumentException("日志目录为空", nameof(logDirectory));
        if (fileSizeLimitBytes < MinFileSizeLimitBytes || fileSizeLimitBytes > MaxFileSizeLimitBytes)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(fileSizeLimitBytes), "文件上限必须在 128 字节到 256 MiB 之间");
        if (retainedFileCount < MinRetainedFileCount || retainedFileCount > MaxRetainedFileCount)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(retainedFileCount), "保留份数必须在 1 到 32 之间");

        string directory = Path.GetFullPath(logDirectory);
        if (File.Exists(directory))
            throw new IOException("日志目录路径已被文件占用: " + directory);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        string filePath = Path.Combine(directory, "server.log");
        var format = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

        ILogEventSink? console = null;
        ILogEventSink? file = null;
        Logger? created = null;
        try
        {
            console = LoggerSinkConfiguration.CreateSink(sink => sink.Console(
                outputTemplate: OutputTemplate,
                formatProvider: format));
            file = LoggerSinkConfiguration.CreateSink(sink => sink.File(
                path: filePath,
                restrictedToMinimumLevel: LogEventLevel.Verbose,
                outputTemplate: OutputTemplate,
                formatProvider: format,
                fileSizeLimitBytes: fileSizeLimitBytes,
                buffered: false,
                shared: false,
                rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Infinite,
                rollOnFileSizeLimit: true,
                retainedFileCountLimit: retainedFileCount,
                encoding: new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false)));
            created = new LoggerConfiguration()
                .MinimumLevel.Is(level)
                .Enrich.With(new AmbientLogContextEnricher())
                .AuditTo.Sink(new RedactingSink(new FanoutSink(console, file)))
                .CreateLogger();

            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_logger != null)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("日志已经配置。先 Dispose 才能再次 Configure");

                _logger = created;
                created = null;
                console = null;
                file = null;
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            if (created != null)
            {
                created.Dispose();
            }
            else
            {
                (file as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
                (console as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>本实例的 Serilog。尚未 Configure 或已经 Dispose 时抛出异常。</summary>
    public ILogger Logger
    {
        get
        {
            Logger? logger = _logger;
            if (logger == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("日志尚未 Configure");
            return logger;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>关闭 logger 并刷出文件。重复调用没有额外效果。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        Logger? logger;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            logger = _logger;
            _logger = null;
        }

        logger?.Dispose();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 测试用。和 Configure 一样先脱敏，再经 Audit 交给接收器。
    /// 接收器抛错会回到写日志的调用方。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="minimumLevel">与 Configure 相同的级别文字。</param>
    /// <param name="sink">观察或故意失败的接收器。</param>
    /// <returns>调用方负责 Dispose 的 logger。</returns>
    internal static Logger CreateAuditLogger(string minimumLevel, ILogEventSink sink)
    {
        if (sink == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sink));

        return new LoggerConfiguration()
            .MinimumLevel.Is(ParseLevel(minimumLevel))
            .Enrich.With(new AmbientLogContextEnricher())
            .AuditTo.Sink(new RedactingSink(sink))
            .CreateLogger();
    }

    /// <summary>解析级别文字。Info 与 Warn 是两个简称，其余用 Serilog 的名字。</summary>
    /// <param name="minimumLevel">调用方给出的级别。</param>
    static LogEventLevel ParseLevel(string minimumLevel)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(minimumLevel))
            throw new ArgumentException("日志级别为空", nameof(minimumLevel));

        switch (minimumLevel.Trim().ToLowerInvariant())
        {
            case "verbose":
                return LogEventLevel.Verbose;
            case "debug":
                return LogEventLevel.Debug;
            case "information":
            case "info":
                return LogEventLevel.Information;
            case "warning":
            case "warn":
                return LogEventLevel.Warning;
            case "error":
                return LogEventLevel.Error;
            case "fatal":
                return LogEventLevel.Fatal;
            default:
                throw new ArgumentException("无法识别的日志级别: " + minimumLevel, nameof(minimumLevel));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>把当前异步流上的 LogContext 五个字段补进事件。模板里已经有的同名属性不覆盖。</summary>
    sealed class AmbientLogContextEnricher : ILogEventEnricher
    {
        /// <summary>有环境请求时补上 PlayerId、MsgId、Seq、OpId、ElapsedMs。</summary>
        /// <param name="logEvent">即将写出的事件。</param>
        /// <param name="propertyFactory">创建属性的工厂。</param>
        public void Enrich(LogEvent logEvent, ILogEventPropertyFactory propertyFactory)
        {
            AmbientRequest? current = RequestAmbient.Current;
            if (current == null || logEvent == null || propertyFactory == null)
                return;

            CloudIsleLogContext context = current.ToLogContext();
            Add(logEvent, propertyFactory, nameof(CloudIsleLogContext.PlayerId), context.PlayerId);
            Add(logEvent, propertyFactory, nameof(CloudIsleLogContext.MsgId), context.MsgId);
            Add(logEvent, propertyFactory, nameof(CloudIsleLogContext.Seq), context.Seq);
            Add(logEvent, propertyFactory, nameof(CloudIsleLogContext.OpId), context.OpId);
            Add(logEvent, propertyFactory, nameof(CloudIsleLogContext.ElapsedMs), context.ElapsedMs);
        }

        /// <summary>同名属性已经存在时跳过。</summary>
        /// <param name="logEvent">事件。</param>
        /// <param name="propertyFactory">属性工厂。</param>
        /// <param name="name">LogContext 的字段名。</param>
        /// <param name="value">这次请求的数字。</param>
        static void Add(LogEvent logEvent, ILogEventPropertyFactory propertyFactory, string name, object value)
        {
            if (logEvent.Properties.ContainsKey(name))
                return;
            logEvent.AddPropertyIfAbsent(propertyFactory.CreateProperty(name, value));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using CloudIsle.Diagnostics;
using CloudIsle.Net;
using CloudIsle.Server.Network;
using Serilog;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Diagnostics;

/// <summary>
/// 套在真实 MessageRouter 分发外面的请求日志。只记录关联字段和结果，不读请求正文。
/// T60 再把它装进正式 Host。这里不启动监听。
/// </summary>
public sealed class RequestLogDecorator
{
    readonly MessageRouter _router;
    readonly ILogger _logger;

    /// <summary>使用已经 Configure 的日志和现有路由。</summary>
    /// <param name="router">真正执行分发的路由。本对象不注册玩法消息。</param>
    /// <param name="logging">提供 Serilog 的配置。尚未 Configure 时构造会失败。</param>
    public RequestLogDecorator(MessageRouter router, LoggingSetup logging)
    {
        _router = router ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(router));
        if (logging == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logging));
        _logger = logging.Logger;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 分发一帧并写下这次的 LogContext。成功、取消和异常都会带上耗时。
    /// 异常继续抛给调用方。日志里的异常由脱敏 sink 处理，这里不调用 Exception.ToString。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">会话、玩家、消息 ID 和序号。不从正文里取。</param>
    /// <param name="packet">交给路由的帧。本方法不读取、不记录 Body。</param>
    /// <param name="opId">这次写操作的编号。没有操作时传 0。不从正文解析。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消分发。</param>
    public async Task DispatchAsync(RequestContext context, Packet packet, long opId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (context == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
        if (packet.Body == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(packet));

        var ambient = new AmbientRequest(
            context.PlayerId,
            context.MsgId,
            context.Seq,
            opId,
            Stopwatch.GetTimestamp());
        using (RequestAmbient.Push(ambient))
        {
            try
            {
                await _router.DispatchAsync(context, packet, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                Write(ambient.ToLogContext(), "ok", null);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                Write(ambient.ToLogContext(), "canceled", null);
                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Write(ambient.ToLogContext(), "fail", ex);
                throw;
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>写一条不含正文的请求结果。</summary>
    /// <param name="context">五个关联数字。</param>
    /// <param name="outcome">ok、fail 或 canceled。</param>
    /// <param name="error">失败时的异常。取消和成功为空。不在这里展开堆栈。</param>
    void Write(LogContext context, string outcome, Exception? error)
    {
        if (error == null)
        {
            _logger.Information(
                "request {Outcome} {PlayerId} {MsgId} {Seq} {OpId} {ElapsedMs}",
                outcome,
                context.PlayerId,
                context.MsgId,
                context.Seq,
                context.OpId,
                context.ElapsedMs);
            return;
        }

        _logger.Error(
            error,
            "request {Outcome} {PlayerId} {MsgId} {Seq} {OpId} {ElapsedMs}",
            outcome,
            context.PlayerId,
            context.MsgId,
            context.Seq,
            context.OpId,
            context.ElapsedMs);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using CloudIsle.Server.Account;
using CloudIsle.Server.Network;
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;
using Serilog;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Diagnostics;

/// <summary>指标循环使用的时钟和等待。测试可以推进时间，不必真的睡 10 秒。</summary>
public interface IMetricsSchedule
{
    /// <summary>从这份时刻表创建以来经过的时间。请求率用它做分母。</summary>
    TimeSpan Elapsed { get; }

    /// <summary>等待下一拍。取消时抛出 OperationCanceledException。</summary>
    /// <param name="interval">这一拍要等的时间。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">停止报告。</param>
    Task DelayAsync(TimeSpan interval, CancellationToken ct);
}

/// <summary>用 Stopwatch 和 Task.Delay 的时刻表。</summary>
public sealed class SystemMetricsSchedule : IMetricsSchedule
{
    readonly long _startedAt = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();

    /// <summary>创建以来的单调时间。</summary>
    public TimeSpan Elapsed => Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(_startedAt);

    /// <summary>按系统时钟等待。已取消时立刻抛出。</summary>
    /// <param name="interval">等待时长。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消等待。</param>
    public Task DelayAsync(TimeSpan interval, CancellationToken ct) => Task.Delay(interval, ct);
}

/// <summary>
/// 按间隔输出连接数、已认证玩家数、请求率、队列长度和内存。
/// 默认 10 秒。队列长度含正在执行的动作。已认证玩家数来自会话绑定，不是缓存条数。
/// T60 再挂到正式 Host。本类型不监听端口。
/// </summary>
public sealed class MetricsReporter
{
    /// <summary>未另行指定时的输出间隔。</summary>
    public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);

    readonly Func<int> _connectionCount;
    readonly Func<int> _authenticatedPlayerCount;
    readonly Func<long> _requestCount;
    readonly Func<int> _queueLength;
    readonly Func<long> _memoryBytes;
    readonly Action<string> _write;
    readonly IMetricsSchedule _schedule;

    /// <summary>用采样函数和时刻表创建报告器。采样函数应读取真实对象。</summary>
    /// <param name="connectionCount">当前 TCP 连接数。</param>
    /// <param name="authenticatedPlayerCount">当前绑定会话的玩家数，不要传缓存数量。</param>
    /// <param name="requestCount">已经进入路由分发的累计次数。</param>
    /// <param name="queueLength">玩家队列尚未结束的动作数，包含正在执行的一项。</param>
    /// <param name="memoryBytes">托管堆字节数。</param>
    /// <param name="write">写出一行指标。抛错会传给 RunAsync 的调用方。</param>
    /// <param name="schedule">间隔等待和经过时间。</param>
    public MetricsReporter(
        Func<int> connectionCount,
        Func<int> authenticatedPlayerCount,
        Func<long> requestCount,
        Func<int> queueLength,
        Func<long> memoryBytes,
        Action<string> write,
        IMetricsSchedule schedule)
    {
        _connectionCount = connectionCount ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(connectionCount));
        _authenticatedPlayerCount = authenticatedPlayerCount ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(authenticatedPlayerCount));
        _requestCount = requestCount ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(requestCount));
        _queueLength = queueLength ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(queueLength));
        _memoryBytes = memoryBytes ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(memoryBytes));
        _write = write ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(write));
        _schedule = schedule ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(schedule));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// PoC 组合入口。把四个真实对象和 Serilog 接在一起，使用系统时钟。
    /// 不启动 TCP，也不表示服务已经上线。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="logging">已经 Configure 的日志。指标行走 Information。</param>
    /// <param name="server">提供连接数的监听器。</param>
    /// <param name="registry">提供已认证玩家数的会话表。</param>
    /// <param name="router">提供累计请求数的路由。</param>
    /// <param name="queue">提供队列长度的玩家队列。</param>
    public static MetricsReporter Create(
        LoggingSetup logging,
        TcpServer server,
        SessionRegistry registry,
        MessageRouter router,
        PlayerQueue queue)
    {
        if (logging == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logging));
        if (server == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(server));
        if (registry == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(registry));
        if (router == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(router));
        if (queue == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(queue));

        ILogger logger = logging.Logger;
        return new MetricsReporter(
            () => server.ConnectionCount,
            () => registry.AuthenticatedPlayerCount,
            () => router.RequestCount,
            () => queue.QueueLength,
            () => GC.GetTotalMemory(forceFullCollection: false),
            line => logger.Information("metrics {MetricsText}", line),
            new SystemMetricsSchedule());
    }

    /// <summary>按默认 10 秒输出，直到取消。</summary>
    /// <param name="ct">取消后不再输出。</param>
    public Task RunAsync(CancellationToken ct) => RunAsync(DefaultInterval, ct);

    /// <summary>按给定间隔输出。间隔不是正数时拒绝。经过时间为 0 的那一拍请求率为 0。</summary>
    /// <param name="interval">两拍之间的等待。必须大于 0。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">取消当前等待并停止后续输出。</param>
    public async Task RunAsync(TimeSpan interval, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (interval <= TimeSpan.Zero)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(interval), "指标间隔必须为正");

        while (true)
        {
            try
            {
                await _schedule.DelayAsync(interval, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                return;

            _write(FormatLine());
        }
    }

    /// <summary>累计请求除以实际经过的秒数。经过时间小于等于 0 时返回 0，不除零。</summary>
    /// <param name="requestCount">累计进入分发的次数。负数拒绝。</param>
    /// <param name="elapsed">从报告开始经过的时间。</param>
    public static double RequestRatePerSecond(long requestCount, TimeSpan elapsed)
    {
        if (requestCount < 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(requestCount));
        if (elapsed <= TimeSpan.Zero)
            return 0;
        return requestCount / elapsed.TotalSeconds;
    }

    /// <summary>采样并格式化一行。内存单位是字节。queueIncludesExecuting 表示长度含正在执行的动作。</summary>
    string FormatLine()
    {
        int connections = _connectionCount();
        int players = _authenticatedPlayerCount();
        long requests = _requestCount();
        int queueLength = _queueLength();
        long memoryBytes = _memoryBytes();
        TimeSpan elapsed = _schedule.Elapsed;
        double rate = RequestRatePerSecond(requests, elapsed);
        return string.Format(
            CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
            "connections={0} authenticatedPlayers={1} requests={2} elapsedSeconds={3:0.###} requestRatePerSecond={4:0.###} queueLength={5} queueIncludesExecuting=true memoryBytes={6}",
            connections,
            players,
            requests,
            elapsed.TotalSeconds,
            rate,
            queueLength,
            memoryBytes);
    }
}
```

```csharp
﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using CloudIsle.Net;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using Google.Protobuf;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Network
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 按 MsgRegistry 把一帧交给已注册的处理函数。
    /// 认证前只放行心跳、注册、登录、重连。登出必须已认证，并且没有响应。
    /// 普通请求每个主体每秒 20 次。未认证主体按会话分开计数。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class MessageRouter
    {
        /// <summary>未登录。</summary>
        public const int CodeNotLogin = 102;

        /// <summary>请求过快。</summary>
        public const int CodeTooFast = 104;

        /// <summary>正式注册表里没有这条消息，不能当成已上线的业务。</summary>
        public const int CodeUnknown = 101;

        const int MaxRequestsPerWindow = 20;
        const int MaxConsecutiveParseFailures = 5;

        readonly Func<RequestContext, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> _sendAsync;
        readonly Func<RequestContext, string, CancellationToken, Task> _closeAsync;
        readonly IRouterClock _clock;
        readonly Action<string>? _trace;
        readonly Dictionary<ushort, RouteHandler> _handlers = new Dictionary<ushort, RouteHandler>();
        readonly Dictionary<long, long> _sessionPlayer = new Dictionary<long, long>();
        readonly Dictionary<long, RateBucket> _sessionRates = new Dictionary<long, RateBucket>();
        readonly Dictionary<long, RateBucket> _playerRates = new Dictionary<long, RateBucket>();
        readonly Dictionary<long, int> _parseFailures = new Dictionary<long, int>();
        readonly object _gate = new object();
        long _requestCount;

        /// <summary>
        /// 用系统时钟创建路由。发送和关闭由调用方接到会话上。
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="sendAsync">写出一帧响应。无响应的拒绝不会调用它。</param>
        /// <param name="closeAsync">连续反序列化失败达到 5 次时关闭这条会话。</param>
        public MessageRouter(
            Func<RequestContext, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> sendAsync,
            Func<RequestContext, string, CancellationToken, Task> closeAsync)
            : this(sendAsync, closeAsync, new SystemRouterClock(), null)
        {
        }

        /// <summary>创建可注入时钟和追踪的路由。</summary>
        /// <param name="sendAsync">写出一帧响应。</param>
        /// <param name="closeAsync">需要关闭会话时调用。</param>
        /// <param name="clock">限流窗口使用的时钟。</param>
        /// <param name="trace">写追踪行。为空则不追踪。</param>
        internal MessageRouter(
            Func<RequestContext, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> sendAsync,
            Func<RequestContext, string, CancellationToken, Task> closeAsync,
            IRouterClock clock,
            Action<string>? trace)
        {
            if (sendAsync == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sendAsync));
            if (closeAsync == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(closeAsync));
            if (clock == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(clock));

            _sendAsync = sendAsync;
            _closeAsync = closeAsync;
            _clock = clock;
            _trace = trace;
        }

        internal int SessionRateCount
        {
            get
            {
                lock (_gate)
                    return _sessionRates.Count;
            }
        }

        internal int PlayerRateCount
        {
            get
            {
                lock (_gate)
                    return _playerRates.Count;
            }
        }

        internal int ParseStateCount
        {
            get
            {
                lock (_gate)
                    return _parseFailures.Count;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>已经进入分发的次数，包含被拒绝和稍后失败的请求。供请求率使用，不是成功次数。</summary>
        public long RequestCount => Interlocked.Read(ref _requestCount);

        internal int SessionBindingCount
        {
            get
            {
                lock (_gate)
                    return _sessionPlayer.Count;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 注册一个请求处理函数。消息 ID 必须等于 MsgRegistry 里该类型的 ID。
        /// 同一个 ID 再注册一次会失败，已有处理函数保持不变。
        /// </summary>
        /// <typeparam name="TRequest">请求的 protobuf 类型。</typeparam>
        /// <param name="msgId">线路上的消息 ID。</param>
        /// <param name="handler">通过认证和限流后调用。</param>
        public void Register<TRequest>(
            ushort msgId,
            Func<RequestContext, TRequest, CancellationToken, Task> handler)
            where TRequest : class, IMessage
        {
            if (handler == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(handler));

            ushort actualId = MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(TRequest));
            if (actualId != msgId)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "注册类型与消息 ID 不一致: " + typeof(TRequest).Name + " 的 ID 是 " + actualId + "，给出的是 " + msgId);
            }

            var route = new RouteHandler(
                typeof(TRequest),
                (context, message, token) => handler(context, (TRequest)message, token));

            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_handlers.ContainsKey(msgId))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("重复注册消息 ID: " + msgId);

                _handlers.Add(msgId, route);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 按帧分发。上下文里的消息 ID 和序号必须与帧一致。
        /// 拒绝已有响应的请求时，用真实响应的 code 字段；没有响应时不发帧。
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="context">会话、玩家、消息 ID 和序号。</param>
        /// <param name="packet">已经完成分帧的包。正文由调用方持有。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">取消分发、回包和关闭。</param>
        public async Task DispatchAsync(RequestContext context, Packet packet, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            if (context == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            if (packet.Body == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(packet));
            if (context.MsgId != packet.MsgId || context.Seq != packet.Seq)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("上下文与帧的消息 ID 或序号不一致");

            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            Interlocked.Increment(ref _requestCount);
            RememberSession(context);

            if (context.PlayerId <= 0 && !IsPreAuthSystemRequest(packet.MsgId))
            {
                await RejectAsync(context, packet, CodeNotLogin, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                return;
            }

            IMessage message;
            try
            {
                message = MsgRegistry.Parse(packet.MsgId, packet.Body);
            }
            catch (InvalidProtocolBufferException)
            {
                await NoteParseFailureAsync(context, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                return;
            }
            catch (InvalidOperationException)
            {
                await RejectAsync(context, packet, CodeUnknown, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                return;
            }

            ClearParseFailures(context.SessionId);

            RouteHandler? handler;
            lock (_gate)
                _handlers.TryGetValue(packet.MsgId, out handler);

            if (handler == null)
            {
                await RejectAsync(context, packet, CodeUnknown, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                return;
            }

            if (!handler.RequestType.IsInstanceOfType(message))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("解析类型与注册类型不一致");

            if (!TryConsumeRequest(context))
            {
                await RejectAsync(context, packet, CodeTooFast, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                return;
            }

            WriteTrace(context, 0, "handler");
            await handler.Invoke(context, message, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 会话关闭后丢掉这条连接的计数和非法消息状态。
        /// 同一个玩家已经没有其他会话时，一并丢掉该玩家的限流计数。
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="sessionId">已经关闭的会话。</param>
        public void ReleaseSession(long sessionId)
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                _sessionRates.Remove(sessionId);
                _parseFailures.Remove(sessionId);
                if (!_sessionPlayer.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long playerId))
                    return;

                _sessionPlayer.Remove(sessionId);
                if (playerId <= 0 || SessionStillBound(playerId))
                    return;

                _playerRates.Remove(playerId);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>未认证时只允许心跳、注册、登录和重连。</summary>
        /// <param name="msgId">本帧消息 ID。</param>
        static bool IsPreAuthSystemRequest(ushort msgId)
        {
            return msgId == MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(HeartbeatReq))
                || msgId == MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(RegisterReq))
                || msgId == MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(LoginReq))
                || msgId == MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(ReconnectReq));
        }

        /// <summary>记下这条会话当前绑定的玩家。</summary>
        /// <param name="context">这一次分发的上下文。</param>
        void RememberSession(RequestContext context)
        {
            lock (_gate)
                _sessionPlayer[context.SessionId] = context.PlayerId;
        }

        /// <summary>同一主体在当前 1 秒窗口内未超过 20 次时返回 true。</summary>
        /// <param name="context">用来选择计数键的上下文。</param>
        bool TryConsumeRequest(RequestContext context)
        {
            long window = _clock.UnixMilliseconds / 1000L;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                Dictionary<long, RateBucket> map = context.PlayerId > 0 ? _playerRates : _sessionRates;
                long key = context.PlayerId > 0 ? context.PlayerId : context.SessionId;
                if (!map.TryGetValue(key, out RateBucket? bucket) || bucket.Window != window)
                {
                    bucket = new RateBucket { Window = window, Count = 0 };
                    map[key] = bucket;
                }

                bucket.Count++;
                return bucket.Count <= MaxRequestsPerWindow;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>合法消息之后把连续反序列化失败次数清零。</summary>
        /// <param name="sessionId">连接会话编号。</param>
        void ClearParseFailures(long sessionId)
        {
            lock (_gate)
                _parseFailures.Remove(sessionId);
        }

        /// <summary>累计反序列化失败。连续 5 次就关闭会话。</summary>
        /// <param name="context">失败的那一次分发。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">关闭会话时使用的取消令牌。</param>
        async Task NoteParseFailureAsync(RequestContext context, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            int count;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                _parseFailures.TryGetValue(context.SessionId, out count);
                count++;
                _parseFailures[context.SessionId] = count;
            }

            WriteTrace(context, 0, "deserialize-failed");
            if (count < MaxConsecutiveParseFailures)
                return;

            try
            {
                await _closeAsync(context, "连续反序列化失败", ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            finally
            {
                ReleaseSession(context.SessionId);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>有配对响应时只回 code。没有响应时只记录结果。</summary>
        /// <param name="context">被拒绝的请求上下文。</param>
        /// <param name="packet">原始请求帧。</param>
        /// <param name="code">业务码，例如 102 或 104。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">发送拒绝响应时的取消令牌。</param>
        async Task RejectAsync(RequestContext context, Packet packet, int code, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            WriteTrace(context, code, "reject");
            if (!MsgRegistry.TryGetResponseId(packet.MsgId, out ushort responseId))
                return;

            IMessage? response = CreateCodedResponse(responseId, code);
            if (response == null)
                return;

            var reply = new Packet(responseId, packet.Seq, response.ToByteArray());
            await _sendAsync(context, reply, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        /// <summary>按响应 ID 造一条只填 code 的消息。没有这种响应时返回空。</summary>
        /// <param name="responseId">配对的响应消息 ID。</param>
        /// <param name="code">要写入的业务码。</param>
        static IMessage? CreateCodedResponse(ushort responseId, int code)
        {
            IMessage response = MsgRegistry.Parse(responseId, Array.Empty<byte>());
            switch (response)
            {
                case HeartbeatResp heartbeat:
                    heartbeat.Code = code;
                    return heartbeat;
                case RegisterResp register:
                    register.Code = code;
                    return register;
                case LoginResp login:
                    login.Code = code;
                    login.Token = string.Empty;
                    return login;
                case ReconnectResp reconnect:
                    reconnect.Code = code;
                    return reconnect;
                default:
                    return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>这个玩家是否还有别的会话绑定着。</summary>
        /// <param name="playerId">玩家编号。</param>
        bool SessionStillBound(long playerId)
        {
            foreach (KeyValuePair<long, long> pair in _sessionPlayer)
            {
                if (pair.Value == playerId)
                    return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>写一行不含正文、密码和 Token 的追踪。</summary>
        /// <param name="context">这次分发的上下文。</param>
        /// <param name="code">结果码。</param>
        /// <param name="action">短动作名。</param>
        void WriteTrace(RequestContext context, int code, string action)
        {
            if (_trace == null)
                return;

            _trace("session=" + context.SessionId + " msg=" + context.MsgId + " seq=" + context.Seq + " code=" + code + " action=" + action);
        }

        sealed class RouteHandler
        {
            /// <summary>记下一种请求的处理函数。</summary>
            /// <param name="requestType">请求的 protobuf 类型。</param>
            /// <param name="invoke">通过认证和限流后调用。</param>
            public RouteHandler(Type requestType, Func<RequestContext, IMessage, CancellationToken, Task> invoke)
            {
                RequestType = requestType;
                Invoke = invoke;
            }

            public Type RequestType { get; }

            public Func<RequestContext, IMessage, CancellationToken, Task> Invoke { get; }
        }

        sealed class RateBucket
        {
            public long Window;
            public int Count;
        }
    }

    internal interface IRouterClock
    {
        long UnixMilliseconds { get; }
    }

    sealed class SystemRouterClock : IRouterClock
    {
        public long UnixMilliseconds => DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();
    }
}
```
