```csharp
﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Network
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 接受 TCP 连接并为每条连接分配一个不复用的会话。
    /// 某个会话失败只结束该会话，不停止监听。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class TcpServer
    {
        readonly Func<ClientSession, CloudIsle.Net.Packet, CancellationToken, Task>? _onPacket;
        readonly int _sendQueueCapacity;
        readonly ConcurrentDictionary<long, ClientSession> _sessions = new ConcurrentDictionary<long, ClientSession>();
        readonly HashSet<Task> _runs = new HashSet<Task>();
        readonly object _runLock = new object();
        readonly TaskCompletionSource _started = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        static long _nextSessionId;
        int _runOnce;

        /// <summary>记下收包回调和每条连接的发送队列长度。</summary>
        /// <param name="onPacket">每个完整包交给它。为空时只接收，不回调。</param>
        /// <param name="sendQueueCapacity">每条连接最多排队的帧数。小于 1 时抛异常。</param>
        public TcpServer(Func<ClientSession, CloudIsle.Net.Packet, CancellationToken, Task>? onPacket, int sendQueueCapacity = 32)
        {
            if (sendQueueCapacity <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(sendQueueCapacity));

            _onPacket = onPacket;
            _sendQueueCapacity = sendQueueCapacity;
        }

        /// <summary>监听套接字已经绑定。端口 0 时这里能读到系统分配的端口。</summary>
        public Task Started => _started.Task;

        /// <summary>实际绑定的本机端点。尚未开始监听时为空。</summary>
        public IPEndPoint? LocalEndpoint { get; private set; }

        /// <summary>当前仍由本监听器跟踪的连接数。会话循环结束后移除，不是历史累计，也不是已认证玩家数。</summary>
        public int ConnectionCount => _sessions.Count;

        /// <summary>监听 endpoint。取消时停止接受连接，关闭已经接入的会话，并等待这些会话任务结束。</summary>
        /// <param name="endpoint">要绑定的本机端点。端口 0 由系统分配。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">停止监听和已接入的会话。</param>
        public async Task RunAsync(IPEndPoint endpoint, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            if (endpoint == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(endpoint));
            if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _runOnce, 1) != 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("监听已经在运行");

            var listener = new TcpListener(endpoint);
            try
            {
                try
                {
                    listener.Start();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    _started.TrySetException(ex);
                    throw;
                }

                LocalEndpoint = (IPEndPoint)listener.LocalEndpoint;
                _started.TrySetResult();

                using (ct.Register(static state =>
                {
                    var tcp = (TcpListener)state!;
                    try
                    {
                        tcp.Stop();
                    }
                    catch (ObjectDisposedException)
                    {
                    }
                    catch (SocketException)
                    {
                    }
                }, listener))
                {
                    while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                    {
                        TcpClient client;
                        try
                        {
                            client = await listener.AcceptTcpClientAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        }
                        catch (OperationCanceledException)
                        {
                            break;
                        }
                        catch (ObjectDisposedException)
                        {
                            break;
                        }
                        catch (SocketException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                        {
                            break;
                        }
                        catch (InvalidOperationException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                        {
                            break;
                        }

                        if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                        {
                            client.Dispose();
                            break;
                        }

                        long sessionId = Interlocked.Increment(ref _nextSessionId);
                        ClientSession session = ClientSession.Accept(sessionId, client, _sendQueueCapacity, _onPacket);
                        _sessions[sessionId] = session;
                        Task run = RunSessionAsync(session, ct);
                        lock (_runLock)
                            _runs.Add(run);
                        _ = run.ContinueWith(
                            finished =>
                            {
                                lock (_runLock)
                                    _runs.Remove(finished);
                            },
                            CancellationToken.None,
                            TaskContinuationOptions.ExecuteSynchronously,
                            TaskScheduler.Default);
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                try
                {
                    listener.Stop();
                }
                catch (SocketException)
                {
                }
                catch (ObjectDisposedException)
                {
                }

                foreach (ClientSession session in _sessions.Values)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        await session.CloseAsync("服务器停止", CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                    catch (Exception)
                    {
                    }
                }

                Task[] runs;
                lock (_runLock)
                    runs = _runs.ToArray();

                try
                {
                    await Task.WhenAll(runs).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                }

                _started.TrySetResult();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>跑一个会话。它自己的异常不传到别的会话。</summary>
        /// <param name="session">已经接入的会话。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">停止这个会话。</param>
        async Task RunSessionAsync(ClientSession session, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            try
            {
                await session.RunAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                try
                {
                    await session.CloseAsync("会话失败", CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                _sessions.TryRemove(session.SessionId, out _);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using CloudIsle.Net;
using Google.Protobuf;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Network;
using CloudIsle.Server.Players;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Account;

/// <summary>
/// 同一玩家只保留一条当前连接。新连接写入映射后，旧连接才收到正式踢线并关闭。
/// 不签发令牌，也不处理登录或登出。
/// </summary>
public sealed class SessionRegistry
{
    /// <summary>未另行指定时，踢线写入和等待旧连接关闭共用的上限。</summary>
    public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultKickBudget = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);

    readonly PlayerQueue _queue;
    readonly TimeSpan _kickBudget;
    readonly Action<string> _log;
    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, ClientSession> _byPlayer = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, long> _bySession = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, Task> _watches = new();
    readonly HashSet<long> _retiring = new();

    /// <summary>使用共享玩家队列，踢线预算为 2 秒，日志写到控制台。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerQueue">同玩家串行的队列。本对象不释放它。</param>
    public SessionRegistry(PlayerQueue playerQueue)
        : this(playerQueue, DefaultKickBudget, null)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>使用共享玩家队列，并指定踢线预算和日志。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerQueue">同玩家串行的队列。绑定会进入这名玩家的队列；本对象不释放它。</param>
    /// <param name="kickBudget">旧连接通知和等待关闭的合计上限，必须为正。用尽后不再占住玩家队列。</param>
    /// <param name="log">诊断输出。为空时写到控制台。回调在字典锁外调用。</param>
    public SessionRegistry(PlayerQueue playerQueue, TimeSpan kickBudget, Action<string>? log)
    {
        if (playerQueue == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(playerQueue));
        if (kickBudget <= TimeSpan.Zero)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(kickBudget), "踢线预算必须为正");

        _queue = playerQueue;
        _kickBudget = kickBudget;
        _log = log ?? (static message => Console.WriteLine(message));
    }

    /// <summary>当前绑定了会话的玩家数。这是在线认证会话，不是玩家缓存条数。</summary>
    public int AuthenticatedPlayerCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _byPlayer.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>当前仍登记为在线的玩家数。</summary>
    internal int MappedPlayerCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _byPlayer.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>会话到玩家的反向索引数量。</summary>
    internal int MappedSessionCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _bySession.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>尚未结束的会话观察数。结束后会从集合删除。</summary>
    internal int WatchCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _watches.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>已失去当前身份、关闭尚未观察结束的会话数。</summary>
    internal int RetiringCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _retiring.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>等待已经登记的观察任务结束。仍在运行的会话会使这个等待一直停着。</summary>
    internal async Task WhenIdleAsync()
    {
        while (true)
        {
            Task[] pending;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_watches.Count == 0)
                    return;
                pending = _watches.Values.ToArray();
            }

            await Task.WhenAll(pending).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 把连接登记为该玩家的唯一在线会话。同一会话重复绑定不踢自己。
    /// 已经处在该玩家队列动作中时直接执行，避免再次入队死锁。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要占线的玩家。必须是正数。不从客户端报文读取。</param>
    /// <param name="session">服务端这条连接。已关闭或正在因顶号关闭时拒绝。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">只在改映射前生效。改映射之后取消不回滚新映射，旧连接仍按预算收尾。</param>
    public Task BindAsync(long playerId, ClientSession session, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (session == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(session));
        if (playerId <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(playerId), "玩家编号必须为正数");

        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (PlayerQueue.IsCurrentPlayer(playerId))
            return BindCoreAsync(playerId, session, ct);

        return _queue.EnqueueAsync(playerId, token => BindCoreAsync(playerId, session, token), ct);
    }

    /// <summary>这名玩家的当前连接是不是这条会话。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要核对的玩家。没有在线会话时返回 false。</param>
    /// <param name="sessionId">服务端会话编号。</param>
    public bool IsCurrent(long playerId, long sessionId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == sessionId
                && _bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long mapped)
                && mapped == playerId;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>按玩家取当前连接。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要查询的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="session">找到时是当前连接；否则为 null。</param>
    /// <returns>该玩家有当前连接时为 true。</returns>
    public bool TryGetCurrentSession(long playerId, [NotNullWhen(true)] out ClientSession? session)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current))
            {
                session = current;
                return true;
            }
        }

        session = null;
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>按服务端会话编号反查玩家。</summary>
    /// <param name="sessionId">服务端会话编号。不采用客户端自行声明的编号。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">找到时为注册表里的玩家；否则为 0。</param>
    /// <returns>该会话仍是某玩家的当前连接时为 true。</returns>
    public bool TryGetPlayerId(long sessionId, out long playerId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long mapped)
                && _byPlayer.TryGetValue(mapped, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == sessionId)
            {
                playerId = mapped;
                return true;
            }
        }

        playerId = 0;
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 用这条服务端连接构造请求上下文。玩家编号只取注册表，未绑定为 0。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="session">正在处理的服务端连接。会话编号取自该对象。</param>
    /// <param name="msgId">本帧的正式消息编号。不从正文推断玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="seq">本帧序号。</param>
    public RequestContext CreateRequestContext(ClientSession session, ushort msgId, uint seq)
    {
        if (session == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(session));

        long playerId = 0;
        if (TryGetPlayerId(session.SessionId, out long mapped))
            playerId = mapped;

        return new RequestContext(session.SessionId, playerId, msgId, seq);
    }

    /// <summary>在玩家队列内完成一次绑定。调用方保证同一玩家不会并发进入这里。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">本次占线的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="session">要成为当前连接的会话。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">改映射前取消则原样抛出，并且不改字典。</param>
    async Task BindCoreAsync(long playerId, ClientSession session, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ClientSession? retiring = null;
        TaskCompletionSource? watch = null;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            if (session.IsCloseRequested || session.Completion.IsCompleted)
            {
                UnmapIfMatch(session.SessionId);
                throw new InvalidOperationException("已关闭的会话不能绑定");
            }

            if (_retiring.Contains(session.SessionId))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("正在关闭的会话不能重新绑定");

            bool sameCurrent = _byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current)
                && current.SessionId == session.SessionId;
            if (!sameCurrent)
            {
                if (_bySession.TryGetValue(session.SessionId, out long previousPlayer) && previousPlayer != playerId)
                {
                    if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(previousPlayer, out ClientSession? previous)
                        && previous.SessionId == session.SessionId)
                    {
                        _byPlayer.Remove(previousPlayer);
                    }

                    _bySession.Remove(session.SessionId);
                }

                if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? old) && old.SessionId != session.SessionId)
                {
                    _byPlayer.Remove(playerId);
                    _bySession.Remove(old.SessionId);
                    _retiring.Add(old.SessionId);
                    retiring = old;
                }

                _byPlayer[playerId] = session;
                _bySession[session.SessionId] = playerId;
            }

            if (!_watches.ContainsKey(session.SessionId))
            {
                watch = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
                _watches[session.SessionId] = watch.Task;
            }
        }

        if (watch != null)
            Observe(RunWatchAsync(session, watch));

        if (retiring != null)
            await RetireAsync(retiring, playerId).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    /// <summary>等会话结束后，仅当反向索引仍是它时才删除。然后丢掉观察项。</summary>
    /// <param name="session">被观察的连接。完成任务是它自己的 Completion。</param>
    /// <param name="done">交给 WhenIdleAsync 的完成源。清理后再完成，避免漏等。</param>
    async Task RunWatchAsync(ClientSession session, TaskCompletionSource done)
    {
        try
        {
            await Task.Yield();
            await session.Completion.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally
        {
            try
            {
                lock (_gate)
                {
                    UnmapIfMatch(session.SessionId);
                    _retiring.Remove(session.SessionId);
                    if (_watches.TryGetValue(session.SessionId, out Task? task) && ReferenceEquals(task, done.Task))
                        _watches.Remove(session.SessionId);
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                done.TrySetResult();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>锁外发送正式踢线并关闭。失败或超时只记日志，不把新映射撤掉。</summary>
    /// <param name="oldSession">已经从当前映射移除的旧连接。</param>
    /// <param name="playerId">这次绑定的玩家，只写入日志。</param>
    async Task RetireAsync(ClientSession oldSession, long playerId)
    {
        Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 已失去当前身份。KickNtf 与关闭等待预算 {_kickBudget.TotalMilliseconds.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} 毫秒。超时或失败不保证通知送达，仍会关闭旧连接。");
        using var budget = new CancellationTokenSource(_kickBudget);
        try
        {
            await oldSession.SendAsync(CreateKickPacket(), budget.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 已写入 KickNtf（KickElsewhere，seq=0）。写入完成不代表对端已经处理。");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 的 KickNtf 未能确认送达（{ex.GetType().Name}）。不保证对方收到，仍关闭旧连接。");
        }

        try
        {
            await oldSession.CloseAsync("顶号", budget.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log($"玩家 {playerId} 的旧会话 {oldSession.SessionId} 在预算内没有完成关闭（{ex.GetType().Name}）。关闭已经发起，玩家队列不再等待。");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 仅当该玩家的当前映射仍是这条会话时，同时删除玩家索引和会话索引。
    /// 已经换成其他会话时不改任何映射。必须在该玩家的队列动作里调用。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">登出上下文里的玩家。必须是正数。</param>
    /// <param name="sessionId">要解除的服务端会话编号。只删除仍指向它的映射。</param>
    public void UnbindIfCurrent(long playerId, long sessionId)
    {
        if (playerId <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(playerId), "玩家编号必须为正数");
        if (!PlayerQueue.IsCurrentPlayer(playerId))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("只能在该玩家的队列内按身份解绑");

        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (!_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current) || current.SessionId != sessionId)
                return;
            if (!_bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long mapped) || mapped != playerId)
                return;

            _byPlayer.Remove(playerId);
            _bySession.Remove(sessionId);
            _retiring.Add(sessionId);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>调用方必须已经持有字典锁。只删除仍然指向这个会话编号的索引。</summary>
    /// <param name="sessionId">完成或被拒绝的服务端会话编号。</param>
    void UnmapIfMatch(long sessionId)
    {
        if (!_bySession.TryGetValue(sessionId, out long playerId))
            return;

        _bySession.Remove(sessionId);
        if (_byPlayer.TryGetValue(playerId, out ClientSession? current) && current.SessionId == sessionId)
            _byPlayer.Remove(playerId);
    }

    /// <summary>组装正式踢线。原因使用生成枚举的顶号值，序号固定为 0。</summary>
    static Packet CreateKickPacket()
    {
        var notification = new KickNtf { Reason = KickReason.KickElsewhere };
        return new Packet(MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(KickNtf)), 0, notification.ToByteArray());
    }

    /// <summary>观察后台任务，避免未观察异常。</summary>
    /// <param name="task">会话观察任务。</param>
    static void Observe(Task task)
    {
        if (task.IsCompleted)
        {
            _ = task.Exception;
            return;
        }

        _ = task.ContinueWith(
            static finished => _ = finished.Exception,
            CancellationToken.None,
            TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted | TaskContinuationOptions.ExecuteSynchronously,
            TaskScheduler.Default);
    }

    /// <summary>写诊断。回调异常不影响关闭。</summary>
    /// <param name="message">已经写好的说明，不含令牌或密码。</param>
    void Log(string message)
    {
        try
        {
            _log("[SessionRegistry] " + message);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Players;

/// <summary>
/// 按玩家串行执行异步动作。同一玩家严格按入队顺序执行；不同玩家各有执行器，可以并发。
/// 空闲玩家会从字典移除，避免一直留下历史玩家对象。
/// 不包含玩家存档、缓存或业务状态。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PlayerQueue : IDisposable
{
    /// <summary>未另行指定时，每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限。此上限包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
    public const int DefaultCapacity = 32;

    /// <summary>当前异步流正在执行的玩家。只由执行器在调用动作前写入，动作结束后恢复。</summary>
    static readonly AsyncLocal<ExecutionScope?> CurrentScope = new();

    /// <summary>动作及其派生异步流共用的生命周期；动作结束时统一失效。</summary>
    sealed class ExecutionScope
    {
        public readonly long PlayerId;
        public int Active = 1;

        /// <param name="playerId">本次动作所属玩家。</param>
        public ExecutionScope(long playerId) { PlayerId = playerId; }
    }

    readonly object _gate = new();
    readonly Dictionary<long, Lane> _lanes = new();
    bool _disposed;

    /// <summary>使用默认上限创建队列。</summary>
    public PlayerQueue()
        : this(DefaultCapacity)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>创建队列。</summary>
    /// <param name="capacity">每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限，必须是正数。包含正在执行的一项；达到上限时新的入队被拒绝。</param>
    public PlayerQueue(int capacity)
    {
        if (capacity <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(capacity), "每名玩家的队列上限必须是正数");
        Capacity = capacity;
    }

    /// <summary>每名玩家尚未结束的动作上限，包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
    public int Capacity { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 全部玩家尚未结束的动作总数。包含正在执行的一项和仍在等待的项，与 <see cref="Capacity"/> 同一口径。
    /// 不是玩家缓存人数。
    /// </summary>
    public int QueueLength
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                int total = 0;
                foreach (Lane lane in _lanes.Values)
                    total += lane.Accepted;
                return total;
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>当前异步流是否正在执行这名玩家的队列动作。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要核对的玩家。与执行器写入的玩家不同，或根本不在动作里时返回 false。</param>
    public static bool IsCurrentPlayer(long playerId)
    {
        ExecutionScope? scope = CurrentScope.Value;
        return scope != null && scope.PlayerId == playerId && Volatile.Read(ref scope.Active) != 0;
    }

    /// <summary>当前异步流是否正处在任意玩家的队列动作里。动作结束后为 false。</summary>
    public static bool IsInPlayerAction
    {
        get
        {
            ExecutionScope? scope = CurrentScope.Value;
            return scope != null && Volatile.Read(ref scope.Active) != 0;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>当前仍占着执行器的玩家数量。空闲玩家会被移除，供测试观察回收。</summary>
    internal int ActiveLaneCount
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
                return _lanes.Count;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>等待指定玩家的当前执行器退出。玩家已经不在字典中时立即完成。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">要观察的玩家。</param>
    internal Task WaitForIdleAsync(long playerId)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (!_lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out Lane? lane))
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            return lane.Idle.Task;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>把动作排到指定玩家的队尾。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家键。同一键共享一个执行器，不同键可以同时执行。</param>
    /// <param name="action">到达队首且尚未取消时才调用。参数是该次动作的取消标记；返回的 Task 结束前不会开始同玩家的下一项。</param>
    /// <param name="ct">调用方取消标记。入队前已取消则不入队；排到队首时已取消则不调用动作；执行中取消只通知动作，仍要等它返回。</param>
    /// <returns>该次动作的完成任务。动作异常或取消只体现在这个任务上。</returns>
    public Task EnqueueAsync(long playerId, Func<CancellationToken, Task> action, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (action == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(action));

        Lane lane;
        bool startExecutor;
        Task queued;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(PlayerQueue));
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                return Task.FromCanceled(ct);

            if (!_lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out lane!))
            {
                lane = new Lane();
                _lanes.Add(playerId, lane);
            }

            if (lane.Accepted >= Capacity)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"玩家 {playerId} 的队列已满，上限为 {Capacity}，该上限包含正在执行的一项");
            }

            var item = new WorkItem(action, ct);
            lane.Waiting.Enqueue(item);
            lane.Accepted++;
            startExecutor = !lane.ExecutorRunning;
            if (startExecutor)
            {
                lane.ExecutorRunning = true;
                if (lane.Idle.Task.IsCompleted)
                    lane.Idle = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            }

            queued = item.Completion.Task;
        }

        // 锁外启动。锁内已经把 ExecutorRunning 设为真，后到的入队不会再创建执行器。
        if (startExecutor)
            Schedule(playerId, lane);
        return queued;
    }

    /// <summary>拒绝新的入队，取消尚未开始的动作，并立刻返回。正在执行的动作继续被等待，直到它自己结束。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        List<WorkItem> dropped = new();
        List<WorkItem> running = new();
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                return;
            _disposed = true;
            foreach (Lane lane in _lanes.Values)
            {
                if (lane.Current != null)
                    running.Add(lane.Current);
                dropped.AddRange(lane.DrainWaiting());
            }
        }

        // Cancel 会同步调用外部注册的回调，必须离开全局锁；一个回调抛异常不能中断其他玩家清理。
        foreach (WorkItem item in running)
        {
            try { item.Linked.Cancel(); }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException) { /* 动作已经正常结束并释放了标记。 */ }
            catch (AggregateException) { /* 回调错误不能阻止队列关闭及待处理任务完成。 */ }
        }
        CompleteDropped(dropped);
    }

    /// <summary>在锁外启动唯一执行器，并观察它的任务，避免未观察异常。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">这个执行器负责的玩家。</param>
    /// <param name="lane">锁内刚刚登记的那一条队列。</param>
    void Schedule(long playerId, Lane lane)
    {
        // 入队只负责提交；同步执行到首个 await 的业务代码也不能阻塞提交者。
        Task worker = Task.Run(() => RunLaneAsync(playerId, lane));
        _ = ObserveAsync(worker);
    }

    /// <summary>吞掉执行器循环自身的异常。动作异常已经写到对应调用者的任务上。</summary>
    /// <param name="worker">执行器任务。</param>
    static async Task ObserveAsync(Task worker)
    {
        try
        {
            await worker.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // 循环内部负责把动作异常交给对应任务。这里只避免后台任务无人观察。
        }
    }

    /// <summary>按入队顺序执行这一名玩家的动作。队列排空时在同一把锁里摘掉执行器并移除玩家。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">玩家键。</param>
    /// <param name="lane">只由这个执行器推进的队列。</param>
    async Task RunLaneAsync(long playerId, Lane lane)
    {
        while (true)
        {
            WorkItem? item;
            List<WorkItem> dropped;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_disposed || lane.Waiting.Count == 0)
                {
                    dropped = lane.DrainWaiting();
                    lane.Current = null;
                    lane.ExecutorRunning = false;
                    if (lane.Waiting.Count == 0
                        && lane.Accepted == 0
                        && _lanes.TryGetValue(playerId, out Lane? mapped)
                        && ReferenceEquals(mapped, lane))
                    {
                        _lanes.Remove(playerId);
                    }

                    lane.Idle.TrySetResult();
                    item = null;
                }
                else
                {
                    item = lane.Waiting.Dequeue();
                    lane.Current = item;
                    dropped = new List<WorkItem>();
                }
            }

            CompleteDropped(dropped);
            if (item == null)
                return;

            await ExecuteAsync(playerId, lane, item).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>执行一项，或在它已经取消时跳过。无论成功、失败还是取消，都要等本次 Task 结束后才返回。</summary>
    /// <param name="playerId">这一项所属的玩家。只在动作执行期间写进异步流。</param>
    /// <param name="lane">该项所属的玩家队列，用于清除“正在执行”标记。</param>
    /// <param name="item">已经从等待队列取出的动作。</param>
    async Task ExecuteAsync(long playerId, Lane lane, WorkItem item)
    {
        Exception? error = null;
        bool canceled = false;
        try
        {
            if (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                canceled = true;
            }
            else
            {
                ExecutionScope? previous = CurrentScope.Value;
                var scope = new ExecutionScope(playerId);
                CurrentScope.Value = scope;
                try
                {
                    Task? work = item.Action(item.Token);
                    if (work == null)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("玩家队列动作返回了空 Task");
                    await work.ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    canceled = true;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    error = ex;
                }
                finally
                {
                    Volatile.Write(ref scope.Active, 0);
                    CurrentScope.Value = previous;
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(lane.Current, item))
                    lane.Current = null;
                lane.Accepted--;
            }
        }

        CancellationToken token = item.Token;
        if (canceled)
            item.Completion.TrySetCanceled(token);
        else if (error != null)
            item.Completion.TrySetException(error);
        else
            item.Completion.TrySetResult();
        item.Linked.Dispose();
    }

    /// <summary>把尚未开始的动作完成成取消，不调用其委托。</summary>
    /// <param name="dropped">从等待队列取出的动作。</param>
    static void CompleteDropped(List<WorkItem> dropped)
    {
        foreach (WorkItem item in dropped)
        {
            if (!item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                try
                {
                    item.Linked.Cancel();
                }
                catch (ObjectDisposedException)
                {
                    // 取消标记已经释放时，下面仍尝试结束调用者的任务。
                }
            }

            if (item.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
                item.Completion.TrySetCanceled(item.Token);
            else
                item.Completion.TrySetCanceled();
            try
            {
                item.Linked.Dispose();
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
                // 重复释放可以忽略。
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一名玩家的等待队列和唯一执行器标记。</summary>
    sealed class Lane
    {
        /// <summary>尚未开始的动作，顺序与成功入队的顺序一致。</summary>
        public Queue<WorkItem> Waiting { get; } = new();

        /// <summary>已接单且尚未结束的数量，包含正在执行的一项。</summary>
        public int Accepted;

        /// <summary>为真时已经有一个执行器会把本队列排空，新的入队不能再启动执行器。</summary>
        public bool ExecutorRunning;

        /// <summary>已经取出、正在等待其 Task 的动作。没有正在执行的动作时为空。</summary>
        public WorkItem? Current;

        /// <summary>执行器退出时完成。续体异步执行，避免在锁内重入。再次启动执行器时若已完成则换新。</summary>
        public TaskCompletionSource Idle = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        /// <summary>取出全部尚未开始的动作，并按取出数量减少已接单计数。</summary>
        public List<WorkItem> DrainWaiting()
        {
            var dropped = new List<WorkItem>(Waiting.Count);
            while (Waiting.Count > 0)
            {
                dropped.Add(Waiting.Dequeue());
                Accepted--;
            }

            return dropped;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一次入队。完成任务只代表这一次动作，不代表整条玩家队列。</summary>
    sealed class WorkItem
    {
        /// <summary>创建一次入队。</summary>
        /// <param name="action">队首才会调用的动作。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">调用方取消标记，与内部标记连接。</param>
        public WorkItem(Func<CancellationToken, Task> action, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            Action = action;
            Linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
            Completion = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        }

        /// <summary>业务动作。</summary>
        public Func<CancellationToken, Task> Action { get; }

        /// <summary>调用方取消或队列关闭时会取消的标记源。</summary>
        public CancellationTokenSource Linked { get; }

        /// <summary>传给动作的取消标记。</summary>
        public CancellationToken Token => Linked.Token;

        /// <summary>交还给 EnqueueAsync 调用者的完成源。</summary>
        public TaskCompletionSource Completion { get; }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using Google.Protobuf;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using CloudIsle.Net;
using CloudIsle.Proto;
using CloudIsle.Server.Diagnostics;
using CloudIsle.Server.Network;
using Serilog;
using Serilog.Core;
using Serilog.Events;

namespace CloudIsle.Tests;

/// <summary>服务端 Serilog、脱敏和真实路由上的请求关联字段。</summary>
[NonParallelizable]
public sealed class DiagnosticsTests
{
    const string BodySecret = "body-secret-xyz";
    const string UpperSecret = "UpperSecret";
    const string ColonSecret = "ColonSecret";
    const string SpacedSecret = "spacedSecret";
    const string JsonSecret = "jsonSecret";
    const string AlphaSecret = "AlphaSecret";
    const string BetaSecret = "BetaSecret";
    const string ContextSecret = "ctx-secret";
    const string PasswordSecret = "pw-secret";
    const string TokenSecret = "tk-secret";
    const string ExceptionSecret = "ex-secret";
    const string ExceptionToken = "ex-token";

    /// <summary>两个 sink 都留下关联字段，低于最低级别的事件不出现。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task Request_WritesCorrelationToConsoleAndFile_AndHonorsMinimumLevel()
    {
        using var holder = new LogHolder();
        using var logging = holder.Open("Information");
        var router = NewRouter();
        ushort msgId = MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(HeartbeatReq));
        router.Register<HeartbeatReq>(msgId, (context, request, token) =>
        {
            logging.Logger.Debug("debug-marker");
            logging.Logger.Information("info-marker");
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        });
        var decorator = new RequestLogDecorator(router, logging);

        await decorator.DispatchAsync(
            new RequestContext(5, 42, msgId, 7),
            PacketOf(new HeartbeatReq { ClientTime = 1 }, msgId, 7),
            88,
            CancellationToken.None);

        string text = holder.ReadBoth();
        Assert.That(text, Does.Contain("info-marker"));
        Assert.That(text, Does.Not.Contain("debug-marker"));
        Assert.That(holder.ConsoleText, Does.Contain("info-marker"));
        Assert.That(holder.FileText, Does.Contain("info-marker"));
        AssertRequest(holder.ConsoleText, "ok", 42, msgId, 7, 88);
        AssertRequest(holder.FileText, "ok", 42, msgId, 7, 88);
        Assert.That(RequestAmbient.HasCurrent, Is.False);
        Assert.That(router.RequestCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>属性、赋值文本和异常消息在两个 sink 里都不再含有原秘密。</summary>
    [Test]
    public void Secrets_AreRedactedInStructuredPropertiesTemplatesAndExceptions()
    {
        using var holder = new LogHolder();
        using var logging = holder.Open("Verbose");
        logging.Logger.Information("keys {PASSWORD} {token}", AlphaSecret, BetaSecret);
        logging.Logger.Information(
            "PASSWORD={Upper} token:{Colon} password = {Spaced}",
            UpperSecret,
            ColonSecret,
            SpacedSecret);
        logging.Logger.Information("literal password=" + UpperSecret + " token:" + ColonSecret);
        logging.Logger.Information("json \"password\":\"" + JsonSecret + "\" \"token\":\"" + JsonSecret + "\"");
        logging.Logger.ForContext("Token", ContextSecret).Information("context-only");
        logging.Logger.Information("carrier {@Carrier}", new SecretCarrier
        {
            Password = PasswordSecret,
            Token = TokenSecret,
            Name = "visible-name"
        });
        logging.Logger.Error(
            new InvalidOperationException("boom password=" + ExceptionSecret + " token:" + ExceptionToken, new IOException("token:" + ExceptionToken)),
            "broken");

        string console = holder.ConsoleText;
        string file = holder.FileText;
        foreach (string text in new[] { console, file })
        {
            Assert.That(text, Does.Contain("visible-name"));
            Assert.That(text, Does.Contain("***"));
            Assert.That(text, Does.Contain("InvalidOperationException"));
            Assert.That(text, Does.Contain("IOException"));
            Assert.That(text, Does.Not.Contain("StackTrace"));
            Assert.That(text, Does.Not.Contain(".cs:line"));
            AssertNoSecrets(text);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>非法配置会失败，改正后仍可配置。Dispose 刷出文件，滚动不超过保留份数。</summary>
    [Test]
    public void InvalidConfig_FailsClearly_ThenRollsFlushesAndReleasesTheFile()
    {
        using var holder = new LogHolder();
        var logging = new LoggingSetup();
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => logging.Configure(" ", "Information"));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => logging.Configure(holder.Directory, "nope"));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => logging.Configure(holder.Directory, "Information", 127, 2));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => logging.Configure(holder.Directory, "Information", LoggingSetup.MaxFileSizeLimitBytes + 1, 2));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => logging.Configure(holder.Directory, "Information", 256, 0));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => logging.Configure(holder.Directory, "Information", 256, LoggingSetup.MaxRetainedFileCount + 1));
        string blocked = Path.Combine(holder.Directory, "blocked");
        File.WriteAllText(blocked, "x");
        Assert.Throws<IOException>(() => logging.Configure(blocked, "Information"));

        logging.Configure(holder.Directory, "Warning", 512, 2);
        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => logging.Configure(holder.Directory, "Information"));
        logging.Logger.Information("info-hidden");
        logging.Logger.Warning("warn-visible");
        logging.Dispose();

        string flushed = holder.FileText;
        Assert.That(flushed, Does.Contain("warn-visible"));
        Assert.That(flushed, Does.Not.Contain("info-hidden"));
        using (var exclusive = new FileStream(Path.Combine(holder.Directory, "server.log"), FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.None))
            Assert.That(exclusive.Length, Is.GreaterThan(0));

        using var rolling = new LoggingSetup();
        rolling.Configure(holder.Directory, "Information", 512, 2);
        rolling.Logger.Information("OLD-MARKER " + new string('o', 300));
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++)
            rolling.Logger.Information("NEW-MARKER " + i.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " " + new string('n', 300));
        rolling.Dispose();

        string[] files = Directory.GetFiles(holder.Directory, "server*.log");
        Assert.That(files.Length, Is.LessThanOrEqualTo(2));
        string rolled = holder.FileText;
        Assert.That(rolled, Does.Contain("NEW-MARKER"));
        Assert.That(rolled, Does.Not.Contain("OLD-MARKER"));
        Assert.That(rolled, Does.Not.Contain("warn-visible"));
    }

    /// <summary>失败请求仍有关联字段。两个并发请求不会串上下文，结束后环境为空。</summary>
    [Test]
    public async Task FailureAndConcurrentRequests_KeepIsolatedCorrelation()
    {
        using var holder = new LogHolder();
        using var logging = holder.Open("Information");
        var router = NewRouter();
        ushort msgId = MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(HeartbeatReq));
        var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var both = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        int entered = 0;
        router.Register<HeartbeatReq>(msgId, (context, request, token) =>
        {
            logging.Logger.Information("handler-touch");
            if (Interlocked.Increment(ref entered) == 2)
                both.TrySetResult();
            return release.Task;
        });
        var decorator = new RequestLogDecorator(router, logging);
        Task first = decorator.DispatchAsync(new RequestContext(1, 101, msgId, 1001), PacketOf(new HeartbeatReq(), msgId, 1001), 501, CancellationToken.None);
        Task second = decorator.DispatchAsync(new RequestContext(2, 202, msgId, 2002), PacketOf(new HeartbeatReq(), msgId, 2002), 602, CancellationToken.None);
        await both.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

        AssertIsolated(holder.ConsoleText);
        release.TrySetResult();
        await Task.WhenAll(first, second);

        var failing = NewRouter();
        failing.Register<HeartbeatReq>(msgId, (context, request, token) =>
            throw new InvalidOperationException("password=" + ExceptionSecret + " token:" + ExceptionToken));
        var failingLog = new RequestLogDecorator(failing, logging);
        Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => failingLog.DispatchAsync(
            new RequestContext(3, 303, msgId, 3003),
            PacketOf(new HeartbeatReq(), msgId, 3003),
            703,
            CancellationToken.None));

        ushort registerId = MsgRegistry.GetId(typeof(RegisterReq));
        var bodyRouter = NewRouter();
        bodyRouter.Register<RegisterReq>(registerId, (context, request, token) => Task.CompletedTask);
        await new RequestLogDecorator(bodyRouter, logging).DispatchAsync(
            new RequestContext(4, 0, registerId, 4),
            PacketOf(new RegisterReq { Username = "u", Password = BodySecret, Nickname = "n" }, registerId, 4),
            0,
            CancellationToken.None);

        logging.Logger.Information("outside-marker");
        Assert.That(RequestAmbient.HasCurrent, Is.False);
        string text = holder.ReadBoth();
        AssertIsolated(text);
        AssertRequest(text, "fail", 303, msgId, 3003, 703);
        Assert.That(text, Does.Contain("InvalidOperationException"));
        Assert.That(text, Does.Not.Contain(ExceptionSecret));
        Assert.That(text, Does.Not.Contain(ExceptionToken));
        Assert.That(text, Does.Not.Contain(BodySecret));
        Assert.That(text, Does.Not.Contain(".cs:line"));
        string outside = LineContaining(text, "outside-marker");
        Assert.That(outside, Does.Not.Contain("PlayerId"));
        Assert.That(outside, Does.Not.Contain(" 101 "));
        Assert.That(outside, Does.Not.Contain(" 202 "));
        Assert.That(failing.RequestCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
    }

    /// <summary>脱敏发生在接收器之前，接收器失败会回到调用方。静态 Log 与本实例互不影响。</summary>
    [Test]
    public void AuditFailure_Propagates_AndStaticLogIsIndependent()
    {
        var seen = new CapturingSink();
        using (Logger audit = LoggingSetup.CreateAuditLogger("Information", seen))
        {
            Exception? error = null;
            try
            {
                audit.Error(
                    new InvalidOperationException("password=" + ExceptionSecret),
                    "probe {Token}",
                    ContextSecret);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                error = ex;
            }

            Assert.That(error, Is.Not.Null);
            Assert.That(error!.ToString(), Does.Contain("sink-failed"));
        }

        Assert.That(seen.Rendered, Does.Not.Contain(ContextSecret));
        Assert.That(seen.Rendered, Does.Not.Contain(ExceptionSecret));
        Assert.That(seen.Rendered, Does.Contain("***"));
        Assert.That(seen.Rendered, Does.Contain("InvalidOperationException"));
        Assert.That(seen.HadExceptionObject, Is.False);

        using var holder = new LogHolder();
        var collected = new List<string>();
        using var probe = new LoggerConfiguration().WriteTo.Sink(new ListSink(collected)).CreateLogger();
        ILogger previous = Log.Logger;
        Log.Logger = probe;
        try
        {
            using var logging = holder.Open("Information");
            Assert.That(Log.Logger, Is.SameAs(probe));
            logging.Logger.Information("from-setup");
            Log.Information("from-static");
        }
        finally
        {
            Log.Logger = previous;
        }

        string files = holder.FileText;
        Assert.That(files, Does.Contain("from-setup"));
        Assert.That(files, Does.Not.Contain("from-static"));
        Assert.That(string.Join("\n", collected), Does.Contain("from-static"));
        Assert.That(string.Join("\n", collected), Does.Not.Contain("from-setup"));
    }

    /// <summary>新建一个不写追踪的路由。</summary>
    static MessageRouter NewRouter()
    {
        return new MessageRouter(
            (context, packet, token) => Task.CompletedTask,
            (context, reason, token) => Task.CompletedTask);
    }

    /// <summary>封一帧。测试只把正文交给路由，装饰器本身不记录它。</summary>
    /// <param name="message">请求消息。</param>
    /// <param name="msgId">消息 ID。</param>
    /// <param name="seq">序号。</param>
        static Packet PacketOf(IMessage message, ushort msgId, uint seq)
    {
        return new Packet(msgId, seq, message.ToByteArray());
    }

    /// <summary>结果行里能解析出这次的五个关联值，并且耗时不是负数。</summary>
    static void AssertRequest(string text, string outcome, long playerId, int msgId, uint seq, long opId)
    {
        var match = Regex.Match(
            text,
            "request " + outcome + " " + playerId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            + " " + msgId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            + " " + seq.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            + " " + opId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            + " (?<elapsed>-?[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)");
        Assert.That(match.Success, Is.True, text);
        double elapsed = double.Parse(match.Groups["elapsed"].Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        Assert.That(elapsed, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0));
    }

    /// <summary>同一行里不能同时出现两个请求的序号。</summary>
    /// <param name="text">控制台或文件文本。</param>
    static void AssertIsolated(string text)
    {
        foreach (string line in text.Split('\n'))
        {
            if (!line.Contains("handler-touch", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                && !line.Contains(" 101 ", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                && !line.Contains(" 202 ", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                continue;
            bool first = line.Contains("101", StringComparison.Ordinal) && line.Contains("1001", StringComparison.Ordinal) && line.Contains("501", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            bool second = line.Contains("202", StringComparison.Ordinal) && line.Contains("2002", StringComparison.Ordinal) && line.Contains("602", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            Assert.That(first ^ second, Is.True, line);
            if (line.Contains("request ok ", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                var elapsed = Regex.Match(line, "request ok \\d+ \\d+ \\d+ \\d+ (?<elapsed>[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)");
                Assert.That(elapsed.Success, Is.True, line);
                Assert.That(double.Parse(elapsed.Groups["elapsed"].Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Is.GreaterThan(0));
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>这些已知秘密都不能留下。</summary>
    /// <param name="text">一个 sink 的文本。</param>
    static void AssertNoSecrets(string text)
    {
        foreach (string secret in new[]
        {
            UpperSecret, ColonSecret, SpacedSecret, JsonSecret, AlphaSecret, BetaSecret,
            ContextSecret, PasswordSecret, TokenSecret, ExceptionSecret, ExceptionToken
        })
            Assert.That(text, Does.Not.Contain(secret));
    }

    /// <summary>找出包含标记的那一行。</summary>
    /// <param name="text">完整输出。</param>
    /// <param name="marker">行内标记。</param>
    static string LineContaining(string text, string marker)
    {
        foreach (string line in text.Split('\n'))
        {
            if (line.Contains(marker, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                return line;
        }

        Assert.Fail("缺少 " + marker);
        return "";
    }

    /// <summary>带 Password 和 Token 的解构对象。</summary>
    sealed class SecretCarrier
    {
        /// <summary>应被整值替换的口令。</summary>
        public string Password { get; set; } = "";

        /// <summary>应被整值替换的令牌。</summary>
        public string Token { get; set; } = "";

        /// <summary>普通字段，应原样保留。</summary>
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    }

    /// <summary>先记下已脱敏事件，再抛出 IO 异常。</summary>
    sealed class CapturingSink : ILogEventSink
    {
        /// <summary>渲染后的文本。</summary>
        public string Rendered { get; private set; } = "";

        /// <summary>交给这个接收器的事件是否还带着异常对象。</summary>
        public bool HadExceptionObject { get; private set; }

        /// <summary>记录事件后失败。</summary>
        /// <param name="logEvent">已经过脱敏的事件。</param>
        public void Emit(LogEvent logEvent)
        {
            HadExceptionObject = logEvent.Exception != null;
            var builder = new StringBuilder();
            builder.Append(logEvent.RenderMessage(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            foreach (var pair in logEvent.Properties)
                builder.Append(' ').Append(pair.Key).Append('=').Append(pair.Value);
            Rendered = builder.ToString();
            throw new IOException("sink-failed");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>把静态 logger 的消息收进列表。</summary>
    sealed class ListSink : ILogEventSink
    {
        readonly List<string> _lines;

        /// <summary>收进调用方的列表。</summary>
        /// <param name="lines">输出目标。</param>
        public ListSink(List<string> lines) => _lines = lines;

        /// <summary>保存渲染后的消息。</summary>
        /// <param name="logEvent">静态 logger 的事件。</param>
        public void Emit(LogEvent logEvent) => _lines.Add(logEvent.RenderMessage(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
    }

    /// <summary>临时目录和可恢复的控制台。</summary>
    sealed class LogHolder : IDisposable
    {
        readonly TextWriter _previousOut;
        readonly StringWriter _console = new StringWriter();
        LoggingSetup? _logging;

        /// <summary>创建临时目录并接走控制台。</summary>
        public LogHolder()
        {
            string path = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "CloudIsle.T40." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            Directory = System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory(path).FullName;
            _previousOut = Console.Out;
            Console.SetOut(_console);
        }

        /// <summary>这次测试的日志目录。</summary>
        public string Directory { get; }

        /// <summary>目前捕获到的控制台文本。</summary>
        public string ConsoleText => _console.ToString();

        /// <summary>目录里全部日志文件的文本。</summary>
        public string FileText
        {
            get
            {
                var builder = new StringBuilder();
                if (!System.IO.Directory.Exists(Directory))
                    return "";
                foreach (string file in System.IO.Directory.GetFiles(Directory))
                {
                    using var stream = new FileStream(file, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite);
                    using var reader = new StreamReader(stream, Encoding.UTF8);
                    builder.AppendLine(reader.ReadToEnd());
                }

                return builder.ToString();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>按 Information 打开日志。</summary>
        /// <param name="level">最低级别。</param>
        public LoggingSetup Open(string level)
        {
            _logging = new LoggingSetup();
            _logging.Configure(Directory, level);
            return _logging;
        }

        /// <summary>先刷出文件，再合并两个 sink 的文本。</summary>
        public string ReadBoth()
        {
            _logging?.Dispose();
            _logging = null;
            return ConsoleText + "\n" + FileText;
        }

        /// <summary>恢复控制台并删除临时目录。</summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            _logging?.Dispose();
            Console.SetOut(_previousOut);
            string full = Path.GetFullPath(Directory);
            string temp = Path.GetFullPath(Path.GetTempPath());
            if (full.StartsWith(temp, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && full.Contains("CloudIsle.T40.", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                System.IO.Directory.Delete(full, true);
        }
```
```csharp
    }
}

    /// <summary>组装一个只把数字交给测试的报告器。</summary>
    static MetricsReporter Reporter(
        IMetricsSchedule schedule,
        Action<string> write,
        Func<int> connections,
        Func<int> players,
        Func<long> requests,
        Func<int> queueLength)
    {
        return new MetricsReporter(connections, players, requests, queueLength, () => 2048, write, schedule);
    }

    /// <summary>等到行数达到预期。只用于同步信号之后的短等待。</summary>
    /// <param name="lines">已经写出的行。</param>
    /// <param name="count">需要的行数。</param>
    static async Task WaitForLinesAsync(List<string> lines, int count)
    {
        var timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);
        var started = DateTime.UtcNow;
        while (lines.Count < count)
        {
            if (DateTime.UtcNow - started > timeout)
                Assert.Fail("指标没有写出");
            await Task.Yield();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>等到条件成立。</summary>
    /// <param name="condition">为真时返回。</param>
    static async Task WaitUntilAsync(Func<bool> condition)
    {
        var started = DateTime.UtcNow;
        while (!condition())
        {
            if (DateTime.UtcNow - started > TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5))
                Assert.Fail("条件没有成立");
            await Task.Delay(10);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>测试可控的等待。完成或取消都由测试决定。</summary>
    sealed class ScriptedSchedule : IMetricsSchedule
    {
        readonly object _gate = new();
        readonly Queue<TaskCompletionSource> _waits = new();
        TaskCompletionSource<TaskCompletionSource>? _notify;

        /// <summary>报告器读到的经过时间。</summary>
        public TimeSpan Elapsed { get; set; }

        /// <summary>已经请求过的等待时长。</summary>
        public List<TimeSpan> Delays { get; } = new();

        /// <summary>记录这一拍并停住，直到测试完成或取消。</summary>
        /// <param name="interval">报告器传入的间隔。</param>
        /// <param name="ct">取消这一拍。</param>
        public Task DelayAsync(TimeSpan interval, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var wait = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            TaskCompletionSource<TaskCompletionSource>? notify = null;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                Delays.Add(interval);
                if (_notify != null)
                {
                    notify = _notify;
                    _notify = null;
                }
                else
                {
                    _waits.Enqueue(wait);
                }
            }

            if (ct.CanBeCanceled)
                ct.Register(() => wait.TrySetCanceled(ct));
            notify?.TrySetResult(wait);
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                wait.TrySetCanceled(ct);
            return wait.Task;
        }

        /// <summary>等到下一拍已经进入等待。</summary>
        public Task<TaskCompletionSource> NextAsync()
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_waits.Count > 0)
                    return Task.FromResult(_waits.Dequeue());
                _notify = new TaskCompletionSource<TaskCompletionSource>(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
                return _notify.Task;
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>端口 0 的临时监听。</summary>
    sealed class ListeningGate : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        readonly CancellationTokenSource _cts = new();
        readonly Task _run;

        /// <summary>启动监听。</summary>
        /// <param name="onPacket">收到完整帧时调用。</param>
        public ListeningGate(Func<ClientSession, Packet, CancellationToken, Task> onPacket)
        {
            Server = new TcpServer(onPacket, 8);
            _run = Server.RunAsync(new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Loopback, 0), _cts.Token);
        }

        /// <summary>被测监听器。</summary>
        public TcpServer Server { get; }

        /// <summary>系统分配的端口。</summary>
        public int Port
        {
            get
            {
                Server.Started.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
                return Server.LocalEndpoint!.Port;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>停止监听并等待结束。</summary>
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            _cts.Cancel();
            await _run.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            _cts.Dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

**发生场景与症状**：调用 `Information("short password={ShortValue}", "q")`，控制台正文变成 `password=***`，但同一行的结构化属性仍是 `{ShortValue="q"}`。短密码并没有真正从输出中消失。

**原因**：初版按渲染前后字符串子串判断应遮住哪些属性，且只处理长度至少 4 的字符串。短字符串和数字不进入判断，正文脱敏后属性仍留下原值；仅检查长测试秘密不能覆盖这条路径。

**修复**：对渲染后才形成的敏感赋值进行第二遍脱敏；一旦发现，保守遮住该事件全部被模板引用的属性，输出脱敏后的消息文本。这样不依赖值长度或子串猜测，也覆盖数字/分段模板；未被模板引用的关联属性保留。代价是同一条含敏感模板赋值的事件，其其他模板属性也可能被遮住。正常请求关联日志不含这些赋值，不受此分支影响。

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Serilog.Core;
using Serilog.Events;
using Serilog.Parsing;

namespace CloudIsle.Server.Diagnostics;

/// <summary>
/// 在事件进入控制台或文件之前改写它。password / token 属性、常见赋值文本和异常消息都会脱敏。
/// 不写出 Exception.ToString()。不识别属性名和这两种文本以外的秘密。
/// </summary>
sealed class RedactingSink : ILogEventSink, IDisposable
{
    static readonly Regex Assignment = new Regex(
        "(?i)\\b(password|token)\\b(\\s*[:=]\\s*)(?:\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'|\\S+)",
        RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    static readonly Regex JsonPair = new Regex(
        "(?i)\"(password|token)\"(\\s*:\\s*)\"(?:[^\"\\\\]|\\\\.)*\"",
        RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    readonly ILogEventSink _inner;

    /// <summary>包住真正的接收器。本对象 Dispose 时会释放它。</summary>
    /// <param name="inner">已经脱敏之后才调用的接收器。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public RedactingSink(ILogEventSink inner)
    {
        _inner = inner ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(inner));
    }

    /// <summary>脱敏后交给内层。内层抛出的异常原样冒泡，不在这里吞掉。</summary>
    /// <param name="logEvent">Serilog 原始事件。为空时抛出异常。</param>
    public void Emit(LogEvent logEvent)
    {
        if (logEvent == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logEvent));

        _inner.Emit(Sanitize(logEvent));
    }

    /// <summary>释放内层接收器，让文件 sink 刷出并关闭。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        (_inner as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
    }

    /// <summary>复制一份去掉原始异常、并改写过属性和模板文本的事件。</summary>
    /// <param name="logEvent">原始事件。</param>
    LogEvent Sanitize(LogEvent logEvent)
    {
        var properties = new List<LogEventProperty>(logEvent.Properties.Count + 2);
        foreach (var pair in logEvent.Properties)
            properties.Add(new LogEventProperty(pair.Key, RedactValue(pair.Value, pair.Key, 0)));

        if (logEvent.Exception != null)
        {
            AddIfMissing(properties, "ExceptionType", new ScalarValue(Classify(logEvent.Exception)));
            AddIfMissing(properties, "ExceptionMessage", new ScalarValue(RedactText(Describe(logEvent.Exception))));
        }

        var tokens = new List<MessageTemplateToken>();
        foreach (var token in logEvent.MessageTemplate.Tokens)
        {
            if (token is TextToken text)
                tokens.Add(new TextToken(RedactText(text.Text)));
            else
                tokens.Add(token);
        }

        var candidate = new LogEvent(
            logEvent.Timestamp,
            logEvent.Level,
            exception: null,
            messageTemplate: new MessageTemplate(tokens),
            properties: properties);
        return ScrubRenderedSecrets(candidate);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 对渲染后才形成的 password= 或 token: 赋值做第二遍脱敏。
    /// 若模板把任意属性当作秘密值，保守遮住本事件所有被模板引用的属性；
    /// 消息保留脱敏后的可读文本。这样短值、数字或分段拼接不会残留在结构化属性中，
    /// 不依赖值长度或子串猜测。未被模板引用的关联属性仍保留。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="candidate">已按键名脱敏、且已去掉原始异常对象的事件。</param>
    static LogEvent ScrubRenderedSecrets(LogEvent candidate)
    {
        string rendered = candidate.RenderMessage(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string redacted = RedactText(rendered);
        if (rendered == redacted)
            return candidate;

        var referenced = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (MessageTemplateToken token in candidate.MessageTemplate.Tokens)
        {
            if (token is PropertyToken property)
                referenced.Add(property.PropertyName);
        }

        var properties = new List<LogEventProperty>(candidate.Properties.Count);
        foreach (var pair in candidate.Properties)
        {
            properties.Add(new LogEventProperty(pair.Key,
                referenced.Contains(pair.Key) ? new ScalarValue("***") : pair.Value));
        }

        return new LogEvent(
            candidate.Timestamp,
            candidate.Level,
            exception: null,
            messageTemplate: new MessageTemplate(new[] { new TextToken(redacted) }),
            properties: properties);
    }

    /// <summary>按名字和嵌套值脱敏。秘密键整值替换，不再往下展开。</summary>
    /// <param name="value">当前值。</param>
    /// <param name="name">属性名或结构成员名。没有名字时为空。</param>
    /// <param name="depth">当前嵌套层。过深时不再展开。</param>
    static LogEventPropertyValue RedactValue(LogEventPropertyValue value, string? name, int depth)
    {
        if (IsSecretKey(name))
            return new ScalarValue("***");
        if (depth >= 16)
            return new ScalarValue("***");

        switch (value)
        {
            case ScalarValue scalar when scalar.Value is string text:
                return new ScalarValue(RedactText(text));
            case StructureValue structure:
                var members = new List<LogEventProperty>(structure.Properties.Count);
                foreach (var member in structure.Properties)
                    members.Add(new LogEventProperty(member.Name, RedactValue(member.Value, member.Name, depth + 1)));
                return new StructureValue(members, structure.TypeTag);
            case SequenceValue sequence:
                var items = new List<LogEventPropertyValue>(sequence.Elements.Count);
                foreach (var item in sequence.Elements)
                    items.Add(RedactValue(item, null, depth + 1));
                return new SequenceValue(items);
            case DictionaryValue dictionary:
                var entries = new List<KeyValuePair<ScalarValue, LogEventPropertyValue>>(dictionary.Elements.Count);
                foreach (var entry in dictionary.Elements)
                {
                    string? key = entry.Key.Value as string;
                    var redactedKey = entry.Key.Value is string keyText
                        ? new ScalarValue(RedactText(keyText))
                        : entry.Key;
                    entries.Add(new KeyValuePair<ScalarValue, LogEventPropertyValue>(
                        redactedKey,
                        RedactValue(entry.Value, key, depth + 1)));
                }
                return new DictionaryValue(entries);
            default:
                return value;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>只把名为 password 或 token 的键视为秘密。比较忽略大小写，也认最后一个点或下划线后的名字。</summary>
    /// <param name="name">属性名。为空时不是秘密键。</param>
    static bool IsSecretKey(string? name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
            return false;

        int split = name.LastIndexOfAny(new[] { '.', '_' });
        string leaf = split >= 0 ? name[(split + 1)..] : name;
        return leaf.Equals("password", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || leaf.Equals("token", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    /// <summary>替换 password=、token: 以及这两种键的 JSON 字符串。认不出的文本保持原样。</summary>
    /// <param name="text">可能含有秘密的文本。为空时原样返回。</param>
    public static string RedactText(string? text)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
            return text ?? "";

        string json = JsonPair.Replace(text, "\"$1\"$2\"***\"");
        return Assignment.Replace(json, "$1$2***");
    }

    /// <summary>异常类型全名。不包含消息和堆栈。</summary>
    /// <param name="exception">要分类的异常。</param>
    static string Classify(Exception exception)
    {
        var names = new List<string>();
        var seen = new HashSet<Exception>();
        for (Exception? current = exception; current != null && seen.Add(current); current = current.InnerException)
            names.Add(current.GetType().FullName ?? current.GetType().Name);
        return string.Join(" <- ", names);
    }

    /// <summary>只拼接异常消息。不调用 ToString，因此没有堆栈。</summary>
    /// <param name="exception">要描述的异常。</param>
    static string Describe(Exception exception)
    {
        var messages = new List<string>();
        var seen = new HashSet<Exception>();
        for (Exception? current = exception; current != null && seen.Add(current); current = current.InnerException)
            messages.Add(current.Message ?? "");
        return string.Join(" <- ", messages);
    }

    /// <summary>已经有同名属性时不覆盖。</summary>
    /// <param name="properties">正在组装的属性。</param>
    /// <param name="name">属性名。</param>
    /// <param name="value">属性值。</param>
    static void AddIfMissing(List<LogEventProperty> properties, string name, LogEventPropertyValue value)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < properties.Count; i++)
        {
            if (properties[i].Name == name)
                return;
        }

        properties.Add(new LogEventProperty(name, value));
    }
}

/// <summary>把同一份已脱敏事件交给控制台和文件。任一接收器抛错都会再抛出，另一路仍会尝试写完。</summary>
sealed class FanoutSink : ILogEventSink, IDisposable
{
    readonly ILogEventSink _console;
    readonly ILogEventSink _file;

    /// <summary>记下两个真正的 Serilog 接收器。</summary>
    /// <param name="console">控制台接收器。</param>
    /// <param name="file">滚动文件接收器。</param>
    public FanoutSink(ILogEventSink console, ILogEventSink file)
    {
        _console = console ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(console));
        _file = file ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(file));
    }

    /// <summary>两边都写。先记下的异常在两边都尝试之后抛出。</summary>
    /// <param name="logEvent">已经脱敏的事件。</param>
    public void Emit(LogEvent logEvent)
    {
        Exception? error = null;
        try
        {
            _console.Emit(logEvent);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error = ex;
        }

        try
        {
            _file.Emit(logEvent);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error ??= ex;
        }

        if (error != null)
            throw error;
    }

    /// <summary>关闭两个接收器。关闭文件接收器时会刷出缓冲。</summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        Exception? error = null;
        try
        {
            (_console as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error = ex;
        }

        try
        {
            (_file as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error ??= ex;
        }

        if (error != null)
            throw error;
    }
}
```
